chapters.title: Chapter 201: Face Matters Less Than Substance
paragraphs: Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh inwardly. As expected of an entertainment area for the direct descendants of the Five Great Giants, this level of venue was similar to the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle he participated in when he was still a Divine Being, and the rental fee must be quite substantial.
Just as Yang Fan was observing his surroundings, a familiar voice suddenly came over.
“Brother Yang!” Sima Bang walked over with a big smile on his Face. “When are we gathering at Yuexiang Pavilion again?”
Before Yang Fan could reply, Gu Le playfully teased first, “Did you come over wanting to spar with my husband?”
Hearing this, Sima Bang instantly shook his head frantically, his big head swaying like a rattle-drum.
“No, no! I just came over to say hi!”
“If I spar with Brother Yang, wouldn’t that be purely asking to be abused?”
Gu Le, however, wore a look of disdain. “How clueless. We got married, and you didn’t even know to give a cash gift? Aren’t you going to use this opportunity to show something?”
Sima Bang was instantly left between laughter and tears, even somewhat regretting taking the initiative to come over and say hello.
This Cousin Gu Le was indeed just like the rumors said, plucking a goose as it flies by.
Among the Five Great Families, what customs of wedding gifts were there? This was clearly extorting him under the guise of an opportunity.
However, right at this moment, a tall figure slowly walked over from not far away.
The other person had a robust build, standing a full half-head taller than those around him. Every step he took seemed to carry a heavy sense of oppression.
Most crucially, this person didn’t conceal his aura at all. That violent and scorching might was like a humanoid Vicious Beast, causing many people around him to subconsciously clear a path.
The originally relaxed atmosphere at the scene faintly quieted down by a few degrees.

Sima Bang also noticed the newcomer, his expression instantly turning somewhat ugly. Then, lowering his voice, he said, “Brother Yang, this person is called Ma Huainan. He’s the Sima Family’s foreign-surname SS-rank Genius I mentioned to you before. His talent is the Martial God Body.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s gaze flickered slightly, and he asked with some confusion, “So... is he here for you?”
Yang Fan had some impression of this name, and even remembered that when Sima Bang first mentioned “Ma Huainan”, his expression was obviously somewhat unnatural.
“Looking for me?” Sima Bang pointed at himself, his Face full of bafflement.
“What would he look for me for?”
“Don’t you have a conflict with him?” Yang Fan asked.
“Of course I do.” Sima Bang curled his lips. “Both he and I walk the Martial Arts Route.”
“His talent is better than mine, but my background is stronger, so there has always been a divergence within the Family on the issue of resource skewing.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan said as a matter of course, “So, is he here to spar with you now?”
“How is that possible!” Sima Bang shook his head on the spot. “He’s a Peerless Prodigy, after all.”
“If he spars with me, wouldn’t he lose Face? Furthermore, I can just refuse directly, and when the time comes, the one who loses Face will still be him.”
As he spoke, the smile on Sima Bang’s Face suddenly stiffened, as if he suddenly realized something.
Then, he abruptly looked at Yang Fan. “Damn it! Brother Yang, I’m afraid this guy is coming for you!”

He hurriedly lowered his voice to remind him, “Bet a little less later. Ma Huainan’s ranking on the Primordial Battlefield is already approaching two hundred thousand. You haven’t accepted the Gu Family’s investment for long, so losing to him isn’t shameful.”
Sure enough, Ma Huainan didn’t look at Sima Bang from beginning to end, but instead walked straight up to Yang Fan.
“Ma Huainan, Divine Kingdom Talent Martial God Body — SS-rank.”
The other person’s voice was deep, and those eyes stared fixedly at Yang Fan, the Battle Intent within them hardly concealed at all.
Looking at this scene before him, Yang Fan had only one thought in his heart — trouble.
He really had no interest in this so-called gambling duel.
At this moment, many gazes had already gathered around. Although there were quite a few people attending this gathering, not many were rated as a “Peerless Prodigy”.
Furthermore, the two of them were of similar age; a clash like this was much more interesting than other people’s spars.
Yang Fan sighed softly. “Greetings, Brother Ma.”
“I want to have a match with you.” Ma Huainan was straightforward. “Any method is fine.”
However, before Yang Fan could speak,
a lazy voice suddenly came from the side. “You have accepted the Sima Family’s investment for two years already; you should go challenge stronger people.”
Sima Tianci walked over slowly holding a wine glass, still wearing that lazy smile on his Face, but the meaning in his words was already very obvious.
In the process of a Divine Kingdom’s development, talent was important, time was important, and Resources were even more important.
Unlike Yang Fan, when Ma Huainan had just awakened his Divine Kingdom in his third year of high school, he was detected to have an SS-rank “Martial God Body”.
Immediately afterward, he obtained the Sima Family’s strategic investment.
High-specification building Resources, massive monthly Divinity Points subsidies, and various exclusive cultivation plans.
The resource skewing he enjoyed far exceeded ordinary Geniuses.
Right now, although Yang Fan and the other were both Peerless Prodigies, in the eyes of outsiders, the starting gap between the two sides was simply too large.
For Ma Huainan to proactively propose a gambling duel now somewhat carried the implication of bullying someone.

Hearing Sima Tianci’s words, Ma Huainan smiled instead. “Big Brother Tianci has misunderstood. I’m just a bit curious. After all, Brother Yang Fan has received such high-spec investment from the Gu Family. Presumably, he must have extraordinary traits.”
“Besides, this place is inherently a place for entertainment gambling duels; everyone is just looking for some fun. As for the amount of the bet, Brother Yang Fan can decide it himself.”
He always wore a smile when speaking, but deep within his eyes, a trace of craftiness faintly leaked out.
Ma Huainan was very clear that taking the initiative to challenge Yang Fan would make many people feel he was losing his status, which was why he specially added such a speech.
He believed that not just himself, but many people present were curious about Yang Fan’s strength.
To be exact, what they were truly curious about wasn’t Yang Fan’s identity as the first place winner of the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.
In the eyes of these Peerless Prodigies, the so-called “first place in the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle” meant jack squat.
What they truly minded was the investment specification the Gu Family gave to Yang Fan.
That portion of resource skewing even exceeded the vast majority of foreign-surname Peerless Prodigies.
Everyone was SS-rank, so why was your treatment so much higher?
Naturally, there would be people who were unconvinced.
And now that Ma Huainan had spoken to this extent, if Yang Fan refused, he would become a coward in other people’s eyes.
Anyway, the one losing Face wouldn’t be him; he was merely having a “friendly spar”.
As for the bet, if Yang Fan brought out too little, it would only make him look petty.
After all, how many Resources the Gu Family gave him was something almost everyone present knew in their hearts.
As a dignified Peerless Prodigy, he surely couldn’t act like an ordinary Human Race Prodigy and pull out a Spiritual Vein to gamble, right?
Thinking of this, a trace of faint excitement even surfaced deep within Ma Huainan’s eyes.
The bigger the bet, the happier he was.
Because he simply couldn’t think of a reason why he would lose.
“Let’s chat later, I still have things I haven’t finished asking for advice on.” Sima Bang let out a soft snort.
Then, he very naturally handed the smart watch on his wrist in front of Yang Fan.
Yang Fan lowered his head to scan it, only to see a line of text abruptly emerge on the screen.
[Don’t look at how rough Ma Huainan looks; in reality, this kid is wicked through and through.]
[Brother Yang, make sure not to fall into the trap. Keep the bet small.]
[Face is less important than substance.]
“Brother Yang, take a look at how this building is? Those believers in my Divine Kingdom can eat like crazy!” Sima Bang’s mouth didn’t stop, as if he were truly discussing Divine Kingdom buildings.
At the same time, he had already smoothly switched to the virtual Divine Shop interface, completely without revealing even a shred of abnormality.

chapters.title: Chapter 202: War God Codex
paragraphs: Seeing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help letting out a light cough, then looked up at Ma Huainan, “In that case, let’s keep it a light wager for fun. Just one S-Rank Building it is.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the entire Virtual World seemed to fall silent for a brief moment.
An S-Rank Building?
A light wager for fun???
At this moment, many people doubted whether they had heard wrong.
Sima Tianci couldn’t help speaking up, “This is not a casino, don’t play for stakes this big.”
His tone at this moment was obviously much more serious.
Since Yang Fan was a friend of Sima Bang, he naturally wanted to look out for him a bit.

Ma Huainan was an SS-Grade Genius who had received the full investment of the Sima Family since the beginning of the Divine Kingdom Awakening. In everyone’s eyes, Yang Fan had no chance of winning this gambling duel at all.
Any S-Rank Building was the most core strategic resource of a divine kingdom.
That wasn’t something that could be bought simply by having Divinity Points; it also required a massive amount of military merit.
Sima Tianci truly couldn’t understand why Yang Fan would propose such a huge stake.
How is this any different from serving oneself up on a platter?
Could it be that the Gu Family gave him too many resources, making him arrogant?
At this time, Sima Bang was so anxious that his face turned red. If not for saving Yang Fan’s face, he would have wanted to pull Yang Fan aside into a corner right now to earnestly advise him.
“Brother Yang, are you sure? Do you really want to use an S-Rank Building as the stake?” Ma Huainan took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the excitement in his heart.
“Of course.” Yang Fan nodded, his tone very calm, “Otherwise it wouldn’t be very interesting.”
In reality, Yang Fan was not lacking in Divinity Points right now; what he truly lacked was the purchase quota for S-Rank Buildings.
Since he was gambling, it naturally was better to gamble big.

Ma Huainan rubbed his forehead, deliberately putting on a troubled look, “Brother Yang is truly bold, but... in my divine kingdom, there is currently only one S-Rank Building. This makes things a bit difficult to handle.”
“What do you mean?” Yang Fan raised his eyebrows slightly.

“To not hide it from Brother Yang, this S-Rank Building is the core resource that the Sima Family invested in me back then. It belongs to the Wonder type, named the War God Codex. Brother Yang can check the information first.”
As the four words “War God Codex” escaped his lips, the smile on Sima Tianci’s face instantly vanished.
The next moment, that aura belonging to a god was no longer suppressed in the slightest, crashing down heavily onto Ma Huainan.
The terrifying mental pressure directly caused Ma Huainan’s body to sink abruptly, and the surrounding air seemed to freeze somewhat.
“Ma Huainan, some things have gone too far.” Sima Tianci warned coldly.
Cold sweat faintly appeared on Ma Huainan’s forehead, yet he still gritted his teeth and said, “Big Brother Tianci, I am only telling the truth. I truly do not have a second S-Rank Building.”
“And I did not force Brother Yang to agree; this stake is indeed far too big. To be honest, even I feel a bit guilty myself.”
At the same time, Yang Fan had already checked the specific information of the “War God Codex” through the Virtual World.
[War God Codex, S-Rank Building, Price: 100 billion Divinity Points (Out of Stock)]

[A special building evolved from a Heaven-Grade Secret Realm, inscribed with hundreds of millions of Martial Arts true meanings internally. It can continuously strengthen believers’ Physiques through methods such as spiritual projection, physical resonance, and Battle Intent baptism.]

[Core Effect One: Martial Arts Resonance. After believers enter the range of the War God Codex, their Cultivation speed can be greatly increased. Being within it for a long time, physical strength, blood-qi quality, and bone toughness will all receive continuous enhancement.]

[Core Effect Two: Extreme Body Tempering. The War God Codex will simulate high-intensity combat pressure, and by continuously stimulating the potential of the Physical Body, it greatly increases believers’ feeding efficiency, Medicinal Pill absorption efficiency, and precious medicine refining efficiency.]

[Core Effect Three: Martial Arts Deduction. It can assist Martial Arts-type believers in comprehending Cultivation Techniques and improve the Cultivation efficiency of battle skills, boxing techniques, and weapon-type Martial Arts. Some Genius believers can even deduce Cultivation Techniques by themselves within it.]

[Core Effect Four: Battle Intent Condensation. Believers who receive baptism from the War God Codex for a long time will gradually condense fearless Battle Intent, making them less prone to negative emotions such as fear, breakdown, and fleeing on the battlefield, which can significantly enhance the overall combat strength of legion-level wars.]

[Core Effect Five: Martial God Blessing. When believers achieve a Breakthrough in their Realm, there is an extremely low probability of triggering resonance with the War God Codex, gaining an additional Physical Body transformation, or even giving birth to a special Physique. (Extremely low probability)]
[Evaluation: The most core strategic resource of the Martial Route, its value is incalculable.]
After seeing the specific information of the War God Codex, even Yang Fan couldn’t help trembling slightly in his heart.
Today, his divine kingdom ran on three lines in parallel.

The Cultivation Route was the core, and the Mechanical Path came from behind to surpass it under the condition of sufficient Divinity Points. Only the development speed of the Martial Route was much slower.
And the War God Codex before his eyes was simply as if it had been tailor-made specifically for him.
“Such a generous move, do you think you’ve got me in the bag?” Yang Fan slowly raised his head, a trace of coldness flashing faintly in his gaze toward Ma Huainan.

But very quickly, a smile appeared on his face once again, “Brother Ma is quite willing to part with it. I can pull out 100 billion Divinity Points. It’s just that this kind of strategic-level resource has always had a price but no market. If we truly discuss its value, it’s hard to evaluate.”
Hearing these words, Ma Huainan’s heart instantly rejoiced, “Simple, a Spirit Vein Planet will suffice.”
“Since Brother Yang took so much investment from the Gu Family, I suppose it shouldn’t be difficult.”
The speed of his speech was a bit faster, clearly afraid that Yang Fan would go back on his word.
“Very well.” Yang Fan nodded, his tone still calm.
“How refreshing!” Ma Huainan’s eyes lit up, “However, since the stake is so big, it’s better for us to sign an agreement.”
“That is only natural.”
Under the watchful eyes of everyone, Ma Huainan used Intelligent Life to draft the gambling duel agreement, and then signed his name without any hesitation.
Yang Fan likewise did not hesitate, directly signing and confirming it.
“Brother Yang, since the stakes have reached this point, we might as well adopt the method of the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle. This is the fairest way.” Ma Huainan continued to speak.
Just like the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, gods personally entering the arena to fight could not fully reflect the strength of both sides.
What could truly determine the strength of a god was, after all, the divine kingdom.
Only a complete Divine Kingdom War could truly reflect a god’s foundation.
And now the stake was so huge that even Ma Huainan himself felt his heart thumping with anxiety; he absolutely did not allow any accidents to happen.
“Of course.” Yang Fan nodded indifferently.
“Then let’s follow the conventional gambling duel rules, with the number of believers limited to one hundred million. Special wartime resources are not allowed to be used.”
“Does Brother Yang have any objections?” Ma Huainan added once more.
He had to seal off all variables as much as possible, because this gambling duel had now reached a point where even he couldn’t afford to lose.
“No problem.” Yang Fan still nodded.
Hearing this, Ma Huainan finally let out a secret sigh of relief.
Then he raised his right hand, making an inviting gesture toward Yang Fan.
The next moment, under everyone’s gaze, the two of them flew up into the air simultaneously, arriving directly above the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battlefield.
At the same time, inside both of their divine kingdoms, troops began to be mobilized and deployed.

Just like the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, gods personally entering the arena to fight could not fully reflect the strength of both sides.
What could truly determine the strength of a god was, after all, the divine kingdom.
Only a complete Divine Kingdom War could truly reflect a god’s foundation.
And now the stake was so huge that even Ma Huainan himself felt his heart thumping with anxiety; he absolutely did not allow any accidents to happen.
“Of course.” Yang Fan nodded indifferently.
“Then let’s follow the conventional gambling duel rules, with the number of believers limited to one hundred million.
Special wartime resources are not allowed to be used.”
“Does Brother Yang have any objections?” Ma Huainan added once more.
He had to seal off all variables as much as possible, because this gambling duel had now reached a point where even he couldn’t afford to lose.
“No problem.” Yang Fan still nodded.
Hearing this, Ma Huainan finally let out a secret sigh of relief.
Then he raised his right hand, making an inviting gesture toward Yang Fan.
The next moment, under everyone’s gaze, the two of them flew up into the air simultaneously, arriving directly above the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battlefield.
At the same time, inside both of their divine kingdoms, troops began to be mobilized and deployed.

chapters.title: Chapter 203: This Is Love!
paragraphs: “F*ck! Ma Huainan is so shady! We need to stay away from this guy in the future.”
“This is the first time I’ve seen such a huge wager.”
“Whoever loses will probably hold a grudge for a lifetime.”
“Awesome, I’ve already started a livestream and sent it to my Family group chat. A normal gathering can actually turn into such a blockbuster drama; my mom loves watching this kind of gossip.”
The discussions below rose and fell, and everyone was thoroughly excited.
A wager battle of this level was extremely rare even among the younger generation of the Five Great Giants.
At this moment, Sima Bang looked up at Yang Fan in the sky, his face turning somewhat red with anxiety.

“Sister-in-law Gu Le! Why didn’t you stop him just now? That scoundrel Ma Huainan clearly didn’t harbor any good intentions. That’s a Spirit Vein Planet! How much development of the Divine Kingdom would that delay?”
Compared to Sima Bang’s anxiety, Gu Le appeared exceptionally calm.
She just quietly gazed at Yang Fan in the sky, her gaze faintly carrying a bit of curiosity, scrutiny, and doubt.
“Cousin,” Gu Jiuheng on the side suddenly said with a smile, “You seem to have a lot of confidence in your brother-in-law?”
Hearing this, Gu Le gently shook her head. “Not that confident. The time he has accepted the Gu Family’s investment is too short, his odds of winning aren’t high.”
“Oh?” Gu Jiuheng raised his eyebrows slightly. “In that case, why didn’t you stop it?”
Gu Le was silent for a moment, then said, “Husband and wife are husband and wife, the Divine Kingdom is the Divine Kingdom.”

“Divine Kingdom assets have always belonged solely to the individual. If he can’t even see through calculations of this level... that can only prove... I misjudged the person, and the Gu Family has also made a failed investment.”
Her voice carried an extremely rational calmness, as if Yang Fan were not her partner.

Speaking of this, Gu Le paused for a moment and looked at Gu Jiuheng with some curiosity. “Cousin, didn’t you not stop it either just now? He is now a person of my Gu Family, and you’re just watching the Sima Family take advantage like this?”
Hearing this, Gu Jiuheng merely shrugged, and then a meaningful smile slowly curled up the corner of his mouth.
“I didn’t stop it... because I feel he can win.”
At this moment, on the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle battlefield, Ma Huainan had already summoned his army of believers.

Five thousand Martial Master Realm powerhouses stood at the very front, and the remaining believers all reached the Martial Apprentice stage, with a total population of one hundred million, forming a military formation with an Aura soaring into the sky.
Ma Huainan looked at Yang Fan with a face full of confidence, seemingly wanting to see regret and panic in the other party’s eyes.
Having only received the Gu Family’s investment for a month, to what extent could the Divine Kingdom possibly develop?
Resources were always the primary factor in the development of a Divine Kingdom.
No matter how strong an S-rank Talent was, it ultimately needed time to grow. In his view, Yang Fan could only suppress those Human Race Prodigies, how could he possibly be his match?
Furthermore, he had absolute confidence in his own strength.

Aside from the Realm of the believers themselves, due to the blessing of his own Divine Kingdom Talent, all participating believers under his command possessed the powerful Physique of the “Martial God Body”, with combat power far exceeding the same tier. Ordinary Martial Apprentices were simply vulnerable before them.
He was confident that even if Yang Fan truly scraped together one hundred million Qi Refining Realm believers, it would be absolutely impossible to be his match.
Before proposing this wager battle, he had already investigated Yang Fan’s battle record.
Right now, Yang Fan’s ranking on the Primordial Battlefield was only around nine hundred thousand.
And he had already charged into the top two hundred thousand!
In his view, there was simply no possibility of losing this match.

“The returns of a Spirit Vein Planet! Originally I just wanted to take the opportunity to show my face and gain additional investment from the Sima Family, I didn’t expect there would be such an unexpected harvest!”
Ma Huainan was incomparably excited inside. With an extra Spirit Vein Planet, the monthly income would be one billion Divinity Points.
For a Divine Kingdom to develop, resources would never be enough!
“Brother Yang, please.” Ma Huainan smiled at the corners of his mouth, raising his hand to signal.
Seeing this, Yang Fan’s expression was calm as he gently snapped his fingers.
The next moment, the Divine Kingdom space shook violently, and a large number of believers materialized out of the Divine Kingdom.

Fifty thousand Foundation Establishment Cultivators! Ten thousand Martial Master powerhouses! Five thousand Second-class Intelligent Life! The remaining Qi Refining, Martial Apprentices, and First-class Intelligent Life appeared in batches on the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle battlefield like a tide.
In just a short moment, the mighty army covered the entire world.
And this military formation was obviously not arranged casually.
It was a top-tier military formation carefully constructed by Yang Da specifically according to the current Divine Kingdom combat power system.
Martial Arts believers were responsible for frontal defense, stabilizing the battle lines.
Cultivation believers focused on offense and slaughter, responsible for ranged bombardment and battlefield harvesting.
As for Intelligent Life, they roamed between the entire military formation, assuming responsibilities such as adjusting the battlefield, replenishing firepower, and supporting vulnerable areas.
The three Divine Kingdom development systems cooperated with each other, unleashing greater combat power.
In addition, under the continuous input of massive funds, the number of Smart Weapons in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had long surpassed one hundred million.
All believers participating in the battle now, apart from weapons like sabers, spears, swords, and halberds, were equipped with complete Smart Weapons on their bodies.
The warfare capability of the entire legion could long no longer be measured by simple Realms.
To cope with this simulation battle, Yang Da even urgently called back Yang Five, who was fighting on The Frontline, to personally serve as the general commander of this major battle.
Boom!!!
An Aura of extreme terror suddenly swept across the entire Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle battlefield.
The sky shook and the earth roared.
Those countless streams of vital blood, spiritual power, and Mechanical fluctuations intertwined together, forcefully suppressing the Aura of Ma Huainan’s side that originally soared into the sky!
Quite a few of the opponent’s believers even instinctively took half a step back, a look of terror appearing in their eyes.
The smile on Ma Huainan’s face also completely froze at this moment.
The spectators below saw this scene, and everyone was dumbfounded, their jaws almost dropping to the ground.
“Am I not seeing things? Isn’t he only a sophomore? How can there be so many Foundation Establishment and Martial Master believers!”

“More than that! There is actually Second-class Intelligent Life inside! Holy sh*t, no wonder the Gu Family is willing to give such a huge investment. Even among Peerless Prodigies, this guy is a monster-level figure!”
“The Divine Kingdom walks the three routes of Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical simultaneously, and every single one of them is outrageously strong!”
“The Gu Family has really struck gold this time!”
Gu Le gazed at Yang Fan on the battlefield, her eyes gradually brightening.
Back at the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, although Yang Fan’s performance was stunning, he was ultimately only at the level of a Human Race Prodigy.
Although Yang Fan was evaluated as a Peerless Prodigy, to what step his Divine Kingdom had actually developed, no one knew.
When she didn’t stop this wager battle just now, she also harbored a bit of probing intent.
Between her and Yang Fan, it was inherently a combination of interests.
She possessed identity and resources, while Yang Fan possessed talent and future. Essentially, both parties were a cooperation of placing bets in advance.
Truly smart people never let emotionality override rationality.
Appreciation could exist, and affection could also exist, but before truly seeing value, any investment must remain clear-headed.
Because emotions would lie, but interests would not.
But at this moment, when Yang Fan truly displayed his Divine Kingdom foundation, Gu Le suddenly discovered that she seemed to have really struck gold.
Gu Le looked at Yang Fan floating in the sky, her gaze brimming with deep affection.
At this moment, she confirmed in her heart: ‘This is love! This is the romance she dreamed of!’

chapters.title: Chapter 204: Brutal Battle
paragraphs: Everyone’s definition of love is different.

Some fall in love at first sight, willing to pour out the rest of their lives just for a fleeting glance; some support each other while spending days and nights together, developing affection over the accumulation of years; and some accompany each other in the lows, and after going through storms together, can no longer leave each other.
Yet Gu Le’s love was even more realistic.
She admired the strong; she would only truly appreciate those standing at the Peak who possessed the ability to change the times.
This was not shameful. The weak looking up to the strong was inherently an instinct of life.
And an existence like Yang Fan was worth chasing after.
On the other side, Sima Bang was already so excited his face turned flush red, wishing he could immediately stand up and cheer for Yang Fan.
You must know that within the Sima Family, he and Ma Huainan were still competitors.
Now seeing the other party being suppressed, he felt so thrilled that his scalp tingled.
Only thinking that he was ultimately still a member of the Sima Family, he could only forcefully suppress this impulse.
“Brother Yang is awesome, this is so fucking satisfying!” Sima Bang laughed loudly in his heart.
High above, Ma Huainan’s gaze locked onto Yang Fan tightly.
Even he himself hadn’t noticed that his back was already completely soaked in cold sweat at this moment.
Facing Yang Fan’s terrifyingly extreme lineup, unease welled up in his heart for the first time.
At this moment, he no longer had his previous composure and secret joy.
Even though his believers possessed the Martial God Body, he still didn’t have absolute certainty of winning this battle.
The War God Codex was something he couldn’t afford to lose!
Without the blessing of this core building, the overall development speed of his Divine Kingdom would drop by at least thirty to forty percent.
“Brother Yang... You really hide deep.” Ma Huainan said in a low voice with an ugly expression.
“Likewise.” Yang Fan sneered, “Facing such a supreme treasure as the War God Codex, I naturally must go all out.”

The other party already harbored hostility towards him. Facing a supreme treasure like the War God Codex, even if it meant forging a deadly feud with a Peerless Prodigy, Yang Fan could not give it up.
“Do you really think you’ve got me in the bag?” Ma Huainan let out a cold hum, his gaze gradually turning icy.
“Being both SS-rank Talents, do you know why combat-type talents are more favored by various major families? Today, I will let you know the power of the Martial God Body!”
As his voice fell, Ma Huainan’s consciousness instantly connected to the wartime Intelligent Life within the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battlefield.
The next moment, the armies of both sides moved simultaneously.
Countless Flying Swords, spiritual lights, Qi, and artillery fire rose into the air simultaneously, and the entire battlefield instantly plunged into chaos.

In Yang Fan’s camp, a large number of Foundation Establishment Cultivators formed hand seals simultaneously. Rain of fire, thunder, and ice spears filled the sky, crashing down like natural disasters.
Yet the next second, a shocking scene appeared.
Seeing one of the Martial Apprentice Realm believers under Ma Huainan charge out against the flames forcefully, his whole body’s Qi soared into the sky like smoke from a beacon tower.
Boom!
That Spell, which was originally enough to severely injure Foundation Establishment Cultivators, was forcibly scattered by that violent Qi!
Meanwhile, hundreds of Flying Swords pierced downwards.
Puchi!

A Martial Apprentice’s chest was directly pierced by a Flying Sword, yet as if unable to feel any pain, he actually reached out with both hands to grab the Flying Sword tightly, his muscles writhing frantically.

Blood continuously flowed down the blade’s edge. The next moment, that Martial Apprentice roared angrily, and relying on his Physical Body strength, he forcibly pulled the Flying Sword out of his body!
Then he fiercely crushed it!
This scene made countless people’s scalps tingle.
“This is the Martial God Body?”
“Isn’t this too abnormal!”
The expressions of the geniuses watching from the outside world all changed.
“A Martial Apprentice Realm resisting Foundation Establishment Spells head-on? This Physical Body is already comparable to a Martial Master!”
“No wonder combat-type SS-rank Talents are valued so much.”
“They really are two monsters...”
On the battlefield, the first wave of tentative clashes ended, and Yang Fan’s army didn’t take the slightest advantage.
Seeing this scene, even a trace of surprise flashed through the depths of Yang Fan’s eyes.
As expected of a Genius who could be evaluated as a Peerless Prodigy.
In this battle, Yang Fan likewise felt pressure.
His Divine Kingdom had already experienced quite a few Divine Kingdom Wars, but those Alien Demigod believers simply didn’t have too many special methods.
Relying on military Formations and weapon advantages, they basically swept across all the way.
Yet right now, just in the first round of tentative clashes, his army was actually unable to suppress the opponent.
“Martial God Body...” Yang Fan’s gaze narrowed slightly.
Right at this moment, Yang Five made a move once again.
“Everyone, listen to my orders!”
“Ten Kings of Hell Formation, rise!”
Boom!!!
Accompanied by Yang Five’s command, the entire battlefield instantly changed.
A large number of Cultivation believers quickly retreated, while the Martial Arts legion began advancing forward under pressure.
Simultaneously, countless Intelligent Life shuttled back and forth at high speed across the battlefield, and streams of spiritual energy links began connecting the entire military Formation.
At this moment, the one hundred million believers under Yang Fan truly seemed to transform into a single entity.
“Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation!”
Hum——
Large areas of cyan light screens rose. Aside from the Formation’s own defense, first-class Smart Weapons simultaneously deployed defensive modes.
Shields and spiritual energy barriers activated simultaneously.
The opponent’s originally violently extreme Qi charge was actually blocked forcefully.
The next second, the Ten Kings of Hell Formation underwent changes.
The Smart Weapons worn by those believers locked onto targets simultaneously.
[Target locking complete]
[The weak area of the enemy Formation has been marked!]
Accompanied by Intelligent Life continuously analyzing the battlefield,
Yang Five’s command completely displayed its terrifying aspects.
“Left wing Martial Arts legion, advance!”
“Cultivation legion, retreat!”
“Spiritual energy cannons, cover the enemy’s right wing!”
“Smart Weapons, cut off the opponent’s Formation connection!”
One command after another was issued consecutively.
The entire battlefield actually began to be split up bit by bit by Yang Five.
A large number of Smart Weapons seemed to come alive, defending on one side while transforming into artillery batteries to attack on the other.
Cultivation believers took the opportunity to frantically bombard; thunder and fire filled the sky, continuously falling, and the entire battlefield was like the apocalypse.
Even so, those believers with the Martial God Body under Ma Huainan were still frighteningly formidable.
Even if their bodies were broken, even if half of their torsos were blasted to pieces, they could still continue fighting relying on their terrifying Qi.
Moreover, many believers in desperate straits had their Qi become even more violent instead, dragging Yang Fan’s believers down to perish together forcefully.

If not for the Martial Arts believers holding up under huge pressure in the front, the powerful defensive power of Smart Weapons, and the Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation at the Great Success stage,
Yang Fan wouldn’t dare to imagine how the course of this war would turn out!
This battle was brutal to the extreme.
Many geniuses watching from the outside were already completely dumbfounded.
“As expected of a Peerless Prodigy... Simply abnormal to the extreme.”
“I’m already a senior in college, but compared to them, I’m completely on a different level.”
“Truly absurd. I thought it would be a steamroll, but who would have expected it to be a fierce battle between dragons and tigers!”
“The Martial God Body is indeed terrifying, but unfortunately, the equipment and Formation comprehension of Ma Huainan’s believers are clearly inferior to Yang Fan’s.”
“The Mechanical Path is still powerful among Divine Kingdoms of the same level, it’s just a pity that it consumes too many Resources.”
“The War God Codex worth 100 billion Divinity Points! Gambling truly harms people! After today, Ma Huainan’s position in the Sima Family is probably in jeopardy.”
Many people with true discernment had already seen it by this moment: Ma Huainan was beginning to fall into a disadvantage.

Accompanied by Intelligent Life continuously analyzing the battlefield,
Yang Five’s command completely displayed its terrifying aspects.
“Left wing Martial Arts legion, advance!”
“Cultivation legion, retreat!”
“Spiritual energy cannons, cover the enemy’s right wing!”
“Smart Weapons, cut off the opponent’s Formation connection!”
One command after another was issued consecutively.
The entire battlefield actually began to be split up bit by bit by Yang Five.
A large number of Smart Weapons seemed to come alive, defending on one side while transforming into artillery batteries to attack on the other.
Cultivation believers took the opportunity to frantically bombard; thunder and fire filled the sky, continuously falling, and the entire battlefield was like the apocalypse.
Even so, those believers with the Martial God Body under Ma Huainan were still frighteningly formidable.
Even if their bodies were broken, even if half of their torsos were blasted to pieces, they could still continue fighting relying on their terrifying Qi.
Moreover, many believers in desperate straits had their Qi become even more violent instead, dragging Yang Fan’s believers down to perish together forcefully.

If not for the Martial Arts believers holding up under huge pressure in the front, the powerful defensive power of Smart Weapons, and the Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation at the Great Success stage,
Yang Fan wouldn’t dare to imagine how the course of this war would turn out!
This battle was brutal to the extreme.
Many geniuses watching from the outside were already completely dumbfounded.
“As expected of a Peerless Prodigy...
Simply abnormal to the extreme.”
“I’m already a senior in college, but compared to them, I’m completely on a different level.”
“Truly absurd.
I thought it would be a steamroll, but who would have expected it to be a fierce battle between dragons and tigers!”
“The Martial God Body is indeed terrifying, but unfortunately, the equipment and Formation comprehension of Ma Huainan’s believers are clearly inferior to Yang Fan’s.”
“The Mechanical Path is still powerful among Divine Kingdoms of the same level, it’s just a pity that it consumes too many Resources.”
“The War God Codex worth 100 billion Divinity Points!
Gambling truly harms people!
After today, Ma Huainan’s position in the Sima Family is probably in jeopardy.”
Many people with true discernment had already seen it by this moment: Ma Huainan was beginning to fall into a disadvantage.

chapters.title: Chapter 205: Sore Loser
paragraphs: Although the Martial God Body was astonishingly strong, as the battle continued, the advantages of Yang Fan’s warfare system gradually began to manifest.
Ma Huainan’s military formation was being nibbled away bit by bit.
On the other side, Sima Bang was even more flushed with excitement.
“Hahahaha!”
“Beat him to death!”
“Brother Yang is awesome!!”
But halfway through his shout, he suddenly realized there were still quite a few people from the Sima Family nearby, and could only hurriedly force it back in.
Yet the smile on his face simply could not be suppressed.

Time ticked away bit by bit, and the battlefield completely turned into a meat grinder; corpses piled up like mountains, a massive number of Smart Weapons were blown up, and the spiritual power of the Cultivation legions was nearly exhausted.
The losses of the Martial Arts legions at the very front of the military formation reached as high as ninety percent.

In this battle, even though the combat strength Yang Fan dispatched was already among the top-tier of the Divine Kingdom, he still ultimately paid the price of over fifty percent of his troops to forcefully and completely rout Ma Huainan’s large army!
Had this not merely been the consciousness projection of believers, Yang Fan’s heart would have ached to death.
Boom!!!
Along with Ma Huainan’s military formation being broken, the battlefield instantly turned into a one-sided massacre and finally quieted down completely.
“The Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle has ended; the winner is Yang Fan.”
Accompanied by the cold prompt tone of the Intelligent Life, the entire virtual space instantly boiled over!
“Won!!”
“Holy shit, that was too wonderful!”
“This is truly a battle of Peerless Prodigies!”
Countless prodigies wore excited expressions; the battle just now had made their blood boil.
Whether it was the nearly perverted Physical Body strength of the Martial God Body or the coordination of the believers under Yang Fan’s command, it opened everyone’s eyes.
Although Yang Fan was not the strongest among all the Peerless Prodigies in Taichu City, this battle made everyone realize just how terrifying his potential truly was.
Triple-line joint Cultivation!
Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical Civilization developed simultaneously; even without a combat-type SS-grade Divine Kingdom talent, it was still frighteningly strong.
At this moment, everyone couldn’t help but admire the vision of that veteran Senior from the Gu Family.
Such a monster was completely worthy of the Gu Family’s investment.
With the end of the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, Yang Fan and Ma Huainan slowly landed.
A large group of heaven’s chosen prodigies impatiently swarmed up.
“Brother Yang, the Smart Weapons in your Divine Kingdom are simply too fierce! Do you have any in stock? Price is not an issue!”
“If Brother Yang lacks Resources in the future, just speak up; my Lu Family also intends to invest in geniuses.”
“Hahaha, Brother Yang, I have an elder sister at home who is only eighty years old this year, and her beauty is simply breath-taking. How about I introduce her to you?”
“Get lost, your sister has already changed eight Dao Companions!”
“What do you understand? The strong should be matched with the best!”
Everyone spoke one after another, enthusiastic to the extreme, and even carrying a hint of deliberate flattery.
After all, anyone could see that with the potential Yang Fan was showing now, as long as he didn’t fall in the future, he would at least be a figure at the High-Order God level.
If they didn’t build connections now, they might not even have the qualification to get close in the future.
Not far away, Gu Le stood quietly there. After hearing the sentence about “introducing the elder sister,” her originally calm expression visibly darkened for a fraction of a second.
But in the end, she still didn’t speak, only silently watching Yang Fan, who was surrounded in the center like the moon among stars.
Regarding everyone’s goodwill, Yang Fan just wore a smile, nodding and responding politely.
Afterwards, his gaze slowly fell onto Ma Huainan.
The gambling match had already ended, and now, it was time for the other party to fulfill their promise.
“Brother Ma, my Divine Kingdom also takes the Martial Arts Route. Here, let me thank you in advance for your gift.” Yang Fan said with a fake smile.
Hearing these words, Ma Huainan’s entire body stiffened slightly, standing in place without making any expression.
Seeing this scene, the originally lively crowd gradually quieted down, and many people even revealed looks of gloating.
Looking at this appearance... this Peerless Prodigy seemed a bit unable to afford to lose.
But upon second thought, everyone felt it was entirely normal.
That was the War God Codex!
It was an S-grade core building with an official pricing as high as one hundred billion Divinity Points, and it had a market price without a supply market—there was simply no purchase channel.
If traded on the black market, let alone one hundred billion, even if multiplied by four or five times, one might not necessarily be able to buy it.

Ma Huainan originally thought this was a surefire gambling match, wanting to take the opportunity to swallow one of Yang Fan’s Spirit Vein Planets, but he didn’t expect that in the end, he would instead get pecked in the eyes by an eagle.
Once he lost the War God Codex.
His competitiveness among the Peerless Prodigies would probably hit rock bottom.
Just as the atmosphere was gradually turning subtle, Gu Jiuheng slowly walked out.
Boom!
The terrifying pressure belonging to a Tier 3 God suddenly descended upon Ma Huainan without holding back in the least.
“Since the gambling match is lost, hand over the item right on the spot. I certainly don’t want to personally go find the elders of the Sima Family to demand an explanation over this matter.”
“Within the Five Great Families of the Human Race, we still need to speak of a bit of integrity, don’t you think?” Gu Jiuheng looked coldly at the other party.

At this moment, Ma Huainan only felt that his Soul was frozen, and that terrifying Evil Qi stepping out from a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood pressed down on him so hard that he could barely breathe.
He instinctively looked towards Sima Tianci in the distance.
However, the other party acted as if he didn’t see it at all, just lazily yawning with an otherworldly look.
Seeing this scene, Ma Huainan’s last shred of hope was completely shattered.
Helpless, he could only take out a card and hand it toward Yang Fan.
Yet at this moment, his right hand was trembling.
This gambling fight was simply too painful, enough to affect the development of his Divine Kingdom for the next hundred years.
“Many thanks, Brother Ma.” Yang Fan smiled and took the card.
Ma Huainan lowered his head without a word, though deep within his lowered eyes, a trace of resentment quietly flashed.
As the gambling match ended, the space that had originally quieted down became lively once again.
Not just young geniuses, even the divine powerhouses from various families actively walked over.
“Hahaha, Brother Yang Fan? You are not bad, are you interested in coming to my Third Legion after graduation?”
“Go away, the Third Legion guards the borderlands every day; only coming to our Second Legion has a future.”

“Kid Yang Fan, if you go to The Frontline in the future, remember to contact your older brother.” A middle-aged god clad in military uniform even directly patted Yang Fan’s shoulder, his tone full of appreciation.
The surrounding young geniuses saw this scene and grew even so envious that their eyes turned red.
You must know that these people not only came from the Five Great Families, but they were now also real-power figures guarding The Frontline.
On ordinary days, these geniuses of the same clan might not even be able to join them, no matter how much they buttered up and acted cute.
But now, these battalion commander and brigade commander-level figures actively ran over to make friends with Yang Fan.
The gap between them was crystal clear.
Gu Le did not know when she had already stood by Yang Fan’s side. She very naturally hooked her arm around Yang Fan’s, her body slightly leaning in, as if declaring sovereignty.
As the gathering gradually came to an end, Gu Le raised her head and softly spoke: “Shall we... go home, or stay right here at this restaurant?”

chapters.title: Chapter 206: This Child Understands
paragraphs: Her voice was very soft, but the eyes looking at Yang Fan were already brimming with love.
After the recent Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, Gu Le had already completely fallen at this moment, and she could hardly wait to give herself to Yang Fan.
“Let’s go home,” Yang Fan said with a smile.
As the night grew deeper, by the time the two returned to the villa, it was already late at night.
The living room lights were soft, and the moonlight outside the window was like water.
As soon as Gu Le entered the door, she directly reached out to turn off the smart lights in the hall.
Then she gently tiptoed, and the temperature in the air gradually began to rise.
A night of spring breeze under thick moonlight, even demigods fear a youthful hero. Originally the proud daughter of the Gu Family, the next day she leans against the wall with a blushing face.
The next day, early in the morning.
Coming downstairs, Yang Fan sat down cross-legged.
His consciousness quickly entered the Divine Kingdom, and without any hesitation, Yang Fan directly loaded the War God Codex.
Boom!!!
The entire Divine Kingdom began to vibrate slightly.
Unlike massive buildings like the divine weapon world-forging platform, after the War God Codex manifested, it was merely an ancient flag.
The flag was entirely dark gold, and countless totem battlefields seemed to be engraved upon it.
There were gods and demons slaughtering each other, all races waging war, and blurry figures standing tall amidst a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood.
Just a single glance was enough to make one’s mind tremble.
The next moment, the War God Codex slowly rose into the air and finally planted itself directly in the very center of the Divine Kingdom.
In an instant, a vast and mighty Battle Intent swept across the entire Divine Kingdom.
The earth trembled and the sky roared.
Countless martial Cultivation believers raised their heads almost simultaneously, and the Qi and blood within their bodies actually began to boil crazily!
Some believers who had been stuck at the Peak of the Martial Apprentice Realm for a long time directly felt their Bottlenecks loosen at this moment.
“A Breakthrough!” Accompanied by an excited roar.
A Martial Apprentice believer’s whole body Qi and blood surged violently, and he actually broke through to the Martial Master Realm on the spot.
And this kind of situation was not an isolated case.

Large areas of martial believers sat cross-legged on the ground one after another, their internal Qi and blood soaring into the sky like smoke signals, and people were constantly breaking through everywhere in the Divine Kingdom.
Even some ordinary Mortals whose bodies were originally frail felt that their own strength had increased significantly at this moment.
In their gazes looking toward the War God Codex, fanaticism and awe even emerged, as if that was not a building, but a divine object.
At the same time, the Cultivation believers on Penglai Island also felt the changes.

The Spiritual Qi between heaven and earth inexplicably gained a hint of sharpness and sternness, and many Cultivation believers were surprised to find that when they cast offensive Spells, their power vaguely increased by a bit.
For a moment, the entire Divine Kingdom seemed to have been injected with a will of “battle”.

As a deity, Yang Fan had the clearest perception of his believers’ changes, especially the believers of the Martial Route; their absorption efficiency for food and Medicinal Pills directly surged by two to three times.

The feedback brought was equally terrifying, as a massive amount of Qi and blood power continuously poured into Yang Fan’s body, and his Physical Body was strengthening at a speed visible to the naked eye.
In the past, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had always focused mainly on the Cultivation Route, because most believers’ Aptitude leaned toward the Cultivation Route.
But now, just a single War God Codex had forcibly pulled back this gap!
All of his past investments in the Cultivation Route combined could not compare to this single S-Rank Building.

“It’s also an S-Rank Building, yet the gap can actually be this huge...” Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly. “If I don’t want to be lopsided, I’ll still need to continue increasing investment in the Cultivation and Mechanical Paths later on.”
Just as Yang Fan was pondering how the Divine Kingdom’s resources should be reallocated in the future now that he had the War God Codex.
Yang Yi’s voice suddenly rang out, “Master, an important person is requesting a meeting in the Virtual World.”
“An important person?” Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
“Gu Xuanting.”
Hearing this name, Yang Fan immediately exited the Divine Kingdom.
Ever since he was rated as a Peerless Prodigy, the messages he received every day were almost massive.

There were recruitment conditions offered by major corporations, investment and goodwill gestures from various factions, and even people he didn’t know at all began trying to get close to him; even high school classmates frequently sent greetings.
Poverty in a bustling market goes unnoticed, while wealth in deep mountains brings distant relatives—that was the principle.
For these worthless interpersonal interactions, Yang Fan naturally couldn’t be bothered to deal with them.
Therefore, he handed over most of his communication permissions to Yang Yi for screening.
Aside from his parents and wife, Yang Yi would only remind him if someone at the deity level contacted him.
And Gu Xuanting was the Third Elder of the Gu Family, not only powerful in strength, but also his nominal father-in-law nowadays.
Yang Fan naturally didn’t dare to let the other party wait for long.
After entering the Virtual World, Yang Fan tapped the coordinates and instantly arrived at the Gu Family Territory.

“Fan’er, your battle last night was truly earth-shattering. By now, it has almost spread throughout the Five Great Families.” Gu Xuanting got straight to the point, with undisguised gratification on his face.
Looking at Yang Fan now, the more he looked, the more satisfied he became; not only was his talent terrifying, but his Heart-Nature was also not bad.

Yang Fan respectfully bowed and said, “This person already harbored hostility toward me, and wanted to take the opportunity to earn a batch of resources from me. Naturally, I had to give him this chance. It’s a pity that he couldn’t seize it himself.”
“Hahaha, good!” Gu Xuanting immediately laughed heartily.

“Using force against force, and the bet was even proposed by the other party himself. Even if those old fellows from the Sima Family are unhappy in their hearts, they can’t say much. You’ve really made a huge profit this time.”
“Just luck,” Yang Fan smiled.
Only after truly loading the War God Codex into the Divine Kingdom did Yang Fan realize that it was far more than just a huge profit—he had hit the absolute jackpot!
Right at this moment, Gu Xuanting suddenly snapped his fingers lightly.
The next second, a stream of data directly surged into Yang Fan’s mind.
“These are the coordinates of ten Spirit Vein Planets,” Gu Xuanting slowly said.

“Your Aptitude is the Hundredfold Time Sequence, and now you have a building of the War God Codex’s caliber. Both the environmental pressure of the Divine Kingdom and the consumption of believers will increase significantly. This batch of resources can be considered my private investment in you.”
“Accelerate the pace of the Divine Kingdom War, and after you truly break through to become a deity, the Gu Family will continue to add more resources.”
Hearing this, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but tremble inwardly.
Ten Spirit Vein Planets!
This meant that from now on, he would have an extra income of ten billion Divinity Points every month.
If he were truly short of resources, he could even directly sell the coordinates.
This was an asset worth trillions of Divinity Points; even an expert like Gu Xuanting probably couldn’t pull it out easily.
“Thank you, Father-in-law,” Yang Fan immediately thanked him sincerely.

Gu Xuanting nodded slightly, and then his tone gradually turned a bit more solemn. “Inside Taichu City, as long as your Divine Kingdom coordinates are not exposed, you basically won’t be in any danger. But eventually, you will still have to go to The Frontline for service in the future. Since you’ve already offended certain people, you must keep your wits about you.”
“Do you understand?”
“This child understands,” Yang Fan nodded earnestly.
Seeing Yang Fan being so composed, the smile on Gu Xuanting’s face deepened a bit more.

Afterwards, he suddenly changed the topic. “In addition, you and that girl Gu Le need to speed things up a bit too. I’m still waiting to hold a grandson early. Once you break through to become a deity in the future and your life level undergoes a complete transformation, wanting to conceive offspring won’t be that easy anymore.”
“Yes,” Yang Fan gave a dry cough and agreed.

Yang Fan respectfully bowed and said, “This person already harbored hostility toward me, and wanted to take the opportunity to earn a batch of resources from me.
Naturally, I had to give him this chance.
It’s a pity that he couldn’t seize it himself.”
“Hahaha, good!” Gu Xuanting immediately laughed heartily.
“Using force against force, and the bet was even proposed by the other party himself.
Even if those old fellows from the Sima Family are unhappy in their hearts, they can’t say much.
You’ve really made a huge profit this time.”
“Just luck,” Yang Fan smiled.
Only after truly loading the War God Codex into the Divine Kingdom did Yang Fan realize that it was far more than just a huge profit—he had hit the absolute jackpot!
Right at this moment, Gu Xuanting suddenly snapped his fingers lightly.
The next second, a stream of data directly surged into Yang Fan’s mind.
“These are the coordinates of ten Spirit Vein Planets,” Gu Xuanting slowly said.
“Your Aptitude is the Hundredfold Time Sequence, and now you have a building of the War God Codex’s caliber.
Both the environmental pressure of the Divine Kingdom and the consumption of believers will increase significantly.
This batch of resources can be considered my private investment in you.”
“Accelerate the pace of the Divine Kingdom War, and after you truly break through to become a deity, the Gu Family will continue to add more resources.”
Hearing this, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but tremble inwardly.
Ten Spirit Vein Planets!
This meant that from now on, he would have an extra income of ten billion Divinity Points every month.
If he were truly short of resources, he could even directly sell the coordinates.
This was an asset worth trillions of Divinity Points; even an expert like Gu Xuanting probably couldn’t pull it out easily.
“Thank you, Father-in-law,” Yang Fan immediately thanked him sincerely.
Gu Xuanting nodded slightly, and then his tone gradually turned a bit more solemn.
“Inside Taichu City, as long as your Divine Kingdom coordinates are not exposed, you basically won’t be in any danger.
But eventually, you will still have to go to The Frontline for service in the future.
Since you’ve already offended certain people, you must keep your wits about you.”
“Do you understand?”
“This child understands,” Yang Fan nodded earnestly.
Seeing Yang Fan being so composed, the smile on Gu Xuanting’s face deepened a bit more.
Afterwards, he suddenly changed the topic.
“In addition, you and that girl Gu Le need to speed things up a bit too.
I’m still waiting to hold a grandson early.
Once you break through to become a deity in the future and your life level undergoes a complete transformation, wanting to conceive offspring won’t be that easy anymore.”
“Yes,” Yang Fan gave a dry cough and agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Soft-Rice Talent, Void Spirit Race
paragraphs: After his consciousness withdrew from the Virtual World.
Yang Fan immediately handed the coordinates of the ten Spirit Vein Planets to Yang Da, having him arrange believers to go and receive them.
Right at this moment, a lazy voice suddenly came from the stairs.
“Hubby... what are we eating this morning? I’m starving to death.” Gu Le leaned against the stairs and slowly walked down.
However, her walking movements were obviously much slower than usual, and when she looked at Yang Fan, she couldn’t help but gently glare at him.
Yang Fan silently looked away, then gently snapped his fingers.
The next moment, a large amount of food materialized directly out of the Divine Kingdom.
Golden-yellow roasted dragon meat, five-color spiritual rice exuding Spiritual Qi, and Monkey Wine brewed from hundred-fruit spiritual nectar filled the entire hall with a rich aroma instantly.
“Why do you have so much food in your Divine Kingdom? Are you planning to open a restaurant?” Gu Le blinked her eyes and sat directly at the table.
All of this food came from the A-rank building “Myriad Spirits Dietary Hub”. The taste might not be top-notch, but it wasn’t bad either.
“Father-in-law just contacted me in the Virtual World.” Yang Fan sat across from Gu Le.
Hearing this, Gu Le wasn’t surprised at all, but asked with some curiosity, “What did he say?”
“He gave some resources and incidentally told us to hurry up and have a child.”
“Cough—” The Monkey Wine that Gu Le had just drank into her mouth almost spewed out.
Her pretty face turned slightly red, and then she feigned calmness and said, “Then... what are your thoughts, hubby?”
“We are both at the Primordial Academy now, and our time is relatively ample. We really should speed things up.” Yang Fan said with a straight face.
Hearing this, Gu Le subconsciously shrank her neck.
“Not today... I’m too tired, wait until tomorrow.”
After speaking, she sneaked another glance at Yang Fan.
Then she suddenly put down her wine glass, her tone turning rare in its seriousness, “Hubby, you are really amazing. I find that... I have already uncontrollably fallen in love with you.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded as well, “I love you too.”
“I’m being serious.” Gu Le stared at him.
“I’m being serious too.” Yang Fan’s face didn’t turn red and his heart didn’t skip a beat.
Gu Le immediately rolled her eyes, “With so many tricks at night, stop acting so deeply affectionate with me.”
“I am naturally very affectionate.” Yang Fan looked at Gu Le with a serious face, his gaze deep and gentle, as if the person before him was his entire world.
Looking at Yang Fan’s straight-laced appearance, Gu Le’s face turned “whoosh” red.
She hurriedly lowered her head to shovel down a couple of mouthfuls of rice, then grabbed a bottle of Monkey Wine and quickly walked upstairs.
When she reached the doorway, Gu Le didn’t forget to turn back and glare at Yang Fan, “You are not allowed to bully me tonight!”
“You sleep on the sofa!”
Bang!
As her words fell, the bedroom door was directly closed.
Immediately after, a “click” of locking came from inside.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan couldn’t help laughing out loud.
“This wife is quite easy to coax, Ruyan sister taught well after all... I didn’t expect I really have the talent for eating soft rice.”
Yang Fan leaned against the sofa, a trace of emotion on his face.
He also knew very well in his heart that he really needed to have a child with Gu Le as soon as possible.
Only in this way would the interest bond between him and the Gu Family become deeper.
After breaking through to a deity in the future, the investment and support given to him by the Gu Family would also be even more.
So-called affection is often fundamentally an exchange of value and interests.
Yang Fan was no longer the ignorant youth of the past. He understood the meaning of the Gu Family. He could likewise see Gu Le’s shrewdness.
Yesterday she was still probing his potential, and today she could already seriously say “I love you”.
But so what? True or false has actually never been important.

As long as you are strong enough, as long as your value is great enough, even the proud daughters of heaven who have always been high above and living in the clouds will likewise actively approach you, and even speak the most cheesy words in the world to you.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan suddenly couldn’t help laughing: “I love you?”
“Haha... My strength is stronger than a hundred Ruyan sisters, but my rank is far too far behind.”
For a moment, Yang Fan inexplicably felt a bit nostalgic for the days when he was still just a Divine Being.
Time flew by, and another month and a half passed in the blink of an eye.
During this period, Gu Le had completely moved into Yang Fan’s villa.
From once every three days at the very beginning, to once every two days later, and now to every single day.
For Yang Fan, reading, studying, and increasing knowledge were certainly important; but coaxing this wealthy beauty well to let the Gu Family continuously increase investment was equally important.
Everything was for developing the Divine Kingdom, everything was for becoming stronger.
Believers were all working hard, and as a deity, he naturally couldn’t slack off either.
Furthermore, the whole process was actually quite comfortable; Yang Fan had no resistance to it whatsoever.
Now the soul nourishing wood in the Divine Kingdom was close to eight thousand years old, and in another twenty-odd days, this batch of soul nourishing wood could be officially sold.
However, as the age of the soul nourishing wood continuously increased, Yang Fan recently always faintly felt that something was wrong.
As a deity, his consciousness had frequently descended into the Divine Kingdom during this period.
But every time, he seemed to sense that some alien life form had appeared in his Divine Kingdom, yet when he descended, he could never find any abnormalities.
This feeling made Yang Fan extremely uncomfortable.

For this reason, he even specifically had Yang Da purchase a large amount of detection equipment, including life detection, spiritual fluctuation scanning, psychic radar, and spatial induction devices.
Various high-end detection instruments from the Mechanical Divine Kingdom almost covered the entire Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan didn’t believe his perception would be wrong. Something must have sneaked into the Divine Kingdom, it was just that he hadn’t discovered it yet.
Now with such a dense detection system, as long as the opponent appeared again, it would be utterly impossible for them to hide.
Right at this moment, Yang Da’s voice suddenly resounded in Yang Fan’s mind.
“Master, the target has been confirmed; it is the Void Spirit Race.”
“The target has set their sights on the soul nourishing wood, but they haven’t officially made a move yet, and are currently scouting out the location.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s consciousness immediately connected to the Virtual World, beginning to retrieve information on the Void Spirit Race.
Soon, a detailed document surfaced before his eyes.
[Void Spirit Race, vassal race.
The bodies of this ethnic group can remain in a semi-ethereal state, capable of penetrating the vast majority of matter for a short time, and can even tear minute spatial rifts to move.
Extremely skilled in infiltration, theft, and reconnaissance.
However, the weaknesses of the Void Spirit Race are equally obvious; their frontal combat power is extremely weak, and under the same Realm, they almost belong to the bottom-tier level.
Once their location is exposed, their Divine Kingdom basically has no ability to resist whatsoever.

The Void Spirit Race is extremely difficult to lock onto. When escaping, they can even actively sever spatial traces. Even if many deities are stolen from, they are simply unable to find the coordinates of the opponent’s Divine Kingdom.
Therefore, among the myriad races, the Void Spirit Race is famous as “Divine Kingdom Thieves”, specially surviving by stealing resources from other Divine Kingdoms.
The Void Spirit Race itself does not have a complete civilization; whether believers or deities, they can only survive by attaching themselves to other powerful races.]

chapters.title: Chapter 208: Six Demigods
paragraphs: Seeing this, Yang Fan immediately furrowed his brows, as he had not expected that such a race actually existed in this world.
Instead of relying on Divine Kingdom War, they made a living by stealing resources from others’ divine kingdoms.
“Vassals...” Yang Fan’s gaze sank slightly.
This meant that behind the Void Spirit Race, there was a very high possibility that other Alien Demigods were standing.
“Yang Da, instantly annihilate all Void Spirit Race members within the divine kingdom. In addition, lock onto the coordinates of the opponent’s divine kingdom for me,” Yang Fan directly ordered.
“Understood, Master.”
The next moment, Yang Fan’s consciousness had already descended into the divine kingdom.
At this moment, within the large expanse of soul nourishing wood woodlands, pitch-black figures were fleeing frantically.

Those creatures were pitch-black all over, their bodies seemingly composed of flowing shadows, lacking facial features and possessing only a pair of eerie green pupils that kept flickering in the darkness.
Their bodies would occasionally turn illusory and occasionally solidify, and their movement speed was astonishingly fast.

Although their aura was only equivalent to the Qi Refining Realm, their speed was not the least bit slower than a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, and they could even continuously penetrate trees, rocks, and buildings.

Yang Fan was also unclear about how these Void Spirit Race members had managed to cross the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, but right now the entire divine kingdom had long been completely sealed off.

The fewer than a thousand Void Spirit Race members were now fish in a barrel; if he hadn’t been worried that a massive battle would damage the soul nourishing wood on a large scale, these things would have already been blasted to death completely.
Boom!
A large number of Intelligent Life rapidly took to the air, spatial sensing devices completely covered the entire region, and countless believers began to seal off the opponent’s scope of activities.
In less than a day, nearly a thousand Void Spirit Race members were all suppressed.
Yang Fan did not hesitate in the slightest and directly ordered them all to be executed.
Accompanied by the death of the very last Void Spirit Race member, a trace of subtle spatial fluctuation appeared on the outer perimeter of the divine kingdom.
Yang Fan’s gaze condensed, and instantly following that thread of spatial fluctuation, he captured the coordinate location of the opponent’s divine kingdom.
“Yang Da, organize ten million believers to enter the enemy’s divine kingdom as the vanguard force,” Yang Fan ordered.
According to the data in the Virtual World, the Void Spirit Race itself was not good at frontal warfare.
Most of them attached themselves to other powerful races, trading for living space through ways such as scouting, reconnoitering, and stealing resources.
Since that was the case, there was a high probability that behind this Void Spirit Race, there were other Demigods, or even more powerful existences.
This invasion of a divine kingdom was not like the divine kingdom coordinates purchased from the Divine Shop which came with basic data; everything required self-exploration.
The unknown was the most terrifying!

Anyway, his own divine kingdom coordinates had already been exposed now, so rather than rashly pressing down with a massive army, it was better to dispatch a vanguard force to go in and scout out the situation.
If the opponent’s strength was average, he would directly wipe them out.
But if a powerful deity truly stood behind them, it would be best to rely on his own divine kingdom’s native territory to fight.
Following Yang Fan’s order, a large number of believers quickly began organizing their troops.
Accompanied by the opening of spatial rifts, an army of ten million believers officially stepped into the opponent’s divine kingdom.
However, when Yang Fan saw the scene before him clearly through the believers’ perspectives, his brows instantly furrowed.
This divine kingdom... was simply like a dead zone.
Looking out, the world was dim and gloomy, the air was permeated with dense Death Qi, the earth was cracked, and the rivers were dried up.
Not a shred of greenery could be seen among the mountains and rivers, and the entire world seemed to have lost its life.

What shocked Yang Fan even more was that there were Void Spirit Race believers on the outer perimeter of the opponent’s divine kingdom, but these Void Spirit Race members were each as thin as skin and bones.
Their originally illusory bodies appeared tottering and on the verge of collapsing as they walked.

Upon seeing Yang Fan’s army, these Void Spirit Race believers immediately revealed looks of terror, and actually panicked as they fled in all directions, harboring no intention of resisting whatsoever.

“What on earth is the deity of this Void Spirit Race doing? To actually squeeze their own believers to such an extent? Could it be the mischief of the Alien Demigods behind them?” Yang Fan couldn’t help but generate a trace of doubt in his heart.
Right at this moment, the Void Realm of this divine kingdom suddenly shook.
Six spatial rifts actually appeared simultaneously in the sky above this divine kingdom, and the violent spatial fluctuations instantly swept across all directions.
The next second, a large number of orc believers began walking out from the spatial rifts.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan felt much more relaxed instead in his heart.
“Six Demigods... Fortunately. It seems there aren’t truly powerful deity existences behind this Void Spirit Race. Otherwise, wanting to take them down would probably be truly somewhat troublesome.”
Since the opponent already knew his divine kingdom coordinates, Yang Fan naturally couldn’t let go of this hidden danger.
However, if a deity truly stood behind this Void Spirit Race, then he really wouldn’t have any methods for the time being.
According to the data, many deities would specially keep the Void Spirit Race in captivity.
After all, the special abilities of the Void Spirit Race played an extremely large role in Divine Kingdom Wars.
Whether it was scouting, infiltration, or intelligence gathering, they could all be called top-tier.
And information warfare had always been an extremely crucial link in Divine Kingdom Wars.
Relying on the rules of divine kingdoms, a deity’s believers could not actively attack Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
But if the Void Spirit Race was the opponent’s Subordinate God, then they could completely dispatch believer armies to garrison.
Even though Yang Fan’s divine kingdom foundation was not weak nowadays, when facing a deity, his heart still felt somewhat apprehensive!
“Yang Da, regarding these six Alien Demigods, is there any way to obtain the coordinates of their divine kingdoms?” Yang Fan opened his mouth to inquire.

“Reporting to Master, this Void Spirit Race should be subordinate deities kept in captivity by them, and this divine kingdom has a large amount of connection traces with these six Alien Demigods. After capturing the divine kingdom, using a Divine Kingdom Deduction Card has a certain probability of obtaining one or multiple divine kingdom coordinates,” Yang Da calmly replied.
“A certain probability?” Yang Fan’s brows slightly furrowed, obviously somewhat unsatisfied.
For the sake of his own divine kingdom’s safety, he certainly didn’t want to leave behind any hidden dangers.
“Unless the opponent actively invades our divine kingdom.”

“However, the Void Spirit Race Demigod has already witnessed the defense power of our divine kingdom, and he will most likely remind these Alien Demigods. Therefore, the possibility of the opponent actively invading is not high,” Yang Da explained.
Meanwhile, relying on the believers’ vision, Yang Fan finally saw clearly the strength of the believers under those six Alien Demigods.
They were merely ordinary Beast-Race Demigods, each dispatching ten million orc believers, while the orcs at the Foundation Establishment Realm among them were even less than a hundred people.
Such strength was not taken seriously by Yang Fan at all.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, and then a trace of a smile slowly emerged at the corners of his mouth. “Will they come or not... Won’t we know by trying?”
As his voice fell, Yang Fan directly issued a retreat order.
At the same time, within a dark and dilapidated grand hall in the core area of the Void Spirit Race divine kingdom,
The Void Spirit Race Demigod “Ling Xuzi” was prostrating on the ground, his body continuously trembling, and his expression panicked.
And in front of him, six massive conscious projections were suspended in mid-air, shockingly being six Beast-Race Demigods.
“Respected Masters! Within that Human Demigod’s divine kingdom, there are a large amount of detection equipment, among which even includes spatial fluctuation detection devices.”
“My believers are truly difficult to hide, I beg all Lords to save my life!” Ling Xuzi spoke with a trembling voice.
One of the Beast-Race Demigods coldly looked down at him. “Ling Xuzi. What is that Human Demigod’s strength like? What about his asset situation?”
