Even though Yang Fan’s divine kingdom foundation was not weak nowadays, when facing a deity, his heart still felt somewhat apprehensive!
“Yang Da, regarding these six Alien Demigods, is there any way to obtain the coordinates of their divine kingdoms?” Yang Fan opened his mouth to inquire.
“Reporting to Master, this Void Spirit Race should be subordinate deities kept in captivity by them, and this divine kingdom has a large amount of connection traces with these six Alien Demigods.
After capturing the divine kingdom, using a Divine Kingdom Deduction Card has a certain probability of obtaining one or multiple divine kingdom coordinates,” Yang Da calmly replied.
“A certain probability?” Yang Fan’s brows slightly furrowed, obviously somewhat unsatisfied.
For the sake of his own divine kingdom’s safety, he certainly didn’t want to leave behind any hidden dangers.
“Unless the opponent actively invades our divine kingdom.”
“However, the Void Spirit Race Demigod has already witnessed the defense power of our divine kingdom, and he will most likely remind these Alien Demigods.
Therefore, the possibility of the opponent actively invading is not high,” Yang Da explained.
Meanwhile, relying on the believers’ vision, Yang Fan finally saw clearly the strength of the believers under those six Alien Demigods.
They were merely ordinary Beast-Race Demigods, each dispatching ten million orc believers, while the orcs at the Foundation Establishment Realm among them were even less than a hundred people.
Such strength was not taken seriously by Yang Fan at all.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, and then a trace of a smile slowly emerged at the corners of his mouth.
“Will they come or not...
Won’t we know by trying?”
As his voice fell, Yang Fan directly issued a retreat order.
At the same time, within a dark and dilapidated grand hall in the core area of the Void Spirit Race divine kingdom,
The Void Spirit Race Demigod “Ling Xuzi” was prostrating on the ground, his body continuously trembling, and his expression panicked.
And in front of him, six massive conscious projections were suspended in mid-air, shockingly being six Beast-Race Demigods.
“Respected Masters!
Within that Human Demigod’s divine kingdom, there are a large amount of detection equipment, among which even includes spatial fluctuation detection devices.”
“My believers are truly difficult to hide, I beg all Lords to save my life!” Ling Xuzi spoke with a trembling voice.
One of the Beast-Race Demigods coldly looked down at him.
“Ling Xuzi.
What is that Human Demigod’s strength like?
What about his asset situation?”

chapters.title: Chapter 209: Lacking Interest
paragraphs: Ling Xuzi hurriedly spoke, “Reporting to Master, this person’s strength is extremely formidable. I once sneaked into the core region of his Divine Kingdom, and believers in the Foundation Establishment Realm alone number no less than a thousand.”
Speaking up to this point, Ling Xuzi’s voice couldn’t help but pause for a fraction of a second.
Meanwhile, the gazes of those few Beast-Race Demigods also noticeably turned several shades graver.
“As for assets...” Ling Xuzi subconsciously swallowed a mouthful of saliva.
“Speak!” One of the Beast-Race Demigods shouted coldly.

“I only saw a large amount of millennium-old soul nourishing wood, and the Spiritual Qi of his Divine Kingdom is extremely dense. Inside... there is a very high possibility that an A-grade Spiritual Vein exists!”
Boom!
As the words fell, the aura of those six demigod phantoms instantly grew several shades heavier.
An A-grade Spiritual Vein was a top-tier treasure worth tens of thousands of Divinity Points.
For wandering gods like them who had no Family background and drifted around, let alone purchasing it, they didn’t even have the channels for it.
For a moment, the six Beast-Race Demigods looked at each other, unable to suppress the greed in their eyes at all.
“Do we do it?” One of the Beast-Race Demigods took the lead to speak.

“Although the opponent possesses over a thousand believers in the Foundation Establishment Realm, after all, the six of us are joining forces. Even if we are not a match, we can completely withdraw back to our Divine Kingdoms to support each other.”
“Such a fat sheep, how could we not do it!” Another Beast-Race Demigod’s eyes were filled with greed.
“That’s right! Even if we ultimately fail to take down the opponent’s Divine Kingdom, just plundering a batch of soul nourishing wood back will be enough for us to make a fortune.”
“After completing this deal, the resources obtained will even be enough for us to develop for several hundred years!”
At this moment, the Beast-Race Demigod standing right in the center slowly lowered his head, those crimson pupils staring fixedly at Ling Xuzi, who was prostrating on the ground.
“Everything you said just now, is it completely true?”
The terrifying coercion descended, causing Ling Xuzi’s body to tremble instantly, “I wouldn’t dare conceal it from Master! There is not a single half-sentence of falsehood!”
Hearing this, another Beast-Race Demigod nearby suddenly sneered.

“Big Brother, what are you worried about? If this person’s strength is truly formidable, why did he immediately retreat back to his Divine Kingdom to defend when he saw our grand army descend just now?”
As soon as these words came out, the rest of the Beast-Race Demigods all nodded, feeling that it made sense.

After all, fighting in one’s native Divine Kingdom was inherently the greatest reliance of all deities. Who would abandon their own home-field advantage and run over to someone else’s Divine Kingdom to risk their lives?
“Since that’s the case...” The leading Beast-Race Demigod finally spoke slowly.
“Ling Xuzi, send over this person’s Divine Kingdom coordinates. We will naturally resolve this trouble for you. Once it’s done, your freedom will be returned to you.”
Hearing the final sentence, Ling Xuzi instantly revealed a look of wild joy, hurriedly prostrating and kowtowing.
“Thank you, Master!”
However, right after the consciousness projections of the six Beast-Race Demigods left this place, Ling Xuzi’s expression, which was previously filled with panic, instantly changed.
In those dim-green pupils, there was now nothing but deep malice and madness.
“Go... all of you go...”
“Once you enter that Human Demigod’s Divine Kingdom, you will know what kind of iron plate you have kicked!”
Ling Xuzi’s voice was low, carrying even a trace of morbid gratification.

“You exploited and enslaved me for nearly a hundred years... Did you really think that my Void Spirit Race was born to be dogs for you? Since I can’t live... then the six of you bastards shouldn’t think about living either!”
In fact, Ling Xuzi was extremely clear in his heart that his believers had only reached the opponent’s outer region.

Having witnessed the terrifying defensive system of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, let alone these six trash right in front of him, even if the troops were multiplied tenfold, it would still be impossible to breach it.
If he continued to be exploited by these Beast-Race Demigods, he wouldn’t live much longer either.
Since that was the case, it was better to borrow a knife to kill someone. He would use that big figure of the Human Race to completely resolve these enemies for himself!
Before dying, he would drag this group of scum down to die with him!
At the same time, Yang Fan, who was closing his eyes to sense the changes in his Divine Kingdom, suddenly opened his eyes.
The next moment, six intense spatial fluctuations simultaneously appeared on the outer periphery of his Divine Kingdom.
Feeling this scene, a trace of delight appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
“They actually dare to attack? That certainly saves me a lot of trouble.” The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth slowly rose, his gaze cold.
Spatial rifts tore open, and a large number of orc believers continuously walked out from within them.
The consciousnesses of the six Beast-Race Demigods descended upon Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom simultaneously.
At this moment, everyone was dumbfounded.

What came into view before their eyes was shockingly a pitch-black Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall spanning across heaven and earth! The city walls soared straight into the clouds, resembling an ancient Dragon slumbering between heaven and earth.
Countless complex formation patterns covered it, and the entire space seemed to be thoroughly suppressed.
Just standing outside the city wall, that oncoming sense of oppression made the hearts of the six Beast-Race Demigods turn cold.
“This... what is this thing?” One of the Beast-Race Demigods’ voices was somewhat trembling.
“On the outer periphery of a Human Demigod’s Divine Kingdom, how could there possibly be such a terrifying city wall structure!”
Another Beast-Race Demigod was similarly full of shock, “Could this possibly be... a B-grade defensive structure?”
“I don’t know...”
“I have never seen such a thing either!”
The six Beast-Race Demigods were completely dumbfounded. They originally thought they were only coming to hunt a fat sheep.
But now they felt as though they had broken into the Divine Kingdom of some deity.
“Then... are we still fighting?” One of the Beast-Race Demigods couldn’t help but swallow a mouthful of saliva.
At this moment, not a single one of the six dared to rashly order an attack.
Right at this time, the leading Beast-Race Demigod’s expression abruptly changed, “Not good! Ling Xuzi harbored rebellious intentions long ago! We’ve been played by that bastard!”
Hearing this, the six Beast-Race Demigods finally reacted completely.
This wasn’t any fat sheep at all, but rather an iron plate strong enough to shatter all their teeth!
However, before they could even make a reaction,
Rumble!!!
Above the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, countless huge artillery turrets slowly rose.
Dense and packed, blotting out the sky and sun. As many as tens of thousands of City-Annihilating Cannons simultaneously locked onto the six great beast-race legions.
The next moment, terrifying energy began to crazily converge, and the entire heaven and earth was illuminated into a brilliant white.
Ten thousand cannons roared simultaneously!
Boom!

Beam after beam of destructive light tore through the firmament. Wherever they passed, space seemed to be completely melted, the earth instantly turned into magma, the air distorted, and the ground was burned into crystal-like glass.
The believers under the command of the six Beast-Race Demigods added up to no more than 300 million, and among them, the believers in the Foundation Establishment Realm were less than five hundred.
With such strength, Yang Fan couldn’t even be bothered to mobilize his army of believers.
Merely the outer defense system of the Divine Kingdom was enough to easily obliterate them.

Yang Fan’s investment in the Divine Kingdom’s defense was immense. Even a large number of F3500 Fighter Jets hadn’t been dispatched yet before the six great beast-race legions were completely vaporized.
At the same time, Yang Fan instantly locked onto the coordinates of the six Divine Kingdoms.

Yang Fan gently waved his hand, his expression appearing somewhat lacking in interest, “This Void Spirit Race’s hidden methods are indeed somewhat interesting. However, the power behind this is too weak; looking at it now, it was just a false alarm.”
“Yang Da, I’ll give you half a month to bring back all of their Divine Kingdom Cores.”

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Getting Along Well
paragraphs: The strength of these Beast-Race Demigods was simply too weak, likely even inferior to the safe-level coordinates in the Divine Shop.
To deal with demigods of this level, Yang Fan didn’t even bother to have war-type Intelligent Life like Yang San personally command them.
Just the conventional legions in his Divine Kingdom were enough to easily crush them.
“Yes, Master,” Yang Da responded respectfully.
Yang Fan nodded slightly, then added, “I’m somewhat interested in that Void Spirit Race. Leave them for last.”
“As you command.”
After giving all the instructions, Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly withdrew from his Divine Kingdom.
Inside the villa in the Real World.
As soon as Yang Fan opened his eyes, he saw Gu Le slowly walking down the stairs.
She was wearing only a black bikini, revealing a large expanse of snow-white skin to the air, her long legs stepping into slippers.
While walking downstairs, she gently swirled the juice in her hand.
This was a little romantic thrill the two had recently developed; Gu Le always liked to deliberately dress like this when they were alone.
Seeing Yang Fan wake up, Gu Le immediately smiled and said, “Hubby, I have good news to tell you.”
She trotted downstairs, her eyes filled with excitement.
“What good news?” Yang Fan asked with a smile.
“The medical robot just checked me. I’m pregnant, and... it’s a boy.” Gu Le’s voice carried an irrepressible joy.
Hearing this, Yang Fan also smiled.
During this period, he and Gu Le had indeed not been idle.
However, as their life tier reached the demigod level, the probability of conceiving offspring became astonishingly low.
No Wonder Gu Le’s parents only had her, their precious daughter, after all these years. The higher the life tier, the more difficult it is to produce descendants—a problem that no god could avoid.
As if thinking of something, Yang Fan suddenly asked, “Do you know about the Void Spirit Race?”
“Of course I do.” Gu Le sat on Yang Fan’s lap and naturally wrapped her arms around his neck. “Many gods on The Frontline keep the Void Spirit Race in captivity.”
“Keep in captivity?” Yang Fan froze slightly. “Isn’t it a Subordinate God Contract?”

Gu Le shook her head. “Subordinate God Contracts are usually only for members of the same race. The rights and obligations of both sides are clearly defined. The Subordinate God provides resources and war supplies, while the main god is responsible for safety and protection.”
“But the Void Spirit Race is different. They are an alien race, and their own strength is extremely weak. Aside from scouting, intelligence, and infiltration, they have almost no value.”
“Whether it’s our Human Race or other alien races, very few would sign a real Subordinate God Contract with them. Most of the time... they are kept in captivity.”
“How are they kept in captivity?” Yang Fan asked curiously.

“It’s simple: ensure their Divine Kingdom Core isn’t destroyed, then constantly exploit them, making their believers continuously go out to scout paths and find other Divine Kingdom coordinates. Even during a Divine Kingdom War, they are forced to infiltrate the enemy’s Divine Kingdom to locate core structures.” Gu Le spoke in a calm tone, as if talking about something mundane.
“Because the Void Spirit Race is too weak to resist, many gods don’t treat them as subordinates at all. As long as their Divine Kingdom isn’t destroyed, they are basically worked to death.”
“Many believers of the Void Spirit Race might not even eat a proper full meal from birth to death.”

“They are forced to wander the Void Realm continuously to find Divine Kingdom coordinates and figure out the enemy’s strength. If they encounter a tough opponent, their main god might even abandon the Void Spirit Race.”
Saying this, Gu Le suddenly smiled. “Hubby, if you know the Divine Kingdom coordinates of that Void Spirit Race, you can actually keep them in captivity in advance as well.”
“Just give them a bit of food and drink. This race is like dogs—throw them a few bones, and they will be eternally grateful to you.”
“To survive, they are willing to do anything.”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly.
It had to be said that the Void Spirit Race indeed held significant value for Divine Kingdom Wars.
After pondering for a moment, Yang Fan decided to wait until he met that Void Spirit Race demigod before making a decision.
Since Gu Le was pregnant, Yang Fan was unusually well-behaved for the next few days.
Not only did he inform Gu Xuanting and his wife about this, but he also brought Gu Le to meet the elders Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong via virtual space.
Meanwhile, the sisters Luo Rou and Luo Bing also learned about Gu Le’s existence.
However, to Yang Fan’s surprise, everyone actually got along quite harmoniously.
Gu Le showed great generosity. Upon their first meeting, she gifted Luo Rou and Luo Bing an A-grade Spiritual Vein each as a meeting present.
Instead, the relationship among the three women grew better and better.
Although Gu Le was Yang Fan’s third wife, every time she came to the Yangcheng Villa, she would always sit closest to Yang Fan.
As for Luo Rou and Luo Bing, they would subconsciously yield a bit to the side.
Meanwhile, the Divine Kingdom War involving the six Beast-Race Demigods soon came to an end.

The foundations of these demigods’ Divine Kingdoms were far too poor, lacking any Family support behind them. They had likely relied on constantly exploiting the Void Spirit Race to steal resources and accumulating them over a long time before barely breaking through to demigod status.
Their Divine Kingdoms were pitifully barren; in less than ten days in the Real World, six palm-sized Divine Kingdom Cores appeared in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
In addition, Yang San, Yang Four, and Yang Five also brought back new Divine Kingdom Cores respectively, and the Otherworldly Collectors had already completed their land reclamation work.
As for the Divine Kingdoms of those six Beast-Race Demigods, they were so poor that even Intelligent Life like Yang Da believed they weren’t worth reclaiming.
Therefore, Yang Fan decided to absorb all the Divine Kingdom Cores at once.
Rumble!!!
As each Divine Kingdom Core fused in, the entire Divine Kingdom began to expand violently once again.

The danger-level Divine Kingdom Core brought back by Yang San was of the highest value, adding a full five million square kilometers of area for Yang Fan, while the Divine Kingdom Cores brought back by Yang Four and Yang Five added 1.5 million square kilometers each; as for the six Divine Kingdom Cores of the Beast-Race Demigods combined, they barely added two million square kilometers.
In just a short moment, the area of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom surged by another ten million square kilometers.
The land continuously extended outward, mountains rose, rivers expanded, and the boundaries of the entire Divine Kingdom grew vast once again.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 29.5 million square kilometers
Talent: Omitted

Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (97,422), Martial Master Realm (54,225), Qi Refining Realm (290 million), Martial Disciple Realm (310 million), Second-class Intelligent Life (12,000), First-class Intelligent Life (2.959 million), Tier 5 Being (13.5 billion)... Mortal (19.2 billion)
Profession: Alchemist (5.85 million)...
Dependents: Adult Elf (25.44 million)
Techniques: Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 14 billion (Provides 12.6 Divinity Points daily in reality)

Buildings: Moon Well x100 million, Sun Spring x100 million, Fountain of Life x11,000, War God Codex (S-grade), Great Void Warship x2 (S-grade), Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest x11 (S-grade), divine weapon world-forging platform (S-grade), Eye of God x22 (A-grade), Spiritual Vein x126,000 (A-grade), Monkey Wine Spring x1.5 million (B-grade)...

Wonders: Penglai Island x3000 (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x15000 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x30000 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x1500 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x30
Assets: Spirit Vein Planet x21, Spirit Plant Star x10, soul nourishing wood (x5 trillion, thousand-year), Dragon Fish Fry (x300 million), f-class transformation pod x5 million...”

Since Gu Le was pregnant, Yang Fan was unusually well-behaved for the next few days.
Not only did he inform Gu Xuanting and his wife about this, but he also brought Gu Le to meet the elders Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong via virtual space.
Meanwhile, the sisters Luo Rou and Luo Bing also learned about Gu Le’s existence.
However, to Yang Fan’s surprise, everyone actually got along quite harmoniously.
Gu Le showed great generosity.
Upon their first meeting, she gifted Luo Rou and Luo Bing an A-grade Spiritual Vein each as a meeting present.
Instead, the relationship among the three women grew better and better.
Although Gu Le was Yang Fan’s third wife, every time she came to the Yangcheng Villa, she would always sit closest to Yang Fan.
As for Luo Rou and Luo Bing, they would subconsciously yield a bit to the side.
Meanwhile, the Divine Kingdom War involving the six Beast-Race Demigods soon came to an end.
The foundations of these demigods’ Divine Kingdoms were far too poor, lacking any Family support behind them.
They had likely relied on constantly exploiting the Void Spirit Race to steal resources and accumulating them over a long time before barely breaking through to demigod status.
Their Divine Kingdoms were pitifully barren; in less than ten days in the Real World, six palm-sized Divine Kingdom Cores appeared in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
In addition, Yang San, Yang Four, and Yang Five also brought back new Divine Kingdom Cores respectively, and the Otherworldly Collectors had already completed their land reclamation work.
As for the Divine Kingdoms of those six Beast-Race Demigods, they were so poor that even Intelligent Life like Yang Da believed they weren’t worth reclaiming.
Therefore, Yang Fan decided to absorb all the Divine Kingdom Cores at once.
Rumble!!!
As each Divine Kingdom Core fused in, the entire Divine Kingdom began to expand violently once again.

The danger-level Divine Kingdom Core brought back by Yang San was of the highest value, adding a full five million square kilometers of area for Yang Fan, while the Divine Kingdom Cores brought back by Yang Four and Yang Five added 1.5 million square kilometers each; as for the six Divine Kingdom Cores of the Beast-Race Demigods combined, they barely added two million square kilometers.
In just a short moment, the area of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom surged by another ten million square kilometers.
The land continuously extended outward, mountains rose, rivers expanded, and the boundaries of the entire Divine Kingdom grew vast once again.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 29.5 million square kilometers
Talent: Omitted

Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (97,422), Martial Master Realm (54,225), Qi Refining Realm (290 million), Martial Disciple Realm (310 million), Second-class Intelligent Life (12,000), First-class Intelligent Life (2.959 million), Tier 5 Being (13.5 billion)...
Mortal (19.2 billion)
Profession: Alchemist (5.85 million)...
Dependents: Adult Elf (25.44 million)
Techniques: Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 14 billion (Provides 12.6 Divinity Points daily in reality)

Buildings: Moon Well x100 million, Sun Spring x100 million, Fountain of Life x11,000, War God Codex (S-grade), Great Void Warship x2 (S-grade), Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest x11 (S-grade), divine weapon world-forging platform (S-grade), Eye of God x22 (A-grade), Spiritual Vein x126,000 (A-grade), Monkey Wine Spring x1.5 million (B-grade)...

Wonders: Penglai Island x3000 (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x15000 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x30000 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x1500 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x30
Assets: Spirit Vein Planet x21, Spirit Plant Star x10, soul nourishing wood (x5 trillion, thousand-year), Dragon Fish Fry (x300 million), f-class transformation pod x5 million...”

chapters.title: Chapter 211: Seeing Through
paragraphs: Anticipating the expansion of the Divine Kingdom that would follow the absorption of the Divine Kingdom Core, Yang Da had already purchased the corresponding assets in advance.
However, the primary source of income for Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom currently remained the Spirit Vein Planet.
As for the profits from the Monkey Wine and Dragon Fish, he had now reached a point where he barely even cared for them.
Compared to the meager Divinity Points generated by the Monkey Wine Spring, the truly immensely valuable asset was actually Penglai Island itself.
After all, it had vastly expanded the residential area for his believers.
Although the profits from the Monkey Wine were not high, it still possessed some value in the end.
While Yang Fan looked down on these small, scattered profits, Yang Da, as an Intelligent Life, continued to invest and expand them.
“If only S-Rank Buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest didn’t have purchase limits,”
Yang Fan sighed softly.

If that were truly the case, he would immediately have Yang Da sell all of the Spirit Peach Mountain on Penglai Island and replace them entirely with the S-Rank resource building—the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.
The profits between the two were simply not on the same level.
But there were no such “what-ifs” in the world.
S-Rank Buildings were far too precious, so it was only natural for them to have purchase limits.
By now, the income of his Divine Kingdom had already reached an exaggerated level that far surpassed many ordinary gods.
One must learn to be content.
Yang Fan slowly exhaled.
“Yang Da, how are things going on the Void Spirit Race’s side?”
“Reporting to Master,”
Yang Da’s voice was calm.
“I have already dispatched an army to blockade the periphery of their Divine Kingdom. We can launch an attack at any moment.”
“Since the coordinates of the Void Spirit Race’s Divine Kingdom have been exposed, they are like lambs to the slaughter. There is no risk whatsoever.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded calmly.
“In that case,”
“let’s go meet this Alien Demigod.”
The Void Realm trembled.
Following the coordinates of the Divine Kingdom, a wisp of Divine Thought slowly descended.
In the next instant,
outside the Void Spirit Race’s Divine Kingdom,
the originally pitch-black and silent Void Realm suddenly rippled with a vast expanse of golden divine radiance.
A blurry yet colossal illusory image of a god slowly coalesced.
As Yang Fan’s consciousness descended,
the hundreds of millions of Human Race believers guarding the periphery immediately knelt and prostrated themselves.
The dense crowd of people spread outward like a tidal wave.
“We welcome the descent of our God!”
“We welcome the descent of our God!”
The magnificent voices echoed throughout the Void Realm.
Just then,
inside the Void Spirit Race’s Divine Kingdom, a fluctuation of Divine Thought suddenly emerged.
In the next instant,
space warped slightly,
and a petite, slender figure rushed out of the Divine Kingdom in a panic.
It was a bizarre woman who had transformed into human form.
Her skin was light purple, her ears were long and pointed, and a long, thin tail grew from her back.
Except at this moment,
her facial expression had absolutely nothing to do with the word “demigod.”
The moment she appeared, she knelt in the Void Realm with a thud.
Her tail even wagged twice subconsciously.
“Ling Xuzi, Demigod of the Void Spirit Race, greets her new Master!”
Her voice was incredibly fast and rushed, as if she were terrified of being killed if she knelt even half a second too late.
Yang Fan: “...”
He fell silent for a brief moment.
“This is a demigod?”
Yang Fan was utterly speechless.
One had to know that in Yang County, where he was born,
a demigod was a high and mighty figure, with over a dozen Subordinate Gods serving under them.
Yet now, this Alien Demigod before him had directly acknowledged him as master the moment they met?
And that appearance... no matter how one looked at it, she resembled a puppy wagging its tail and begging for pity.
It was Yang Fan’s first time seeing such a race, completely lacking even a shred of the dignity a deity should possess.
Especially her subtle actions of constantly stealing glances to gauge his expression,
which made her look exactly like she was trying to judge if her master would throw her a bone.
“Ling Xuzi?”
Yang Fan frowned.
“Is that your name?”
“Reporting to Master, yes!”
Ling Xuzi nodded hastily.
“If Master does not like it, please bestow a name upon me!”
“I am willing to serve Master faithfully from now on!”
“I am very useful!”
She spoke extremely fast, as if terrified of speaking too slowly.
“During a Divine Kingdom War, I can be responsible for gathering intelligence, tracking traces in the Void Realm, and searching for unknown Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“I am really useful!”
By the end,
Ling Xuzi even instinctively puffed out her chest,
as if trying her best to market herself.
“Please, Master, do not devour my Divine Kingdom Core.”
“I will definitely become your most loyal servant!”
Having said that,
she prostrated herself flat on the ground,
her entire body trembling violently,
as if awaiting the judgment of fate.
Meanwhile, Yang Fan remained completely silent.
A dead silence filled the surroundings, with only the vast Divine Might permeating the Void Realm, weighing down so heavily that Ling Xuzi did not even dare to raise her head.
As time ticked by, cold sweat began to bead on Ling Xuzi’s forehead.
“Raise your head,”
Yang Fan’s voice was calm.
“and look into my eyes.”
Ling Xuzi shuddered,
and then carefully raised her head.
Except at this moment, her pale golden eyes were already filled with terror.
“Those six Beast-Race Demigods attacked my Divine Kingdom simultaneously,”
“allowing me to easily obtain their Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
Yang Fan slowly looked down at her.
“You played a significant part in this, didn’t you?”
Yang Fan’s words were like a heavy hammer smashing ruthlessly against Ling Xuzi’s chest.
Her face instantly turned pale, and cold sweat poured down her forehead.
For a moment, she was at a complete loss for how to answer.
Betrayal,
no matter where it occurred, would never earn genuine trust.
If one could betray their old master for benefits today,
they might betray their new master tomorrow to save their own life.
True superiors might utilize such a person, but they would never place full trust in them without precautions.
Ling Xuzi naturally understood this logic.
If she had truly informed those six Beast-Race Demigods of the actual situation of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, they would have run away immediately.
They wouldn’t even have sent troops to station in her Divine Kingdom.
With the strength of those six fools, daring to attack a monstrous Divine Kingdom like Yang Fan’s was highly abnormal in itself.
Combined with Ling Xuzi’s current behavior,
it was not difficult for Yang Fan to guess what had transpired.
After a moment of silence,
Ling Xuzi suddenly took a deep breath,
as if she had made up her mind completely.
She slowly raised her head,
and her originally terrified and panicked eyes gradually calmed down.
“Master’s guess is correct.”
“I deliberately concealed your true strength.”
“Those six beasts... deserved to die.”
Speaking to this point,
hatred surfaced in Ling Xuzi’s eyes for the first time.
“Over the years, they constantly squeezed my Divine Kingdom.”
“Every time a Divine Kingdom War ended, no matter how many resources were harvested, they would not leave me even a fraction of it.”
“They even took my believers and sold them.”
“And a large number of my believers were used as consumables to explore Void Realm cracks.”
“If this continues, in less than a hundred years, the believers in my Divine Kingdom will go completely extinct.”
Ling Xuzi’s voice was very soft,
but the hatred in it grew increasingly intense.
However, she quickly
regained her composure.
She had originally wanted to take a gamble,
betting that Yang Fan had not noticed her little tricks,
and that by relying on the abilities of the Void Spirit Race, she could find a new master and continue to live.
After all, with the foundation Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom currently displayed,
even just a tiny bit of leftover resources leaked from his fingers would be enough for her Divine Kingdom to develop extremely well.
But since she had already been seen through by him, she had nothing left to hide.
Since she would face the blade either way,
she might as well face it with composure.

chapters.title: Chapter 212: Am I Being Too Good to My Believers?
paragraphs: At least her objective had been achieved.
Those six beasts were dead.
Thinking of this, Ling Xuzi suddenly felt much more relieved in her heart.
Even if Yang Fan swallowed her Divine Kingdom Core now,
she wouldn’t seem to hold much resentment.
At least he had avenged her.
Right at that moment, Yang Fan suddenly let out a light chuckle.
“I don’t care what you did in the past.”
“I only care about one thing.”
“Whether you can bring me value.”
Yang Fan looked down at her, his voice calm.
“If you are willing,”
“you can sign a Subordinate God Contract with me.”
“From now on, I will help you develop your divine kingdom.”
“A... Subordinate God Contract?”
Ling Xuzi snapped her head up, her pale gold eyes filled with disbelief.
The Void Spirit Race was originally seen as vassals and slaves in the eyes of many races.
Most Void Spirit Race demigods would ultimately devolve into tools kept in captivity by other races.
As for a Subordinate God Contract?
That was something she had never dared to hope for.
Because a Subordinate God Contract was recognized by the rules of divine kingdoms.
Once signed,
both parties would be bound by the rules.
If her divine kingdom came under attack,
Yang Fan would have to assume a certain degree of responsibility to protect it.
While she would be responsible for logistics, intelligence, and assisting in Divine Kingdom Wars.
But the problem was... her divine kingdom had no productive capacity at all.
She was so poor that even her believers were on the verge of starving.
Under these circumstances, there was no need for Yang Fan to sign a Subordinate God Contract.
Enslaving her directly would be the most cost-effective method.
After all, she lacked any combat capability.
Yang Fan could break through her Divine Kingdom Core at any time.
“Are you willing?”
Yang Fan spoke again.
“I am willing! I am willing!”
Ling Xuzi didn’t hesitate in the slightest.
She frantically nodded her head in a hurry.
“Ling Xuzi greets Master!”
She had no idea what Yang Fan was thinking.
But how could she refuse such a windfall?
For the Void Spirit Race, choosing a powerful master was far too important.
Compared to those six useless trash before, Yang Fan’s divine kingdom was countless times more powerful.
Only by following such a master could she see a future.
Soon, the two began to sign the Subordinate God Contract.
The rules were very simple.
Yang Fan would provide the power to protect the divine kingdom.
While Ling Xuzi needed to accept Yang Fan’s dispatch and arrangements.
The Subordinate God Contract originated from the rules of divine kingdoms to begin with.
Now, both of their consciousnesses were within the bounds of the divine kingdom.
As both parties agreed simultaneously,
a large number of divine runes rapidly surfaced in the Void Realm.
The power of rules intertwined, ultimately forming a pale-gold contract mark that sank into both of their bodies at the same time.
In the next moment, Yang Fan clearly felt a special connection form between his divine kingdom and Ling Xuzi’s divine kingdom.
A one-way divine kingdom passage slowly took shape.
As long as he was willing,
he could send a massive army into Ling Xuzi’s divine kingdom at any moment.
Having done all this,
Ling Xuzi finally breathed a long sigh of relief.
It felt as though the heavy stone weighing on her heart had finally dropped completely.
Then she hurriedly spoke in a respectful tone:
“Master, what do I need to do now?”
“Currently, there are 130 million citizens in my divine kingdom.”
“The area of the divine kingdom is 5.42 million square kilometers.”
“Among them, twenty-three are believers at the Qi Refining Stage.”
“Your subordinate can search for new divine kingdom coordinates for Master at any time!”
As she spoke,
Ling Xuzi secretly looked up at Yang Fan.
Only at this moment, an embarrassed expression appeared on her face.
Her tail swayed gently and her fingers twisted together, looking as if she hesitated to speak.
“If you have something to say, speak directly,” Yang Fan said indifferently.
“To report to Master...”
Ling Xuzi’s voice grew quieter and quieter.
“My divine kingdom... has run out of food.”
“Could you lend some aid?”
“Ordinary grain or wormwood is fine; my believers are not picky eaters.”
By the end of her words,
Ling Xuzi was too embarrassed to even raise her head.
During the years she followed those six Beast-Race Demigods,
her divine kingdom had long been squeezed to the absolute limit.
A large number of Void Spirit Race believers had not even died in Divine Kingdom Wars,
but rather... starved to death.
Yang Fan’s gaze swept over the entire divine kingdom.
He saw vast stretches of Void Spirit Race believers prostrating on the ground, every single one skin and bones.
Many even found it extremely difficult to stand up.
Especially those children,
with sunken eye sockets and weak breaths,
looking as if a gust of wind could blow them over.
“This is expecting the horse to run without giving it grass to eat.”
“They wouldn’t even part with Guanyin clay!”
Yang Fan was speechlessly exasperated in his heart.
In his view,
those Beast-Race Demigods were simply draining the pond to catch the fish.
They didn’t treat the Void Spirit Race as living beings at all.
In the next moment,
Yang Fan slowly raised his hand.
Snap.
Accompanied by a crisp snap of his fingers,
the Void Realm suddenly shook.
A spatial passage instantly opened up.
Rumble—
Like a torrential flood pouring out,
countless foodstuffs gushed wildly out of the spatial passage.
Stretches of translucent spiritual rice piled up like mountains of white jade.
Spiritual fruits emitting rich Spiritual Qi covered the ground.
Piles of processed dragon beast flesh and blood stacked up like mountains, blood qi soaring into the sky.
There was even a vast quantity of delicacy dishes processed by the Myriad Spirits Dietary Hub.
Golden, crispy roasted meat; thick soups surging with Spiritual Qi; and spiritual cakes crystal-clear like jade.
All kinds of aromas intertwined together.
Taking just a single whiff caused the eyes of countless Void Spirit Race believers to instantly turn red.
The rich aroma of food became almost tangible, permeating the entire divine kingdom.
In the next moment,
countless Void Spirit Race believers went completely wild.
“Food!!!”
“Eats!!!”
They pounced forward like reincarnated starved ghosts.
A massive number of believers even fought directly among themselves to snatch a piece of spiritual cake.
Male Void Spirits directly kicked nearby females to the ground in order to scramble for food.
Those emaciated children couldn’t even squeeze in, left to stand outside the crowd crying loudly in despair.
The entire scene completely spiraled out of control.
“Everyone stop!”
Ling Xuzi suddenly shouted coldly.
Her Divine Might spread outward.
Reverence for their deity had long been engraved deep into the bones of these believers.
Even though only the desire for food remained in their minds at this moment,
once the Divine Decree descended,
everyone still froze right in their tracks.
They stood there trembling all over, not daring to take another step closer.
“Ration according to need!”
Ling Xuzi took a deep breath.
“This food must last at least five months!”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression instantly became somewhat peculiar.
“Five months?”
The food he had just given,
normally speaking, was probably only enough for 130 million believers for about ten days.
And seeing the current state of these Void Spirits,
let alone ten days,
it might not even hold out for five days.
At this moment, Yang Fan suddenly had an extremely bizarre feeling.
It seemed... it wasn’t just that those Beast-Race Demigods squeezed them too harshly.
Ling Xuzi, as their deity, was equally ruthless.
“Was I... too good to my believers in the past?”
This thought inexplicably arose in Yang Fan’s mind.

In the next moment, Yang Fan clearly felt a special connection form between his divine kingdom and Ling Xuzi’s divine kingdom.
A one-way divine kingdom passage slowly took shape.
As long as he was willing,
he could send a massive army into Ling Xuzi’s divine kingdom at any moment.
Having done all this,
Ling Xuzi finally breathed a long sigh of relief.
It felt as though the heavy stone weighing on her heart had finally dropped completely.
Then she hurriedly spoke in a respectful tone:
“Master, what do I need to do now?”
“Currently, there are 130 million citizens in my divine kingdom.”
“The area of the divine kingdom is 5.42 million square kilometers.”
“Among them, twenty-three are believers at the Qi Refining Stage.”
“Your subordinate can search for new divine kingdom coordinates for Master at any time!”
As she spoke,
Ling Xuzi secretly looked up at Yang Fan.
Only at this moment, an embarrassed expression appeared on her face.
Her tail swayed gently and her fingers twisted together, looking as if she hesitated to speak.
“If you have something to say, speak directly,” Yang Fan said indifferently.
“To report to Master...”
Ling Xuzi’s voice grew quieter and quieter.
“My divine kingdom... has run out of food.”
“Could you lend some aid?”
“Ordinary grain or wormwood is fine; my believers are not picky eaters.”
By the end of her words,
Ling Xuzi was too embarrassed to even raise her head.
During the years she followed those six Beast-Race Demigods,
her divine kingdom had long been squeezed to the absolute limit.
A large number of Void Spirit Race believers had not even died in Divine Kingdom Wars,
but rather... starved to death.
Yang Fan’s gaze swept over the entire divine kingdom.
He saw vast stretches of Void Spirit Race believers prostrating on the ground, every single one skin and bones.
Many even found it extremely difficult to stand up.
Especially those children,
with sunken eye sockets and weak breaths,
looking as if a gust of wind could blow them over.
“This is expecting the horse to run without giving it grass to eat.”
“They wouldn’t even part with Guanyin clay!”
Yang Fan was speechlessly exasperated in his heart.
In his view,
those Beast-Race Demigods were simply draining the pond to catch the fish.
They didn’t treat the Void Spirit Race as living beings at all.
In the next moment,
Yang Fan slowly raised his hand.
Snap.
Accompanied by a crisp snap of his fingers,
the Void Realm suddenly shook.
A spatial passage instantly opened up.
Rumble—
Like a torrential flood pouring out,
countless foodstuffs gushed wildly out of the spatial passage.
Stretches of translucent spiritual rice piled up like mountains of white jade.
Spiritual fruits emitting rich Spiritual Qi covered the ground.
Piles of processed dragon beast flesh and blood stacked up like mountains, blood qi soaring into the sky.
There was even a vast quantity of delicacy dishes processed by the Myriad Spirits Dietary Hub.
Golden, crispy roasted meat; thick soups surging with Spiritual Qi; and spiritual cakes crystal-clear like jade.
All kinds of aromas intertwined together.
Taking just a single whiff caused the eyes of countless Void Spirit Race believers to instantly turn red.
The rich aroma of food became almost tangible, permeating the entire divine kingdom.
In the next moment,
countless Void Spirit Race believers went completely wild.
“Food!!!”
“Eats!!!”
They pounced forward like reincarnated starved ghosts.
A massive number of believers even fought directly among themselves to snatch a piece of spiritual cake.
Male Void Spirits directly kicked nearby females to the ground in order to scramble for food.
Those emaciated children couldn’t even squeeze in, left to stand outside the crowd crying loudly in despair.
The entire scene completely spiraled out of control.
“Everyone stop!”
Ling Xuzi suddenly shouted coldly.
Her Divine Might spread outward.
Reverence for their deity had long been engraved deep into the bones of these believers.
Even though only the desire for food remained in their minds at this moment,
once the Divine Decree descended,
everyone still froze right in their tracks.
They stood there trembling all over, not daring to take another step closer.
“Ration according to need!”
Ling Xuzi took a deep breath.
“This food must last at least five months!”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression instantly became somewhat peculiar.
“Five months?”
The food he had just given,
normally speaking, was probably only enough for 130 million believers for about ten days.
And seeing the current state of these Void Spirits,
let alone ten days,
it might not even hold out for five days.
At this moment, Yang Fan suddenly had an extremely bizarre feeling.
It seemed... it wasn’t just that those Beast-Race Demigods squeezed them too harshly.
Ling Xuzi, as their deity, was equally ruthless.
“Was I... too good to my believers in the past?”
This thought inexplicably arose in Yang Fan’s mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Cooling Down
paragraphs: Then, he directly waved his hand to interrupt Ling Xuzi.
“Alright, since you have become my Subordinate God,”
“you won’t have to worry about food issues in the future.”
“They can eat as much of these things as they want.”
As soon as these words came out, Ling Xuzi was completely stunned.
She stared blankly at Yang Fan, her eyes filled with shock.
One had to know that the Spiritual Qi in the food Yang Fan had just taken out was amazingly dense.
Let alone ordinary believers, even she in the Real World had never eaten anything like it.
At that moment, a bold idea had even popped into her mind.
After Yang Fan left, she could secretly materialize these spirit foods into the Real World to sell, and then exchange them for ordinary coarse grains to load into her Divine Kingdom.
That way, she could support at least dozens of times more population.
She had no choice; she was truly terrified of being poor.
But now, Yang Fan was telling her...
they could eat as much of these things as they wanted?
At this moment, Ling Xuzi felt like her entire worldview was crumbling.
Both were demigods, so how could the gap between them be this huge?
Right at this moment.
Yang Fan waved his hand again.
Boom!
A spring head emanating dense life aura slowly descended.
A massive amount of life aura spread like a tide.
The entire Void Spirit Race Divine Kingdom seemed to come alive at this instant.
“This is the Fountain of Life; consider it my gift to you,”
Yang Fan said calmly.
“For now, I don’t have anything I need you to do.”
“First, focus on developing your Divine Kingdom well.”
“In the future, there will naturally be a time when I need your help.”
“Thank you for the reward, Master!”
Ling Xuzi knelt on the ground in excitement, her voice trembling slightly.
The Fountain of Life.
She had naturally heard of a treasure of this level.
Forget the Fountain of Life; with the current assets of her Divine Kingdom,
she couldn’t even afford the lowest-grade Moon Well.
At this moment, Ling Xuzi felt a wave of soreness in her nose.
What kind of life... had she been living before?
Only at this moment did she finally understand.
It turned out that even when being someone’s dog, the difference could be so immense.
Some people would only squeeze out your very last drop of blood.
While others, with a casually thrown bone, could change the fate of an entire race.
“For subsequent resource requirements, you can just discuss them with my Intelligent Life.”
Leaving these words behind, Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly departed from the Void Spirit Race Divine Kingdom.
Inside the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Da stood to the side. After a moment of silence, he couldn’t help but speak up:
“Master, she is merely a Void Spirit Race demigod. Why go out of your way to nurture her?”
“Isn’t it a bit of a waste to spend these resources?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan merely shook his head gently.
“A demigod-level Void Spirit Race member is indeed not worth it.”
“But what if she becomes a deity?”
Yang Da was taken aback.
“Master, you want to nurture her into a deity?”
“That’s right,”
Yang Fan spoke slowly.
“Even as mere ranked beings, the Void Spirit Race already possesses the ability to roam in spatial interlayers.”
“After stepping into the Qi Refining Stage, they can hide within spatial rifts for extended periods.”
“Without special detection devices, even I would find it hard to spot them.”
“And if they step into the Core Formation Realm...”
Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly.
“Even within a deity’s Divine Kingdom, they could move about completely unimpeded.”
Hearing this, Yang Da couldn’t help saying, “The investment will probably not be small.”
“No matter.”
Yang Fan’s expression remained calm.
“As I am now, I don’t lack basic resources.”
“If I can truly nurture a Void Spirit Race deity in the future,”
“that small investment won’t even be worth mentioning.”
Yang Da nodded, but then felt a bit confused again.
“If so, why doesn’t Master simply give her more resources right away?”
“Relying solely on a single Fountain of Life is probably far from enough.”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan chuckled softly.
“The art of managing subordinates lies not in how much you give,”
“but in when you give it.”
“Once someone gains too much too easily, they will no longer cherish it.”
“If I directly raise her entire Divine Kingdom for her today,”
“she won’t be grateful; she will only gradually get used to it and even take it for granted.”
“However, if I give her a lifeline when she is most desperate,”
“and grant her rewards after she earns merit,”
“only then will she truly understand who gave her everything she has.”
Yang Fan’s voice was calm.
“What I need is a Void Spirit Race member who can win Divine Kingdom Wars for me,”
“not a giant baby who only knows how to stretch out its hands and demand things.”
“Resources can be given,”
“but she must know”
“that everything must be exchanged through value.”
After listening, Yang Da nodded thoughtfully.
These principles were actually things Yang Fan had learned during his time at the Primordial Academy.
Most of the time, knowledge from books isn’t necessarily inapplicable to reality.
“In books lies a house of gold, in books lies a beauty like jade.” The ancients truly did not deceive me.
Right at that moment, Yang Fan suddenly looked up toward the area where the soul nourishing wood was located in the Divine Kingdom.
The energy was growing denser and denser, clearly not far from fully maturing.
“The soul nourishing wood is about to mature.”
“During this time, do not proactively initiate any more Divine Kingdom Wars.”
“Recall all military forces and focus primarily on defense.”
Yang Fan slowly instructed.
Hearing this, Yang Da couldn’t help rolling his eyes internally.
“Master.”
“Actually, the defensive strength of our Divine Kingdom is already very strong now.”
“Even... extremely strong.”
However, Yang Fan merely gave him a cool glance.
“Do as I say.”
“This time we only encountered six trash.”
“What about next time?”
“Even a lion uses its full strength when hunting a rabbit.”
“Now that the Divine Kingdom’s development is on the right track, there is no need to rush.”
“Besides, I just absorbed a Divine Kingdom Core, so in the short term, our combat power will experience another surge.”
Yang Fan’s voice was serious, without a hint of jest.
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded obediently.
Then, he suddenly showed an expression of hesitating to speak.
“Something else?” Yang Fan asked.
Yang Da swallowed hard.
“I feel... should Master consider restoring your previous carefree, uninhibited personality?”
“Actually, if you let me manage the development of Divine Kingdom Wars and future planning, the efficiency might be a bit higher...”
Yang Da mustered his courage to say.
However, Yang Fan didn’t say a word, just watching him quietly.
The air suddenly fell silent, and feeling that increasingly dangerous gaze,
Yang Da’s scalp instantly went numb, and he hurriedly bowed his head.
“I was wrong, Master!”
“I didn’t say anything just now!”
The corner of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
Yang Da was originally a part of his own consciousness.
Scolding him was, in a sense, pretty much the same as scolding himself.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan didn’t bother to pay him any more mind.
His consciousness directly withdrew from the Divine Kingdom.
It wasn’t until Yang Fan completely left that Yang Da finally breathed a long sigh of relief.
“Phew—”
“Master has been getting more and more scary lately...”
Yang Da couldn’t help muttering softly.
Then, he suddenly called out: “Yang Yi!”
Swoosh! A figure instantly appeared.
“What orders do you have, Lord?”
“Go clean up and manage the newly built palace properly for me.”
“In addition, go buy some exotic-style clothing.”
“Have all those female cultivators in the Foundation Establishment Realm change into them.”
Yang Yi froze slightly.
“What are you planning to do, Lord?”
Yang Da remained silent for a moment.
Then, with a serious face, he said:
“Cool down.”

chapters.title: Chapter 214: Lighting a Sky Lantern in the Dark
paragraphs: The final stage before the soul nourishing wood matured.
The entire divine kingdom had completely changed its appearance.
If one looked from the Void Realm,
Yang Fan’s divine kingdom seemed to have transformed into a giant sphere of light emitting a faint golden glow.
An extremely dense Soul aura constantly diffused outward, like a bonfire in the dark night.
Frantically attracting the demigod believers wandering and exploring in the Great Void.
In just a few days,
several waves of unfamiliar forces had already appeared around the periphery of the divine kingdom.
However, these demigods were clearly much more cautious, not directly sending their believers into Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
Instead, they chose all sorts of bizarre detection methods.

Some released silver floating detection spheres, some released flesh-and-blood eyeballs, and some even used paper dolls. Floating in the turbulent space like ghosts, those things possessed almost no aura of life.
In addition to these, there were a large number of other strange detection methods.
There were mental ripples, special spiritual insects, and even transparent spore-like creatures.
As long as they approached the divine kingdom, they would automatically record the surrounding environment.
This also gave Yang Fan a true taste of the bizarre and varied detection methods of foreign races.
However, these demigods were clearly extremely cautious, not rashly letting their believers enter Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
Because once believers stepped into an enemy’s divine kingdom, it meant the Divine Kingdom War had officially begun.
If the believers were completely wiped out, one’s own divine kingdom coordinates would also be exposed.
Therefore, before officially going to war, intelligence warfare and information probing were almost inevitable stages of any Divine Kingdom War.
After all, no one wanted to inexplicably provoke an existence they absolutely could not afford to offend.
Just like the basic information attached to the divine kingdom coordinates Yang Fan had previously purchased in the Divine Shop.
In essence, it was all gathered bit by bit through similar means.
Of course, the price of divine kingdom coordinates in the Divine Shop was extremely expensive.
Not all demigods could be as wealthy and overbearing as Yang Fan.
Most demigods still preferred to let their believers explore outward.
And Yang Da dealt with these detection methods without any politeness.
The moment those detectors approached the periphery of the divine kingdom,
in the next second, they would be vaporized on the spot by a shot from the City-Annihilating Cannon, leaving absolutely no opportunity for investigation.
At this moment, in the Real World.
Yang Fan was sitting in the courtyard of the villa provided by the Primordial Academy.
A gentle breeze blew, and the spiritual bamboo in the courtyard swayed.
Not far away, Gu Le was kneeling by the stone table, carefully brewing tea for Yang Fan.
White mist slowly rose, and the aroma of tea overflowed.
Meanwhile, Yang Fan was half-reclining on a rocking chair, flipping through a newly purchased book in his hand—’Subordinate God System Construction and Loyalty Control’.
The title of the book was simple and straightforward, but the content inside was quite useful to Yang Fan.
Gently turning a page, Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly.
Then he sighed softly,
“The storm is coming.”
Gu Le was slightly stunned upon hearing this.
“Husband, what storm is coming?”
“It’s nothing.”
Yang Fan smiled.
“Just some annoying flies.”
Now, there were only two or three days left before the soul nourishing wood matured, which was also the time when its aura was densest.
Only now did Yang Fan finally truly understand
why neither demigods nor gods were willing to plant soul nourishing wood on a large scale.
The risk of exposing the divine kingdom’s coordinates was simply too high.
Time slowly passed.
Finally, it was the eve of the soul nourishing wood’s maturation.
Yang Fan, who was resting in reality, suddenly heard Yang Da’s call.
In the next instant, his consciousness immediately entered his divine kingdom.
“Master.”
Yang Da’s expression turned solemn.
“Once my detection equipment leaves the range of the divine kingdom, it immediately loses connection.”
“No information is being transmitted back.”
“At this point, I’m afraid many enemies have already gathered around the periphery of the divine kingdom.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly.
“they are waiting for the soul nourishing wood to mature?”
“Exactly.”
Yang Da nodded.
“And there are quite a few of them coming.”
“I’m afraid many people want to take this opportunity to reap some benefits.”
“Heh.”
Yang Fan suddenly sneered.
“Since that’s the case,”
“then let’s wait and see.”
“It just so happens that some people are delivering divine kingdom coordinates for free, saving us from having to continue buying them in the Divine Shop.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan’s gaze was ice-cold.
Staring intently in the direction of the divine kingdom’s periphery, he even subconsciously licked his lips, like a beast eyeing its prey.
“Send orders to Ling Xuzi.”
“Have her send Qi Refining Stage believers out to investigate.”
“Let’s see exactly how many blind demigods there are.”
“Yes!”
Yang Da immediately nodded.
Soon, the order was dispatched.
In just a moment, Ling Xuzi’s consciousness phantom appeared in front of Yang Fan.
Compared to before, her current state was clearly much better.
She looked refreshed, and a bit of color had returned to her face.
“Master.”
“I have already dispatched ten Qi Refining Stage believers to investigate.”
“There will be results soon.”
However, halfway through her sentence,
Ling Xuzi seemed to suddenly see something through her believers’ field of vision, and her entire body instantly froze on the spot.
Her face turned visibly pale.
“Ma... Master...”
“This is bad!”
Ling Xuzi’s voice trembled slightly.
“Outside... there are twenty demigods outside!”
“Among them are the Human Race, Beast Race, Undead Race, Bug Race...”
Clearly, she was completely terrified by the scene she saw.
Yang Fan, however, merely waved his hand calmly. “How is their strength?”
“My believers didn’t dare to get too close.”
Ling Xuzi wiped the cold sweat from her forehead.
“In each wave of forces, there are several thousand Foundation Establishment Realm believers.”
“And those are just the vanguard.”
When had Ling Xuzi ever seen a war scale of this magnitude?
At this moment, she only felt her scalp go numb.
She didn’t even understand why her newly acknowledged master was suddenly targeted by so many demigods.
Moreover, they were existences from different races.
Human Race, Beast Race, Undead Race, Bug Race...
These forces, which usually slaughtered each other, now seemed to have formed a strange, unspoken agreement, all waiting for an opportunity.
Ling Xuzi slowly turned her head, sensing the increasingly dense Soul aura within Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
Her voice trembled slightly.
“Ma... Master.”
“Just how much soul nourishing wood did you plant?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan only smiled faintly.
“Not much.”
“Only five trillion trees.”
“And they are almost ten thousand years old.”
The moment these words were spoken, Ling Xuzi instantly froze in place.
Her mind was left completely blank.
“Crazy!”
“No wonder it attracted the covetous eyes of so many demigods!”
“This was simply—lighting a sky lantern in the dark night, terrified that others wouldn’t know how rich he was!”
“Master.”
Ling Xuzi hurriedly spoke.
“These people are not of one mind.”
“Perhaps... we can distribute a portion of the soul nourishing wood.”
“As long as they see profit, they might not fight to the death.”
As a Subordinate God, she shouldn’t have spoken out of turn.
But the problem was, she had only just found such a good master in Yang Fan.
“She really didn’t want to change allegiance so quickly!”
However, Yang Fan only spoke calmly, “Just watch in peace.”

Meanwhile, Yang Fan was half-reclining on a rocking chair, flipping through a newly purchased book in his hand—’Subordinate God System Construction and Loyalty Control’.
The title of the book was simple and straightforward, but the content inside was quite useful to Yang Fan.
Gently turning a page, Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly.
Then he sighed softly,
“The storm is coming.”
Gu Le was slightly stunned upon hearing this.
“Husband, what storm is coming?”
“It’s nothing.”
Yang Fan smiled.
“Just some annoying flies.”
Now, there were only two or three days left before the soul nourishing wood matured, which was also the time when its aura was densest.
Only now did Yang Fan finally truly understand
why neither demigods nor gods were willing to plant soul nourishing wood on a large scale.
The risk of exposing the divine kingdom’s coordinates was simply too high.
Time slowly passed.
Finally, it was the eve of the soul nourishing wood’s maturation.
Yang Fan, who was resting in reality, suddenly heard Yang Da’s call.
In the next instant, his consciousness immediately entered his divine kingdom.
“Master.”
Yang Da’s expression turned solemn.
“Once my detection equipment leaves the range of the divine kingdom, it immediately loses connection.”
“No information is being transmitted back.”
“At this point, I’m afraid many enemies have already gathered around the periphery of the divine kingdom.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly.
“they are waiting for the soul nourishing wood to mature?”
“Exactly.”
Yang Da nodded.
“And there are quite a few of them coming.”
“I’m afraid many people want to take this opportunity to reap some benefits.”
“Heh.”
Yang Fan suddenly sneered.
“Since that’s the case,”
“then let’s wait and see.”
“It just so happens that some people are delivering divine kingdom coordinates for free, saving us from having to continue buying them in the Divine Shop.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan’s gaze was ice-cold.
Staring intently in the direction of the divine kingdom’s periphery, he even subconsciously licked his lips, like a beast eyeing its prey.
“Send orders to Ling Xuzi.”
“Have her send Qi Refining Stage believers out to investigate.”
“Let’s see exactly how many blind demigods there are.”
“Yes!”
Yang Da immediately nodded.
Soon, the order was dispatched.
In just a moment, Ling Xuzi’s consciousness phantom appeared in front of Yang Fan.
Compared to before, her current state was clearly much better.
She looked refreshed, and a bit of color had returned to her face.
“Master.”
“I have already dispatched ten Qi Refining Stage believers to investigate.”
“There will be results soon.”
However, halfway through her sentence,
Ling Xuzi seemed to suddenly see something through her believers’ field of vision, and her entire body instantly froze on the spot.
Her face turned visibly pale.
Master...”
“This is bad!”
Ling Xuzi’s voice trembled slightly.
“Outside... there are twenty demigods outside!”
“Among them are the Human Race, Beast Race, Undead Race, Bug Race...”
Clearly, she was completely terrified by the scene she saw.
Yang Fan, however, merely waved his hand calmly.
“How is their strength?”
“My believers didn’t dare to get too close.”
Ling Xuzi wiped the cold sweat from her forehead.
“In each wave of forces, there are several thousand Foundation Establishment Realm believers.”
“And those are just the vanguard.”
When had Ling Xuzi ever seen a war scale of this magnitude?
At this moment, she only felt her scalp go numb.
She didn’t even understand why her newly acknowledged master was suddenly targeted by so many demigods.
Moreover, they were existences from different races.
Human Race, Beast Race, Undead Race, Bug Race...
These forces, which usually slaughtered each other, now seemed to have formed a strange, unspoken agreement, all waiting for an opportunity.
Ling Xuzi slowly turned her head, sensing the increasingly dense Soul aura within Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
Her voice trembled slightly.
Master.”
“Just how much soul nourishing wood did you plant?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan only smiled faintly.
“Not much.”
“Only five trillion trees.”
“And they are almost ten thousand years old.”
The moment these words were spoken, Ling Xuzi instantly froze in place.
Her mind was left completely blank.
“Crazy!”
“No wonder it attracted the covetous eyes of so many demigods!”
“This was simply—lighting a sky lantern in the dark night, terrified that others wouldn’t know how rich he was!”
“Master.”
Ling Xuzi hurriedly spoke.
“These people are not of one mind.”
“Perhaps... we can distribute a portion of the soul nourishing wood.”
“As long as they see profit, they might not fight to the death.”
As a Subordinate God, she shouldn’t have spoken out of turn.
But the problem was, she had only just found such a good master in Yang Fan.
“She really didn’t want to change allegiance so quickly!”
However, Yang Fan only spoke calmly, “Just watch in peace.”

chapters.title: Chapter 215: Twenty Demigods Invade
paragraphs: Hearing this, Ling Xuzi was slightly taken aback.
A hint of coldness slowly surfaced in Yang Fan’s eyes.
Since he was prepared to nurture Ling Xuzi,
then first, he had to completely domesticate her.
The Fountain of Life, infinitely supplied spiritual grain, and dragon meat—this was the carrot.
And letting her witness this war with her own eyes next was the stick.
Only by letting the other party truly witness his power
would she understand what kind of existence she was following.
Right at this moment,
Boom!!!
The entire Divine Kingdom suddenly vibrated violently.
The next moment, all the soul nourishing wood simultaneously erupted with brilliant divine light.
Seeing that, the trunks that were already towering into the clouds began to surge crazily once more.
The thick roots plunged into the earth like true dragons, their branches and leaves blotting out the sky, with every single leaf emitting a faint golden radiance.
A terrifyingly extreme Soul aura instantly soared into the sky.
At this moment,
the entire Divine Kingdom seemed to have transformed into a burning Soul sun.
However, Yang Fan’s gaze did not fall on those matured soul nourishing wood.
Instead, he slowly looked toward the outer perimeter of the Divine Kingdom.
“Have they finally arrived...”
Yang Fan murmured softly.
The next second,
Rumble!!!
Large areas of space suddenly tore apart.
Terrifying space cracks spread out like spiderwebs.
Following closely, countless alien believers poured in crazily.
Charging out first was the Undead Race.
A large number of undead knights wrapped in Death Qi came riding bone dragons.
In the sky, flocks of ghouls let out ear-piercing screeches.
And behind them was an endless legion of bones.
On the other side, the beast-race army roared out, with a large number of giant beasts dozens of meters tall shattering the Void Realm.
Behemoths, blood wolves, the Golden Lion Clan...
The terrifying blood Qi swept across all directions like a wave.
And the most terrifying part was the Zerg, whose dense sea of insects almost obscured the entire sky.
A pitch-black mass wriggled crazily, and giant flying insects continuously emitted sharp hisses.
It made one’s scalp tingle.
Aside from that, there was also a well-equipped Human Race legion.
A large number of Human Race Cultivators clad in battle armor formed battle Formations.
Although these believers were not of the same faction,
at this moment, all of their gazes fell uniformly upon that Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall spanning across heaven and earth.
Upon the city wall,
a large number of City-Annihilating Cannons emitted a cold, freezing light, and a rich aura of destruction constantly diffused.
Even before firing, it made people feel a suffocating sense of oppression.
At the outer perimeter of the Divine Kingdom,
phantom projections of demigods slowly emerged, with as many as twenty divine consciousnesses standing tall in the Void Realm.
In everyone’s eyes looking toward the soul nourishing wood, there was undisguised greed.
“Tsk tsk.”
“The owner of this Divine Kingdom actually dares to cultivate so much ten-thousand-year soul nourishing wood.”
“They have both the strength and the courage.”
A Beast-Race Demigod sneered and spoke.
“I thought we’d have to wait a bit longer; I didn’t expect them to mature so quickly.”
Another voice slowly sounded.
Subsequently, a demigod shrouded entirely in black fog said indifferently:
“Will the owner of this Divine Kingdom not show themselves for a meeting?”
“We have no intention of fighting to the death.”
“However, with so many Resources, you must surely share some out.”
“Give me one million ten-thousand-year soul nourishing wood.”
“I will withdraw my troops immediately.”
Although they sounded strong with their words,
at this moment,
these demigods still felt their scalps tingling as they looked at the massive amount of City-Annihilating Cannons on the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
They were all very clear in their hearts:
the Divine Kingdom before them was outrageously strong.
No one wanted to truly risk their lives fighting such an existence.
In their view, as long as they could extort a sum today,
they would absolutely never look at the coordinates of this Divine Kingdom again in the future.
However, right at this time,
Boom!!!
A terrifying Divine Might suddenly descended.
The next moment, Yang Fan’s figure instantly transformed into a ten-thousand-foot giant, standing between heaven and earth.
He slowly lowered his head, looking down at all the invaders.
“So many demigods have actually come.”
“And their strengths are all pretty good.”
Yang Fan’s tone was icy.
“Very good.”
Saying this,
his gaze suddenly fell upon the only Human Race member among the twenty demigods.
Unlike the other demigods, this person’s consciousness projection was extremely blurry, as if intentionally concealed by some kind of power.
Making it impossible to see their true appearance.
“You too want to participate in this battle?”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“Why hide and cover up?”
Hearing this, that blurry figure smiled slowly.
However, the voice was extremely hoarse, obviously having undergone special processing.
“Apologies.”
“Just a little trick.”
“After all, I don’t want to violate the Federation laws either.”
“Joining forces with alien races to attack our own kind.”
“If you really manage to catch evidence, I will still have some trouble to varying degrees.”
“I only seek wealth.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan immediately gave a disdainful chuckle.
“Since that is the case...”
“then your Divine Kingdom coordinates—”
“I’ll accept them.”
As Yang Fan’s voice fell,
the war officially began!
In the Void Realm, that ten-thousand-foot divine projection slowly dissipated.
Meanwhile, upon the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall,
countless City-Annihilating Cannons simultaneously changed their directions.
Their cold muzzles locked uniformly onto the outer perimeter of the Divine Kingdom.
Seeing this scene, the twenty demigods present all furrowed their brows tightly.
One fighting twenty,
and yet he still dared to be so decisive?
“Heh.”
“The Human Race is indeed as arrogant as ever.”
A Beast-Race Demigod sneered and spoke.
“Seems like a Genius.”
“Just right...”
“I love killing geniuses the most!”
On the other side, an Undead Demigod shrouded entirely in black fog said in a deep voice:
“Attack together!”
“The Spiritual Qi of this Divine Kingdom is so dense; there must definitely be a large number of Spiritual Veins laid out inside.”
“When the time comes, everyone will split them equally.”
“Once this job is done,”
“no one will know anyone else!”
The next second,
Boom!!!
a dazzling white light suddenly shot down from the city head.
Terrifying energy tore through space.
And at the very moment the City-Annihilating Cannons fired,
dozens of massive Formations rose simultaneously around the outer perimeter of the Divine Kingdom.
Rumble!!!
Violent explosions shook heaven and earth.
However, these twenty demigods were clearly not simple characters; not a single one of them was weak.
The Formations they deployed were bizarre and varied.
Some transformed into blood-colored light barriers, some summoned undead barriers, and others condensed starlight projections.
What was even more terrifying was that almost all of these Formations had reached the Major Achievement level.
Under the blessing of numerous Formations, the City-Annihilating Cannons’ attacks, which were sufficient to destroy a city, were forcefully blocked.
Although a large number of believers were still shaken to death by the shockwaves,
the overall battle line was still constantly pushing forward.
Their objective was very clear:
breach the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall and seize all Resources within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
However, shortly after these alien armies advanced,
a large number of believers suddenly plunged into quagmires.
large swathes of the ground had somehow transformed into a toxic swamp, instantly swallowing up numerous low-tier believers who let out miserable screams.
Although the armies brought by these demigods possessed quite a few Foundation Establishment Realm and Qi Refining Stage believers,
yet even more of them were merely ranked beings.
And ranked beings did not possess flight capabilities; now, facing the massively covered Thousand Poison Swamp, their scope of movement was instantly severely restricted.
“Dammit!”
“Just how much Thousand Poison Swamp did this guy buy?”
“How fucking disgusting!”
An Undead Demigod snorted coldly and spoke.
