chapters.title: Chapter 216: Completely Panicked
paragraphs: The next moment, a necromancer under his command suddenly raised his staff.
Boom!
A massive ice spike instantly pierced into the ground.
In the blink of an eye, an area several kilometers around was completely frozen, turning a large expanse of the poisonous swamp to ice.
“A mere C-grade defense structure.”
“It can’t stop me!”
The Undead Demigod laughed aloud.
“My believers specialize in ice magic.”
“Do you want me to clear the path for you?”
“When we capture this divine kingdom, I get to pick a building first!”
“No need for me,” the Insectoid Demigod sneered from the side.
“These swamps have no effect on me.”
“If I weren’t waiting for you, my insectoid army might have already flown past this wretched city wall.”
Hearing the Insectoid Demigod’s boasting, a Beast-Race Demigod mocked, “Tch, aren’t you just afraid of losing too many of your believers?”
“If you’ve got the guts, charge ahead alone. I definitely won’t stop you!”
The group of demigods was even casually bantering with each other as they advanced.
Meanwhile, deep within the divine kingdom, Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“The Thousand Poison Swamp is still too ordinary after all.”
“As the enemies get stronger,”
“the role it can play has become limited.”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan slowly turned his head to look at Yang Da.
“The weight of this batch of invaders should be enough to test the divine kingdom’s current defense system, right?”
“Let me see...”
“...to what extent the divine kingdom’s defenses have reached now.”
Hearing this, Yang Da took a deep breath.
A trace of excitement even surfaced in his eyes.
“Yes, Master!”
The next moment.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Accompanied by the roar of massive engines, countless f3500 fighter jets soared into the air simultaneously.
Their pitch-black fuselages gleamed with cold metallic light, their streamlined designs exuding a strong sense of advanced technology.
The psionic thrusters at their tails spewed blue flames, resembling a flock of steel raptors slicing through the sky.
At the same time, the Eye of God in the sky rotated slowly.
Beams of scanning light swept across the entire battlefield.
The locations of all enemy forces were instantly and precisely locked on.
The next second.
Boom!
Countless laser cannons opened fire frantically.
A massive hail of armor-piercing shells poured down like torrential rain, while psionic burst missiles continuously bombarded the ground.
The battlefield instantly turned into a living hell.
Numerous foreign believers were pierced straight through by lasers.
Some insectoids were blown into minced meat on the spot.
The beast-race legions were blasted by a salvo of missiles, sending flesh and blood flying everywhere.
Most terrifyingly, with the enhancement of the Eye of God,
the attacks of these f3500 fighter jets were terrifyingly accurate, hardly ever missing a shot.
For a moment, the entire battlefield descended into complete chaos.
Flames of war reached the heavens; technological weapons, torrents of magic, military Formation power, Flying Swords, Magic Treasures...
all kinds of attacks wildly interwoven.
The entire sky seemed about to be shattered completely.
At this moment, the expressions of those twenty demigods finally began to turn solemn.
“Fuck!”
“Just how much defense force did this guy deploy?”
“Is he really that rich?”
A Beast-Race Demigod couldn’t help but curse loudly.
Another demigod suddenly turned to look at the Human Demigod who was hiding his identity.
“A scion of your Human Race’s Five Great Giants?”
At this moment, that Human Demigod was also feeling panicked inside, even starting to regret stepping foot into this place.
Others might not recognize it, but he did.
The f3500 fighter jet.
That was a genuine B-grade defensive weapon!
The problem was... there were too many of them.
“Hundreds of thousands of them?”
“What fucking demigod could squander resources like this?”
On the outer battlefield, countless foreign believers were dying rapidly.
Although defense Formations could block direct hits from the City-Annihilating Cannon, it was impossible to achieve 360-degree coverage with zero blind spots.
The City-Annihilating Cannon had immense power, making it easy to target in advance.
But the f3500 fighter jets were different; they were extremely fast, and their attack angles were virtually impossible to guard against.
They bombarded and slaughtered frantically from almost all directions.
In just a short moment, the foreign alliance had already lost nearly one-fifth of its believers.
Right at this moment.
Buzz!!!
Swarms of insectoids suddenly took to the air.
Densely covering the sky.
Immediately after, those insectoids actually began to split frantically.
Shrinking rapidly, they eventually turned into countless tiny black dots that frantically burrowed into the interiors of the fighter jets.
They began chewing through circuits and destroying core structures.
In the blink of an eye, a large number of f3500 fighter jets in the sky went out of control.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
One jet after another exploded in midair, plummeting to the ground as burning fireballs.
However, just as the insectoid swarm was wreaking havoc,
Boom!
A massive ice pillar suddenly shot straight into the sky.
Freezing air swept through heaven and earth, and in the blink of an eye,
large numbers of insectoids were frozen solid mid-air.
The Insectoid Demigod immediately swore, “What the hell is that?”
“The nine profound ice tower, a B-grade defense building,” the Human Demigod said in a heavy voice.
Except now, his tone was clearly no longer as calm as before.
“Damn it...”
“Isn’t his capital a bit too exaggerated?”
Another demigod’s expression was unsightly to the extreme.
“With our current forces, we can’t break in at all.”
“Should we fight or retreat? Give us a straight answer!”
No one expected that twenty demigods joining forces
would encounter such a huge obstacle right after stepping into the outer perimeter of the divine kingdom.
If things continued like this, the vanguard forces they brought would likely be completely slaughtered before even getting close to the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
Right then, that Human Demigod suddenly gritted his teeth hard.
“We can’t retreat!”
“The stronger his divine kingdom, the more terrifying his divine kingdom assets are!”
“And don’t forget... today we have already exposed our own divine kingdom coordinates.”
“If we just retreat like this, who knows if this person will come knocking on our doors one by one later?”
“Since we’ve already kicked a steel plate,”
“we might as well work together and kick this steel plate into pieces!”
“Today isn’t just for wealth—”
“it’s to save our own lives!”
By the time he finished, the Human Demigod’s voice even carried a hint of ruthlessness.
At this moment, he was completely panicked inside.
If the enemy really was a monster nurtured by one of the Human Race’s Five Great Giants Families,
once his identity was found out, let alone him,
even the Family behind him would likely be uprooted entirely.
Most of the time, what people fear most isn’t doing the wrong thing,
but entertaining foolish hopes after making a mistake.
Since they had already drawn their blades, they could never leave their enemy a chance to breathe.
Otherwise, if they spared someone today,
tomorrow, that person might return stepping over their corpses.
Cut the grass without removing the roots, and it will grow again with the spring breeze.
Hearing these words, the expressions of the other demigods gradually turned grave.
They had originally come solely for the soul nourishing wood.
But now, after witnessing the true depth of Yang Fan’s divine kingdom foundation,
everyone began to worry about their own safety instead.
Because the gap was simply too huge.
Even up until now, the opponent’s divine kingdom believers hadn’t even taken action.
If it were one-on-one,
even in their own home divine kingdom territory, they might not be confident in stopping such a monster.
“Let me fight with everything we’ve got!”
“The timid starve while the bold feast!”
“Help me block the nine profound ice tower.”
“I’ll go deal with those flying machines.”
“When the time comes, I want to pick a piece of spoils first!”
“Alright!”

“Let me see...”
“...to what extent the divine kingdom’s defenses have reached now.”
Hearing this, Yang Da took a deep breath.
A trace of excitement even surfaced in his eyes.
“Yes, Master!”
The next moment.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Accompanied by the roar of massive engines, countless f3500 fighter jets soared into the air simultaneously.
Their pitch-black fuselages gleamed with cold metallic light, their streamlined designs exuding a strong sense of advanced technology.
The psionic thrusters at their tails spewed blue flames, resembling a flock of steel raptors slicing through the sky.
At the same time, the Eye of God in the sky rotated slowly.
Beams of scanning light swept across the entire battlefield.
The locations of all enemy forces were instantly and precisely locked on.
The next second.
Boom!
Countless laser cannons opened fire frantically.
A massive hail of armor-piercing shells poured down like torrential rain, while psionic burst missiles continuously bombarded the ground.
The battlefield instantly turned into a living hell.
Numerous foreign believers were pierced straight through by lasers.
Some insectoids were blown into minced meat on the spot.
The beast-race legions were blasted by a salvo of missiles, sending flesh and blood flying everywhere.
Most terrifyingly, with the enhancement of the Eye of God,
the attacks of these f3500 fighter jets were terrifyingly accurate, hardly ever missing a shot.
For a moment, the entire battlefield descended into complete chaos.
Flames of war reached the heavens; technological weapons, torrents of magic, military Formation power, Flying Swords, Magic Treasures...
all kinds of attacks wildly interwoven.
The entire sky seemed about to be shattered completely.
At this moment, the expressions of those twenty demigods finally began to turn solemn.
“Fuck!”
“Just how much defense force did this guy deploy?”
“Is he really that rich?”
A Beast-Race Demigod couldn’t help but curse loudly.
Another demigod suddenly turned to look at the Human Demigod who was hiding his identity.
“A scion of your Human Race’s Five Great Giants?”
At this moment, that Human Demigod was also feeling panicked inside, even starting to regret stepping foot into this place.
Others might not recognize it, but he did.
The f3500 fighter jet.
That was a genuine B-grade defensive weapon!
The problem was... there were too many of them.
“Hundreds of thousands of them?”
“What fucking demigod could squander resources like this?”
On the outer battlefield, countless foreign believers were dying rapidly.
Although defense Formations could block direct hits from the City-Annihilating Cannon, it was impossible to achieve 360-degree coverage with zero blind spots.
The City-Annihilating Cannon had immense power, making it easy to target in advance.
But the f3500 fighter jets were different; they were extremely fast, and their attack angles were virtually impossible to guard against.
They bombarded and slaughtered frantically from almost all directions.
In just a short moment, the foreign alliance had already lost nearly one-fifth of its believers.
Right at this moment.
Buzz!!!
Swarms of insectoids suddenly took to the air.
Densely covering the sky.
Immediately after, those insectoids actually began to split frantically.
Shrinking rapidly, they eventually turned into countless tiny black dots that frantically burrowed into the interiors of the fighter jets.
They began chewing through circuits and destroying core structures.
In the blink of an eye, a large number of f3500 fighter jets in the sky went out of control.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
One jet after another exploded in midair, plummeting to the ground as burning fireballs.
However, just as the insectoid swarm was wreaking havoc,
Boom!
A massive ice pillar suddenly shot straight into the sky.
Freezing air swept through heaven and earth, and in the blink of an eye,
large numbers of insectoids were frozen solid mid-air.
The Insectoid Demigod immediately swore, “What the hell is that?”
“The nine profound ice tower, a B-grade defense building,” the Human Demigod said in a heavy voice.
Except now, his tone was clearly no longer as calm as before.
“Damn it...”
“Isn’t his capital a bit too exaggerated?”
Another demigod’s expression was unsightly to the extreme.
“With our current forces, we can’t break in at all.”
“Should we fight or retreat?
Give us a straight answer!”
No one expected that twenty demigods joining forces
would encounter such a huge obstacle right after stepping into the outer perimeter of the divine kingdom.
If things continued like this, the vanguard forces they brought would likely be completely slaughtered before even getting close to the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
Right then, that Human Demigod suddenly gritted his teeth hard.
“We can’t retreat!”
“The stronger his divine kingdom, the more terrifying his divine kingdom assets are!”
“And don’t forget... today we have already exposed our own divine kingdom coordinates.”
“If we just retreat like this, who knows if this person will come knocking on our doors one by one later?”
“Since we’ve already kicked a steel plate,”
“we might as well work together and kick this steel plate into pieces!”
“Today isn’t just for wealth—”
“it’s to save our own lives!”
By the time he finished, the Human Demigod’s voice even carried a hint of ruthlessness.
At this moment, he was completely panicked inside.
If the enemy really was a monster nurtured by one of the Human Race’s Five Great Giants Families,
once his identity was found out, let alone him,
even the Family behind him would likely be uprooted entirely.
Most of the time, what people fear most isn’t doing the wrong thing,
but entertaining foolish hopes after making a mistake.
Since they had already drawn their blades, they could never leave their enemy a chance to breathe.
Otherwise, if they spared someone today,
tomorrow, that person might return stepping over their corpses.
Cut the grass without removing the roots, and it will grow again with the spring breeze.
Hearing these words, the expressions of the other demigods gradually turned grave.
They had originally come solely for the soul nourishing wood.
But now, after witnessing the true depth of Yang Fan’s divine kingdom foundation,
everyone began to worry about their own safety instead.
Because the gap was simply too huge.
Even up until now, the opponent’s divine kingdom believers hadn’t even taken action.
If it were one-on-one,
even in their own home divine kingdom territory, they might not be confident in stopping such a monster.
“Let me fight with everything we’ve got!”
“The timid starve while the bold feast!”
“Help me block the nine profound ice tower.”
“I’ll go deal with those flying machines.”
“When the time comes, I want to pick a piece of spoils first!”
“Alright!”

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Escape!
paragraphs: In the next moment.
Rumble!!!
A massive number of spatial rifts appeared simultaneously.
Countless believers surged frantically into Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
The war—completely escalated!
In just a brief moment,
the number of living beings gathered on the outskirts of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had already exceeded fifty billion!
Because the outskirts of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom were covered with the Thousand Poison Swamp,
if one’s strength was too weak, let alone participating in the war,
they would probably be poisoned to death by the environment the moment they entered the Divine Kingdom.
Therefore, the weakest of these alien believers were Tier 5 Beings.
Even the cannon fodder insect soldiers sent by the Zerg Race were far more ferocious than ordinary Zerg.
Boom!!!
Accompanied by deafening explosions, the entire battlefield was completely transformed into a meat grinder.
In the sky, hundreds of thousands of f3500 fighter jets darted frantically, constantly sweeping with torrents of lasers.
On the ground, the City-Annihilating Cannons roared time and again.
With every fire, a vast area would be directly vaporized.
Meanwhile, the nine profound ice towers constantly condensed icy storms, freezing large numbers of Zerg and Beast-Race legions.
However, these Alien Demigods were not fools either.
They quickly began to demonstrate cooperation.
The Zerg were responsible for disrupting the fighter jets, with massive micro-insect swarms frantically boring into the Mechanical interiors.
The Undead Race used necromantic Spells to form death barriers, weakening the power of the City-Annihilating Cannons.
The Beast-Race deployed defensive Formations, forcibly pushing forward the battle lines.
The Human Race Cultivators controlled war Formations, repeatedly and precisely bombarding the nine profound ice towers.
Boom!!!
Another nine profound ice tower violently exploded, sending a massive amount of ice shards flying through the air.
At the same time, f3500 fighter jets in the sky were constantly being corroded by the insect swarms, exploding and crashing.
In a short amount of time, the loss of fighter jets had already exceeded ten thousand.
Meanwhile, the casualties of the alien coalition forces were equally horrifying.
A massive number of believers kept falling, their corpses piling into mountains, and their blood nearly dyeing the entire outskirts of the Divine Kingdom red.
A thick, bloody stench wafted over, making even the air feel as if it had become viscous.
Tens of billions of living beings were fighting frantically on this land.
At this moment, the so-called Divine Kingdom War truly revealed its horror.
This was not a personal brawl, but a collision between civilizations.
It was a comprehensive confrontation of resources, systems, races, and war heritage.
For a moment, the battle situation between both sides actually fell into a stalemate.
Meanwhile, Ling Xuzi, standing beside Yang Fan, already had her scalp tingling with numbness, completely dumbfounded.
She could not imagine just how many Divinity Points this newly acknowledged master of hers had poured into the Divine Kingdom’s defense system.
Yet, in the face of such a terrifying offensive, Yang Fan still sat calmly, without the slightest hint of worry on his face.
At the same time, atop the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, a large number of the Elf Race finally officially joined the battlefield.
Clad in light armor, they stood high upon the city walls, drawing their longbows fully in unison.
One arrow after another, radiating green spiritual light, shot out instantly.
Their targets were all enemies at or above the Qi Refining Stage.
Even Foundation Establishment Realm beings dared not look down on the arrows shot by these elves.
“His Divine Kingdom actually has Adult Elf followers as well!”
“Quick, set up a defensive Formation!”
A demigod’s expression changed abruptly.
Foundation Establishment Realm believers were the core of the Formations; if they died in large numbers, the power of the Formations would inevitably plummet.
“Damn it!”
“No wonder he dared to plant so much soul nourishing wood!”
“Could this bastard be fishing?”
“Deliberately baiting us to expose our Divine Kingdom coordinates, and then swallowing our Divine Kingdom Cores?”
As soon as these words were spoken, the expressions of many demigods changed instantly.
Because the more they thought about it, the more they felt it was possible.
“Everyone, don’t hold back anymore!”
“If we keep dragging this out, even our own Divine Kingdoms will be in danger!”
In the next moment.
Rumble!!!
Even more spatial rifts frantically appeared, and a massive number of reinforcements descended once again.
In a short amount of time,
the number of the alien coalition forces on the outskirts of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had already skyrocketed to seventy or eighty billion!
Blotting out the sky and covering the earth, they were boundless and endless.
That terrifying sense of oppression even caused the entire sky to dim, as if doomsday had arrived.
Seeing this scene, Ling Xuzi’s voice trembled slightly.
“Ma... Master.”
“There are too many enemies, we...”
Yang Fan merely raised his hand gently, gesturing for her to remain silent.
Then, he slowly turned his head to look at Yang Da.
“What do you think?”
Yang Da heard this and suddenly revealed a sinister smile.
“Reporting to Master.”
“These invaders have already had their courage shattered.”
“In order to breach the Divine Kingdom, they have mobilized almost all of their core combat forces here.”
“it is about time to pull in the net.”
“As long as we wipe out this batch of active forces,”
“invading their Divine Kingdoms next will be much easier.”
Hearing these words, a look of gratification immediately appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
As expected of his own Incarnation of Will.
Without him needing to say it explicitly, their thoughts were completely aligned.
After all, this was his own native Divine Kingdom, supported by so many defensive structures.
The war losses would be greatly reduced!
Rumble!!!
The entire sky suddenly darkened.
Just above the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, a colossally massive Warship slowly emerged.
The hull spanned heaven and earth, blotting out the sky and sun, like a steel continent floating above the firmament.
Just by hovering there, it radiated a suffocating pressure.
At this moment, the entire battlefield fell into an eerie silence for an instant.
All the alien believers, and even those demigods, subconsciously stopped their movements.
For the first time, genuine terror surfaced in their eyes.
It was an instinctive fear born from facing the unknown.
“W-What... what is this thing?”
The Undead Demigod’s voice trembled.
He hurriedly looked at the Human Demigod.
“Speak quickly!”
“I... I don’t know either.”
That Human Demigod’s face had already gone completely pale.
“I have never seen such a war weapon before.”
Although the Great Void Warship had not yet actually launched an attack,
everyone felt an extremely terrifying sense of oppression.
It was as if the moment it moved, the entire battlefield would be completely crushed.
And right at this moment, a Beast-Race Demigod seemed to finally recognize something, his face instantly turning deathly pale.
“Not good!”
“Run!”
“This is a war weapon used by gods fighting on the Human Race’s Frontline!”
“Staying here any longer is just waiting for death!”
As his voice fell, that Beast-Race Demigod did not even care about the others, directly leading his subordinate believers to flee frantically toward the outskirts of the Divine Kingdom.
However, it was already too late.
Buzz—
The Great Void Warship suddenly vibrated slowly.
In the next second, an incredibly massive white orb of light began to rapidly condense at its bottom.
The surrounding space began to warp extensively.
Void Cannon!
Boom!!!
Accompanied by a deafening roar,
the terrifying beam of light instantly slammed into the densest area of the aliens.
Those defensive Formations, which were originally indestructible, were like paper in front of the Void Cannon.
They shattered with a bang!
In the next moment,
a vast number of alien believers were completely vaporized, turning into ashes before they could even let out a scream.
The defeat was like a landslide.
At this moment, all the invaders completely lost their Battle Intent.
No one thought about breaching the Divine Kingdom anymore.
Only one thought remained in everyone’s minds—
Escape!

chapters.title: Chapter 218: Plan for Defeat Before Planning for Victory
paragraphs: Escape from here immediately!
Flee back to their own divine kingdom!
However, after fishing for so long...
How could Yang Da possibly let them leave so easily?
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Streaks of Void Cannon continued to condense and blast out.
At the same time, inside the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall...
A large number of believers under Yang Fan formed a formation simultaneously.
Ten Halls of Yama Formation!
Terrifying Yin Qi soared into the sky.
Countless believers began a comprehensive pursuit.
At this moment, the war completely turned into a one-sided massacre.
A large number of Foundation Establishment Realm Cultivators rode their swords through the air, yet on their backs they carried Smart Weapon.
Accompanied by the continuous changes in the Mechanical structure...
At times they transformed into psionic rocket launchers, and at other times they turned into laser turrets.
With a single cannon blast, large swaths of alien believers were blown into minced meat.
They didn’t even need to engage in close combat at all.
Only when encountering powerhouses of the same level would they truly draw their swords.
Under the blessing of the War God Codex, even these Cultivation Route believers had Physical Bodies that long ago far surpassed ordinary Cultivators.
While their attack power was formidable, their defense was equally astonishing.
Many aliens managed to rush to the front with great difficulty.
Yet they discovered that these Human Race Cultivators were equally ridiculously strong in close combat.
It was a complete crushing defeat!
At this moment, the Thousand Poison Swamp, which had originally been the most inconspicuous, instead became the ultimate death warrant.
When attacking, advancing the frontline wasn’t difficult.
But now, fleeing in defeat, it had become a genuine dead end.
A large number of alien believers were deeply trapped in the swamp, continuously emitting miserable screams.
There were even quite a few Foundation Establishment Realm and Qi Refining Stage powerhouses.
In order to survive, they directly abandoned their own compatriots and fled through the air alone.
Some beast Cultivators even kicked their companions beside them into the swamp with one foot, just to buy themselves a moment of time.
The cruelty of war was displayed vividly and thoroughly at this moment.
Twenty demigods.
Nearly one hundred billion believers, and the vast majority of them were beings above the fifth tier.
Yet now, nearly ninety percent of them had died in Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
Looking afar...
The entire periphery of the divine kingdom had long since turned into a living hell.

Blood converged into rivers, severed limbs and broken arms were everywhere, beast corpses piled up like mountains, zerg minced meat covered the earth, and a large number of Undead Race skeletons were scattered around.
There were even quite a few corpses of Human Race Cultivators floating in the sea of blood.
A thick bloody stench hit them in the face.
The entire world seemed to have been dyed dark red.
Ling Xuzi was completely dumbfounded.
She had lived for a very long time and had also followed quite a few masters.
Yet this was the first time she had ever seen such a terrifying demigod.
This strength... is this really a demigod?
Ling Xuzi only felt her worldview continuously collapsing.
The next moment, she actually dropped to her knees with a thump, her face filled with fanaticism.
“Congratulations to Master for your heaven-shaking Divine Might, sweeping across all directions!”
“What demigod? In front of Master, they are mere rubble!”
“Master is wise and martial, with meticulous plans. Today’s battle is destined to shock the Human Race!”
“For Ling Xuzi to follow Master is simply smoke rising from my ancestors’ graves—no, it’s the blessing of the entire Void Spirit Race for eight lifetimes!”
At this moment, Ling Xuzi wasn’t even using her brain anymore while sucking up.
And Yang Fan, looking at her comical appearance, merely smiled faintly.
Then, he slowly looked toward Yang Da.
“Next, arrange for Yang San, Yang Four, and Yang Five to reorganize the troops.”
“Respectively go and invade these divine kingdoms.”
“Yes, Master!” Yang Da’s face was filled with excitement.
“After this battle...”
“The opposing divine kingdom’s resistance forces are greatly reduced.”
“I believe it won’t be long before we bring back the Divine Kingdom Core.”
Yang Fan nodded with equal satisfaction.
At this moment, he even vaguely felt that there was completely no need to continue buying divine kingdom coordinates from the Divine Shop in the future.
The returns from this fishing method were obviously much greater.
Thinking of this, a thought suddenly popped into Yang Fan’s mind.
“These ten-thousand-year soul nourishing wood... How about we don’t sell them for now?”
But very quickly, he suppressed this thought.
The most important thing right now was still to take advantage of the opponent’s weakness and swallow these demigod Divine Kingdom Cores as soon as possible.
Furthermore, these soul nourishing wood could already bring in a full fifty billion Divinity Points of income; continuing to place them in the divine kingdom would instead be somewhat wasteful.
Although the profits of fishing were huge, they were similarly accompanied by massive risks.
Although Yang Fan had confidence in his own strength, no one could guarantee...
Whether next time, he might actually fish up a shark capable of biting back at him.
Plan for defeat before planning for victory.
Only by doing so could the path of the divine kingdom go further.
After thinking all this through...
Yang Fan ultimately still issued an order to sell all the mature soul nourishing wood.
Then he repurchased a new batch of soul nourishing wood saplings and planted them into the divine kingdom.
As the divine kingdom’s area expanded...
This time, a full eighty trillion soul nourishing wood plants were planted.
After finishing these, Yang Fan no longer continued to pay attention to the subsequent development of the divine kingdom.
The f3500 fighter jet and nine profound ice tower lost in the war had all been repurchased and replenished.
As for the remaining funds, most of them were continued to be invested by Yang Da into the development of the Mechanical Civilization.
Besides this, some funds were used to purchase f-class transformation pod.
After all, as the divine kingdom’s area continued to expand, the believer population would similarly welcome explosive growth.
Under the blessing of the Breeding Card, the population in Yang Fan’s divine kingdom was skyrocketing almost every day.
And under this high-speed development, Yang Fan could clearly sense that the feedback he obtained from the divine kingdom was becoming stronger and stronger.
Especially his Physical Body strength, the change was the most obvious.
Due to the existence of the War God Codex, the Martial Route was rapidly popularizing within the divine kingdom.
A large number of believers embarked on the path of martial arts.
And these powers would continuously feed back into Yang Fan himself.
Nowadays, he could even feel every day that his Physical Body was undergoing transformation at a speed visible to the naked eye.
His blood qi was becoming increasingly majestic.
His muscles and bones were becoming increasingly formidable.
Just standing there faintly gave people the oppressive feeling of a humanoid Vicious Beast.
Only ten days had passed in the Real World.
The first batch of Divine Kingdom Cores had already been brought back.
In order to accelerate the speed of the war’s progression...
Yang Da once again purchased five high-tier combat-type Intelligent Life forms from the Divine Shop.
They were named all the way from Yang Six to Yang Ten.
As Yang Fan’s divine kingdom continued to develop, the scale of future wars would only become more and more massive.
Even high-tier combat-type Intelligent Life could not completely control the overall situation.
Only with the existence of more command nodes could the war’s progression be made more precise.
With Yang Fan’s current assets, he naturally didn’t care about this little expenditure.
Afterwards, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the divine kingdom, absorbing all eight Divine Kingdom Cores brought back this time.
Each of these Divine Kingdom Cores was a full Half-man in height.
As the absorption completed, the area of Yang Fan’s divine kingdom surged violently once again.
It increased by nearly twenty million square kilometers, and the overall expansion approached seventy percent!
Those demigods who had once invaded his divine kingdom were not weak in themselves.
It was just that their core combat power happened to be shattered in one wave by the Great Void Warship.
Therefore, the returns brought by these Divine Kingdom Cores were naturally extremely astonishing.
As the divine kingdom’s revenues continuously increased, the once-costly Monkey Wine Spring now appeared somewhat like tasteless chicken ribs.

At this moment, the war completely turned into a one-sided massacre.
A large number of Foundation Establishment Realm Cultivators rode their swords through the air, yet on their backs they carried Smart Weapon.
Accompanied by the continuous changes in the Mechanical structure...
At times they transformed into psionic rocket launchers, and at other times they turned into laser turrets.
With a single cannon blast, large swaths of alien believers were blown into minced meat.
They didn’t even need to engage in close combat at all.
Only when encountering powerhouses of the same level would they truly draw their swords.
Under the blessing of the War God Codex, even these Cultivation Route believers had Physical Bodies that long ago far surpassed ordinary Cultivators.
While their attack power was formidable, their defense was equally astonishing.
Many aliens managed to rush to the front with great difficulty.
Yet they discovered that these Human Race Cultivators were equally ridiculously strong in close combat.
It was a complete crushing defeat!
At this moment, the Thousand Poison Swamp, which had originally been the most inconspicuous, instead became the ultimate death warrant.
When attacking, advancing the frontline wasn’t difficult.
But now, fleeing in defeat, it had become a genuine dead end.
A large number of alien believers were deeply trapped in the swamp, continuously emitting miserable screams.
There were even quite a few Foundation Establishment Realm and Qi Refining Stage powerhouses.
In order to survive, they directly abandoned their own compatriots and fled through the air alone.
Some beast Cultivators even kicked their companions beside them into the swamp with one foot, just to buy themselves a moment of time.
The cruelty of war was displayed vividly and thoroughly at this moment.
Twenty demigods.
Nearly one hundred billion believers, and the vast majority of them were beings above the fifth tier.
Yet now, nearly ninety percent of them had died in Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
Looking afar...
The entire periphery of the divine kingdom had long since turned into a living hell.

Blood converged into rivers, severed limbs and broken arms were everywhere, beast corpses piled up like mountains, zerg minced meat covered the earth, and a large number of Undead Race skeletons were scattered around.
There were even quite a few corpses of Human Race Cultivators floating in the sea of blood.
A thick bloody stench hit them in the face.
The entire world seemed to have been dyed dark red.
Ling Xuzi was completely dumbfounded.
She had lived for a very long time and had also followed quite a few masters.
Yet this was the first time she had ever seen such a terrifying demigod.
This strength... is this really a demigod?
Ling Xuzi only felt her worldview continuously collapsing.
The next moment, she actually dropped to her knees with a thump, her face filled with fanaticism.
“Congratulations to Master for your heaven-shaking Divine Might, sweeping across all directions!”
“What demigod?
In front of Master, they are mere rubble!”
“Master is wise and martial, with meticulous plans.
Today’s battle is destined to shock the Human Race!”
“For Ling Xuzi to follow Master is simply smoke rising from my ancestors’ graves—no, it’s the blessing of the entire Void Spirit Race for eight lifetimes!”
At this moment, Ling Xuzi wasn’t even using her brain anymore while sucking up.
And Yang Fan, looking at her comical appearance, merely smiled faintly.
Then, he slowly looked toward Yang Da.
“Next, arrange for Yang San, Yang Four, and Yang Five to reorganize the troops.”
“Respectively go and invade these divine kingdoms.”
“Yes, Master!” Yang Da’s face was filled with excitement.
“After this battle...”
“The opposing divine kingdom’s resistance forces are greatly reduced.”
“I believe it won’t be long before we bring back the Divine Kingdom Core.”
Yang Fan nodded with equal satisfaction.
At this moment, he even vaguely felt that there was completely no need to continue buying divine kingdom coordinates from the Divine Shop in the future.
The returns from this fishing method were obviously much greater.
Thinking of this, a thought suddenly popped into Yang Fan’s mind.
“These ten-thousand-year soul nourishing wood...
How about we don’t sell them for now?”
But very quickly, he suppressed this thought.
The most important thing right now was still to take advantage of the opponent’s weakness and swallow these demigod Divine Kingdom Cores as soon as possible.
Furthermore, these soul nourishing wood could already bring in a full fifty billion Divinity Points of income; continuing to place them in the divine kingdom would instead be somewhat wasteful.
Although the profits of fishing were huge, they were similarly accompanied by massive risks.
Although Yang Fan had confidence in his own strength, no one could guarantee...
Whether next time, he might actually fish up a shark capable of biting back at him.
Plan for defeat before planning for victory.
Only by doing so could the path of the divine kingdom go further.
After thinking all this through...
Yang Fan ultimately still issued an order to sell all the mature soul nourishing wood.
Then he repurchased a new batch of soul nourishing wood saplings and planted them into the divine kingdom.
As the divine kingdom’s area expanded...
This time, a full eighty trillion soul nourishing wood plants were planted.
After finishing these, Yang Fan no longer continued to pay attention to the subsequent development of the divine kingdom.
The f3500 fighter jet and nine profound ice tower lost in the war had all been repurchased and replenished.
As for the remaining funds, most of them were continued to be invested by Yang Da into the development of the Mechanical Civilization.
Besides this, some funds were used to purchase f-class transformation pod.
After all, as the divine kingdom’s area continued to expand, the believer population would similarly welcome explosive growth.
Under the blessing of the Breeding Card, the population in Yang Fan’s divine kingdom was skyrocketing almost every day.
And under this high-speed development, Yang Fan could clearly sense that the feedback he obtained from the divine kingdom was becoming stronger and stronger.
Especially his Physical Body strength, the change was the most obvious.
Due to the existence of the War God Codex, the Martial Route was rapidly popularizing within the divine kingdom.
A large number of believers embarked on the path of martial arts.
And these powers would continuously feed back into Yang Fan himself.
Nowadays, he could even feel every day that his Physical Body was undergoing transformation at a speed visible to the naked eye.
His blood qi was becoming increasingly majestic.
His muscles and bones were becoming increasingly formidable.
Just standing there faintly gave people the oppressive feeling of a humanoid Vicious Beast.
Only ten days had passed in the Real World.
The first batch of Divine Kingdom Cores had already been brought back.
In order to accelerate the speed of the war’s progression...
Yang Da once again purchased five high-tier combat-type Intelligent Life forms from the Divine Shop.
They were named all the way from Yang Six to Yang Ten.
As Yang Fan’s divine kingdom continued to develop, the scale of future wars would only become more and more massive.
Even high-tier combat-type Intelligent Life could not completely control the overall situation.
Only with the existence of more command nodes could the war’s progression be made more precise.
With Yang Fan’s current assets, he naturally didn’t care about this little expenditure.
Afterwards, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the divine kingdom, absorbing all eight Divine Kingdom Cores brought back this time.
Each of these Divine Kingdom Cores was a full Half-man in height.
As the absorption completed, the area of Yang Fan’s divine kingdom surged violently once again.
It increased by nearly twenty million square kilometers, and the overall expansion approached seventy percent!
Those demigods who had once invaded his divine kingdom were not weak in themselves.
It was just that their core combat power happened to be shattered in one wave by the Great Void Warship.
Therefore, the returns brought by these Divine Kingdom Cores were naturally extremely astonishing.
As the divine kingdom’s revenues continuously increased, the once-costly Monkey Wine Spring now appeared somewhat like tasteless chicken ribs.

chapters.title: Chapter 219: Completely Destroyed
paragraphs: After pondering over and over again, Yang Fan finally decided to sell all the Monkey Wine Springs and Spirit Peach Mountains.
When he initially chose to develop the winemaking industry, Yang Fan was still just a Divine Being.
The income brought by the Grade B building, the Monkey Wine Spring, was naturally quite considerable.
But nowadays, this small bit of income was completely insignificant.
What was even more crucial was that the area occupied by Spirit Peach Mountain was simply too large.
What Yang Fan valued most nowadays was long no longer pure resource income, but the development of believers.
The more believer population there was, the probability of strong individuals being born would increase proportionally.
And the overall combat power of the Divine Kingdom would also improve synchronously.
Sacrificing a large amount of living space for believers just for that bit of income already seemed somewhat not worth the loss.
Furthermore, for ordinary believers, Penglai Island could be considered the top-tier residential area.
The Spiritual Qi was rich, and the environment was superior.
It was extremely suitable for population reproduction and Cultivate.
It was time for Spirit Peach Mountain to be eliminated by the Divine Kingdom!
To further expand the living space, Yang Da also began to purchase City of Technology in large quantities.
However, all of this took time.
Believers were not tools after all.
They had their own culture, their own Family, living habits, and emotional belonging.
If they blindly piled up City of Technology, the believers might not necessarily be willing to relocate.
This was just like people who originally lived in a bustling major city suddenly being asked to move to a remote new district.
Even if the conditions were not bad, most people would still instinctively resist.
Yang Fan was not in a hurry about this.
As the Divine Kingdom continuously evolved, the newly added cities would sooner or later gradually prosper.
When the population density of the old urban area became higher and higher and the living environment began to decline, naturally someone would actively migrate.
This kind of matter did not need to be forcibly interfered with through Divine Decree at all.
Allowing believers to choose for themselves was instead the best way.
As for the Dragon Marsh Water Mansion, Yang Fan had not moved it for the time being.
After all, his believers currently did not have the ability to live in the water.

However, with the current scale of the Dragon Marsh Water Mansion, under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, it could also bring Yang Fan nearly 800 million Divinity Points in income every month.
Even if placed in the present, it could still be considered a pretty good income.
And the real reason that could support Yang Fan in cutting down resource-type buildings on such a large scale was actually only one, which was Spirit Vein Planet.
Nowadays, his Divine Kingdom’s expenditures were skyrocketing exponentially.
Cultivating believers, developing technology, expanding legions, purchasing Mechanical Heart...
Every single item required massive amounts of resources.
And the existence of those twenty-one Spirit Vein Planets was equivalent to providing Yang Fan with a steady stream of external resource supplies.
Because of this, he was able to reform the structure of the Divine Kingdom so drastically.
When all was said and done, the large-scale construction of resource-type buildings in the Divine Kingdom was essentially to earn Divinity Points.
And the purpose of earning Divinity Points was to Cultivate believers.
Now that there were resource planets to support him, Yang Fan could naturally and unscrupulously pour all resources into the development of believers.
Time flew by.
In the blink of an eye, another month passed.
During this period of time, Yang Da successively brought back ten Divine Kingdom Cores.
As these Divine Kingdom Cores were continuously absorbed, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom area ushered in a skyrocketing increase once again.
[Divine Kingdom Area: 70 million square kilometers]
Yang Fan had already destroyed eighteen of the twenty Divine Kingdom coordinates from back then.
Although the remaining two encountered some resistance, with continuous reinforcement, breaking through them was only a matter of time.
At the same time.
A living planet infinitely far away from Taichu City.
This place belonged to the ruling scope of the Rao Family.
Over ninety percent of the industries, resources, and population mobility of the entire planet were controlled by the Rao Family.
And at this moment, deep within the ancestral residence of the Rao Family, an extremely secret Family meeting was being held.
The heavy metal door slowly closed, and the entire space was instantly isolated by a Formation.
Not only was it unable to be probed, but even sound could not be transmitted out.
The lights in the meeting hall were dim, with only strips of projection data constantly flashing.
“This month’s tax revenue has increased by 5%, and the total income is about 100 billion Divinity Points.”
“Sixty percent of it needs to be handed over to the Federal Government. Of the remaining part, fifty percent must continue to be invested into the planet’s operation.”
A middle-aged man reported calmly.
“Population mobility will continue to be controlled, and immigration is prohibited.”
“In addition, the welfare expenditures for the bottom-tier Divine Beings can continue to be compressed.”
Hearing this, another old man slowly nodded.
“The taxes are still too little. Since those Divine Beings are under the protection of our Rao Family, they naturally need to contribute a bit more effort.”
Someone nearby chuckled.
“Have the Actuary redo a report and calculate the limit of endurance for these people.”
“Tax revenue... must be pulled to the limit.”
Everyone nodded upon hearing this.
It was as if what they were discussing was not living people at all, but strings of cold numbers.
Just at this moment, someone suddenly spoke.
“Family Head, the Greedy Wolf Mercenary Group that we secretly funded has had some problems recently.”
The Rao Family Head slowly raised his head, “What is going on?”

“A Human Demigod had quite a lot of assets, so they made a move. However, it seems they were caught by the handle and it has now blown up to the Federal Court. Now some high-level personnel have come to investigate.”
“Who is in charge?”
“People from the Gu Family, it seems to be that affectionate Young Master.”
Hearing these words, the old man’s originally slightly furrowed brows instead smoothed out.
“Do things more cleanly in the future. As for that Young Master of the Gu Family... just smooth things over.”
“The Federation has levied so much tax from us, our massive Family must find some other way out.”
Someone nearby hesitated and said, “Continuing like this... won’t there be any problems?”
The old man smiled faintly, “It doesn’t matter, most of the money we earn flows into the pockets above.”
“If they really want to investigate, they will investigate others first.”
“Business continues.”
Just at this moment.
Bang!!!
The door of the meeting hall was suddenly pushed open violently, and a man rushed in with a face full of panic.
“Family Head! It’s bad!”
“Young Master Raoyu is dead!”
“The Divine Kingdom Core has been seized! This is... this is the last will he left behind!”
As soon as these words came out, the entire meeting hall instantly quieted down, and many people’s expressions changed drastically.
Yet the Rao Family Head’s expression remained calm.
He slowly took the last will and read it quietly.
A moment later, he raised his head.
There was not the slightest fluctuation in his expression.
“Starting from today, the Rao Family does not have a person named Raoyu.”
“Everyone is forbidden to mention it again.”
Having said that, the old man threw the last will directly into the flames, burning it completely into ashes.
At the same time.
Two Divine Kingdom Cores were quietly floating within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
For a full two months, those twenty invaders were finally completely eliminated by him.
One of the Divine Kingdom Cores was even as tall as a person.
The Divine Kingdom Origin aura it emitted was even a section stronger than that Black Armored Beetle Race Demigod back then.
“Master, this is the Divine Kingdom Core of that Human Demigod.” Yang Da spoke up to remind him.
“His strength is indeed not weak, but unfortunately he ran into me.” Yang Fan said calmly.
Afterward, Yang Fan directly began to absorb.
Accompanied by the two Divine Kingdom Cores merging into the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom area skyrocketed once again, increasing by a full 10 million square kilometers.
Nowadays, he was only short of the last 20 million square kilometers from Breakthrough to a deity.

chapters.title: Chapter 220: Going Out
paragraphs: Using the soul nourishing wood as bait this time had yielded an incredibly massive harvest.
Previously, Yang Fan thought he would be able to become a god within a year, but now it seemed he might not even need half a year.
At this thought, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel his heart surge with excitement.
However, he quickly suppressed the stirrings in his heart.
Now that the area of his Divine Kingdom had skyrocketed, it was the golden age for the development of his believers.
Currently, he was actually in no hurry to continue expanding the area of his Divine Kingdom, and there was even less need to rush a Breakthrough into godhood.
Compared to his Realm, what was more important now was to continue raising the overall strength of his Divine Kingdom.
If one walked too fast, danger would also arrive quickly.
He must slow down.
With this in mind, Yang Fan directly ordered, “From now on, there is no need to continue launching Divine Kingdom Wars externally. Focus primarily on raising the strength of the believers.”
“Yes, Master,” Yang Da nodded respectfully.
Yang Fan knew very well that once he made a Breakthrough into godhood, the opponents he would face would no longer be demigods, but Tier 1 to Tier 3 Gods.
By contrast, the current demigod stage...
...was actually the safest and most suitable time to accumulate a solid foundation.
He possessed the Evolution Talent, so there was absolutely no need for him to be eager for quick success.
Winning through stability was the best choice.
What’s more, according to the rules of the Primordial Academy...
...once one broke through to godhood, it meant graduation.
At that time, he would have to head to the Human Race’s The Frontline to truly fight to the death with Alien Gods.
Yang Fan felt that there was absolutely no need for him to rush so much, and that he could fully utilize this relatively safe period of development.
During the demigod stage, he could develop the overall strength of his Divine Kingdom to its limit, and only then consider making a Breakthrough into godhood.
After handling the matters in his Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan’s consciousness exited the Divine Kingdom.
He returned to reality.
In the villa’s courtyard, Gu Le was sitting on the sofa, swinging her calves.
Seeing Yang Fan open his eyes, she immediately threw herself over.
“Husband, the old man just contacted me.”
“Hmm?”
“He said he wants us to meet in the Virtual World.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan did not dare to delay.
The two of them quickly entered the Virtual World.
The Virtual World, Gu Family Territory.
In the room, besides Gu Xuanting, there was also a young man standing there.
The man was dressed in white, handsome, with a gentle smile always on his face.
He looked quite a bit cynical and playboyish.
As soon as they entered the door, Gu Le threw herself forward.
“Dad!”
“You finally remembered you still have me as your daughter?”
A look of helplessness appeared on Gu Xuanting’s face.
“How old are you already, still acting like a spoiled child?”
Though he said so, his eyes were clearly filled with doting affection.
Then, his gaze fell upon Yang Fan. After pausing for just a moment, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
“Not bad. Not having seen you for a short while, your strength has increased quite a bit again.”
“It seems my son-in-law is indeed becoming more and more of a Prodigy.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan bowed respectfully. “Father, you flatter me.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand, then looked at the young man beside him.
“This is Gu Shaoqing. He is two classes ahead of you and can be considered your senior.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan immediately said politely, “Greetings, Senior.”
However, Gu Shaoqing was startled.
He hurriedly waved his hands.
“Don’t, don’t, don’t!”
“Greetings, Young Lord.”
As he spoke, he even gave a solemn bow.
In the Primordial Academy...
...seniority was never important.
Strength and talent were what truly gave one a voice.
A Peerless Prodigy like Yang Fan was destined to be a core figure of the Gu Family in the future.
While he, Gu Shaoqing, was only an A-grade Genius.
The status of the two sides was simply not on the same level.
Seeing this, Gu Xuanting laughed and scolded, “Alright, we’re all Family here and there are no outsiders. Don’t be so polite.”
Then, he looked back at Yang Fan.
“Fan’er.”
“I called you here today because I want you to accompany Shaoqing on a trip.”
Yang Fan’s expression turned serious. “Please instruct me, Father.”
Gu Xuanting only smiled mysteriously.
“Allow me to keep it a secret for now.”
“Once you reach the destination...”
“...the two of you can discuss and decide what to do.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan became even more puzzled.
However, Gu Xuanting was clearly not planning to say more, so he could only temporarily suppress his doubts.
Soon, they all exited the room.
However, Yang Fan and Gu Le did not leave the Virtual World immediately.
Outside the main hall, Gu Le crossed her arms, staring warily at Gu Shaoqing.
“I’m warning you.”
“Do what you are supposed to do.”
“He is my husband.”
“You are not allowed to lead him astray.”
Gu Shaoqing broke into a cold sweat upon hearing this and hurriedly waved his hands.
“Don’t worry, Third Young Miss.”
“On this trip, I will definitely follow Brother Yang’s lead.”
His appearance was the very image of a sycophantic lackey.
After returning to reality...
...Yang Fan was still somewhat puzzled.
“Le’er, what exactly does Father-in-law want me to do?”
Gu Le shook her head.
“Don’t worry.”
“It’s definitely a good thing.”
“But the old man didn’t tell me the details either.”
Yang Fan nodded.
Then, he thought of something else.
“This Gu Shaoqing...”
To his surprise, as soon as the words left his mouth, Gu Le suddenly looked nervous.
“Husband, you must not learn bad habits from him!”
“Ah?”
Yang Fan was taken aback.
Gu Le couldn’t help but roll her eyes.
“This guy has no other skills...”
“...but he is a master at picking up girls.”
“Between Divine Beings and demigods, he already has over two hundred wives now.”
“Since his name is Shaoqing...”
“...everyone calls him the ‘Passionate Young Master’.”
“He’s a total scumbag.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was utterly shocked.
Two years older than him, yet he already had over two hundred wives?
Where did this guy find the time? Does he act like a breeding stud every single day?
Yang Fan was deeply shaken in his heart.
If he really had such needs, there were plenty of service establishments like Tianxiang Renjian, where he could have a different one every day without issue.
Yet this kid actually raised a massive Family of his own.
Sure enough, while human hobbies shared some commonalities, they could also be vastly different.
The next day.
Yang Fan notified Tang Yue and Ye Wen, and then went to meet up with Gu Shaoqing.
Looking at the lineup of Yang Fan’s entourage, Gu Shaoqing’s eyes immediately showed envy.
“As expected of a Peerless Prodigy, to actually have two Tier 3 Gods guarding you.”
“Awesome!”
As he spoke, he also secretly gave a thumbs-up.
Gu Shaoqing had a very outgoing and familiar personality.
But at the same time, he was very smart, carrying himself with perfect propriety in both his words and actions.
He constantly behaved like ‘Brother Yang’s little brother,’ making it very hard for anyone to dislike him.
The group of four boarded the space vessel prepared by the Gu Family.
Only after sitting down did Gu Shaoqing speak.
“Our destination this time...”
“...is Xiling Planet, which is five billion light-years away.”
“Through space jumps, we can arrive in about ten days.”
Yang Fan frowned.
“What are we going there for?”
Gu Shaoqing shrugged.
“I’m not too sure either.”
“But the Third Elder said...”
“...that once we reach Xiling Planet...”
“...Brother Yang, you can do whatever you want.”
“The strongest combat power on Xiling Planet is only a Tier 3 God.”
Gu Shaoqing grinned.
“Let alone doing business...”
“...even if you conquer Xiling Planet, no one will be able to stop you.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan felt his mind fill with question marks.
What on earth did that riddler, Gu Xuanting, want to do?
Unable to figure it out, Yang Fan simply stopped dwelling on it.
Once they reached Xiling Planet, he would naturally find out the answer.

sentences.text: Using the soul nourishing wood as bait this time had yielded an incredibly massive harvest.
Previously, Yang Fan thought he would be able to become a god within a year, but now it seemed he might not even need half a year.
At this thought, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel his heart surge with excitement.
However, he quickly suppressed the stirrings in his heart.
Now that the area of his Divine Kingdom had skyrocketed, it was the golden age for the development of his believers.
Currently, he was actually in no hurry to continue expanding the area of his Divine Kingdom, and there was even less need to rush a Breakthrough into godhood.
Compared to his Realm, what was more important now was to continue raising the overall strength of his Divine Kingdom.
If one walked too fast, danger would also arrive quickly.
He must slow down.
With this in mind, Yang Fan directly ordered, “From now on, there is no need to continue launching Divine Kingdom Wars externally.
Focus primarily on raising the strength of the believers.”
“Yes, Master,” Yang Da nodded respectfully.
Yang Fan knew very well that once he made a Breakthrough into godhood, the opponents he would face would no longer be demigods, but Tier 1 to Tier 3 Gods.
By contrast, the current demigod stage...
...was actually the safest and most suitable time to accumulate a solid foundation.
He possessed the Evolution Talent, so there was absolutely no need for him to be eager for quick success.
Winning through stability was the best choice.
What’s more, according to the rules of the Primordial Academy...
...once one broke through to godhood, it meant graduation.
At that time, he would have to head to the Human Race’s The Frontline to truly fight to the death with Alien Gods.
Yang Fan felt that there was absolutely no need for him to rush so much, and that he could fully utilize this relatively safe period of development.
During the demigod stage, he could develop the overall strength of his Divine Kingdom to its limit, and only then consider making a Breakthrough into godhood.
After handling the matters in his Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan’s consciousness exited the Divine Kingdom.
He returned to reality.
In the villa’s courtyard, Gu Le was sitting on the sofa, swinging her calves.
Seeing Yang Fan open his eyes, she immediately threw herself over.
“Husband, the old man just contacted me.”
“Hmm?”
“He said he wants us to meet in the Virtual World.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan did not dare to delay.
The two of them quickly entered the Virtual World.
The Virtual World, Gu Family Territory.
In the room, besides Gu Xuanting, there was also a young man standing there.
The man was dressed in white, handsome, with a gentle smile always on his face.
He looked quite a bit cynical and playboyish.
As soon as they entered the door, Gu Le threw herself forward.
“Dad!”
“You finally remembered you still have me as your daughter?”
A look of helplessness appeared on Gu Xuanting’s face.
“How old are you already, still acting like a spoiled child?”
Though he said so, his eyes were clearly filled with doting affection.
Then, his gaze fell upon Yang Fan.
After pausing for just a moment, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
“Not bad.
Not having seen you for a short while, your strength has increased quite a bit again.”
“It seems my son-in-law is indeed becoming more and more of a Prodigy.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan bowed respectfully.
“Father, you flatter me.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand, then looked at the young man beside him.
“This is Gu Shaoqing.
He is two classes ahead of you and can be considered your senior.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan immediately said politely, “Greetings, Senior.”
However, Gu Shaoqing was startled.
He hurriedly waved his hands.
“Don’t, don’t, don’t!”
“Greetings, Young Lord.”
As he spoke, he even gave a solemn bow.
In the Primordial Academy...
...seniority was never important.
Strength and talent were what truly gave one a voice.
A Peerless Prodigy like Yang Fan was destined to be a core figure of the Gu Family in the future.
While he, Gu Shaoqing, was only an A-grade Genius.
The status of the two sides was simply not on the same level.
Seeing this, Gu Xuanting laughed and scolded, “Alright, we’re all Family here and there are no outsiders.
Don’t be so polite.”
Then, he looked back at Yang Fan.
“Fan’er.”
“I called you here today because I want you to accompany Shaoqing on a trip.”
Yang Fan’s expression turned serious.
“Please instruct me, Father.”
Gu Xuanting only smiled mysteriously.
“Allow me to keep it a secret for now.”
“Once you reach the destination...”
“...the two of you can discuss and decide what to do.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan became even more puzzled.
However, Gu Xuanting was clearly not planning to say more, so he could only temporarily suppress his doubts.
Soon, they all exited the room.
However, Yang Fan and Gu Le did not leave the Virtual World immediately.
Outside the main hall, Gu Le crossed her arms, staring warily at Gu Shaoqing.
“I’m warning you.”
“Do what you are supposed to do.”
“He is my husband.”
“You are not allowed to lead him astray.”
Gu Shaoqing broke into a cold sweat upon hearing this and hurriedly waved his hands.
“Don’t worry, Third Young Miss.”
“On this trip, I will definitely follow Brother Yang’s lead.”
His appearance was the very image of a sycophantic lackey.
After returning to reality...
...Yang Fan was still somewhat puzzled.
“Le’er, what exactly does Father-in-law want me to do?”
Gu Le shook her head.
“Don’t worry.”
“It’s definitely a good thing.”
“But the old man didn’t tell me the details either.”
Yang Fan nodded.
Then, he thought of something else.
“This Gu Shaoqing...”
To his surprise, as soon as the words left his mouth, Gu Le suddenly looked nervous.
“Husband, you must not learn bad habits from him!”
“Ah?”
Yang Fan was taken aback.
Gu Le couldn’t help but roll her eyes.
“This guy has no other skills...”
“...but he is a master at picking up girls.”
“Between Divine Beings and demigods, he already has over two hundred wives now.”
“Since his name is Shaoqing...”
“...everyone calls him the ‘Passionate Young Master’.”
“He’s a total scumbag.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was utterly shocked.
Two years older than him, yet he already had over two hundred wives?
Where did this guy find the time?
Does he act like a breeding stud every single day?
Yang Fan was deeply shaken in his heart.
If he really had such needs, there were plenty of service establishments like Tianxiang Renjian, where he could have a different one every day without issue.
Yet this kid actually raised a massive Family of his own.
Sure enough, while human hobbies shared some commonalities, they could also be vastly different.
The next day.
Yang Fan notified Tang Yue and Ye Wen, and then went to meet up with Gu Shaoqing.
Looking at the lineup of Yang Fan’s entourage, Gu Shaoqing’s eyes immediately showed envy.
“As expected of a Peerless Prodigy, to actually have two Tier 3 Gods guarding you.”
“Awesome!”
As he spoke, he also secretly gave a thumbs-up.
Gu Shaoqing had a very outgoing and familiar personality.
But at the same time, he was very smart, carrying himself with perfect propriety in both his words and actions.
He constantly behaved like ‘Brother Yang’s little brother,’ making it very hard for anyone to dislike him.
The group of four boarded the space vessel prepared by the Gu Family.
Only after sitting down did Gu Shaoqing speak.
“Our destination this time...”
“...is Xiling Planet, which is five billion light-years away.”
“Through space jumps, we can arrive in about ten days.”
Yang Fan frowned.
“What are we going there for?”
Gu Shaoqing shrugged.
“I’m not too sure either.”
“But the Third Elder said...”
“...that once we reach Xiling Planet...”
“...Brother Yang, you can do whatever you want.”
“The strongest combat power on Xiling Planet is only a Tier 3 God.”
Gu Shaoqing grinned.
“Let alone doing business...”
“...even if you conquer Xiling Planet, no one will be able to stop you.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan felt his mind fill with question marks.
What on earth did that riddler, Gu Xuanting, want to do?
Unable to figure it out, Yang Fan simply stopped dwelling on it.
Once they reached Xiling Planet, he would naturally find out the answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 221: Xiling Planet
paragraphs: Ten days later, the spatial spacecraft suddenly shook.
“Brother Yang, we have arrived.” Gu Shaoqing said with a smile.
As the cabin door slowly opened, a dazzling ray of sunlight shone in.
Yang Fan stepped out of the spacecraft.
He was slightly stunned.
Outside the spacecraft, it was already crowded with a dense crowd of people.
Tens of thousands of people stood in neat formation, with red carpets spread along both sides of the road.
A large number of hovering instruments floated in the sky, continuously projecting dazzling lights and shadows.
Further away, thousands of women wearing light gauze formed a square formation, dancing gracefully to the music.
Every movement was extremely neat, obviously rehearsed for a long time in advance.
At the very front, a middle-aged man was standing there with a respectful expression.
The Divine Might faintly emanating from his body undoubtedly revealed him to be a Tier 3 God.
At this moment, his face was full of flattery and awe.
“Patriarch of the Rao Family, Rao Tianming.”
“Greetings, Young Master Gu.”
He hurried forward with an extremely enthusiastic expression.
He even reached out directly, as if wanting to take Yang Fan’s hand.
However, before he could get close, Tang Yue already stepped forward to block his path, her cold gaze falling upon him.
The air instantly stagnated.
Cold sweat instantly broke out on Rao Tianming’s forehead.
A Tier 3 God, and her aura was stronger than his own.
He hadn’t expected that this Young Master of the Gu Family had a Tier 3 God guarding him!
Gu Shaoqing suddenly waved his hand and said,
“Patriarch Rao, the selection for the investigation has changed. You have the wrong person.”
“I am Gu Shaoqing, and this is my Brother Yang.”
“Right, these two Seniors are here specifically to escort Brother Yang.”
Hearing this, Rao Tianming’s pupils suddenly shrank.
Gu Shaoqing was just accompanying him?
Two Tier 3 Gods providing protection?
At this moment, he became even more cautious and hurriedly bowed again.
“Greetings, Young Master Yang!”
Although there was no Yang surname among the Five Great Giants.
But being able to make the Gu Family attach such importance and arrange two Tier 3 Gods to escort him—
Such a figure was simply not someone he could afford to offend.
Until this moment, Yang Fan truly felt a change in his status.
Back in Yang County, demigods were already high and lofty existences.
But now a Tier 3 God was being so respectful in front of him.
The world truly seemed to have changed.
Rao Tianming personally led everyone to their residence.
Along the way, various hovering motorcades cleared the path, creating an extravagant spectacle.
Yang Fan was finally arranged to stay in an extremely luxurious manor.
Spiritual springs flowed, artificial mountains clustered together, and the air was even permeated with a special spiritual fragrance.
Taking just a single breath refreshed one’s mind and spirit.
Around the courtyard, dozens of fair-faced maidservants waited with lowered heads.
“If Young Master Yang has any requests, please feel free to give orders.”
“My Rao Family will definitely satisfy them with all our strength.”
Rao Tianming wore a brilliant smile, putting his posture extremely low.
After they left, Yang Fan sat in the courtyard, his brows furrowing slightly.
For some reason, ever since coming to Xiling Planet,
he always felt that everything about him seemed to have been arranged in advance.
This feeling made him vaguely uncomfortable.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan directly stood up and privately sought out Gu Shaoqing.
“Brother Gu.”
“Let’s stop beating around the bush.”
“What on earth does my father-in-law want me to do?”
Upon hearing this, Gu Shaoqing let out two dry laughs.
“Brother Yang, I’m just a bum.”
“I really don’t know...”
However, before he finished speaking, Yang Fan grabbed his right hand.
In an instant, a terrifying force came over.
Gu Shaoqing’s face instantly turned red.
“Ouch, ouch, ouch!”
“Brother Yang, don’t resort to violence!”
“I’ll talk! I’ll talk!”
Yang Fan then let go.
Gu Shaoqing hurriedly shook his hand frantically, feeling extremely shocked in his heart.
He was already a Senior in university now, yet the gap between him and Yang Fan was actually this huge.
As expected of a Peerless Prodigy, no wonder the Family valued him so much.
Gu Shaoqing lowered his voice.
“Actually...”
“This Rao Family has always been engaging in illegal businesses.”
“Including secretly selling Human Race divine kingdom coordinates, reselling The Frontline strategic materials, falsifying tax accounts...”
“And even secretly funding mercenary groups to hunt down demigods with no background.”
Yang Fan’s brows furrowed instantly.
“Since that’s the case, wouldn’t it be fine for the Gu Family to handle it directly?”
“Why drag a junior like me into this kind of matter?”
Gu Shaoqing spread his hands helplessly.
“Because most of the money they earn is handed upwards. Therefore, someone wants to protect them.”
“Can they be greater than the Third Elder?” Yang Fan asked doubtfully.
Gu Shaoqing was instantly amused.
“How is that possible?”
“What kind of figure is the Third Elder.”
“Usually, he wouldn’t even bother to glance at this kind of matter.”
“The reason he stepped forward this time... is completely because of you, Brother Yang.”
“Me?”
“That’s right.”
Gu Shaoqing nodded.
“This Xiling Planet is different from ordinary planets; it occupies a vital transportation hub.”
“Spacecraft spatial jump points, The Frontline resource transportation, and Virtual World data stations all pass through here.”
“Every year, the taxes alone are an astronomical figure.”
“And the Third Elder... wants to see how you will handle this matter.”
Gu Shaoqing paused slightly in his tone.
Then he looked at Yang Fan.
“After that, the Gu Family will hand over the ownership of Xiling Planet into your hands.”
“This is also the Gu Family’s largest investment in you.”
As soon as these words were spoken, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but freeze in place.
The value of Xiling Planet was incomparable to those divine kingdom resource planets.
What this involved was federal taxation, the core interests of the Real World.
“Give it to me?”
Yang Fan even felt a bit incredulous.
You must know that the planet belonging to Yang County where he used to be had a larger area than Xiling Planet.
But in terms of geographical location, it simply couldn’t compare to this.
“Myself...”
“Am I about to become the master of a planet?”
Storms surged in Yang Fan’s heart; he felt that the Gu Family’s investment in him was a bit excessive.
And Gu Shaoqing beside him also wore a face full of envy.
“Brother Yang, that’s all I know.”
“Anyway, this time, do whatever you want to do.”
“Those two Seniors can be mobilized.”
“Whether the Rao Family is destroyed or left behind is entirely up to your single thought.”
After saying that, Gu Shaoqing suddenly revealed a smile that every man understands.
“Right, this Patriarch of the Rao Family is quite sensible.”
“Beauties have already been arranged in my room, I’ll take my leave first.”
Yang Fan suddenly spoke, “Brother Gu, can I really do anything?”
“Yes.”
Gu Shaoqing waved his hand without looking back.
“Then... what if I destroy this planet?”
As soon as these words were said, Gu Shaoqing’s footsteps suddenly paused, and then he slowly turned around.
Giving Yang Fan a thumbs up.
“Quite a dangerous thought, but if you really want to do it, Brother Yang... this time, the Gu Family will cover for you.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s heart shook violently.
It was originally just a joke.
But now looking at Gu Shaoqing’s serious expression, for the first time, he truly felt the terrifying power of the Five Great Families.
That feeling was as if he had finally managed to stand a little higher,
only to suddenly discover that the true behemoth had just revealed the tip of the iceberg.
For a moment, Yang Fan even had the feeling of becoming insignificant once again.
