chapters.title: Chapter 222: Returning Very Soon
paragraphs: Under the protection of Tang Yue and Ye Wen, no one around Yang Fan dared to approach him, let alone spy on him.
Returning to his room, Yang Fan casually changed into ordinary clothes and quietly left his residence.
Ye Wen remained in place, while Tang Yue concealed her aura and silently followed behind.
Xiling Planet was not particularly large; its overall surface area was perhaps only one percent of the planet Yang Fan used to live on.
However, its population density was surprisingly high.
Yang Fan walked all the way toward the city center.
On the streets, the crowds were densely packed.
But to his surprise, almost no demigods could be seen here.
As far as the eye could see, almost everyone was a Divine Being, along with a large number of children who had yet to awaken their divine kingdoms.
The streets appeared somewhat old and run-down, and the air was even thick with a sense of oppression.
Every so often,
one could see Enforcement Teams wearing official uniforms.
They inspected house by house with arrogant, overbearing tones.
“It’s time to pay this month’s poll tax.”
“One thousand Faith Points per person.”
A woman turned pale and hurriedly pleaded in a low voice.
“My Lord, the child was just born.”
“The resources in my divine kingdom have all been sold out. I really can’t come up with anything more.”
The man from the Enforcement Team sneered.
“Sold out?”
“Then go become a Subordinate God under a Lord Demigod and put your believers to hard labor.”
“The Federation isn’t feeding you people just so you can sit around doing nothing.”
At another household,
an old man shivered as he transferred the money.
“Still short by three hundred Faith Points...”
“Could you give me a few days’ grace?”
Slap!
The Enforcement Team member slapped him backhanded, knocking the old man straight to the ground.
“Grace period?”
“What kind of place do you think this is?”
“If you can’t pay the tax, go sell your divine kingdom resources.”
“If that’s still not enough, sell your believers!”
Beside them, a child cowered in the corner, not daring to make a sound.
The entire street was steeped in a lifeless gloom.
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
Logically speaking, Xiling Planet was a major transportation hub.
Its annual tax revenue should be an astronomical figure.
Why were the people here living such miserable lives?
Filled with doubts, Yang Fan continued forward.
Soon, he arrived at a massive spaceship space-jump port.
Countless spaceships were constantly taking off and landing, and the people coming and going were all wealthy or prominent.
The Enforcement Teams who had been posturing arrogantly on the streets earlier
were now all smiles and flattery.
“Boss Zhao, take care.”
“The procedures have all been taken care of for you.”
“Taxes? Haha, you’re a VIP! Why talk about taxes? We’ll just need you to say a few good words for our Rao Family up there.”
“President Li, next time you pass by Xiling Planet, please be sure to drop by again.”
Those traveling on the spaceships didn’t even need to go through inspections; they were let through all the way.
Meanwhile, the enforcement officers were all smiles, bowing and scraping.
It was a complete night-and-day contrast to how they treated ordinary people earlier.
As more and more Intelligent Life was born in his divine kingdom, Yang Fan’s Mental Energy was currently extremely strong, and his perception was remarkably keen.
Although Xiling Planet had a large population, their strength was pitifully low.
What made Yang Fan frown even more was that
the eyes of the people here were extremely numb, as if they had been completely crushed by life, unable to see even a sliver of hope.
“Fuck.”
“Gods exploit believers.”
“In the Real World, the strong exploit the weak.”
“Everyone’s playing the exact same game, huh?”
Yang Fan took a deep breath, feeling a sense of revulsion toward this planet in his heart.
He suddenly felt that if he had been born on Xiling Planet,
even surviving might have been a problem.
Yang Fan turned and walked into a secluded dark alley.
The moment he stepped inside, a dark figure suddenly darted out from the shadows.
An iron rod in the figure’s hand smashed violently toward his legs.
The attacker didn’t strike at vital points, clearly intending only to incapacitate him.
But Yang Fan didn’t even move.
Bang!
A dull thud echoed.
The iron rod was jolted straight out of his hand.
The shock even split the web of the teenager’s hand open.
Yang Fan remained standing where he was, completely unharmed.
With his current physical physique, let alone an iron rod, even a high-speed sports car crashing into him would be easily blocked.
At this moment, the teenager was utterly dumbfounded.
He stood there blankly, seemingly completely unable to comprehend what had just happened.
Only then did Yang Fan size the boy up.
The boy was around fifteen or sixteen years old, clearly not yet at the age to awaken a divine kingdom.
His frame was frail and weak, his complexion sallow, looking chronically malnourished.
Just then, two petite figures suddenly rushed out from the side, stepping directly in front of the boy.
“Don’t hurt big brother!”
Yang Fan paused in surprise, seeing a pair of twin young girls.
The two looked like porcelain dolls, fair-skinned and delicate, though their faces were smeared with dirt and their clothes were tattered.
In contrast, the brother behind them was thin to the bone.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
He had stood there without moving and gotten struck out of nowhere.
And now, he had somehow turned into the villain?
“Well...”
“It seems like your brother was the one trying to hurt me, wasn’t he?”
Yang Fan said with amusement.
Hearing this, the teenager’s face instantly flushed red.
He then immediately pulled his two younger sisters down to kneel.
“Forgive us, My Lord!”
“We... we just wanted to get something to eat.”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“Where are your adults?”
He really couldn’t understand it.
In an era where everyone could awaken a divine kingdom, there were still people lacking food?
Shouldn’t food be the cheapest thing in this world?
In the past, Yang Fan’s life in Yang County hadn’t been great either, but that was due to high rent and tax pressures.
But even so, food was never lacking.
One could simply raise some cattle and sheep in their divine kingdom, slaughter them the next day, and materialize them into the Real World.
Therefore, Yang Fan couldn’t comprehend how someone in this day and age could resort to crime over food.
Especially when it was just a few children.
Recalling the sudden ambush earlier, Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly.
Although the attack had been sudden, the boy’s strike had clearly avoided vital areas.
Even while launching a sneak attack, he had exercised restraint.
It was precisely because of this that Yang Fan was willing to ask a few more questions.
The young boy lowered his head and remained silent.
Instead, the twin sisters at his side grew anxious.
“A year ago, the fighting between The Frontline and the alien races was intense. Father’s divine kingdom had a forging talent, so he was drafted into the military.”
“He said he would come back very soon.”
When the young girl said this, her eyes shone with clear anticipation.
The brother kept his head down without saying a word.
Only his tightly clenched fists trembled slightly.
Deep within his eyes, a long-suppressed trace of hatred flashed by.
How powerful was Yang Fan’s Mental Energy? These subtle movements naturally couldn’t escape his eyes.
After a moment of silence, Yang Fan casually materialized a few Spirit Fruits from his divine kingdom and handed them over.
As soon as the Spirit Fruits appeared, the two young girls’ eyes instantly lit up, and their breathing grew hurried.
“For... for us?”
Upon receiving confirmation, the two young girls immediately began devouring the fruits ravenously, as if fearing the food would vanish in the next second.
By contrast, the boy remained standing where he was, unmoved.
He merely stared at the Spirit Fruits in silence.

sentences.text: Under the protection of Tang Yue and Ye Wen, no one around Yang Fan dared to approach him, let alone spy on him.
Returning to his room, Yang Fan casually changed into ordinary clothes and quietly left his residence.
Ye Wen remained in place, while Tang Yue concealed her aura and silently followed behind.
Xiling Planet was not particularly large; its overall surface area was perhaps only one percent of the planet Yang Fan used to live on.
However, its population density was surprisingly high.
Yang Fan walked all the way toward the city center.
On the streets, the crowds were densely packed.
But to his surprise, almost no demigods could be seen here.
As far as the eye could see, almost everyone was a Divine Being, along with a large number of children who had yet to awaken their divine kingdoms.
The streets appeared somewhat old and run-down, and the air was even thick with a sense of oppression.
Every so often,
one could see Enforcement Teams wearing official uniforms.
They inspected house by house with arrogant, overbearing tones.
“It’s time to pay this month’s poll tax.”
“One thousand Faith Points per person.”
A woman turned pale and hurriedly pleaded in a low voice.
“My Lord, the child was just born.”
“The resources in my divine kingdom have all been sold out.
I really can’t come up with anything more.”
The man from the Enforcement Team sneered.
“Sold out?”
“Then go become a Subordinate God under a Lord Demigod and put your believers to hard labor.”
“The Federation isn’t feeding you people just so you can sit around doing nothing.”
At another household,
an old man shivered as he transferred the money.
“Still short by three hundred Faith Points...”
“Could you give me a few days’ grace?”
Slap!
The Enforcement Team member slapped him backhanded, knocking the old man straight to the ground.
“Grace period?”
“What kind of place do you think this is?”
“If you can’t pay the tax, go sell your divine kingdom resources.”
“If that’s still not enough, sell your believers!”
Beside them, a child cowered in the corner, not daring to make a sound.
The entire street was steeped in a lifeless gloom.
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
Logically speaking, Xiling Planet was a major transportation hub.
Its annual tax revenue should be an astronomical figure.
Why were the people here living such miserable lives?
Filled with doubts, Yang Fan continued forward.
Soon, he arrived at a massive spaceship space-jump port.
Countless spaceships were constantly taking off and landing, and the people coming and going were all wealthy or prominent.
The Enforcement Teams who had been posturing arrogantly on the streets earlier
were now all smiles and flattery.
“Boss Zhao, take care.”
“The procedures have all been taken care of for you.”
“Taxes?
Haha, you’re a VIP!
Why talk about taxes?
We’ll just need you to say a few good words for our Rao Family up there.”
“President Li, next time you pass by Xiling Planet, please be sure to drop by again.”
Those traveling on the spaceships didn’t even need to go through inspections; they were let through all the way.
Meanwhile, the enforcement officers were all smiles, bowing and scraping.
It was a complete night-and-day contrast to how they treated ordinary people earlier.
As more and more Intelligent Life was born in his divine kingdom, Yang Fan’s Mental Energy was currently extremely strong, and his perception was remarkably keen.
Although Xiling Planet had a large population, their strength was pitifully low.
What made Yang Fan frown even more was that
the eyes of the people here were extremely numb, as if they had been completely crushed by life, unable to see even a sliver of hope.
“Fuck.”
“Gods exploit believers.”
“In the Real World, the strong exploit the weak.”
“Everyone’s playing the exact same game, huh?”
Yang Fan took a deep breath, feeling a sense of revulsion toward this planet in his heart.
He suddenly felt that if he had been born on Xiling Planet,
even surviving might have been a problem.
Yang Fan turned and walked into a secluded dark alley.
The moment he stepped inside, a dark figure suddenly darted out from the shadows.
An iron rod in the figure’s hand smashed violently toward his legs.
The attacker didn’t strike at vital points, clearly intending only to incapacitate him.
But Yang Fan didn’t even move.
Bang!
A dull thud echoed.
The iron rod was jolted straight out of his hand.
The shock even split the web of the teenager’s hand open.
Yang Fan remained standing where he was, completely unharmed.
With his current physical physique, let alone an iron rod, even a high-speed sports car crashing into him would be easily blocked.
At this moment, the teenager was utterly dumbfounded.
He stood there blankly, seemingly completely unable to comprehend what had just happened.
Only then did Yang Fan size the boy up.
The boy was around fifteen or sixteen years old, clearly not yet at the age to awaken a divine kingdom.
His frame was frail and weak, his complexion sallow, looking chronically malnourished.
Just then, two petite figures suddenly rushed out from the side, stepping directly in front of the boy.

Yang Fan paused in surprise, seeing a pair of twin young girls.

In contrast, the brother behind them was thin to the bone.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
He had stood there without moving and gotten struck out of nowhere.
And now, he had somehow turned into the villain?
“Well...”
“It seems like your brother was the one trying to hurt me, wasn’t he?”
Yang Fan said with amusement.

He then immediately pulled his two younger sisters down to kneel.
“Forgive us, My Lord!”
“We... we just wanted to get something to eat.”

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Some Lines Cannot Be Crossed
paragraphs: Soon after.
Yang Fan directly found a nearby hotel and booked two rooms.
He arranged the twin sisters into one room.
As for himself, he brought the boy into the other.
The hotel environment was very good.
Soft beds, a private bathroom, and even an automatic constant temperature System.
At least it was countless times better than the dilapidated little place Yang Fan used to rent in Yang County.
In fact, the infrastructure of the entire Xiling Planet was not bad at all, and even far surpassed Yang County.
Yet the people living here happened to be poor to such an extent.
The door closed.
Yang Fan sat in a chair and asked directly,
“Where is your father?”
The boy fell silent for a few seconds before slowly speaking, “Dead.”
His voice was very calm, but that irrepressible anger was almost being squeezed out from between his teeth.
Yang Fan looked at him and got straight to the point.
“I am not a person from Xiling Planet.”
“Tell me, what on earth happened to this planet?”
Ning Bailian was silent for a moment and slowly spoke.
“Two years ago... it wasn’t like this.”
“At that time, everyone had jobs, food to eat, and hope.”
“Although it couldn’t be considered wealthy, at least we could survive.”
“Until the Rao Family started continuously increasing taxes.”
Speaking of this, Ning Bailian’s voice gradually turned cold.
“In the beginning, it was the war tax.”
“Later it turned into the poll tax.”
“Housing tax.”
“Urban maintenance tax.”
“Environmental protection tax.”
“Even breathing required paying an air usage fee.”
“If you had no connections and no background, the taxes you paid became heavier and heavier.”
“If you earned 100 Faith Points, you had to hand over 80.”
By the end, Ning Bailian was practically gritting his teeth, his eyes filled with anger.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s mouth also twitched slightly.
Having a humble background himself, he had always felt that the tax burden in Yang County was already outrageous enough.
As a result, compared to Xiling Planet, Yang County was simply like heaven.
“Because of the war?” Yang Fan asked.
Ning Bailian shook his head.
“The war is just an excuse.”
“Actually, everyone knows the real reason.”
“The Rao Family... is leaving.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was slightly taken aback.
Ning Bailian continued, “Xiling Planet is just a planet they manage.”
“Now they are going to transfer to a larger planet and a better location.”
“Therefore, before leaving, they naturally want to take everything they can get.”
“Taxes, resources, minerals, population...”
“Squeezing Xiling Planet dry and sending the resources up will make their political achievements look very good.”
“In exchange for a higher position.”
“Anyway, they are leaving, and as for what happens here in the future, who would care?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan understood instantly.
No wonder such a good location like Xiling Planet could be messed up to this extent.
After all this fuss, this Rao Family was not managing at all, but rather doing a final harvest.
Yang Fan sat in the chair, gently tapping the tabletop with his right hand.
He was no saint.
In this world, there was fundamentally no absolute right or wrong.
Clear water has no fish; with many people standing in different positions, their choices naturally differed.
Towards the Divine Beings of Xiling Planet, Yang Fan indeed felt some sympathy, but that was all.
What truly concerned Yang Fan was what Gu Xuanting actually wanted him to do by sending him here.
Testing him?
Or was there another purpose?
Yang Fan suddenly recalled Gu Shaoqing’s words, his gaze gradually becoming firm.
“Forget it.”
“Rather than guessing what these old monsters are thinking.”
“It is better to act according to one’s heart.”
“Anyway, the strongest of the Rao Family is at most a Tier 3 God.”
“They cannot resist me.”
“What is your name?” Yang Fan continued to ask.
“Reporting to My Lord, this humble one is Ning Bailian.”
“A good name, refined through a hundred trials to become steel.” Yang Fan nodded.
Ning Bailian said in a low voice,
“My great-grandfather, grandfather, and father all had forging-type talents.”
“My Family used to do the weapon business.”
“That’s why my father gave me this name.”
Speaking of this, Ning Bailian’s eyes dimmed once again.
“You’re about to awaken your Divine Kingdom, right?” Yang Fan continued to ask.
Ning Bailian nodded.
“I could have awakened it last year.”
“It’s just that no one dares to go now.”
“The Awakening stones are controlled by the Rao Family.”
“Awakening now might result in being forced to hand over the Divine Kingdom coordinates and then being sold to other Star Domains.”
“Therefore, many people who just reached adulthood have been hidden away by their Family Elders.”
“Everyone is waiting, waiting for the Rao Family to leave, and waiting for a new god to come and uphold justice.”
After listening, Yang Fan couldn’t help but admire the Rao Family’s audacity in his heart.
These weren’t believers of a Divine Kingdom, but real people in reality; this was completely touching the red line of federal law.
“Aren’t they afraid of being discovered?” Yang Fan asked, puzzled.
Ning Bailian smiled bitterly.
“Discovered?”
“Right now, ordinary people can’t send out messages at all.”
“The immigration channels were also sealed long ago.”
“Plus, the Rao Family has backing.”
“Why should they be afraid?”
Speaking of this, Ning Bailian’s voice became lower and lower, leaving only helplessness on his face.
Yang Fan slowly stood up.
“I’ve booked this place for you for a month.”
“You can eat the food directly in the hotel.”
“Perhaps...”
Yang Fan paused for a moment.
“It won’t take long.”
“You will be able to go and awaken your Divine Kingdom.”
Having said that, without giving the other party a chance to continue speaking, Yang Fan directly turned and left.
After leaving the hotel, Yang Fan did not linger and went straight back to the residence arranged by the Rao Family.
As soon as he entered the courtyard, he gave instructions, “Ye Wen, call Gu Shaoqing over.”
“Now?”
“Now.”
A quarter of an hour later, the courtyard door was pushed open.
Gu Shaoqing walked in with a bitter expression, his hair even somewhat messy.
The complexions of the several maids following behind him were also somewhat unnatural.
“Brother Yang...”
Gu Shaoqing was full of resentment.
“No.”
“I finally managed to get some rest...”
“Do you know how much damage interrupting this kind of thing does to a man?”
Yang Fan glanced at him, “Continue after the matter is done.”
Gu Shaoqing instantly felt even worse, but still honestly sat down.
“Brother Yang, speak.”
Yang Fan did not talk nonsense and spoke directly.
“I’ve made my decision.”
Gu Shaoqing was slightly stunned, “Oh?”
Yang Fan said calmly, “This Rao Family, I am going to wipe them out.”
The air fell silent for a moment.
The playful smile on Gu Shaoqing’s face slowly faded, and then he nodded, seeming not surprised by this.
“Actually, I guessed it.”
As he spoke, Gu Shaoqing raised his hand.
The next moment, a large amount of criminal data on the Rao Family was directly transmitted to Yang Fan.
Yang Fan glanced over it slightly, his expression gradually turning icy.
Illegally restricting immigration, forced conscription, trafficking Divine Kingdom coordinates, human smuggling, embezzlement of resources, falsely reporting war losses...
Piece by piece, the evidence was even more exaggerated than what Ning Bailian had described.
Gu Shaoqing sat to the side and said casually, “The Third Elder told me to tell you, no need to wait for the Federal Law Enforcement Team, Brother Yang, you can handle it yourself.”
“The Rao Family wouldn’t dare to resist, nor could they resist.”
Yang Fan looked up at him, “Is the Gu Family testing me?”
Gu Shaoqing scratched his head.
“Sort of, but not entirely.”
“The higher-ups of the Family have always held a view.”
“Resources can be contested, benefits can be snatched, and being ruthless doesn’t matter either. But some lines cannot be crossed.”
Speaking of this, Gu Shaoqing turned serious for once.
“Today they dare to sell outsiders, tomorrow they will dare to sell their own people.”
“Such a Family, keeping it is meaningless.”

chapters.title: Chapter 224: I Understand
paragraphs: Gu Shaoqing continued, “Of course, there is another reason.”
“The Third Elder wanted to see what kind of person you are.”
After saying that, Gu Shaoqing returned to his usual grinning demeanor.
“So now, the answer is out.”
“Since you decided to take action, Brother Yang, the rest is simple.”
Yang Fan pondered for a moment and suddenly asked:
“The Rao Family has operated on Xiling Planet for so many years.”
“Their industries, connections, and clan members are deeply intertwined.”
“Relying on Tang Yue and Ye Wen alone, I’m afraid they won’t be able to handle it?”
Hearing this, Gu Shaoqing smiled. “Don’t worry, Brother Yang, preparations were made long ago.”
Speaking up to this point, Gu Shaoqing’s expression suddenly turned a bit strange.
He said with a hint of helplessness, “The backer behind the Rao Family... was originally someone from the Gu Family. And... an acquaintance of mine.”
Gu Shaoqing rubbed his nose, his face looking somewhat embarrassed.
“After receiving the Third Elder’s message, that person barely hesitated before handing over all the lists, industries, and social connections.”
“The Family Law Enforcement Squad arrived long ago.”
“Now, it only takes a word from you, Brother Yang.”
“Not a single person in the entire Rao Family will escape.”
Hearing this, although Yang Fan still had some doubts in his mind, he nodded, “Then give the order.”
Gu Shaoqing smiled, then turned on his smartwatch and sent out the message.
His action was understated, as if he was merely sending an ordinary message.
However, in the next instant, a wave of commotion suddenly came from outside.
“Who goes there!”
“This is the Rao Family grounds!”
“Halt!”
“Who gave you permission to barge in!”
Immediately after, angry shouts resounded continuously.
“Presumptuous!”
“Do you know who we are!”
“Behind our Rao Family stands the Gu Family!”
“Have you all gone crazy!”
Inside the room, Yang Fan sat quietly.
Gu Shaoqing poured himself another cup of tea.
Neither of them stood up, as if everything happening outside had nothing to do with them.
But the commotion outside grew louder and louder.
Footsteps, roars, crying, and the clashing of weapons.
Then it rapidly died down.
In just a few short minutes, everything was completely suppressed.
The entire Rao Family instantly fell silent.
Just at this moment, Rao Tianming’s voice came from outside the door.
“Young Master Yang...”
His voice was trembling slightly.
“May I ask... where exactly did my Rao Family go wrong?”
The moment the voice sounded, Tang Yue had already silently stepped in front of Yang Fan like a shield.
Gu Shaoqing smiled and said, “Brother Yang, care to meet him?”
“Let’s meet,” Yang Fan nodded slowly.
At this moment, even he himself felt a bit dazed.
He was clearly just a demigod, yet now, leveraging the influence of the Gu Family, he could easily decide the life and death of a Tier 3 God Family.
Gu Shaoqing looked nonchalant, as if Rao Tianming outside was completely unworthy of mention.
But Yang Fan couldn’t feel that way.
Because he knew very well that in Yang County, a Tier 3 God was an absolute high-and-mighty figure.
“Patriarch Rao,” Gu Shaoqing said calmly, “come in.”
The room door opened slowly.
In the next instant, Rao Tianming dropped directly to his knees.
“Spare my life, Young Master Yang!”
“Spare us!!”
His voice was even filled with fear.
In fact, from the moment the Rao Family was subdued...
Rao Tianming had already utilized all his connections.
His backers, allies, profit partners, and even those he usually called brothers—he had contacted every single one of them.
But the result was no response whatsoever.
Only at this moment did Rao Tianming finally understand.
Someone had suppressed all of them simultaneously.
Anyone with such power was definitely not someone he could afford to provoke.
Although Gu Shaoqing held a high status, he was notoriously hands-off, so he clearly couldn’t have done this.
The only possibility was the young man before him.
Having realized this, Rao Tianming didn’t even dare to resist and immediately rushed over to beg for mercy.
A Tier 3 God, the local overlord of Xiling Planet, a big shot in the eyes of outsiders.
But only Rao Tianming himself knew that he was merely a dog kept by others.
There were far too many people who could squash him to death.
Just then, the room door opened again.
Ye Wen walked in, and several figures were thrown in behind him.
They slammed heavily onto the ground beside Rao Tianming.
“Patriarch!”
“Save me!”
The few people had terrified expressions; they were all God-level powerhouses of the Rao Family.
Ye Wen bowed respectfully, “Young Lord, all God-level powerhouses of the Rao Family have been subdued.”
Yang Fan nodded, then compiled the evidence Gu Shaoqing had sent earlier, projected it directly onto an electronic display, and tossed it in front of Rao Tianming.
Yang Fan spoke calmly, “I suppose you have no excuses?”
Looking at the dense, overwhelming evidence before him, cold sweat broke out on Rao Tianming instantly.
His lips trembled; he wanted to explain, but did not dare to.
His gaze kept shifting toward Gu Shaoqing.
Seeing this, Gu Shaoqing suddenly let out a cold laugh.
“Uncle Gu Ming was also deceived by you.”
“Am I right?”
Rao Tianming’s body shuddered violently.
Gu Shaoqing continued unhurriedly:
“The direct and collateral branches of the Rao Family total twenty thousand people.”
“Those guilty of capital crimes who must die number about five hundred.”
“There are also around three thousand whose sentences of a century in prison would suffice.”
“As for the remaining collateral members, they can be treated with leniency.”
“So regarding certain words and how they should be spoken, you should understand, right?”
Saying this, Gu Shaoqing smiled.
Yet that smile sent a chill through Rao Tianming’s entire body.
Hearing these words, the final sliver of hope in Rao Tianming’s heart died completely.
Just then, a First-Order God of the Rao Family nearby suddenly scrambled to his feet, his face full of unwillingness.
“Patriarch Big Brother!”
“All the dirty deeds we’ve done over the years, what actually ended up in our pockets isn’t even—”
Before he could finish his sentence, Rao Tianming made his move.
Without any warning, his right palm lashed out violently.
Boom—
The air burst in an instant; that palm strike seemed to rip through space directly as terrifying Divine Power compressed wildly.
Yang Fan could only catch a blurred afterimage flashing past.
In the next instant.
The First-Order God’s body instantly froze.
Immediately after, his Physical Body crumbled piece by piece.
Flesh, bones, and Divine Power seemed to be wiped out directly by an invisible giant hand, annihilated in an instant.
The entire room instantly fell quiet.
Yang Fan’s pupils contracted slightly, and his heart pounded uncontrollably.
At this moment, he finally truly realized what kind of existence a Tier 3 God was.
If that palm strike had landed on him just now, it would have meant certain death.
A demigod had zero power to resist before a God!
Seeing Rao Tianming make such a choice, the rest of the Rao Family Elders lowered their heads one after another, falling completely silent.
Rao Tianming slowly rose to his feet and bowed deeply to Yang Fan.
“I understand. My Rao Family’s fate has run out. Since that’s the case, I am willing to serve as a stepping stone.”
“To assist you, Young Master, in taking control of Xiling Planet.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan frowned slightly, a bit puzzled.
What did this guy... understand?
Just at this moment, Rao Tianming slowly brought his hands together in a prayer motion.
Buzz—
His body actually began to emit a blinding white light.
In the next instant, terrifying Divine Power surged straight into the sky.
A thousand-zhang-tall phantom image of Divine Power instantly condensed, crashing through the roof and standing tall between heaven and earth.
Across the entire Xiling Planet, countless people looked up at the sky simultaneously.
Rao Tianming’s voice slowly resounded.

“The Third Elder wanted to see what kind of person you are.”
After saying that, Gu Shaoqing returned to his usual grinning demeanor.
“So now, the answer is out.”
“Since you decided to take action, Brother Yang, the rest is simple.”
Yang Fan pondered for a moment and suddenly asked:
“The Rao Family has operated on Xiling Planet for so many years.”
“Their industries, connections, and clan members are deeply intertwined.”
“Relying on Tang Yue and Ye Wen alone, I’m afraid they won’t be able to handle it?”
Hearing this, Gu Shaoqing smiled.
“Don’t worry, Brother Yang, preparations were made long ago.”

He said with a hint of helplessness, “The backer behind the Rao Family... was originally someone from the Gu Family.
And... an acquaintance of mine.”
Gu Shaoqing rubbed his nose, his face looking somewhat embarrassed.
“After receiving the Third Elder’s message, that person barely hesitated before handing over all the lists, industries, and social connections.”
“The Family Law Enforcement Squad arrived long ago.”
“Now, it only takes a word from you, Brother Yang.”
“Not a single person in the entire Rao Family will escape.”
Hearing this, although Yang Fan still had some doubts in his mind, he nodded, “Then give the order.”
Gu Shaoqing smiled, then turned on his smartwatch and sent out the message.
His action was understated, as if he was merely sending an ordinary message.
However, in the next instant, a wave of commotion suddenly came from outside.

“This is the Rao Family grounds!”
“Halt!”
“Who gave you permission to barge in!”
Immediately after, angry shouts resounded continuously.
“Presumptuous!”
“Do you know who we are!”
“Behind our Rao Family stands the Gu Family!”
“Have you all gone crazy!”
Inside the room, Yang Fan sat quietly.
Gu Shaoqing poured himself another cup of tea.
Neither of them stood up, as if everything happening outside had nothing to do with them.
But the commotion outside grew louder and louder.
Footsteps, roars, crying, and the clashing of weapons.
Then it rapidly died down.
In just a few short minutes, everything was completely suppressed.
The entire Rao Family instantly fell silent.
Just at this moment, Rao Tianming’s voice came from outside the door.
“Young Master Yang...”
His voice was trembling slightly.
“May I ask... where exactly did my Rao Family go wrong?”
The moment the voice sounded, Tang Yue had already silently stepped in front of Yang Fan like a shield.
Gu Shaoqing smiled and said, “Brother Yang, care to meet him?”
“Let’s meet,” Yang Fan nodded slowly.
At this moment, even he himself felt a bit dazed.
He was clearly just a demigod, yet now, leveraging the influence of the Gu Family, he could easily decide the life and death of a Tier 3 God Family.
Gu Shaoqing looked nonchalant, as if Rao Tianming outside was completely unworthy of mention.
But Yang Fan couldn’t feel that way.
Because he knew very well that in Yang County, a Tier 3 God was an absolute high-and-mighty figure.
“Patriarch Rao,” Gu Shaoqing said calmly, “come in.”
The room door opened slowly.
In the next instant, Rao Tianming dropped directly to his knees.
“Spare my life, Young Master Yang!”
“Spare us!!”
His voice was even filled with fear.
In fact, from the moment the Rao Family was subdued...
Rao Tianming had already utilized all his connections.
His backers, allies, profit partners, and even those he usually called brothers—he had contacted every single one of them.
But the result was no response whatsoever.
Only at this moment did Rao Tianming finally understand.
Someone had suppressed all of them simultaneously.
Anyone with such power was definitely not someone he could afford to provoke.
Although Gu Shaoqing held a high status, he was notoriously hands-off, so he clearly couldn’t have done this.
The only possibility was the young man before him.
Having realized this, Rao Tianming didn’t even dare to resist and immediately rushed over to beg for mercy.
A Tier 3 God, the local overlord of Xiling Planet, a big shot in the eyes of outsiders.
But only Rao Tianming himself knew that he was merely a dog kept by others.
There were far too many people who could squash him to death.

Ye Wen walked in, and several figures were thrown in behind him.
They slammed heavily onto the ground beside Rao Tianming.

“Save me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 225: The Darkness Has Ended
paragraphs: Under the boost of a Tier 3 God’s Divine Power, the voice echoed across the entire planet.
“I am Rao Tianming, announcing today to all living beings of Xiling Planet.”
“My Rao Family was boundlessly greedy, levied extortionate taxes, oppressed all beings, and restricted freedom.”
“Unpardonable in our crimes, we have now been punished by the Federation.”
The voice echoed through heaven and earth, and countless people looked dumbfoundedly toward the sky.
Rao Tianming continued, “As of today, immigration restrictions are lifted, communication restrictions are lifted, and the freedom of all living beings on Xiling Planet is returned.”
Speaking up to here, Rao Tianming paused for a moment.
Then his voice suddenly became solemn.
“Today, Young Lord Yang Fan arrives at Xiling Planet.”
“To purge the darkness and restore order.”
“Henceforth, Xiling Planet will return to the right track.”
“May all living beings remember.”
“From now on...”
“Dawn has arrived.”
As the voice faded, the entire Xiling Planet fell into a dead silence.
Yang Fan watched all this, his whole mind somewhat stunned.
“What kind of chuunibyou speech is this?!” Yang Fan complained frantically in his heart, feeling his cheeks turn slightly red at this moment.
Beside him, Tang Yue slowly stepped forward and spoke coldly,
“Consider yourself sensible. Give me the Divine Kingdom coordinates of that person from earlier.”
“I will give you all a chance to join forces. If you can win, you may live.”
Rao Tianming nodded respectfully, “Thank you, Senior.”
Then he knelt before Yang Fan again.
“Young Master Yang, I know I am an abandoned piece, and I accept my fate.”
“However... please do me a small favor.”
Yang Fan rubbed the space between his eyebrows. “Speak.”
Rao Tianming said softly, “In our Rao Family’s development to this day, the only one who can truly be called a Genius is my grandson—Rao Yu.”
“But a few days ago, he was killed.”
Speaking of this, Rao Tianming’s fists clenched slightly.
“The other party’s background is not simple. With my Rao Family’s capabilities, this revenge can probably never be exacted.”
“But you are different, Young Master Yang. With your background, resolving this person will not be difficult.”
Saying that, Rao Tianming took out a storage device and handed it to Yang Fan with both hands.
“Inside this, there is all the information.”
“If it is convenient for Young Master Yang in the future, please help us fulfill this humble wish.”
“In addition...”
Rao Tianming lowered his head slightly.
“If Young Master Yang takes over Xiling Planet in the future...”
“Please do not make things difficult for the collateral branch disciples of the Rao Family.”
“They do not know about many of these things.”
Yang Fan looked at the storage device in his hand without speaking.
Rao Tianming did not seem to expect an answer either.
He simply rose slowly, turned to face Tang Yue, and closed his eyes.
“I trouble you, Senior.”
Tang Yue’s expression was calm as she gently raised her hand.
The next instant, Yang Fan witnessed a scene he could not comprehend to this day.
No divine arts, no energy explosion, not even any fluctuation.
It seemed as if she had merely made a gentle stroke in the air.
Hum.
Space twisted slightly.
In the next instant, the bodies of Rao Tianming and all the Rao Family gods in the room froze simultaneously.
Then, they dissipated bit by bit.
Flesh, bones, and even their very existence seemed to be directly erased by a power of a higher level.
The entire process took only a moment, and silence returned to the room.
Yang Fan stood on the spot, silent for a long time.
Only at this moment did he truly understand how powerful his Dao protector was.
“Their Divine Kingdom coordinates?” Yang Fan frowned slightly.
He knew full well.
Once a Demigod or a Divine Being dies in the Real World, their Divine Kingdom collapses along with it.
But true gods are different.
As long as the Divine Kingdom is not destroyed, the god will not die.
To them, the Physical Body in the Real World is more like a special Clone.
Even if the real Physical Body is destroyed...
As long as the Divine Kingdom remains, it can still nurture a new Physical Body and return to the Real World.
Currently, he was still just a Demigod. Since he had decided to annihilate the Rao Family, Yang Fan naturally did not want to leave behind any future troubles.
“Reporting to the Young Lord.”
“I have obtained all of their Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“My believers have also begun invading these people’s Divine Kingdoms.”
Tang Yue answered respectfully.
“You already obtained the coordinates?” Yang Fan looked a bit confused.
Seeing this, Tang Yue immediately explained:
“Between gods, as long as the Physical Body in the Real World is killed, the killer can obtain the other party’s Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“Young Lord has been studying in Taichu City and may not know much about these matters on The Frontline.”
“In the war between the Federation and foreign races, gods in the Real World will also take action.”
“Battles in the Real World are merely fought to seize coordinates.”
“What truly determines life and death is always the Divine Kingdom War.”
Yang Fan nodded thoughtfully.
Yet in his heart he couldn’t help feeling emotional; although he had crammed a lot of theoretical knowledge recently...
In the end, his background was too humble. Many things that children of big families grew up immersed in, he had to learn bit by bit.
“I still need to study more.” Yang Fan noted to himself secretly.
Right at this moment, Gu Shaoqing suddenly smiled and took out a silver disc.
“Brother Yang.”
“This is a promotional video prepared for you in advance by the Third Elder.”
“After that set-up by Rao Tianming just now...”
“The effect will only be better.”
After saying that, Gu Shaoqing gently pressed on the disc.
Hum—
A huge beam of light instantly soared into the sky, piercing straight into the clouds.
Yang Fan subconsciously looked up.
In the next instant, that pillar of light slowly turned into a massive phantom.
It was none other than Yang Fan.
The image hung high above the firmament like a deity descending upon the world.
A brilliant glow continuously radiated from around his body, and a terrifying pressure covered the entire Xiling Planet.
Sacred, vast, impossible to look directly at—like a true savior.
At this moment, across the entire Xiling Planet, countless people looked up simultaneously, gazing blankly into the sky.
A grand voice slowly resounded.
“I am Yang Fan.”
“As of today, I take charge of Xiling Planet.”
The voice rang across heaven and earth, shaking everyone’s minds.
The massive phantom in the sky continued to speak:
“The Federation’s oversight was lax, allowing the Rao Family to bring disaster to Xiling Planet for many years; this was a lapse of duty by the Federation.”
“Now, the Rao Family has been brought to justice.”
“All immigration restrictions, communication blockades, and Awakening controls are completely lifted.”
“Xiling Planet...”
“Will return to normal order as of today.”
The voice paused, then continued:
“The Federation will rebuild Xiling Planet.”
“For the next two years, the entire planet will be tax-free.”
“Everyone who suffered persecution due to the Rao Family may receive compensation.”
“Anyone with special talents such as forging, Planting, alchemy, or construction may go to any city to register.”
“The Federation will reopen resource support.”
“As long as you are willing to work hard, no one on Xiling Planet will suffer anymore.”
The voice echoed across the entire planet.
Countless people’s eyes turned red in an instant.
And that grand voice was still continuing.
“The darkness of the past has ended.”
“Starting today...”
“Hope...”
“Will descend upon Xiling Planet once more.”
Boom—
Along with the fall of the last sentence...
The massive phantom in the sky slowly radiated a dazzling light and then dissipated.
At this moment, countless people even fell straight to their knees.
Inside the hotel.
Ning Bailian stared blankly at the sky, his eyes filled with disbelief.
“Is actually the new master of Xiling Planet?”

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Water That Is Too Clear Has No Fish
paragraphs: Just then, there was a sudden knock on the door.
His twin younger sisters ran in excitedly.
“Big Brother!”
“Did you see?”
“It’s that big brother!”
“It turns out he’s the new master of Xiling Planet!”
“And he even avenged us!”
Hearing the word “avenged,”
Ning Bailian’s body shuddered violently as he looked at his two younger sisters in disbelief.
One of the little girls squeezed out a smile, but tears welled up uncontrollably in her eyes.
“Actually...”
“We already knew Daddy wasn’t coming back.”
The other little girl also lowered her head, her eyes rimmed with red. “We just didn’t dare to say it.”
Ning Bailian remained silent for a long time. He slowly squatted down and pulled his two younger sisters into his embrace.
But the little girl quickly smiled again.
“Big Brother!”
“Once you awaken your Divine Kingdom in the future,”
“we can go back home!”
“When that time comes, we can be just like Daddy!”
“We’ll go to the Virtual Divine Shop and open a private weapon shop!”
“Yes, yes!”
The other little girl said huffily,
“But Big Brother, you can’t be like Daddy.”
“He always liked giving discounts to those students.”
“A lot of them were just big liars pretending to be miserable!”
“Exactly!”
“Once, he actually gave a discount of two hundred thousand Faith Points!”
“Because of that, our meals that month were so much worse!”
Listening to his two younger sisters chatter away,
Ning Bailian finally couldn’t help but laugh.
He then gently hugged them tight.
“Big Brother will definitely make sure we live a good life again,” Ning Bailian said earnestly.
But in his heart, he silently added another line.
‘If there is an opportunity in the future...’
‘I must repay Lord Yang Fan.’
Meanwhile, listening to the increasingly ridiculous promotional video playing in the sky,
Yang Fan’s lips couldn’t help but twitch.
Was he...
being fast-tracked all the way to becoming the master of Xiling Planet?
“Congratulations, Young Lord, on gaining control of a living planet like Xiling Planet.”
“I will completely destroy the Divine Kingdoms of the Rao Family’s gods within a month.”
Tang Yue said respectfully.
But as she spoke, she still couldn’t hide the envy in her eyes.
A living planet, and one tied to Federation taxes at that.
Even among Fourth-Order and Fifth-Order Gods, very few actually owned one.
Yet now, while Yang Fan was still only a demigod, he had already become the master of Xiling Planet.
This was the treatment of a Peerless Prodigy. The Gu Family’s investment in Yang Fan was indeed immense.
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
But right now, his mind was still a bit chaotic.
Ever since he left Taichu City, almost everything he had experienced seemed to have been prearranged.
How valuable was Xiling Planet? Why did they make him the master of this place of all people?
He still hadn’t fully figured out these questions.
Just then, Gu Shaoqing suddenly reminded him:
“Brother Yang.”
“Things are mostly handled here.”
“Perhaps you should go to the Virtual World to meet the Third Elder.”
Yang Fan nodded, then waved his hand to signal everyone to leave.
Once the room quieted down, he slowly took out his virtual helmet and put it on.
His consciousness entered the Virtual World.
Following the Gu Family coordinates, he quickly arrived at the Gu Family Territory.
Just as he entered, Gu Xuanting was already sitting there waiting.
“Greetings, Father,” Yang Fan immediately bowed.
Gu Xuanting smiled and waved his hand. “Sit.”
Once Yang Fan sat down,
Gu Xuanting slowly spoke: “Do you have doubts regarding this trip?”
“Yes,” Yang Fan did not hide it.
Gu Xuanting continued to ask, “Then do you know how much this Xiling Planet is worth?”
Yang Fan shook his head.
Gu Xuanting smiled.
“Xiling Planet has an area of about thirty million square kilometers, with a permanent population of nearly eight billion.”
“At its Peak, its monthly tax revenue exceeded two hundred billion Divinity Points.”
Yang Fan’s pupils contracted slightly.
Gu Xuanting continued:
“Half of that needs to be turned over to the Federation.”
“The remaining half, after deducting the costs to maintain the planet’s operations, belongs to the planet owner as personal income.”
As those words fell, Yang Fan’s heart couldn’t help but thud violently.
A living planet... was actually this valuable?
Just the tax revenue alone was equivalent to the income of two hundred Spirit Vein Planets.
Only at this moment did Yang Fan finally understand
why Gu Shaoqing had said this was the Gu Family’s biggest investment in him.
Seeing Yang Fan’s shocked expression,
Gu Xuanting smiled and said:
“Everyone will awaken a Divine Kingdom.”
“And the development of the Divine Kingdom, the circulation of resources, transactions, and consumption...”
“almost all of it requires paying taxes.”
“If not for Xiling Planet’s relatively small size,”
“the income would only be higher.”
Speaking up to this point, Gu Xuanting’s voice suddenly turned serious.
“Sending you to Xiling Planet this time...”
“I actually prepared three choices for you.”
Yang Fan immediately sat up straight. “Please guide me, Father.”
Gu Xuanting slowly uttered three terms:
“Politics.”
“Business.”
“The military.”
Yang Fan listened intently.
Gu Xuanting continued:
“If you had really slaughtered the entire Xiling Planet like that joke you made,”
Gu Xuanting suddenly chuckled.
“then this planet could not be given to you.”
“We could only send you to The Frontline.”
“However, with the Gu Family’s maneuvering and your talent,”
“it wouldn’t be difficult to secure you at least a Corps Commander position.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was suddenly a bit embarrassed.
His words back then were truly a joke; who knew they would actually reach Gu Xuanting’s ears.
Fortunately, the other party didn’t take it seriously, otherwise, he might have really thought his son-in-law was some kind of lunatic.
Gu Xuanting continued:
“As for business and politics,”
“that will depend on your subsequent performance.”
“Xiling Planet...”
“is the exam paper I am giving you.”
“If you choose politics, I can help you enter the Parliament.”
“If you choose business, your mother-in-law has the resources of the Lu Family behind her.”
“In the future, she can even help you buy up several surrounding living planets to build your own business empire.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan immediately stood up and bowed respectfully. “Thank you for your cultivation, Father.”
Gu Xuanting smiled and nodded.
Meanwhile, Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel a wave of emotion in his heart.
This was what it felt like to have backing.
Those at the bottom often had to rely on luck, talent, and hard work.
None of the three could be lacking.
Struggling for a lifetime might only yield a tiny bit of achievement.
But for those with real backgrounds,
Elders would pave the way in advance, resources would actively tilt in their favor, and even their future direction would be planned out by someone else.
Sometimes, the gap between people was never just about talent.
Being in a great Family, even a useless person could achieve something great!
‘This soft rice...’
‘is so damn delicious.’
Yang Fan couldn’t help but marvel in his heart.
Gu Xuanting looked at Yang Fan with a faint smile, then continued to ask:
“Let me ask you another thing. Standing behind the Rao Family is Uncle Gu Ming, a branch member of the Gu Family.”
“An ordinary First-Order God.”
“Of course, he is also Gu Shaoqing’s cousin-uncle.”
“How do you think this person should be handled?”
Yang Fan was slightly startled, then cautiously glanced at Gu Xuanting.
After pondering for a moment, he slowly spoke:
“Father, I think...”
“water that is too clear has no fish.”
Gu Xuanting suddenly laughed, his laughter incredibly hearty.
“Hahaha! Since that’s the case, we will do as you say.”
“No punishment.”
Gu Xuanting’s tone was calm, as if he were deciding a trivial matter.
“My Gu Family controls living planets across the vast universe.”
“One or two planets...”
“indeed amount to nothing.”

chapters.title: Chapter 227: Long-term Management
paragraphs: Soon, Yang Fan’s consciousness exited the Virtual World.
Returning to reality, he let out a long breath and leaned his entire body against the back of the chair.
Only then did he notice that his mind was somewhat exhausted.
Chatting with Gu Xuanting this time indeed carried quite a bit of pressure.
Every single sentence felt like taking an exam.
Thump, thump.
Right at this moment, a knock came from outside the door.
“Come in.”
Gu Shaoqing pushed open the door and entered.
However, his face unusually lacked its usual flippant smile; instead, he appeared somewhat awkward and nervous.
“Brother Yang...”
“How did your chat with the Third Elder go?”
Yang Fan glanced at him and quickly guessed what he wanted to ask.
Thus, he directly spoke up:
“Rest assured.”
“Your uncle is fine.”
Hearing this, Gu Shaoqing visibly breathed a sigh of relief, as if the heavy stone pressing on his chest had finally fallen to the ground.
Then, he turned out to be rarely serious, cupping his hands toward Yang Fan.
“Thank you, Brother Yang, for interceding for Uncle Gu Ming.”
In fact, this matter was very serious.
No matter how sincere Uncle Gu Ming’s attitude of admitting his mistake was.
If it were truly brought out into the open.
Theoretically, he should have suffered the same fate as Rao Tianming.
But the problem was that Uncle Gu Ming shared the surname Gu.
And as for punishments of this sort.
When all is said and done, it was nothing more than a single word from above.
Back then, to handle this matter, Uncle Gu Ming had no idea how many connections he had to pull just to squeeze Gu Shaoqing in.
He originally wanted to turn a big matter into a small one, and a small matter into nothing at all.
Yet who could have expected that the Third Elder would directly arrange for Yang Fan to come.
Although Gu Shaoqing was of the direct lineage, his Elders were simply not in the same tier compared to Gu Xuanting.
Therefore, all along this path, he could only desperately try to get on good terms with Yang Fan.
Yet many things simply could not be explicitly stated.
Regardless, his branch could be considered to owe Yang Fan a favor.
Gu Shaoqing patted his chest and said earnestly:
“Brother Yang.”
“Although my talent isn’t much to speak of, I have quite a few friends.”
“In the future, if you have any matters, just give a word; whatever can be done will never be refused.”
Yang Fan wore a polite smile.
“Then many thanks.”
Who Uncle Gu Ming was, he didn’t actually care.
The fate of the Rao Family was already sealed; there was no need to make more enemies for unrelated people.
After marrying Gu Le, he indeed had a giant tree to lean on.
But that wasn’t a reason to make enemies everywhere.
Yang Fan had always felt that this world was very cruel.
In reality, everyone could only take care of themselves.
He was no righteous magistrate, nor could he achieve fairness in everything.
Being able to hold one’s bottom line and not actively commit evil was already not easy most of the time.
The so-called upholding of justice was sometimes a luxury in itself.
Gu Shaoqing said again at this time:
“Brother Yang.”
“Now that Xiling Planet belongs to your jurisdiction in the future, do you want me to help introduce a professional team to you?”
“For matters like managing a planet, outsiders easily suffer losses.”
Yang Fan shook his head.
“Thank you for the kind offer.”
“However, I already have a candidate in mind.”
“If it doesn’t work out, I will come to trouble you then.”
Gu Shaoqing smiled.
“Alright, when we return to Taichu City, we’ll drink together.”
“Good.”
Soon, Gu Shaoqing left, and the room quieted down once more.
Yang Fan took out his communicator and sent a message to Ma Yu.
Managing a planet, such a professional matter, should naturally be handed over to professional people.
And Ma Yu was precisely the best candidate in Yang Fan’s heart.
In the Virtual World, the location where the two agreed to meet.
Ma Yu rushed over almost at the first instance.
“Boss.”
“Is there any matter you wish to instruct?”
Yang Fan didn’t talk nonsense either, stating directly:
“The Gu Family invested in a living planet for me.”
“I have already sent the data to you.”
“From now on, you will be in charge of holding down the fort there.”
The air suddenly fell silent.
Ma Yu’s entire person froze in place.
His mouth slowly widened, his face full of disbelief.
“A... a living planet?”
“Boss.”
“What you spoke of is... a living planet?!”
Ma Yu couldn’t help but swallow a mouthful of saliva.
Yang Fan frowned, “Doesn’t Elephant Loan also have planets? Is there any need to be this surprised?”
Ma Yu smiled bitterly.
“Boss.”
“You are in bliss and yet unaware of your blessings.”
“Strictly speaking, those planets of Elephant Loan can only be considered resource planets or asteroids.”
“Although after investment, it ‘met the conditions for habitation.'”
“Yet who would be willing to immigrate there?”
Ma Yu took a deep breath and explained earnestly:
“The most valuable thing about a living planet has never been the environment.”
“Instead, it is people.”
“Those living, breathing people, those people who have already formed an ecology, industry, and civilization.”
Ma Yu pointed at himself.
“People are money.”
“A single living planet is worth tens of thousands, or even one hundred thousand dead stars.”
Speaking up to this point, Ma Yu looked toward Yang Fan, his gaze turning complicated.
At this moment, he suddenly felt even more fortunate that he had chosen to become Yang Fan’s subordinate back then.
Because even he himself had never possessed a living planet.
And this was the foundation of the Gu Family, one of the Five Great Families.
A single living planet was already enough to crush the total assets of the vast majority of low-tier deities.
“Managing Xiling Planet, you won’t have any problems, right?” Yang Fan asked.
Ma Yu nodded immediately.
“Boss, rest assured.”
“When all is said and done, the core of planet management boils down to a single word — money.”
“Most of the other procedures are actually fixed templates; you can just hand them over to Intelligent Life.”
Speaking up to this point, Ma Yu continued: “The key lies in how the boss wants to manage this planet.”
“What do you mean?” Yang Fan asked.
Ma Yu thought for a moment and organized his words.
“If we pursue short-term returns, we should raise taxes, strengthen management, increase the cost of population mobility, and concentrate resources as much as possible.”
“The benefit of doing this is that the short-term returns will be very high.”
“However, the price is that the entire planet will become increasingly dead, people will decrease, geniuses will drain away, and in the end, one can only continuously squeeze the remaining people.”
Speaking up to this point, Ma Yu paused for a moment, then continued:
“The other way is long-term management.”
“Lower taxes, reduce intervention, provide resource support, encourage population mobility, and cultivate more powerhouses.”
“Short-term returns will decrease, and continuous investment will even be required in the early stage.”
“But as long as it develops, the more people there are, the more powerhouses there are, the more prosperous commerce becomes, and naturally the higher the taxes will get.”
“Simply put, the former treats the planet like mining, while the latter operates the planet like an industry.”
Yang Fan looked thoughtful, then directly said:
“Choose long-term development; Xiling Planet is currently in a state of disrepair and waiting to be revived.”
“Continuing to squeeze won’t squeeze out much oil and water either.”
In fact, over the past two years, the Rao Family had almost sucked Xiling Planet dry.
Those demigods had either died or fled.
The ones left behind were basically Divine Beings.
And the taxes brought by hundreds or thousands of Divine Beings probably couldn’t even compare to a single demigod.
Furthermore, Yang Fan was not short on Divinity Points right now.
He naturally understood the reasoning of draining the pond to catch fish.
Xiling Planet would be his base camp in the future, so he naturally had to manage it carefully.
“Understood, boss can rest assured.”
Ma Yu immediately guaranteed.
“I will make arrangements right away.”
“First, we’ll move the headquarters of Elephant Loan over there.”
“By then, it will at least bring a considerable amount of commercial activity.”

chapters.title: Chapter 228: I Love You
paragraphs: Yang Fan nodded and continued to add, “In addition, arrange a few spaceships to make a trip to my hometown.”
“I will send you the list, and bring these people over.”
“There is also a Family named Luo Family in Yang County.”
“They helped me before, ask if they are willing to relocate.”
“If they are willing, help them immigrate.”
“If not, leave a batch of resources behind.”
Ma Yu recorded earnestly, “Understood.”
Early the next morning, Yang Fan and Gu Shaoqing and the others boarded the spaceship, embarking on the road back to Taichu City.
As for Xiling Planet, it was temporarily taken over by Intelligent Life.
Basic administrative work would not have any problems.
In a few more days, Ma Yu would arrive and officially preside over the overall situation.
For Yang Fan, the development of the Divine Kingdom always ranked first.
Xiling Planet was more like his Foundation in reality, which was a stable source of income in the future.
As for specific matters, they were naturally handed over to professionals to handle.
After the spaceship entered stable navigation.
Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom, and then he took out the small storage device left by Rao Tianming.
“Yang Da.”
“Play the contents inside.”
Yang Fan’s tone was calm.
Considering that Rao Family was sensible enough.
If the matter was not troublesome, it didn’t matter to help out along the way.
“As you command, Master.”
A blue beam of light shot out from Yang Da’s eyes, instantly scanning the storage device.
Immediately after, above the sky, a huge light screen slowly unfolded.
What was recorded inside was impressively a Divine Kingdom War.
The flames of war spread, believers slaughtered each other, and countless buildings collapsed.
And at the end of the picture was the image of Rao Yu’s divine kingdom before its destruction.
The moment he saw the picture, Yang Fan was directly stunned.
“This...”
Yang Fan extended his right hand.
Pointing at the picture with an expression of disbelief.
Yang Da confirmed earnestly:
“Reporting to Master, the identity of the invader has been confirmed, it is the previous Human Demigod.”
The air suddenly became quiet.
After a moment, Yang Fan finally couldn’t help cursing.
“Damn.”
“Even this probability can be encountered by me?”
“So people wanted revenge.”
“And as a result, they found the enemy?”
Yang Fan took a deep breath, and his expression gradually became serious.
Originally, he felt that he didn’t have much to do with Rao Family.
It was just that Gu Xuanting wanted to give Xiling Planet to himself and deal with Rao Family along the way.
But now, the situation had changed.
This was not someone else’s enmity.
This was his own enmity.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan directly sent a message to Ma Yu.
“Upon arriving at Xiling Planet.”
“Do not let a single direct descendant of Rao Family go.”
“In addition.”
“If there are individuals with extremely high talent among the collateral branches, deal with future troubles in advance.”
After sending the message, Yang Fan slowly let out a breath.
Dealing with enemies and leaving hidden dangers was not his habit.
Ten days later, the spaceship slowly drove into the parking area of Taichu City.
The familiar city reappeared before his eyes.
Yang Fan stood in front of the cabin door, inexplicably having a feeling of going home.
Soon, the spaceship stopped steadily, and everyone walked down one after another.
Tang Yue and Ye Wen stopped at the same time and respectfully saluted Yang Fan.
“Young Lord, we shall take our leave first.”
“Mm.” Yang Fan nodded.
At this moment, he suddenly discovered that someone was already waiting at the berth.
That was a middle-aged man.
Slightly plump in figure, wearing very decent clothes.
There was always a smile on his face, and when his gaze swept over Yang Fan and the others, his eyes even carried a bit of ingratiation.
Before Yang Fan could ask, Gu Shaoqing on the side had already introduced with a smile.
“Brother Yang, this is my cousin uncle.”
“Uncle Gu Ming.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan immediately showed a smile, “Greetings, Uncle Gu Ming.”
In fact, Yang Fan knew very well in his heart that Rao Family was just a black glove.
And the one truly standing behind was most likely the person in front of him.
However.
So what?
Now Xiling Planet already belonged to him, and he was also a person of Gu Family.
He couldn’t hold Gu Family’s rice bowl and then smash Gu Family’s pot.
Whether Uncle Gu Ming was good or bad didn’t have much to do with him.
In the eyes of Rao Family, Uncle Gu Ming might be a protective umbrella, a towering tree.
But in Yang Fan’s view, the other party was just a marginal deity of Gu Family.
He had read a lot of books recently.
Yang Fan increasingly felt that many things never had absolute right or wrong.
The so-called red gates smell of wine and meat, while bones freeze on the road.
Whichever position you stood in, you would naturally think from that position.
The world was never simply black and white.
More often, position dictates thought.
Starting from interests, letting Uncle Gu Ming off and doing a favor along the way was the choice with the greatest return.
Uncle Gu Ming hurriedly waved his hand, even slightly bending over, his smile becoming more and more fawning.
“Young Lord Yang.”
“This won’t do.”
“I am merely a few hundred years older.”
“How could I dare to act as your uncle?”
“If you don’t mind, you can call me Little Gu, or Little Ming.”
Gu Shaoqing rolled his eyes instantly on the side.
“Uncle Gu Ming.”
“Your seniority is messed up.”
“I call Brother Yang.”
Uncle Gu Ming’s smile froze instantly.
His expression was obviously a bit awkward.
However, after such a fuss, the atmosphere became much more relaxed.
Uncle Gu Ming quickly took out a crystal card and handed it over with both hands.
“Young Lord Yang.”
“This is a portion of the tribute proceeds from Rao Family over the years.”
“I hope you don’t mind.”
Yang Fan was slightly startled, “This... isn’t good, right.”
Uncle Gu Ming hurriedly waved his hand, his tone even a bit anxious.
“Young Lord saved my life.”
“A small token of appreciation, please do not decline.”
Seeing this, Yang Fan sighed.
“Since that is the case.”
“Then I will accept it.”
After Yang Fan left.
Gu Shaoqing asked curiously, “Uncle Gu Ming, how much was given?”
Uncle Gu Ming had a look of heartache, “Twenty billion Divinity Points.”
“Just this little?” Gu Shaoqing curled his lips.
Uncle Gu Ming rolled his eyes instantly.
“I am from a collateral branch.”
“How can I compare with little monsters like you.”
“What Rao Family gives me, I still have to continue to tribute upwards.”
“This is already all my working capital.”
Speaking of this, Uncle Gu Ming was even more depressed.
What kind of person was Gu Shaoqing? A Grade-A Genius of Primordial Academy, a key cultivation object of Gu Family, whose resources had never been cut off since childhood.
And what about himself?
His rating back then was mediocre.
He didn’t even have the qualification to enter the top academy of Taichu City, and could only go to a pheasant institution to study.
Relying on the remaining shade of his ancestors, he could stay in Taichu City.
The Foundations of their Divine Kingdoms were simply not on the same level.
On the other side, Yang Fan had already returned to the villa.
Just pushing open the door, Gu Le was already sitting on the sofa waiting.
Seeing Yang Fan return, she immediately smiled and greeted him.
“Husband.”
“Hearing father say.”
“Gu Family rewarded you with a life planet?”
“How is that place?”
Yang Fan sat down with a smile.
“Pretty good.”
“And father also helped me apply for a two-year tax exemption.”
Gu Le’s eyes lit up slightly, and then she suddenly smiled and joked.
“Then in the future.”
“When our child grows up.”
“Will you let him inherit Xiling Planet?”
Yang Fan almost didn’t hesitate, directly reaching out to pull Gu Le into his arms.
“Of course, my things.”
“In the future, they will naturally be yours as well.”
“What’s more.”
“I love you.”
Gu Le’s body stiffened slightly, and her earlobes instantly turned red.
Although she knew Yang Fan was just sweet-talking and deliberately coaxing her,
But hearing these words, her heart was still sweet.
She couldn’t help leaning into Yang Fan’s arms, whispering:
“Don’t worry.”
“On father’s side.”
“He will definitely fully support you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Something Else Added
paragraphs: Yang Fan gently held Gu Le in his arms, feeling quietly emotional.
Sometimes, hard work truly is important.
But choosing the right path is even more crucial.
At least...
...living off a rich woman truly tastes sweet.
After comforting Gu Le, Yang Fan’s consciousness quickly entered his Divine Kingdom.
As soon as he entered, he took out the crystal card Uncle Gu Ming had given him.
Scanning it with his Divine Thought, he saw the string of numbers inside.
Even Yang Fan couldn’t help but curl his lips into a slight smile.
“20 billion Divinity Points.”
“As expected of the behind-the-scenes umbrella, so generous with a single gesture.”
Then, Yang Fan checked his Divine Kingdom’s information.
Compared to before he left, earth-shaking changes had already taken place.

“Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (220,000), Martial Master Realm (450,000), Qi Refining Realm (500 million), Martial Apprentice Realm (800 million), Second-class Intelligent Life (150,000), First-Class Intelligent Life (140 million), Tier 5 Being (30 billion)... Mortal (60 billion).”
During the time Yang Fan was away...
Nearly three thousand years had passed inside the Divine Kingdom.
Now, the total population was approaching one hundred billion.
Looking at the data before him, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel emotional.
Due to the existence of the War God Codex, the internal layout of the entire Divine Kingdom had completely transformed.
Previously, the Immortal Alliance had held sole dominance.
Now, however, the Wanxiang Martial Court had completely risen to power.
Martial arts civilization expanded forcefully, almost entirely suppressing the Immortal Alliance and the Mechanical Civilization.
In response to this, Yang Da was continuously adjusting resource allocation.
Madly tilting resources toward the Cultivation Route and the Mechanical Path.
Unfortunately, no matter how abundant ordinary resources were, they ultimately couldn’t compare to a supreme treasure like the War God Codex, so the effect remained limited.
Yang Fan wasn’t in a hurry, though.
At least with the Martial Route as the mainstream...
In future Divine Kingdom Wars, having a strong Physical Body and defense capabilities would actually make them safer.
Now, the entire Divine Kingdom was vibrant with vitality.
Under the planning of Yang Yi and Yang Da, the territories of the three major factions had expanded four to five times compared to the past.
Many of the former cities had long been demolished and rebuilt.
Some were new types of cities purchased from the Divine Shop.
Others were constructed entirely by the believers themselves.
In the Immortal Alliance, mountains floated in the sky, and immortal cities stood in grand numbers.
In the Wanxiang Martial Court, giant cities stretched continuously, and martial arts Holy Lands dotted the land.
As for the Mechanical Civilization, it had formed a steel metropolis cluster covering millions of square kilometers.
As the civilization continuously evolved, even though Yang Fan had never deliberately guided it...
...more and more specialized professions naturally emerged within the Divine Kingdom.
Besides Alchemists and Blacksmiths...
...there also appeared Spirit Plant Cultivators, Array Pattern Architects, Construction Master Architects, Exotic Beast Cultivators, Ecological Planners...
The number of people in these professions was far smaller than that of Alchemists and Blacksmiths.
But the changes they brought were by no means minor.
Civilization is never built solely by stacking combat professions.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan began to replan his future in his mind.
Now, the Divine Kingdom’s area was within a hair’s breadth of reaching one hundred million square kilometers.
If he were willing to keep purchasing coordinates and wildly devour Divine Kingdom Cores...
...with his current troop strength, fighting on multiple fronts...
...he could Breakthrough to Godhood in two months at most.
But Yang Fan was in no rush.
Because breaking through meant leaving the Primordial Academy.
And before leaving, he naturally had to fleece all the benefits he possibly could.
The Primordial Academy had three most important resource areas in total.
The Primordial Academy, the Primordial Battlefield, and the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
First was the Primordial Academy; after over a year of lavish investment regardless of cost, the Alchemy and forging systems in the Divine Kingdom had long matured.
Various Legacies were gradually forming, so even if he left Taichu City in the future...
...relying on the believers’ own research, they could still continuously develop new Pill Formulas and higher-quality Medicinal Pills.
For the current Divine Kingdom, the Primordial Academy had gradually become dispensable.
Next was the Primordial Battlefield.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but smile.
He had only claimed the rewards for the top one million rank so far.
The rewards for top 100,000, top 10,000, and even top 100 had yet to be claimed.
Finally, there was the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
That was the place where the Primordial Academy specially kept captive Alien Demigods.
Gu Le had warned him before that it was extremely dangerous.
Alien Demigods were exceptionally powerful.
Furthermore, the rules were strict: it had to be one-on-one, with no outside interference allowed.
Many Human Race Prodigies had even met their downfall there.
But similarly, danger meant high returns.
The Divine Kingdoms of those demigods in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone were extremely rich in resources, and there might even be S-Rank Buildings inside.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s gaze gradually turned resolute.
However, there was no rush for any of this.
A lion uses its full strength even when hunting a rabbit.
Once the Divine Kingdom evolved for nearly another ten thousand years, the believers overall would hit a Bottleneck, reaching the limit allowed by the current Divine Kingdom’s rules.
That would be the true time for harvesting.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan spoke slowly:
“Yang Da.”
“Next, develop the believers with all our strength.”
“Increase investment in the Mechanical Civilization and Cultivation Civilization.”
“Use surplus funds to purchase growth buildings similar to the f-class transformation pod.”
“Make full use of every single bit of resources.”
Yang Da immediately bowed his head. “As you command, Master.”
The entire Divine Kingdom began operating at high speed once again.
Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality.
The days that followed returned to tranquility once more.
Reading and studying daily, observing the Divine Kingdom’s development, and feeling his body grow stronger and stronger.
It was as if he had returned to his state when he first entered the Primordial Academy.
However, unlike before...
...Yang Fan clearly felt that his life now was much more relaxed.
The Divine Kingdom developed rapidly, and the believers grew at a frantic pace.
He could feel changes in his own strength almost every day.
That kind of growth was no longer a sudden leap after a single Opportunity.
But rather a continuous, tangible improvement.
Apart from studying and Cultivating...
...Yang Fan spent almost all of his remaining time accompanying Gu Le.
It couldn’t be helped; living off this rich woman was simply too sweet.
The total investment Gu Le’s parents had provided him before and after was already an unimaginable sum.
Since that was the case, offering this Gu Family Young Miss sufficient emotional value was naturally the proper thing to do.
It is vital to have self-awareness, and Yang Fan would never get carried away just because he had achieved a bit of success now.
Especially after experiencing the affair on Xiling Planet, he realized ever more clearly that compared to a colossus like the Gu Family...
...the current him was probably truly no different from an ant.
Asserting husband authority? Nonsense.
With such a beautiful, rich, and extraordinarily well-connected wealthy woman...
...Yang Fan wished he could pamper her every day, terrified of slacking in any way.
But gradually, Yang Fan noticed...
...without realizing when it began, he had grown accustomed to someone waiting for him to eat.
Accustomed to someone chatting with him about trivial matters.
And accustomed to that atmosphere of everyday life outside the Divine Kingdom.
It seemed that on his path of continuously growing stronger, something else had finally been added.
One month later, in the Virtual World.
Yang Fan arrived at the meeting spot as agreed.
Ma Yu had already been waiting for a long time.
“Boss, we have completely taken over Xiling Planet.”
“Currently, the overall operation is stable.”
Yang Fan nodded. “How is the situation?”
Speaking of this, Ma Yu couldn’t help but spit in annoyance, clearly rendered speechless.
“Boss, what on earth were those previous managers doing?”
“Only after taking over did I discover that the tax rate on Xiling Planet was outrageously high.”
“It was far above the average level of most living planets.”
“So I directly slashed taxes by 50%.”
The more Ma Yu spoke, the more speechless he became.
“Those demigods had nearly all run away.”
“If they kept squeezing them like that, probably no one would be left to pay taxes in the future.”
“According to historical records...”
“Under normal circumstances on Xiling Planet, monthly tax revenue would never be lower than two hundred billion Divinity Points.”
“As a result, right now, we can’t even collect one hundred billion.”
