“Only after taking over did I discover that the tax rate on Xiling Planet was outrageously high.”
“It was far above the average level of most living planets.”
“So I directly slashed taxes by 50%.”
The more Ma Yu spoke, the more speechless he became.
“Those demigods had nearly all run away.”
“If they kept squeezing them like that, probably no one would be left to pay taxes in the future.”
“According to historical records...”
“Under normal circumstances on Xiling Planet, monthly tax revenue would never be lower than two hundred billion Divinity Points.”
“As a result, right now, we can’t even collect one hundred billion.”

chapters.title: Chapter 230: The Thigh
paragraphs: Yang Fan was not particularly surprised by this.
Xiling Planet had indeed been battered miserably enough.
With everything waiting to be rebuilt, continuing to crazily exploit like the Rao Family made no sense.
Those low-level Divine Beings had almost no Resources to begin with; even under high-pressure rule, how much could possibly be squeezed out?
To take from them, one must first give to them.
Yang Fan still understood this principle.
Ma Yu continued reporting:
“Boss.”
“The Human Federation gave a two-year tax exemption period.”
“Now this month, the total tax revenue is about fifty billion.”
“However, the expenditures are not few either.”

“Civil servant salaries, basic urban maintenance, transportation waterway repairs, public security system reconstruction, commercial district recovery, immigrant subsidies, plus some education and medical investments.”
“Currently, the total expenditure is about ten billion.”
“There are still forty billion in floating funds now.”
Ma Yu looked at Yang Fan, waiting for his decision.
Yang Fan thought for a moment and spoke directly:
“Leave ten billion as emergency funds.”
“Transfer the remaining thirty billion into my Divine Kingdom.”
“Your task now is to restore the commercial environment of Xiling Planet as soon as possible.”
“Understood,” Ma Yu nodded and said.
Then he continued:
“In addition.”
“Elephant Loan headquarters has already moved in.”
“I also gave some tax concessions and invited many old friends to set up branch offices here.”
“At the same time, the immigration reward policy has been released.”
“In addition, I have exposed the matters of the Rao Family in the surrounding Star Domain.”
“Those demigods who left should return in part.”
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“Leave these matters for you to arrange.”
“I am at ease.”
After saying this, Ma Yu seemed to suddenly think of something.
“That’s right, Boss, besides your parents and friends.”
“The Luo Family has also completely moved into Xiling Planet.”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, “The entire Family moved here?”
Ma Yu smiled and nodded.
“Of course.”
“Xiling Planet is an important hub after all.”
“I sent the coordinates over, and they checked the Virtual World.”
“They could immediately understand that the development potential here far exceeds Yang County.”
“The Luo Family head is a smart person.”
“Naturally, they know how to choose.”
Speaking of this, Ma Yu showed a meaningful smile.
“The only trouble is.”
“Magistrate Wang Yun of Yang County was somewhat unwilling to let people go.”
“After all, the first Family suddenly moving away has quite a big impact.”
“And this also means that the connection between the Boss and Yang County will become less and less.”
“So I personally participated in the negotiations.”
“Fortunately, he is quite sensible.”
Looking at Ma Yu’s slightly strange smile,
Yang Fan frowned slightly; he always felt that this negotiation process probably wasn’t that pleasant.
However, he couldn’t be bothered to continue asking.
Since the important people had all left, that was enough.
As he became a Peerless Prodigy,
Yang County had actually long since received enough returns.
Often, a hometown does not necessarily equal home.
The place truly worthy of being called home has always been the place where someone is waiting for you.
People always have to move upwards.
For growth.
For the future.
No one will stay in the same place forever.
And some places can ultimately only become the path by which one came.
“Since that’s the case, send out a notice.”
“Have everyone enter the Virtual World, I am heading to Xiling Planet right away,” Yang Fan said.
“Yes, Boss.”
As the words fell, Ma Yu’s consciousness exited the Virtual World.
A moment later, Yang Fan followed the coordinates and arrived at Xiling Planet.
Just as he landed, he discovered that in just a month’s time, quite a lot of changes had already taken place here.
On the streets, those fierce-looking law enforcement officers had long since disappeared.
Replaced by Divine Beings doing business everywhere.
On the roadside, the sound of quarreling was endless.
“Old Man Li!”
“Do you want these twenty thousand cattle of mine or not?”
“Not want! You’re selling twenty thousand ordinary beasts for one thousand Faith Points?”
“Do you take me for a fool?”
The person selling the cattle suddenly became anxious, “What ordinary beasts? This is top-quality marbled beef!”
“Scram, scram, scram! Old Zhang bought from you last time.”
“His believers all said it was stringy! You aren’t trying to fool a brother with cheap goods, are you?”
Not far away, shouting noises were also continuous.
“Bodhi Precious Snake private transaction! Avoid taxes! First come, first served!”
“Erbao Grain Shop opens today! Leave your address! The boss delivers in person! Definitely cheaper than the Divine Shop!”
Various sounds mixed together, appearing somewhat noisy.
Yet it made the entire city come alive again.
With Yang Fan’s current Mental Energy,
he could hear these conversations clearly.
Some bargained for dozens of Faith Points, some shouted at a loss just to keep customers, and others calculated meticulously every day just to make a living.
These Divine Beings were not strong.
Even the vast majority of them remained at the bottom throughout their lives.
Yet it was precisely these most ordinary people who supported a living planet.
Last month, this place was still lifeless with Death Qi.
Now that a batch of administrators had changed, everyone started making a living all over again.
Thinking about making money again, thinking about climbing upwards again.
Yang Fan suddenly understood a bit why those truly powerful planets instead did not overly interfere with the operation of the bottom layer.
Whether it was a country or a planet,
the greatest wealth had never been Resources, but people.
And if you want people to create wealth,
often, the best management is actually no management at all.
Give them a way out, give them space.
For the rest, people will create miracles by themselves.
Divine Beings were very weak, but countless weak people converging together constituted the entire Human Federation.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan simply perceived it for a moment, then withdrew his gaze.
The development of the Divine Kingdom takes time, and the development of the planet is the same.
As the master, there was no need to do everything personally; just leave it to professional people to manage.
Soon, Yang Fan arrived at the residential area.
As soon as he approached, he was slightly stunned.
Inside the house were familiar figures.
Yet outside the house stood densely packed people.
A rough scan showed there were actually over a thousand.
Those people waited quietly without any commotion, not even daring to breathe heavily.
Among them, Luo Hai, Luo Chengfeng, and other familiar figures were surprisingly all in the mix.
However, no one dared to go inside, and upon seeing Yang Fan, they all lowered their heads, not daring to strike up a conversation.
This was deliberately arranged by Ma Yu.
In Ma Yu’s eyes, a Tier 3 God like Luo Hai was perhaps not even as important as Yang Fan’s childhood friend Zhang Pang.
Pushing open the door and entering, Yang Tiexin immediately stood up.
“You’re back?”
Sun Rong hurried over even more eagerly, looking him up and down for a long time.
“Did you lose weight?”
“Have you been tired recently?”
“How have you been eating?”
Faced with his parents’ inquiries,
Yang Fan answered with a smile:
“Pretty good.”
“No one is bullying me.”
As the words fell, two figures had already walked up.
One on the left and one on the right, they directly hugged Yang Fan’s arms.
“Husband”
“I missed you to death”
Luo Rou’s voice was gentle.
Luo Bing leaned directly against him.
“Husband, are you really the master of this living planet?”
“Why do I feel this is so unreal.”
On the other side, Zhang Pang and Zhang Wanshan were obviously much more restrained, even somewhat fidgety.
Especially Zhang Pang, whose mood at this moment was extremely complicated.
He still remembered that sentence from back then: “If we attain wealth and honor, let us not forget each other.”
It was originally a joke.
As a result, Yang Fan actually remembered it.

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Only Young Master Yang's Battle Intent Burns Fierce
paragraphs: After learning that Yang Fan had become the master of a life planet,
Zhang Pang immediately went home, dragged Zhang Wanshan along, and packed their things overnight.
Whatever assets could fit into their divine kingdoms were packed; they didn’t even have time to sell their house before fleeing directly.
What a joke!
His petty assets were practically nothing!
Zhang Pang had long made up his mind.
He had to cling to this thick thigh for the rest of his life.
What did “when one man attains the Dao, his poultry and dogs rise to heaven” mean?
This was it!
Thinking of this, Zhang Pang took a deep breath and plucked up the courage to say, “Brother... Brother Yang.”
“You’re getting a bit scary.”
“A minor piece of news every three days, and a major one every five.”
“My standards aren’t high. In the future, when you eat meat, I don’t even need soup—just give me a dog bone.”
“My abilities are limited, so just let me lie low beside you.”
After saying this, Zhang Pang scratched his head and gave a familiar, honest smile.
On the other hand, Zhang Wanshan beside him...
Hearing this, he couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
Then he reached out viciously and pinched the fat on Zhang Pang’s waist.
“Ouch!!”
“Dad!”
“Why did you pinch me?!”
Zhang Pang jumped back with a howl, rubbing the fat on his waist with an aggrieved look on his face.
“Those words of loyalty you taught me were way too cringey.”
“I just couldn’t say them!”
“You...” Zhang Wanshan was so furious that his beard bristled and his eyes widened. He pointed at him for a long time, unable to squeeze out a complete sentence.
Watching the comical father-son pair before him, Yang Fan finally couldn’t help laughing out loud.
“Alright, alright.”
“How have you been doing lately?”
Speaking of this, Zhang Pang instantly perked up.
“Great!”
“Couldn’t be better!”
“Senior Ma put me directly in charge of an administrative district!”
“I’m managing hundreds of thousands of Divine Beings right now!”
“In the future, I might even manage demigods!”
As he spoke, Zhang Pang grew increasingly excited.
“The main point is...”
“I don’t even need to know how to manage at all!”
“Those Intelligent Lifes handle everything!”
“All I need to do is collect red envelopes—”
Halfway through his sentence, Zhang Pang suddenly froze and hurriedly covered his mouth.
Then he quickly covered his ears, acting like someone plugging his ears while stealing a bell.
“I didn’t say anything.”
“You didn’t hear a thing.”
Seeing this, Yang Fan didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
However, seeing that his former brother was doing well, he was genuinely happy in his heart.
As for the so-called red envelopes, Yang Fan didn’t care at all.
Things were never easy for people at the bottom.
Back when he was studying at Yang County No. 1 Middle School, his mother had also given red envelopes to teachers so he could be assigned to a good class.
Wherever there are people, there is a Jianghu, and there are worldly conventions.
Xiling Planet wasn’t a utopia, and he had no interest in turning the entire planet into one either.
As long as it didn’t cross the line, letting nature take its course was fine.
After catching up with Family, it was finally time for the Luo Family Elders to enter.
Outside the house, Luo Hai stood at the very front, while to his left and right stood all the Gods currently in the Luo Family.
As soon as he entered, Luo Hai bowed respectfully.
“Tier 3 God Luo Hai greets the Master.”
Yang Fan was momentarily stunned and hastily stood up.
“Father-in-law, why do you say that?”
Luo Hai’s expression was solemn, without a trace of jest.
“Now the entire Luo Family relies on Xiling Planet to survive.”
“And since you are the master of Xiling Planet, you are naturally the master of everyone on this planet.”
In fact, the moment the spaceship landed in Yang County and stated its purpose...
Luo Hai knew that he had severely underestimated Yang Fan.
The master of a life planet—what kind of concept was that?
One had to know that Tiannan Star, where Yang County was located, was also merely a life planet.
What shocked Luo Hai even more was that there was even a Fifth-Order God willing to follow Yang Fan.
Luo Hai simply couldn’t imagine how Yang Fan had accomplished all of this.
But there was one thing he knew very clearly.
Although Yang Fan was currently only a demigod, the power he wielded had long surpassed the Luo Family.
It even surpassed all the big figures he had come into contact with in the past.
He was indeed Yang Fan’s father-in-law, but that was only at home.
Outside, he wouldn’t even dare to bring up this relationship on his own initiative, afraid of displeasing Yang Fan.
Yang Fan shook his head slightly and said seriously,
“There is no need to be so polite.”
“The help the Luo Family once gave me...”
“...I have always remembered.”
“In the future, the Luo Family will become the number one Family on Xiling Planet.”
Hearing this, Luo Hai’s body visibly trembled. He took a deep breath and cupped his hands solemnly.
“Thank you. My Luo Family is willing to live and die with Xiling Planet.”
Yang Fan nodded gently.
Current Xiling Planet was indeed short on people.
Due to the Rao Family’s actions over the past two years, a large number of powerhouses had fled Xiling Planet, causing a severe fault in the planet’s mid-level forces.
Meanwhile, the migration of the entire Luo Family held immense significance for present-day Xiling Planet as well.
As for the promise he just made, Yang Fan was also serious about it.
He didn’t consider himself a good person, but he knew how to repay kindness.
If not for the Luo Family back then, he might not have emerged as a dark horse in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, let alone received a special admission to the Primordial Academy.
Yang Fan had always kept these things in mind.
Now that he had the capability, he was naturally willing to push the Luo Family up another level.
Yang Fan reassured the Luo Family members while giving them peace of mind.
Now that Xiling Planet was awaiting revival from ruins, it was the time when opportunities were most abundant; as long as they developed with peace of mind, they would naturally progress further.
Once everything was arranged properly...
...Yang Fan chatted with his parents for a long time.
He was originally planning to exit the Virtual World.
But just as he stood up, two soft little hands grabbed him from the left and right.
“Husband, did you forget something?”
Luo Rou blinked, her voice gentle.
On the other side, Luo Bing softly held Yang Fan’s arm.
“You haven’t spent time with us in a very long time.”
Yang Fan froze, feeling a bit guilty.
These past days, he had indeed favored one over the other.
Gu Le accompanied him every day, whereas he spent less and less time meeting Luo Rou and Luo Bing.
Although it was the Virtual World, the sensory experience was no different from reality.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan coughed softly.
“Then... I won’t leave today.”
Someone leans against the wall, sighing at the moonlight; someone hides her face, whispering as day breaks.
The two beauties can hardly withstand the dragon-tiger vigor; only Young Master Yang’s Battle Intent burns fierce.
The next day, Yang Fan exited the Virtual World.
The moment he opened his eyes, he smelled a burst of delicious aroma.
Gu Le was dressed in a loose long dress, standing by the dining table preparing breakfast.
Ever since she became pregnant, an intelligent medical lifeform would visit every few days for a checkup.
Now, Gu Le’s lower abdomen was already bulging slightly.
Looking at this scene, a smile unconsciously appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
Toward Gu Le, Yang Fan was now exhausting all his skill and tricks.
From reading and learning to accompanying her in conversation, from daily surprises to emotional support, he brought everything to the max.
After all, this was top-tier “soft rice” that ranked among the very best in the entire Federation.
If he didn’t work hard, even Yang Fan himself would feel it was unacceptable.
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, another month passed.
Inside the divine kingdom, the re-cultivated soul nourishing wood finally approached the ten-thousand-year level.
Dense Soul aura continuously diffused outward.
Over the entire divine kingdom, a unique fluctuation permeated the air.
However, this time, Yang Fan noticed something strange.
Not many demigods came to target him.
There were only two or three blind fools in total.
They didn’t even manage to stir up a ripple before Yang Da dispatched troops to deal with them.
Even their Divine Kingdom Cores were brought back.
Three Divine Kingdom Cores quietly floated in the divine kingdom’s core region.

Now that Xiling Planet was awaiting revival from ruins, it was the time when opportunities were most abundant; as long as they developed with peace of mind, they would naturally progress further.
Once everything was arranged properly...
...Yang Fan chatted with his parents for a long time.
He was originally planning to exit the Virtual World.
But just as he stood up, two soft little hands grabbed him from the left and right.
“Husband, did you forget something?”
Luo Rou blinked, her voice gentle.
On the other side, Luo Bing softly held Yang Fan’s arm.
“You haven’t spent time with us in a very long time.”
Yang Fan froze, feeling a bit guilty.
These past days, he had indeed favored one over the other.
Gu Le accompanied him every day, whereas he spent less and less time meeting Luo Rou and Luo Bing.
Although it was the Virtual World, the sensory experience was no different from reality.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan coughed softly.
“Then...
I won’t leave today.”
Someone leans against the wall, sighing at the moonlight; someone hides her face, whispering as day breaks.
The two beauties can hardly withstand the dragon-tiger vigor; only Young Master Yang’s Battle Intent burns fierce.
The next day, Yang Fan exited the Virtual World.
The moment he opened his eyes, he smelled a burst of delicious aroma.
Gu Le was dressed in a loose long dress, standing by the dining table preparing breakfast.
Ever since she became pregnant, an intelligent medical lifeform would visit every few days for a checkup.
Now, Gu Le’s lower abdomen was already bulging slightly.
Looking at this scene, a smile unconsciously appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
Toward Gu Le, Yang Fan was now exhausting all his skill and tricks.
From reading and learning to accompanying her in conversation, from daily surprises to emotional support, he brought everything to the max.
After all, this was top-tier “soft rice” that ranked among the very best in the entire Federation.
If he didn’t work hard, even Yang Fan himself would feel it was unacceptable.
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, another month passed.
Inside the divine kingdom, the re-cultivated soul nourishing wood finally approached the ten-thousand-year level.
Dense Soul aura continuously diffused outward.
Over the entire divine kingdom, a unique fluctuation permeated the air.
However, this time, Yang Fan noticed something strange.
Not many demigods came to target him.
There were only two or three blind fools in total.
They didn’t even manage to stir up a ripple before Yang Da dispatched troops to deal with them.
Even their Divine Kingdom Cores were brought back.
Three Divine Kingdom Cores quietly floated in the divine kingdom’s core region.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Not Less Than 80 Billion
paragraphs: The core of each Divine Kingdom was only about the size of a calf, but Yang Fan was in no rush to absorb it.
“Why didn’t many demigods come this time?” Yang Fan asked with some confusion.
Yang Da replied calmly:
“Master.”
“To judge whether a demigod is powerful, the most intuitive information is the area of their Divine Kingdom.”
“Last time, Master’s Divine Kingdom area was less than twenty million square kilometers.”
“Many demigods would think this was a soft persimmon.”
“But now, the area of the Divine Kingdom has reached eighty million square kilometers.”
“Those who rely on believers to explore and discover Master’s Divine Kingdom—”
“Even if they sense the aura of the soul nourishing wood, they might not dare to make a move.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly, understanding quite a bit in his heart.
Unlike coordinates purchased from the Divine Shop,
the Divine Kingdom coordinates obtained by believers through their own exploration do not lead directly into the interior of the Divine Kingdom.
Instead, they stay outside the Divine Kingdom and can see its approximate scale.
With his current scale now,
in the eyes of outsiders, he is already considered an expert.
Naturally, this will make many people wary.
Of course, this is not absolute.
Those who still dare to invade him now are either fools looking to freeload or true experts.
However, Yang Fan was quite lucky.
The soul nourishing wood was about to mature, and no terrifying opponents appeared.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s gaze gradually turned serious.
Once this wave of soul nourishing wood harvesting was over, he would suspend Planting and prepare to head to the Primordial Academy’s Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
Those Alien Demigods who had been kept in captivity for countless years were not simple characters.
Being able to survive was proof of their strength in itself.
Among them, Human Race Prodigies and even Peerless Prodigies had even been buried there.
No one knew what talents these Alien Demigods possessed,
or what structures and trump cards they had.
Naturally, Yang Fan did not dare to be careless.
He definitely didn’t want his own backyard to catch fire while fighting a powerful enemy.
In the blink of an eye, another month passed.
Now, the strength of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom ushered in another explosive growth.
And today, Yang Da brought even more good news.
“Master, the number of believers with the Alchemist profession has currently broken through two hundred million.”
“The resources of the ten Spirit Plant Stars rewarded by the Gu Family have been fully utilized.”
“Currently, the monthly income of each Spirit Plant Star is about two billion Divinity Points.”
Hearing this, a smile also appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
Now, after the medicinal herbs of the Spirit Plant Stars were refined into Medicinal Pills, the profit was almost twice that of the Spirit Vein Planets.
The only problem was that requiring a large number of believers to invest in Alchemy would affect their cultivation speed.
However, Yang Fan could completely accept this cost.
Now, the Divine Kingdom’s Medicinal Pill industry had gradually become one of its most important economic pillars.
The development of a Divine Kingdom was inherently a long accumulation process.
Resources, population, and civilization all required bit-by-bit Evolution and growth.
But for Yang Fan, his speed far exceeded ordinary people.
The accumulation that others needed a century to complete, he might only need a year for.
The wealth possessed by Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom now had long surpassed the vast majority of low-tier gods.
Under such exaggerated resource provision, over a month in the Real World
was almost equivalent to ten years of bitter cultivation for other geniuses.
Furthermore, the Primordial Academy itself had a four-year academic system.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan slowly lowered his head and looked at his own body.
Accompanied by his breathing, the power within his body surged continuously.
That aura was like a vast ocean—
boundless, majestic, and endless.
Yang Fan even had an illusion: looking across the entire younger generation of the Primordial Academy now, did he really still have any opponents?
Just at this moment, the doorbell suddenly rang.
Yang Fan withdrew his thoughts and opened the door.
He found Tang Yue standing outside the door.
“Greetings, Young Lord.”
“The Divine Kingdom Cores of the few gods from the Rao Family have already been breached.”
“I have already arranged for believers to carry out reclamation work. Once the resources are sorted out, they will be handed over uniformly to the Young Lord.”
Tang Yue bowed respectfully.
Hearing this, Yang Fan shook his head gently.
“No need. Since it is the Divine Kingdom you breached, the resources naturally belong to you.”
Hearing this, Tang Yue was visibly stunned.
Yang Fan was no longer the novice who knew nothing back then.
He was very clear that the Divine Kingdom foundation of gods in Taichu City and ordinary gods in the outside world were completely two different concepts.
Most of the income from Xiling Planet over the years had long been offered upward layer by layer.
Although Rao Tianming was a Tier 3 God, the accumulation of his Divine Kingdom might not be that deep.
With his current financial resources, he looked down upon that bit of income.
Tang Yue had already achieved her goal by solving the hidden troubles for him.
As for how many resources were obtained from the specific reclamation, he couldn’t possibly stare at it every moment.
Furthermore, the art of governing subordinates—
many times, it was not about clutching benefits in one’s own hands,
but making the people working for you feel that it was worth it.
Tang Yue was a guardian, not a servant.
A favor done along the current was far more valuable than haggling over every ounce.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan simply waved his hand.
“Let it be like this.”
Hearing this, Tang Yue bowed respectfully again.
“Thank you for the reward, Young Lord.”
Time passed once again.
More than ten days later, all the soul nourishing wood in the Divine Kingdom finally matured completely.
Yang Da completed the harvest at the first instance and put all of them on sale in the Divine Shop.
The final total income—eighty billion Divinity Points.
Upon learning the news, Yang Fan’s consciousness immediately entered the Divine Kingdom to check its current information.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: Eighty million square kilometers
Talent: Omitted

Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (1.52 million), Martial Master (5.56 million), Qi Refining Realm (2.8 billion), Martial Apprentice Realm (8.8 billion), Second-class Intelligent Life (1.66 million), First-class Intelligent Life (3.7 billion), Tier 5 Being (63 billion)... Mortal (30 billion)

Profession: Alchemist (230 million) (capable of refining Qi Gathering Pill, Blood Essence Pill, Bone Strengthening Pill...), Blacksmith (7 million) (can mass-produce B-grade weapons), Talisman Master (1.2 million), Formation Master (1.4 million)
Kin: Adult Elf (110 million)
Technique: Everlasting Spring Technique (Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 92 billion (Real World provides 68.4 Divinity Points daily)

Buildings: Moon Well x 100 million, Sun Spring x 100 million, Fountain of Life x 380,000... Alchemy Tower x 140,000 (B-grade), prison-suppressing body-refining tower x 10,000 (B-grade), immortal nurturing tower x 50,000 (B-grade), Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (100,000 years old, nurturing Adult Elf), Special Building Enlightenment Stone x 100,000...
Wonders: Penglai Island x 11,000 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x 110,000 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x 10,000 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x 1000

Assets: Spirit Vein Planet x 21, Spirit Plant Star x 10, f-class transformation pod x 20 million, First-class Smart Weapon x 5 billion, Mechanical Heart x 1000, Otherworldly Collector x 4.1 billion, cloning nutrient pod x 1 million, Large Mineral Vein x 10, Ordinary Zombie (100 billion)...”
Now, the monthly income of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had reached an extremely exaggerated degree.
21 billion Divinity Points came from Spirit Vein Planets.
20 billion Divinity Points came from the Medicinal Pill industry.
Coupled with assets like Spirit Stones, Earth Heart Milk, and Dragon Fish, it could bring in about another 7 billion in revenue each month.
In addition, the Gu Family provided a fixed monthly subsidy of 2 billion Divinity Points.
These alone pushed the total monthly income past 50 billion.
If one added the monthly tax revenue of around 30 to 40 billion from Xiling Planet,
Yang Fan’s total monthly income now was not less than 80 billion Divinity Points.

chapters.title: Chapter 233: Primordial Battlefield War Once More
paragraphs: However, the higher the revenue, the more terrifying the investment became.
As the overall strength of the believers increased, the rate at which resources were consumed within the Divine Kingdom also skyrocketed.
Medicinal Pill, equipment, Spirit Stone consumption, civilization construction, and wartime reserves—various expenditures continued to rise.
With Yang Da maximizing resource investment, the current fixed monthly consumption of the Divine Kingdom was approximately two billion Divinity Points.
This bit of consumption was almost negligible in the face of current revenues.
Most of the funds in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom were still invested in buildings like the f-class transformation pod and the construction of the Mechanical Civilization.
However, Yang Fan gradually discovered a problem.
The growth of the believers’ strength was clearly beginning to slow down.
It was not due to a lack of resources, but rather the restrictions of the Divine Kingdom rules.
For the Cultivation system to produce Core Formation Cultivators.
For the Martial Arts system to produce a Martial King.
For the Mechanical system to produce Third-class Intelligent Life.
All of these required the rules of the Divine Kingdom to be further perfected; otherwise, it was basically impossible.
Yang Fan possessed the Evolution Talent.
His believers were strong in overall Evolution rather than individual talent.
Wanting to rely on the believers themselves to break through the restrictions of the Divine Kingdom rules had a probability that was almost infinitely close to zero.
Even with a Hundred-fold Evolution speed, it remained the same.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan slowly let out a breath, his gaze gradually turning serious.
“It is time to go to the Primordial Battlefield.”
Since the strength of the believers at the Demigod stage was already approaching a Bottleneck.
Then breaking through to become a deity should also be put on the agenda.
However, before that, the rewards that should be obtained naturally could not be let go.
Entering the Virtual World with his consciousness, Yang Fan arrived at Taichu City.
With a slight movement of his thoughts, his consciousness was instantly sucked into the Primordial Battlefield.
The voice of Intelligent Life sounded.
“Peerless Prodigy-level Genius Yang Fan, do you wish to immediately connect to the Divine Kingdom and materialize believers?”
“Yes.” Yang Fan nodded calmly.
The next moment, the connection to the Divine Kingdom was completed.
Boom——
The Void Realm shook, and ten million believers descended instantly.
Three million Foundation Establishment Cultivators, three million Second-class Intelligent Life, and four million Martial Master powerhouses.
This was the strongest lineup carefully selected by Yang Da.
For this battle, the Divine Kingdom had started collaborative training a hundred years ago.
These believers were not only powerful in strength, but they were also all equipped with Smart Weapons.
At the same time, Yang San, Yang Four, and Yang Five appeared simultaneously and began coordinating command.
On the other side, countless alien creatures began to spawn.
Ten million, twenty million, thirty million...
The numbers skyrocketed crazily, seemingly endless.
Yang Fan was long used to this.
These were merely appetizers.
As the battle began, Yang Fan’s believers were too lazy to even set up a Formation.
Everyone simply stood neatly in Formation.
The next moment, a large number of Smart Weapons began to transform.
Clack.
Clack.
The Mechanical structures unfolded.
Energy turrets formed instantly one after another.
Immediately following that, countless white lights lit up simultaneously.
Boom!
Torrents of energy swept across the battlefield one after another.
Large areas of alien beings didn’t even have time to get close before their bodies directly exploded into pieces.
Flesh and blood flew everywhere, and severed limbs scattered around.
The entire battlefield seemed to have transformed into a large meat grinder.
The alien beings charged like a tide and died like a tide.
Time slowly passed, and half an hour elapsed in the blink of an eye.
At this moment, a large number of Foundation Establishment entities finally began to appear within the alien army.
And Yang Fan’s believers finally moved.
The Ten Kings of Hell Formation unfolded instantly.
Four million Martial Masters stood at the very front, holding their shields high.
A large number of Smart Weapons covered their bodies, and countless energy lines flickered constantly, making them look like a wall of steel.
The alien beings constantly slammed into them, but they couldn’t shake them at all.
Meanwhile, the three million Second-class Intelligent Life in the rear opened fire simultaneously.
Blessed by the Mechanical Heart, the power of the Smart Weapons in their hands skyrocketed dozens of times.
Every bombardment would clear out a large area.
The Foundation Establishment Cultivators further in the rear struck simultaneously.
Hum——
Flying Swords rose into the air.
Sword light filling the sky slashed across the heavens, precisely executing those that slipped through the net.
Across the entire battlefield, the three systems cooperated with each other, forming a perfect cycle.
Defense, firepower, decapitation.
Even when facing hundreds of millions of alien beings, these ten million believers remained as steady as a rock.
“Master, I just checked the ranking changes. You have now entered the top one hundred thousand.” Yang Da’s voice sounded in Yang Fan’s mind.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression remained calm.
When the Primordial Battlefield had just begun, whether in quantity or Realm, the alien creatures were climbing crazily.
But fighting until now, ever since a large number of Foundation Establishment Realm alien beings appeared, the growth rate of the enemy army had clearly begun to slow down.
At least for now, it was still far from reaching the limit of Yang Fan’s believers.
Continuing to fight at this rhythm, Yang Fan even doubted whether these believers of his would even need to expend too much effort.
“Continue monitoring the rankings and remind me after entering the top one hundred.”
“Yes, Master.”
An hour later, Yang Da’s voice sounded again.
“Master, the current ranking—has entered the top ten thousand.”
At the same time, inside a certain room in Taichu City, a light curtain floated in mid-air.
What was reflected within it was precisely the scene of Yang Fan’s believers slaughtering in the Primordial Battlefield.
Senior Gu Yuan stood with his hands behind his back, his eyes full of appreciation.
“Good lad, to have cultivated such an elite force in such a short time.”
“It is a pity that the rules of the Primordial Battlefield restrict it, only allowing the materialization of ten million believers.”
“Otherwise, this old man would really like to see to what extent your Divine Kingdom has actually developed.”
Senior Gu Yuan chuckled softly.
With his discernment, he could naturally tell.
For Yang Fan’s army, entering the top one hundred was almost effortless.
Even—they were qualified to contend for the top few positions.
However, Senior Gu Yuan did not believe that this meant Yang Fan’s true strength had already surpassed those senior-year Peerless Prodigies.
What the Primordial Battlefield itself assessed was not total military strength, but the Cultivation of top-tier combat power.
The purpose was to tell students that Divine Kingdom War was not blindly mass-producing troops.
In order to fight for rankings, many students would concentrate resources to cultivate ten million elites.
In Senior Gu Yuan’s view, Yang Fan was also very likely doing the same.
However, this was not shameful; after all, the rewards of the Primordial Battlefield were generous.
The earlier the rewards were obtained, the faster the Divine Kingdom would develop.
Being able to cultivate such a legion during the sophomore stage was already worthy of the name ‘Peerless Prodigy’.
At this moment, in the center of the Primordial Battlefield, the battle had entered a white-hot stage.
The alien beings appearing now had all transformed into Foundation Establishment Realm entities.
Looking out, they were dense, covering the sky and earth, like an endless black tide.
They had no Formations, no intelligence, and their attack methods could even be described as crude.
But their numbers were simply too many, as if they could never be killed completely.
If they didn’t possess the War God Codex, after tens of thousands of years of Evolution, the Physical Body of Yang Fan’s believers would have long been incomparably tyrannical.
Coupled with the continuous support provided by Smart Weapons.
Facing this tidal, unceasing impact, they might not truly be able to hold on.
To reduce the losses of the Martial Master believers, Yang San had long changed the Formation.
“Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation—rise!”
Boom——
The next moment.
Above the ten million believers, countless Formation patterns lit up simultaneously.
A dark green giant turtle measuring several hundred miles in size slowly emerged, and the phantom of its huge turtle shell enveloped the entire military Formation.

Every bombardment would clear out a large area.
The Foundation Establishment Cultivators further in the rear struck simultaneously.
Hum——
Flying Swords rose into the air.
Sword light filling the sky slashed across the heavens, precisely executing those that slipped through the net.
Across the entire battlefield, the three systems cooperated with each other, forming a perfect cycle.
Defense, firepower, decapitation.
Even when facing hundreds of millions of alien beings, these ten million believers remained as steady as a rock.
“Master, I just checked the ranking changes.
You have now entered the top one hundred thousand.” Yang Da’s voice sounded in Yang Fan’s mind.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression remained calm.
When the Primordial Battlefield had just begun, whether in quantity or Realm, the alien creatures were climbing crazily.
But fighting until now, ever since a large number of Foundation Establishment Realm alien beings appeared, the growth rate of the enemy army had clearly begun to slow down.
At least for now, it was still far from reaching the limit of Yang Fan’s believers.
Continuing to fight at this rhythm, Yang Fan even doubted whether these believers of his would even need to expend too much effort.
“Continue monitoring the rankings and remind me after entering the top one hundred.”
“Yes, Master.”
An hour later, Yang Da’s voice sounded again.
“Master, the current ranking—has entered the top ten thousand.”
At the same time, inside a certain room in Taichu City, a light curtain floated in mid-air.
What was reflected within it was precisely the scene of Yang Fan’s believers slaughtering in the Primordial Battlefield.
Senior Gu Yuan stood with his hands behind his back, his eyes full of appreciation.
“Good lad, to have cultivated such an elite force in such a short time.”
“It is a pity that the rules of the Primordial Battlefield restrict it, only allowing the materialization of ten million believers.”
“Otherwise, this old man would really like to see to what extent your Divine Kingdom has actually developed.”
Senior Gu Yuan chuckled softly.
With his discernment, he could naturally tell.
For Yang Fan’s army, entering the top one hundred was almost effortless.
Even—they were qualified to contend for the top few positions.
However, Senior Gu Yuan did not believe that this meant Yang Fan’s true strength had already surpassed those senior-year Peerless Prodigies.
What the Primordial Battlefield itself assessed was not total military strength, but the Cultivation of top-tier combat power.
The purpose was to tell students that Divine Kingdom War was not blindly mass-producing troops.
In order to fight for rankings, many students would concentrate resources to cultivate ten million elites.
In Senior Gu Yuan’s view, Yang Fan was also very likely doing the same.
However, this was not shameful; after all, the rewards of the Primordial Battlefield were generous.
The earlier the rewards were obtained, the faster the Divine Kingdom would develop.
Being able to cultivate such a legion during the sophomore stage was already worthy of the name ‘Peerless Prodigy’.
At this moment, in the center of the Primordial Battlefield, the battle had entered a white-hot stage.
The alien beings appearing now had all transformed into Foundation Establishment Realm entities.
Looking out, they were dense, covering the sky and earth, like an endless black tide.
They had no Formations, no intelligence, and their attack methods could even be described as crude.
But their numbers were simply too many, as if they could never be killed completely.
If they didn’t possess the War God Codex, after tens of thousands of years of Evolution, the Physical Body of Yang Fan’s believers would have long been incomparably tyrannical.
Coupled with the continuous support provided by Smart Weapons.
Facing this tidal, unceasing impact, they might not truly be able to hold on.
To reduce the losses of the Martial Master believers, Yang San had long changed the Formation.
“Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation—rise!”
Boom——
The next moment.
Above the ten million believers, countless Formation patterns lit up simultaneously.
A dark green giant turtle measuring several hundred miles in size slowly emerged, and the phantom of its huge turtle shell enveloped the entire military Formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 234: A Man Fears Fame, a Pig Fears Getting Fat
paragraphs: Boom! Boom! Boom!
Countless aliens crashed against it, and the entire green light barrier shook violently, yet it remained completely unshaken.
Inside the Formation, the front row of Martial Masters raised their shields simultaneously as the Smart Weapons on their bodies continuously extended.
Armguards, shoulder pauldrons, and backs—energy turrets rose up one after another.
In the next instant,
tens of millions of white lights erupted simultaneously.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
A vast number of aliens were vaporized before they could even get close, exploding into a sky full of bloody mist.
Behind them, the eyes of the Second-class Intelligent Life flickered with blue light as their Mechanical Hearts operated at high speed.
Under their control, heavy turrets continuously adjusted their angles.
Every volley instantly cleared a massive area.
Even further back, Foundation Establishment Cultivators sat cross-legged, with millions of Flying Swords hovering in the sky.
“Slash!”
Guided by Divine Sense, the Flying Swords transformed into a river of swords, shooting out to cover the sky.
The entire military Formation was like a massive, precise war machine.
The aliens charged frantically, while the believers steadily held the line.
But compared to the beginning, the war was no longer so easy.
Martial Master believers began to be sent flying from the impacts, and Foundation Establishment Cultivators were running out of spiritual energy.
Casualties were gradually rising.
Yet even so, the entire military Formation remained as steady as a mountain.
Facing hundreds of millions of Foundation Establishment aliens, the tens of millions of believers did not take a single step back.
“Master, we have entered the top one hundred,” Yang Da’s voice rang out.
The moment he heard this,
Yang Fan looked up and, without the slightest hesitation, spoke loudly.
“I request to end the assessment.”
As his voice fell, the entire battlefield seemed to be put on pause.
All the frantically charging aliens came to a complete halt.
In the next moment,
the mountains of corpses, seas of blood, and severed limbs all began to dissolve into data and dissipate.
The Primordial Battlefield, which had just resembled a living purgatory, instantly returned to being empty.
It was as if the fierce battle that had lasted for several hours had never happened.
“This assessment has concluded:
Student: Yang Fan
Identity: Demigod
Divine Kingdom Talent: Hundredfold Time Sequence
School Ranking: 99′′
As Yang Fan’s ranking in the Primordial Battlefield surged into the top one hundred,
the entire Primordial Academy completely erupted.
With nearly ten million students enrolled in the Primordial Academy, the lower rankings changed daily.
Fluctuations of hundreds of thousands or even millions of ranks wouldn’t even warrant a second glance.
But entering the top one thousand carried an entirely different significance.
Those who could rank at this level were mostly the Senior-year Peerless Prodigies and Human Race Prodigies.
Not to mention the top one hundred.
This was a status that truly stood at the very peak of the Primordial Academy’s pyramid.
Yet Yang Fan was only a sophomore.
Within the Virtual World, various messages flooded the screens almost instantly.
“Yang Fan? A sophomore is this fierce?”
“Holy crap, I just saw him in the hundreds of thousands, and in the blink of an eye, he’s in the top one hundred?”

“I know this guy. He was there during the gathering of the Five Great Families’ younger generation, and he even won an S-Rank Building from a Genius of the Sima Family. He cultivates three paths of his Divine Kingdom simultaneously and is extremely strong, but I didn’t expect him to be this powerful.”
“I was there too. Looking back now, Yang Fan actually saved some Face for the Sima Family.”
“Ridiculous, the sophomores this year are this monstrous?”
Meanwhile, in a certain virtual space, Ma Huainan stared intently at the leaderboard.
His eyes gradually turned red, and his fists clenched so hard they cracked.
“Yang Fan!!!”
“Everything I lost, I will take back with my own hands one day!”
He stared fixedly at that name, his eyes filled with intense resentment.
Across the entire Primordial Academy,
countless chat groups and forums
almost all began to discuss this sophomore monster who had suddenly emerged.
In the Gu Family Territory, Gu Xuanting looked at the leaderboard and couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
“Good!”
“Wonderful!”
“As expected of my son-in-law!”
“To break into the top one hundred of the Primordial Battlefield as a sophomore, there is hope for him to become a High-Order God!”
Beside him, Lu Qinglan also smiled.
“The girl indeed has good taste.”
“Among the current generation of Peerless Prodigies in the Primordial Academy, Xiao Fan’s potential is at least in the top five.”
Speaking up to this point, Lu Qinglan’s expression suddenly turned slightly solemn.
“However...”
“He seems to have performed a bit too well.”
“Entering the top one hundred of the Primordial Battlefield as a sophomore, the alien races will probably take notice of him.”
Hearing this, the smile on Gu Xuanting’s Face also faded slightly.
After a moment of silence, Gu Xuanting spoke slowly.
“Nowadays, the federal supreme intelligent life’s information protection for Peerless Prodigies is becoming stricter and stricter.”
“It won’t be that easy for the alien races to deduce Xiao Fan’s Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“Moreover...”
Gu Xuanting suddenly smiled.
“Even if they do find the coordinates,”
“those Alien Demigods might not necessarily be a match for this kid.”
Lu Qinglan frowned slightly. “What if a God takes action?”
Gu Xuanting shook his head. “Impossible, the price is too high.”
“With the value Xiao Fan has shown now, it is not enough to warrant the alien races investing such a huge cost.”
Pausing for a moment, Gu Xuanting continued,
“Once he finishes collecting his rewards, I will meet with him and urge him to Breakthrough to Godhood in his junior year.”
“By then, he can form an offensive and defensive alliance with the other Gods of our Gu Family.”
“It won’t be so easy for the alien races to make a move on him again.”
Lu Qinglan finally nodded gently.
“Xiao Fan’s Divine Kingdom talent is the Hundredfold Time Sequence, so the probability of him breaking through to Godhood in his junior year is very high.”
Meanwhile,
inside the Primordial Battlefield,
Yang Fan was originally waiting for the rewards to be distributed.
But in the next moment, space warped slightly, and a familiar figure slowly appeared.
“Greetings, Senior Gu Yuan,” Yang Fan hastily bowed.
Senior Gu Yuan’s aura was even more unfathomable than Gu Xuanting’s.
Moreover, he could even mobilize the authority of the Primordial Battlefield; his status was likely even higher than that of Yang Fan’s father-in-law.
Naturally, Yang Fan did not dare to be impolite.
Senior Gu Yuan sized up Yang Fan from head to toe, looking more and more pleased.
“You are very good.”
“With the performance of your believers, it wouldn’t be difficult to enter the top ten or even the top five.”
“Why did you give up?”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned upon hearing this, then asked seriously,
“Senior, is there a reward for entering the top ten?”
Senior Gu Yuan: “...”
He remained silent for two seconds before replying, “No.”
Yang Fan nodded. “Then that’s correct.”
The corner of Senior Gu Yuan’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
According to the regulations of the Primordial Academy, the Primordial Battlefield only offered four rewards.
These corresponded to the top one million, top one hundred thousand, top ten thousand, and top one hundred.
Theoretically, Yang Fan had already collected all the rewards he could possibly get.
But even so, the vast majority of Peerless Prodigies would still continue to climb the ranks.
After all, a person’s life is nothing more than fame and fortune.
Rewards were one thing, but standing a head above others in the rankings was equally important.
So-called geniuses naturally possessed arrogance; who would be willing to be inferior to others?
Senior Gu Yuan stared at Yang Fan, his gaze gradually turning strange.
This kid... how was he completely different from the geniuses he knew?
He didn’t have the slightest sense of competitiveness.
He was the very picture of someone who wouldn’t do anything without a profit.
“Ahem, entering the top one hundred is indeed good,”
Senior Gu Yuan coughed lightly and continued,
“but if you can enter the top ten, your name will probably spread across the Five Great Families, and even all the factions of the entire Human Race will know of your existence.”
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan showed a look of confusion. “A man fears fame just as a pig fears getting fat. Wouldn’t that be very dangerous?”

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Heavenly Court + Goddess of Wisdom
paragraphs: Senior Gu Yuan: “...”
The air suddenly fell silent for a moment. Senior Gu Yuan opened his mouth, only to find himself unable to refute.
After a brief silence, Senior Gu Yuan suddenly smiled.
“So young, yet I didn’t expect you to be a practitioner of the cautious path.”
“An interesting little fellow.”
Senior Gu Yuan shook his head.
“Forget it, you are Xuan Ting’s son-in-law after all.”
“I came here in person to give you a chance to choose your reward.”
Hearing about the reward, Yang Fan’s expression instantly turned serious.
He had participated in the Primordial Battlefield in the first place just to reap some benefits.
If the rewards weren’t generous enough, who would bother competing for some ranking?
“Thank you, Senior.”
Senior Gu Yuan nodded.
“According to the rules of the Primordial Academy.”
“Ranking in the top one hundred thousand rewards you with an S-Rank Building.”
“However, its value won’t be too high, probably between ten million and one hundred million Divinity Points.”
“Entering the top ten thousand upgrades the reward to an S-Rank Building valued between one hundred million and ten billion Divinity Points, plus a Spirit Vein Planet.”
“As for entering the top one hundred...”
Senior Gu Yuan paused for a moment and said slowly,
“You can obtain an S-Rank Building in the hundred-billion Divinity Points tier.”
“These buildings, even within the Human Race, are considered strategic Resources.”
“The only thing I can do is give you a chance to choose for yourself.”
As his voice fell, a massive light screen emerged.
In the next moment, a massive amount of building information began to refresh rapidly.
[Eternal Temple]
[Mechanical Hive]
[Void Gate]
[Goddess of Wisdom]
It was densely packed and countless.
Now that Yang Fan had been nurtured by his Divine Kingdom’s Intelligent Life, his computing power had long surpassed that of ordinary Intelligent Life.
Even with just a simple glance, the information of those buildings was quickly imprinted into his mind.
He began screening, filtering, and excluding.
In just a moment, Yang Fan found his target.
But at this moment, he fell into silence.
Because he had taken a liking to two items, not just one.
Ordinary S-Rank Buildings could hardly tempt Yang Fan anymore.
But he wanted both of the ones before his eyes.
After a long silence, Yang Fan mustered up his courage.
“Senior Gu Yuan.”
“I Wonder if this Junior could give up the rewards for the top one hundred thousand and top ten thousand rankings...”
“...to exchange for another hundred-billion-tier building?”
“After all, a Spirit Vein Planet is also worth nearly a hundred billion.”
“The academy shouldn’t lose out...”
Yang Fan’s voice grew softer and softer.
Hearing this, Senior Gu Yuan rolled his eyes directly.
“You brat.”
“Do you really take this old man for a fool?”
“A Spirit Vein Planet is indeed worth a hundred billion, and it can be bought with Divinity Points.”
“But you don’t actually think these buildings are only worth their listed price, do you?”
Senior Gu Yuan suddenly showed a meaningful smile.
“How about you sell the War God Codex to me for one hundred billion?”
Yang Fan’s Face instantly turned red.
He had indeed just been testing the waters.
After all, Senior Gu Yuan was also from the Gu Family. What if he really opened a back door for him?
As for selling the War God Codex...
Only if his brain was broken.
Senior Gu Yuan sighed. “You brat, which two do you want?”
Yang Fan’s eyes lit up slightly, instantly feeling there was a chance.
“To report to Senior.”
“I want the Goddess of Wisdom and the Heavenly Court.”
Hearing this, Senior Gu Yuan couldn’t help but take a few more looks at Yang Fan, and then slowly smiled.
“Smart, and greedy enough.”
“It seems you plan to advance all three paths side-by-side.”
Senior Gu Yuan pondered for a moment and finally spoke.
“For the sake of Xuan Ting’s Face, I will open a back door for you.”
“However, the rules cannot be broken. You must make up for it with ten Spirit Vein Planets.”
“As for the rest, I will find a way for you.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan had almost no hesitation.
“Thank you, Senior!”
“These are the coordinates of the ten Spirit Vein Planets.”
“I will immediately arrange for my believers to evacuate.”
After speaking, Yang Fan directly transmitted the coordinates without the slightest heartache.
Seeing this, Senior Gu Yuan’s gaze became increasingly pleased.
“Bold and resourceful.”
“Brat.”
“I think highly of you.”
Speaking to this point, Senior Gu Yuan’s expression suddenly turned serious.
“Let me give you a reminder.”
“With the wealth your Divine Kingdom currently possesses,”
“even many poorer Mid-tier Gods might not be able to compare.”
“Aside from the War God Codex, do not let anyone else know about the Goddess of Wisdom and the Heavenly Court.”
Senior Gu Yuan said slowly,
“Without enough strength,”
“you cannot keep such wealth.”
“Even with the Gu Family standing behind you,”
“there will always be those who take desperate risks.”
As his voice faded, Senior Gu Yuan’s figure slowly dissipated.
At the same time, Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality.
Except at this moment, his breathing was noticeably heavier.
Two top-tier S-Rank Buildings.
This trip to the Primordial Battlefield had simply brought him insane gains.
Yang Fan slowly spread open his right hand. Unbeknownst to him, two cards were already lying quietly in his palm.
The cards were only the size of a palm, yet they seemed to carry an unimaginable weight.
One of them was pale gold, shrouded in immortal clouds, where countless floating palaces and towering divine mountains could be faintly seen, as if an entire world were compressed within it.

The other was pure white all over, with countless data streams flashing on its surface, occasionally revealing Mechanical runes and complex structures. Just a single glance gave one the illusion that their spirit was being sucked in.
The two cards floated gently, and the surrounding space even slightly distorted.
[Heavenly Court, Rank: S-Rank, Price: 100 billion Divinity Points]
[Description: A special Wonder building formed by the Evolution of a Heaven-Grade Secret Realm, containing the Dao of Longevity and capable of evolving the rules of the Immortal Court]

[Effect One: The Cultivation speed of Cultivation believers is significantly increased, the efficiency of Spiritual Qi absorption is greatly enhanced, and the operation path of Cultivation Techniques is automatically optimized]
[Effect Two: Reduces the difficulty of Realm Breakthroughs, increasing the probability of Comprehension Ability and Epiphanies]
[Effect Four: Enhances Spiritual Root adaptability, strengthening believers’ perception of the rules of heaven and earth]
[Effect Five: Automatically converts high-quality energy, raising the upper limit of the Cultivation environment]
[Effect Six: Can evolve the order of the Immortal Court, forming a complete ecological buff for the Cultivation civilization]
[Evaluation: The most core strategic resource of the Cultivation Route, its value is inestimable]
[Goddess of Wisdom, Rank: S-Rank, Price: 100 billion Divinity Points]
[Description: A Heaven-Grade Secret Realm building formed after the fall of a high-tier Mechanical god, containing a complete Intelligent Life Evolution system]
[Effect One: Increases the computing power of Intelligent Life, accelerating the speed of Intelligent Life Evolution]
[Effect Two: Shares databases, enhancing overall evolutionary efficiency]
[Effect Three: Accelerates the speed of technological deduction, increasing the probability of Intelligent Life Breakthroughs]
[Effect Four: Establishes a wisdom network, achieving civilization-level data interconnection]
[Effect Five: Automatically optimizes Mechanical structures, increasing resource utilization efficiency]
[Effect Eight: Possesses the complete Legacy of the Mechanical Civilization]
[Evaluation: The most core strategic resource of the Mechanical Path, its value is inestimable]
After reading the descriptions, Yang Fan couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
The value of these two buildings was completely on par with the War God Codex.
From this day forward, his Divine Kingdom would no longer have any obvious shortcomings.
Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical—the three paths would advance side-by-side.
Coupled with the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan couldn’t even imagine to what extent his Divine Kingdom would grow in the future.
“For treasures of this level, I’ll feel more at ease loading them earlier.”

Because he had taken a liking to two items, not just one.
Ordinary S-Rank Buildings could hardly tempt Yang Fan anymore.
But he wanted both of the ones before his eyes.
After a long silence, Yang Fan mustered up his courage.
“Senior Gu Yuan.”
“I Wonder if this Junior could give up the rewards for the top one hundred thousand and top ten thousand rankings...”
“...to exchange for another hundred-billion-tier building?”
“After all, a Spirit Vein Planet is also worth nearly a hundred billion.”
“The academy shouldn’t lose out...”
Yang Fan’s voice grew softer and softer.
Hearing this, Senior Gu Yuan rolled his eyes directly.
“You brat.”
“Do you really take this old man for a fool?”
“A Spirit Vein Planet is indeed worth a hundred billion, and it can be bought with Divinity Points.”
“But you don’t actually think these buildings are only worth their listed price, do you?”
Senior Gu Yuan suddenly showed a meaningful smile.
“How about you sell the War God Codex to me for one hundred billion?”
Yang Fan’s Face instantly turned red.
He had indeed just been testing the waters.
After all, Senior Gu Yuan was also from the Gu Family.
What if he really opened a back door for him?
As for selling the War God Codex...
Only if his brain was broken.
Senior Gu Yuan sighed.
“You brat, which two do you want?”
Yang Fan’s eyes lit up slightly, instantly feeling there was a chance.
“To report to Senior.”
“I want the Goddess of Wisdom and the Heavenly Court.”
Hearing this, Senior Gu Yuan couldn’t help but take a few more looks at Yang Fan, and then slowly smiled.
“Smart, and greedy enough.”
“It seems you plan to advance all three paths side-by-side.”
Senior Gu Yuan pondered for a moment and finally spoke.
“For the sake of Xuan Ting’s Face, I will open a back door for you.”
“However, the rules cannot be broken.
You must make up for it with ten Spirit Vein Planets.”
“As for the rest, I will find a way for you.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan had almost no hesitation.
“Thank you, Senior!”
“These are the coordinates of the ten Spirit Vein Planets.”
“I will immediately arrange for my believers to evacuate.”
After speaking, Yang Fan directly transmitted the coordinates without the slightest heartache.
Seeing this, Senior Gu Yuan’s gaze became increasingly pleased.
“Bold and resourceful.”
“Brat.”
“I think highly of you.”
Speaking to this point, Senior Gu Yuan’s expression suddenly turned serious.
“Let me give you a reminder.”
“With the wealth your Divine Kingdom currently possesses,”
“even many poorer Mid-tier Gods might not be able to compare.”
“Aside from the War God Codex, do not let anyone else know about the Goddess of Wisdom and the Heavenly Court.”
Senior Gu Yuan said slowly,
“Without enough strength,”
“you cannot keep such wealth.”
“Even with the Gu Family standing behind you,”
“there will always be those who take desperate risks.”
As his voice faded, Senior Gu Yuan’s figure slowly dissipated.
At the same time, Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality.
Except at this moment, his breathing was noticeably heavier.
Two top-tier S-Rank Buildings.
This trip to the Primordial Battlefield had simply brought him insane gains.
Yang Fan slowly spread open his right hand.
Unbeknownst to him, two cards were already lying quietly in his palm.
The cards were only the size of a palm, yet they seemed to carry an unimaginable weight.
One of them was pale gold, shrouded in immortal clouds, where countless floating palaces and towering divine mountains could be faintly seen, as if an entire world were compressed within it.
The other was pure white all over, with countless data streams flashing on its surface, occasionally revealing Mechanical runes and complex structures.
Just a single glance gave one the illusion that their spirit was being sucked in.
The two cards floated gently, and the surrounding space even slightly distorted.
[Heavenly Court, Rank: S-Rank, Price: 100 billion Divinity Points]
[Description: A special Wonder building formed by the Evolution of a Heaven-Grade Secret Realm, containing the Dao of Longevity and capable of evolving the rules of the Immortal Court]

[Effect One: The Cultivation speed of Cultivation believers is significantly increased, the efficiency of Spiritual Qi absorption is greatly enhanced, and the operation path of Cultivation Techniques is automatically optimized]
[Effect Two: Reduces the difficulty of Realm Breakthroughs, increasing the probability of Comprehension Ability and Epiphanies]
[Effect Four: Enhances Spiritual Root adaptability, strengthening believers’ perception of the rules of heaven and earth]
[Effect Five: Automatically converts high-quality energy, raising the upper limit of the Cultivation environment]
[Effect Six: Can evolve the order of the Immortal Court, forming a complete ecological buff for the Cultivation civilization]
[Evaluation: The most core strategic resource of the Cultivation Route, its value is inestimable]
[Goddess of Wisdom, Rank: S-Rank, Price: 100 billion Divinity Points]
[Description: A Heaven-Grade Secret Realm building formed after the fall of a high-tier Mechanical god, containing a complete Intelligent Life Evolution system]
[Effect One: Increases the computing power of Intelligent Life, accelerating the speed of Intelligent Life Evolution]
[Effect Two: Shares databases, enhancing overall evolutionary efficiency]
[Effect Three: Accelerates the speed of technological deduction, increasing the probability of Intelligent Life Breakthroughs]
[Effect Four: Establishes a wisdom network, achieving civilization-level data interconnection]
[Effect Five: Automatically optimizes Mechanical structures, increasing resource utilization efficiency]
[Effect Eight: Possesses the complete Legacy of the Mechanical Civilization]
[Evaluation: The most core strategic resource of the Mechanical Path, its value is inestimable]
After reading the descriptions, Yang Fan couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
The value of these two buildings was completely on par with the War God Codex.
From this day forward, his Divine Kingdom would no longer have any obvious shortcomings.
Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical—the three paths would advance side-by-side.
Coupled with the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan couldn’t even imagine to what extent his Divine Kingdom would grow in the future.
“For treasures of this level, I’ll feel more at ease loading them earlier.”

chapters.title: Chapter 236: Loading Buildings, Massive Changes in the Divine Kingdom
paragraphs: With a single thought, Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly entered the divine kingdom.
He first chose to load — — Heavenly Court.
Boom — —
The moment the card merged into the divine kingdom,
Yang Fan’s pupils abruptly constricted.
The sky split open.
To be exact, it wasn’t split open.
Rather, another world had appeared above the sky.
Immortal palaces slowly emerged.
Divine mountains floated, immortal clouds surged, and golden divine light cascaded down from the firmament.
In merely a moment, the more than 10,000 Penglai Islands originally scattered throughout the divine kingdom were all forcibly pulled, flying toward the sky.
In the end, they all merged into that Immortal Court world.
The sky of the entire divine kingdom seemed to have transformed into the Immortal Realm.
At the same time, the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi within the divine kingdom began to change.
Over 400,000 Spiritual Veins trembled wildly, and countless amounts of Spiritual Qi gushed out.
However, as soon as this Spiritual Qi appeared, it was rapidly extracted as if being spurned by some force.
The Spiritual Qi that originally filled the heaven and earth completely vanished in just a few breaths.
Afterwards, a more Advanced energy began to appear.
Yang Fan’s expression abruptly changed, “Immortal Qi!”
Of course he recognized it; this was the Immortal Qi produced by Penglai Island back then.

It was just that in the past, the amount of Immortal Qi produced by Penglai Island was too small. Even if Spirit Peach Mountain were sold, the moment this drifting Immortal Qi appeared, it would be diluted by the massive amount of Spiritual Qi.
But it was different now; the energy generated by the over 400,000 Spiritual Veins was actually all converted into Immortal Qi.
Although the quantity decreased, the quality had improved countless times over.
At this moment, Yang Fan even had an illusion.
Compared to the Immortal Court in the sky, the ground of his own divine kingdom simply felt like an uncultured, barren land.
At the same time, a large number of Cultivation believers began to make Breakthroughs.
Believers who originally stayed at the fifth tier directly stepped into Qi Refining.
Qi Refining broke through to Foundation Establishment.
The early stage of Foundation Establishment entered the Middle Stage, and the Middle Stage broke through to the Late Stage.
Yang Fan even sensed that many Late Stage Foundation Establishment believers were beginning to actively attempt condensing a Golden Core.
“My God has bestowed an immortal affinity!”
“Thank you, my God, for bestowing the Dao of longevity!”
“We are willing to follow the deity for all eternity!”
A massive number of believers knelt and prostrated themselves, kowtowing frantically toward the sky, their fanatical faith almost turning into a substance.
Looking at this scene, Yang Fan felt somewhat dazed.
The Cultivation civilization, which had gradually entered a Bottleneck, was actually ushering in another transformation.
Moreover, Yang Fan could faintly sense it.
The current Heavenly Court still seemed far from its limit.
Had it not been restricted by the area of his own divine kingdom, it could have even continued to expand.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan lowered his head to look at those Penglai Islands he had once purchased at a high price.
There were also a large number of supporting facilities, such as the Solar Core, Spirit Rain Transformation Platform, Cloud Step Heavenly Path, and so on.
Looking at them now, there was inexplicably a sense of incongruity.
Those Penglai Islands floating inside the Heavenly Court were simply like a few patches.
Compared to the true Immortal Court, the living environment of Penglai Island could be described as harsh.
Even a large number of Cultivation believers had already actively left Penglai Island, beginning to search for new Immortal Caves in the Heavenly Court.
“As expected of the most core strategic Resources of the Human Race.”
“For me right now... it’s a bit overspec.”
Yang Fan muttered to himself.
“I’ll arrange for Yang Da to dispose of these obsolete items in a bit.”
Without the slightest hesitation, Yang Fan slowly merged another card into the divine kingdom.
Goddess of Wisdom, loading begins.
In an instant.
The entire Mechanical Civilization seemed to fall into stagnation, and countless Mechanical factories stopped operating.
Aircraft hovered in mid-air, and transportation tracks suspended operations.
All Intelligent Life seemed to sense something simultaneously, stopping their actions one after another.
The next moment.
All of them knelt on one knee, looking up toward the sky.
In the center of the Mechanical Civilization, the ground suddenly began to tremble.
Countless metal structures automatically decomposed, reorganized, and underwent Fusion.
Accompanied by the continuous convergence of pale white data streams, a pure white statue slowly rose.
It was the appearance of a woman, her face blurry and impossible to make out clearly.
Her eyes were slightly closed, and her expression was calm.
It was as if she didn’t belong to life at all, yet also as if she were the source of all wisdom.
The statue was pure white throughout, without any patterns.
Yet countless data streams continuously emerged from its surface.
[Permission established]
[Data synchronization]
[Calculation begins]
A massive amount of data poured down like a waterfall.
The entire statue was filled with holiness and the unknown.
It seemed that as long as one got close, they would be completely swallowed by that endless data.
Immediately following, the statue emitted a pale white light that rapidly expanded, covering the entire Mechanical Civilization.
At this moment, the bodies of all Intelligent Life shook simultaneously.
An unprecedented connection appeared.
Massive amounts of data were uploaded, massive amounts of information were shared, and massive amounts of research achievements were synchronized.
The originally scattered Mechanical Civilization seemed to instantly transform into a single entity.
Countless Intelligent Life began sharing databases, knowledge, calculation results, and even a portion of computing power.
A project that an Intelligent Life in the past would take a hundred years to research and complete,
now had the entire civilization participating simultaneously.
The deduction speed of the Mechanical Civilization began to increase wildly.
Factories began automated optimization, and production lines began autonomous iteration.
A large amount of technological data that was previously incomprehensible automatically unlocked.
A large number of Advanced Mechanical structures were rapidly parsed.
Even some technological routes that had yet to be created began to be actively deduced by the Goddess of Wisdom.
The entire Mechanical Civilization seemed to have come alive.
In the sky, countless data torrents converged.
The Mechanical Kingdom lit up with blinding white light, and the cores of a massive amount of Intelligent Life began to operate at high speed.
Computing power skyrocketed, learning speed skyrocketed, and calculation capability skyrocketed.
Quite a few Second-class Intelligent Life even began to show signs of a Breakthrough.
“Higher permission access detected.”
“Civilization upgrade detected.”
“Thank you, Creator, for bestowing wisdom.”
“Praise my God.”
Countless Intelligent Life spoke simultaneously.
Their voices were uniform, cold, and devout.
Looking at this scene, Yang Fan was even somewhat lost in thought.
This was no longer a building, but a civilization core in the true sense.
As the Goddess of Wisdom completely loaded, Yang Fan suddenly felt a wave of clarity in his mind.
The processing speed of the originally complex and miscellaneous information abruptly increased, his Mental Energy skyrocketed once more, and the entire world seemed much clearer.
Right at this moment, Yang Da appeared beside Yang Fan, his face currently filled with excitement.
“Congratulations, Master, felicitations, Master.”
“With the two S-Rank Buildings, Heavenly Court and the Goddess of Wisdom, the development speed of the divine kingdom’s believers will rise to another level.”
Yang Da paused for a moment, his voice even showing a hint of agitation.
“Master, within this Goddess of Wisdom, there is contained the vast majority of core Legacy of an Advanced Mechanical Divine Kingdom.”
“As long as Resources are sufficient, after Master achieves a Breakthrough to become a deity—”
“all the way to a tier-7 Mechanical deity, there will practically be no more obvious Bottlenecks.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but have his breathing turn somewhat rapid.
Fortunately he had come to the Primordial Academy, and fortunately he had become a member of the Gu Family.
Otherwise, how could a core resource of the Human Race at this level ever fall to his turn?
“Master.”
Yang Yi suddenly appeared.
“Gu Xuanting of the Gu Family invites you to go to the Virtual World, Gu Family Territory.”
Yang Fan nodded, then looked toward Yang Da.
“Mobilize all Resources.”
“Enhance the believers’ combat power with all our strength.”
“Not long from now, I plan to go to the Primordial Academy’s Alien Divine Kingdom Zone to battle with the top powerhouses among those Alien Demigods.”
“Understood, Master.” Yang Da responded firmly.
