chapters.title: Chapter 237: Marital Relations
paragraphs: Returning to reality, Yang Fan put his virtual helmet back on.
Gu Family Territory.
“Greetings, Father.” Yang Fan bowed respectfully.
Gu Xuanting looked at Yang Fan, his eyes filled with satisfaction.
“To have grown to this extent in such a short time.”
“It is truly gratifying.”
Yang Fan said earnestly, “It is all thanks to Father’s cultivation.”
“Without the Gu Family’s investment, even if you gave me another ten years, I might not have reached where I am today.”
This was not false modesty.
For the development of a Divine Kingdom, talent is important, but resources are even more so.
If not for the backing of the Gu Family, possessing wealth at the Demi-god stage that even mid-tier gods would envy...
His Divine Kingdom could not possibly have grown so excessively.
Sometimes, Yang Fan has to admit.
Without talent, he could not have stepped out of his original family.
Without being a kept man, he could not have progressed so quickly.
Talent is responsible for letting him see the mountaintop, while being a kept man is responsible for taking the elevator directly there.
Gu Xuanting couldn’t help but chuckle upon hearing this, “You are certainly honest.”
After speaking, Gu Xuanting stood up, patted Yang Fan on the shoulder, and signaled for him to sit.
After Yang Fan sat down, Gu Xuanting’s expression gradually became serious.
“Although you were only ranked ninety-ninth on the Primordial Battlefield.”
“But you are only a sophomore, after all; it is inevitable that you will be targeted by the Alien Demigods.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression also became grave.
He recalled the words Sima Bang had once spoken.
There had been an Alien God who forcibly broke the rules to attack a Human Race Peerless Prodigy, and they had succeeded.
Yang Fan was confident that he had nothing to fear when facing Demi-gods.
But if a true god were to attack...
He was not sure if he could withstand it as he was now.
“Will powerful Alien Gods attack me?” Yang Fan asked, frowning.
The safety of the Divine Kingdom was always Yang Fan’s top priority.
“Rest assured, it is highly unlikely.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“The cost of breaking the Divine Kingdom rules to attack is too high—so high that no race would easily choose to do so.”
“Your talent is indeed good, but according to my estimates, you would be at most in the top five of the Primordial Academy.”
“If you count the Xingqiong Academy and the entire younger generation of the Human Race, your priority might not even make the top ten.”
“Even if a god were to attack, it is highly unlikely it would be your turn.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan felt much more relaxed.
As long as gods do not attack, he really has nothing to fear.
“However, one cannot be careless.”
Gu Xuanting’s expression became a bit more serious.
“The probability of a god attacking is low, but if your coordinates are exposed, it is highly possible for powerful Alien Demigods to invade your Divine Kingdom.”
“Your talent is great, but the time your Divine Kingdom has developed is ultimately too short.”
“Some Demi-gods have even lived for thousands of years.”
“For the sake of their race’s interests, they might even share your coordinates and join forces to hunt you down.”
“One cannot afford not to be prepared.”
“What does Father mean?” Yang Fan asked.
“Break through to become a god as soon as possible.”
Gu Xuanting spoke slowly.
“The federal supreme intelligent life protects your information well, but there are always oversights.”
“It is highly likely that aliens will consume a large number of Divine Kingdom Deduction Cards to find your coordinates.”
“You had better break through to become a god before your junior year.”
“When the time comes, head to the front lines and form an offensive and defensive alliance with the Gu Family’s gods to fight together.”
“By then, it won’t be so easy for those aliens to target you.”
After hearing this, Yang Fan actually felt much more relaxed.
If Alien Demigods attack?
He is not afraid at all.
One year in reality is worth a hundred years for others.
Furthermore, what kind of Cultivate environment does his Divine Kingdom have now?
As for breaking through to become a god by his junior year...
Gu Xuanting really underestimated him.
If not for continuing to fleece the Primordial Academy.
Perhaps by now, he would already be a First-Order God.
“Thank you for your guidance, Father. I understand.” Yang Fan stood up and said earnestly.
Gu Xuanting nodded with satisfaction.
Then, as if suddenly remembering something, he changed the subject.
“Right.”
“That girl of mine, every time she meets me now, she can’t go three sentences without mentioning you.”
“How did I not notice before that she was a romantic fool?”
Gu Xuanting rubbed his chin.
“You kid... do you have any experience to share?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan felt a chill down his spine and hurriedly sat up straight.
“Father, I am just treating Le’er well; she might just be... protective of me.”
“Enough.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“What are you nervous about?”
“As long as you don’t hurt her and make her happy, I couldn’t care less about who is on top or bottom among you young people.”
Speaking of this, Gu Xuanting suddenly sighed.
“I am sincerely asking for advice: how does one handle marital relations?”
Yang Fan was stunned.
For a moment, he even felt like his image of the man was collapsing.
The person before him is a High-Order God, a truly big figure in the Gu Family.
Now he is actually asking for advice on how to get along as a married couple?
Gu Xuanting seemed a bit embarrassed and coughed lightly.
“You don’t understand.”
“The lifespan of gods is too long; having lived so long, the number of arguments is also high.”
“When young, I would send flowers and resources.”
“Now, when I send resources, she says I’m being perfunctory.”
“When I give gifts, she says it’s a waste.”
“The year before last, I went to the front lines, and she actually asked if I had died out there.”
Gu Xuanting spoke with growing frustration.
“I am good at managing a Divine Kingdom, and the Divine Kingdom War is not difficult.”
“But your mother-in-law... is harder to deal with than an Alien God.”
Yang Fan: “...”
After a moment of silence, looking at Gu Xuanting’s serious expression.
Yang Fan decided to bring out the knowledge he had learned from Liu Ruyan.
“Father, actually, getting along as a married couple is simple.”
“First, provide more emotional value.”
“Second, argue less about logic.”
“Third, spend more time together.”
“Fourth, never try to prove that you are right.”
Gu Xuanting frowned, “Explain in detail?”
Yang Fan explained earnestly:
“For example, if Mother-in-law says she is tired, do not say ‘Just rest for a while and you’ll be fine’.”
“You should say—’You’ve worked hard’.”
“If Mother-in-law says she misses you.”
“Do not reply ‘I miss you too’.”
“You should say—’I was just thinking about you too’.”
“Also, regardless of who is right or wrong.”
“You must admit you are wrong first.”
Gu Xuanting’s brows furrowed deeper, “But what if it really isn’t my fault?”
Yang Fan was silent for two seconds.
“Father.”
“In a marital relationship, right and wrong are not important.”
Gu Xuanting: “...”
At this moment, this High-Order God suddenly fell into deep thought.
After a moment, he nodded slowly.
“It makes sense; no wonder my daughter is so infatuated with you.”
“You son of a bitch, you really are a Genius. How did you learn this at such a young age?”
Yang Fan: “...”
He did not know how to answer; he certainly couldn’t tell the other party that Tianxiang Renjian has free teachers for ten thousand Faith Points!
Gu Xuanting looked at Yang Fan with a faint smile, his eyes carrying a hint of playfulness.
Yang Fan immediately shivered.
Only at this moment did he realize.
His father-in-law was not asking for advice on marital relations at all; he was clearly using the conversation to keep him in check.
“Enough.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“Your talent is great, and your future is bright.”
“But from now on, you must not let my daughter suffer any grievances, understand?”
Yang Fan’s expression became serious, “Understood.”

Gu Xuanting looked at Yang Fan, his eyes filled with satisfaction.
“To have grown to this extent in such a short time.”
“It is truly gratifying.”
Yang Fan said earnestly, “It is all thanks to Father’s cultivation.”
“Without the Gu Family’s investment, even if you gave me another ten years, I might not have reached where I am today.”
This was not false modesty.
For the development of a Divine Kingdom, talent is important, but resources are even more so.
If not for the backing of the Gu Family, possessing wealth at the Demi-god stage that even mid-tier gods would envy...
His Divine Kingdom could not possibly have grown so excessively.
Sometimes, Yang Fan has to admit.
Without talent, he could not have stepped out of his original family.
Without being a kept man, he could not have progressed so quickly.
Talent is responsible for letting him see the mountaintop, while being a kept man is responsible for taking the elevator directly there.
Gu Xuanting couldn’t help but chuckle upon hearing this, “You are certainly honest.”
After speaking, Gu Xuanting stood up, patted Yang Fan on the shoulder, and signaled for him to sit.
After Yang Fan sat down, Gu Xuanting’s expression gradually became serious.
“Although you were only ranked ninety-ninth on the Primordial Battlefield.”
“But you are only a sophomore, after all; it is inevitable that you will be targeted by the Alien Demigods.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression also became grave.
He recalled the words Sima Bang had once spoken.
There had been an Alien God who forcibly broke the rules to attack a Human Race Peerless Prodigy, and they had succeeded.
Yang Fan was confident that he had nothing to fear when facing Demi-gods.
But if a true god were to attack...
He was not sure if he could withstand it as he was now.
“Will powerful Alien Gods attack me?” Yang Fan asked, frowning.
The safety of the Divine Kingdom was always Yang Fan’s top priority.
“Rest assured, it is highly unlikely.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“The cost of breaking the Divine Kingdom rules to attack is too high—so high that no race would easily choose to do so.”
“Your talent is indeed good, but according to my estimates, you would be at most in the top five of the Primordial Academy.”
“If you count the Xingqiong Academy and the entire younger generation of the Human Race, your priority might not even make the top ten.”
“Even if a god were to attack, it is highly unlikely it would be your turn.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan felt much more relaxed.
As long as gods do not attack, he really has nothing to fear.
“However, one cannot be careless.”
Gu Xuanting’s expression became a bit more serious.
“The probability of a god attacking is low, but if your coordinates are exposed, it is highly possible for powerful Alien Demigods to invade your Divine Kingdom.”
“Your talent is great, but the time your Divine Kingdom has developed is ultimately too short.”
“Some Demi-gods have even lived for thousands of years.”
“For the sake of their race’s interests, they might even share your coordinates and join forces to hunt you down.”
“One cannot afford not to be prepared.”
“What does Father mean?” Yang Fan asked.
“Break through to become a god as soon as possible.”
Gu Xuanting spoke slowly.
“The federal supreme intelligent life protects your information well, but there are always oversights.”
“It is highly likely that aliens will consume a large number of Divine Kingdom Deduction Cards to find your coordinates.”
“You had better break through to become a god before your junior year.”
“When the time comes, head to the front lines and form an offensive and defensive alliance with the Gu Family’s gods to fight together.”
“By then, it won’t be so easy for those aliens to target you.”
After hearing this, Yang Fan actually felt much more relaxed.
If Alien Demigods attack?
He is not afraid at all.
One year in reality is worth a hundred years for others.
Furthermore, what kind of Cultivate environment does his Divine Kingdom have now?
As for breaking through to become a god by his junior year...
Gu Xuanting really underestimated him.
If not for continuing to fleece the Primordial Academy.
Perhaps by now, he would already be a First-Order God.
“Thank you for your guidance, Father.
I understand.” Yang Fan stood up and said earnestly.
Gu Xuanting nodded with satisfaction.
Then, as if suddenly remembering something, he changed the subject.
“Right.”
“That girl of mine, every time she meets me now, she can’t go three sentences without mentioning you.”
“How did I not notice before that she was a romantic fool?”
Gu Xuanting rubbed his chin.
“You kid... do you have any experience to share?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan felt a chill down his spine and hurriedly sat up straight.
“Father, I am just treating Le’er well; she might just be... protective of me.”
“Enough.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“What are you nervous about?”
“As long as you don’t hurt her and make her happy, I couldn’t care less about who is on top or bottom among you young people.”
Speaking of this, Gu Xuanting suddenly sighed.
“I am sincerely asking for advice: how does one handle marital relations?”
Yang Fan was stunned.
For a moment, he even felt like his image of the man was collapsing.
The person before him is a High-Order God, a truly big figure in the Gu Family.
Now he is actually asking for advice on how to get along as a married couple?
Gu Xuanting seemed a bit embarrassed and coughed lightly.
“You don’t understand.”
“The lifespan of gods is too long; having lived so long, the number of arguments is also high.”
“When young, I would send flowers and resources.”
“Now, when I send resources, she says I’m being perfunctory.”
“When I give gifts, she says it’s a waste.”
“The year before last, I went to the front lines, and she actually asked if I had died out there.”
Gu Xuanting spoke with growing frustration.
“I am good at managing a Divine Kingdom, and the Divine Kingdom War is not difficult.”
“But your mother-in-law... is harder to deal with than an Alien God.”
Yang Fan: “...”
After a moment of silence, looking at Gu Xuanting’s serious expression.
Yang Fan decided to bring out the knowledge he had learned from Liu Ruyan.
“Father, actually, getting along as a married couple is simple.”
“First, provide more emotional value.”
“Second, argue less about logic.”
“Third, spend more time together.”
“Fourth, never try to prove that you are right.”
Gu Xuanting frowned, “Explain in detail?”
Yang Fan explained earnestly:
“For example, if Mother-in-law says she is tired, do not say ‘Just rest for a while and you’ll be fine’.”
“You should say—’You’ve worked hard’.”
“If Mother-in-law says she misses you.”
“Do not reply ‘I miss you too’.”
“You should say—’I was just thinking about you too’.”
“Also, regardless of who is right or wrong.”
“You must admit you are wrong first.”
Gu Xuanting’s brows furrowed deeper, “But what if it really isn’t my fault?”
Yang Fan was silent for two seconds.
“Father.”
“In a marital relationship, right and wrong are not important.”
Gu Xuanting: “...”
At this moment, this High-Order God suddenly fell into deep thought.
After a moment, he nodded slowly.
“It makes sense; no wonder my daughter is so infatuated with you.”
“You son of a bitch, you really are a Genius.
How did you learn this at such a young age?”
Yang Fan: “...”
He did not know how to answer; he certainly couldn’t tell the other party that Tianxiang Renjian has free teachers for ten thousand Faith Points!
Gu Xuanting looked at Yang Fan with a faint smile, his eyes carrying a hint of playfulness.
Yang Fan immediately shivered.
Only at this moment did he realize.
His father-in-law was not asking for advice on marital relations at all; he was clearly using the conversation to keep him in check.
“Enough.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“Your talent is great, and your future is bright.”
“But from now on, you must not let my daughter suffer any grievances, understand?”
Yang Fan’s expression became serious, “Understood.”

chapters.title: Chapter 238: I Will Cultivate Him Myself
paragraphs: Consciousness returned to reality.
Yang Fan slowly took off his virtual helmet.
In the courtyard.
Gu Le was sitting on a swing, gently swinging her legs while humming an unknown little tune.
She was basking in the sun while slowly eating a spiritual fruit, looking incredibly relaxed.
Seeing Yang Fan, Gu Le’s eyes lit up. “Husband, you’ve come out.”
After saying this, she trotted over and very naturally hugged Yang Fan’s arm.
Yang Fan sighed softly.
The knowledge taught by Big Sister Liu Ruyan was indeed formidable.
But it seemed... one shouldn’t learn it too intensely.
The women raised by these great Families.
When they were smart, they were terrifyingly shrewd, but when they were lovesick, they were overly absurd.
Yang Fan naturally understood in his heart that although Gu Xuanting was always joking, he was not without the intention of reminding him.
As a father, worrying about his daughter falling too deep was only human nature.
Of course, these were all just minor matters.
Now, he was not just someone Gu Xuanting was focusing on cultivating.
Looking at the entire younger generation of the Gu Family, he could also be called a top contender.
There would always be games between biological parents and children, and naturally, the same applied to fathers-in-law and sons-in-law.
Helping you is because interests align.
Guarding against you is because it is human nature.
Relationships between people were never just black and white.
Many relationships inherently involved both caution and trust existing simultaneously.
Gu Le tilted her head, looking at the dazed Yang Fan. “Husband, what are you thinking about?”
Yang Fan regained his senses and rubbed her head.
“Nothing, I just suddenly felt that your father was right.”
Gu Le blinked. “What did my father say?”
Yang Fan smiled. “He said to let me treat you better.”
Gu Le’s eyes immediately curved into crescents, and she hugged Yang Fan’s arm even tighter.
“Actually, you are already very good.”
Yang Fan: “...”
At this moment, he suddenly understood a bit why Gu Xuanting was worried.
How could such a shrewd heaven-blessed daughter suddenly become lovesick!
Besides wanting to use Gu Le to pull in more investment, Yang Fan didn’t have any bad intentions.
Otherwise, thinking back to those meaningful words from Gu Xuanting just now, he would probably have to slap himself twice.
It was one thing to be a kept man.
But if he were to also deceive someone else’s daughter... that would be a bit inhumane.
“By the way.”
Yang Fan spoke up suddenly.
“Does your God’s Kingdom lack anything recently?”
Gu Le blinked. “Why are you suddenly asking this?”
“My God’s Kingdom recently phased out a batch of buildings, about ten thousand Penglai Island units. If you need them, I’ll give them to you.”
Hearing this, Gu Le’s eyes clearly brightened.
Although she didn’t need these buildings, but... this was the first time Yang Fan had taken the initiative to give her something.
“No.”
Gu Le shook her head with a smile.
“My God’s Kingdom is developing quite well, and I have my own system of blessed lands.”
“Putting these Wonders on my side, other than exchanging for Divinity Points, doesn’t have much use.”
Speaking of this, Gu Le gently nudged Yang Fan.
“You should sell them yourself. When you get stronger in the future, send me something better.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan didn’t insist further.
After all, Gu Le was the apple of the eye of the Third Elder of the Gu Family, and her starting point was too high.
A building like Penglai Island might be a supreme treasure to others, but to her, it was probably just taking up space.
However, seeing Gu Le look obviously much happier.
Yang Fan suddenly felt that sometimes, when it came to giving gifts, the important thing was never the item itself.
Returning to his room, Yang Fan’s consciousness sank into his God’s Kingdom.
On the other side, Gu Le picked up her virtual helmet and entered the Virtual World.
Soon, Lu Qinglan appeared in front of her.
“Mom, what is it?”
Lu Qinglan looked at her daughter, remaining silent for a moment before speaking slowly.
“Recently, every time your father sees me, he talks about you and Yang Fan.”
“It’s true that you are husband and wife, but the development of the God’s Kingdom is the foundation.”
“Daughter, you understand what Mother means, right?”
Gu Le nodded.
“Don’t worry.”
“Do you think your daughter would be lovesick?”
Lu Qinglan raised an eyebrow. “Then what is this recently?”
Gu Le leaned back gently in her chair.
“Because he is worth it.”
“Your daughter wants the best of everything.”
“I want the best resources, the best companies, and marriage... naturally, the same.”
She paused for a moment, her voice gradually becoming serious.
“At first, I just thought his talent was worthy of me and he could help Father share the pressure.”
“But later I realized, I seemed to have underestimated him.”
“His growth speed even reminds me of Father when he was young.”
“For this kind of person, a mere contract is not enough.”
Gu Le slowly raised her head.
“I want to be true husband and wife with him, just like Father and Mother.”
“Sharing weal and woe, bound in life and death.”
Lu Qinglan listened quietly without interrupting.
Gu Le continued: “Husband started from humble beginnings. After coming to Taichu City, he was very cautious about everything.”
“On the surface, he looks like a rising star.”
“But in reality, he wraps himself up too tightly.”
“He has no malice toward me, just... more of it is still utilization.”
Hearing this, Lu Qinglan’s brows furrowed slightly.
Gu Le, however, smiled. “But he changed quite a bit today; at least he was willing to take the initiative to give me something.”
“Although...”
Gu Le paused for a moment and added softly.
“A bit stingy.”
Lu Qinglan: “...”
Gu Le put away her smile, her expression gradually becoming serious.
“Mother, rather than looking for someone without flaws.”
“I prefer a challenge.”
“The person I like, I hope he likes me too.”
“I want to change him, so he doesn’t have to be cautious about everything he faces.”
“Make him more decent, more magnanimous.”
“Let him truly integrate into the upper class, and one day, even become a big shot who dominates the life and death of countless people.”
The corners of Gu Le’s mouth curled up slightly, but her eyes were terrifyingly serious.
“My man, I will cultivate him myself.”
Hearing this, Lu Qinglan felt both relieved and couldn’t help but frown.
“You girl, why is your mind so heavy?”
“Aren’t you afraid that Yang Fan will find out later?”
Gu Le, upon hearing this, just smiled.
“Why should I be afraid?”
“I didn’t lie to him.”
“Besides... I do all this for his own good.”
“Isn’t it?”
Inside Yang Fan’s God’s Kingdom, time passed rapidly under the Evolution Talent.
But the entire world had already undergone earth-shaking changes.
Above the sky, a towering Heavenly Court hung high, and countless Immortal Qi descended from the Nine Heavens.
At the center of the Mechanical Civilization.
The pure white statue of the Goddess of Wisdom emitted a faint radiance, and countless torrents of data flickered in the Void Realm.
The three paths of Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical.
Seemed to have pressed the acceleration button simultaneously.
At this moment, Yang Da was standing in front of Yang Fan to report.
“Master, according to the latest statistics, the number of believers at the Foundation Establishment Realm has nearly doubled compared to a hundred years ago in the God’s Kingdom.”
“The number of believers at the Martial Master stage has increased by more than 50%.”
“The birth efficiency of Second-class Intelligent Life has increased by about two times.”
“Besides this...”
Yang Da’s voice paused slightly, and a hint of excitement appeared in his eyes.
“The Mechanical Civilization has begun to attempt to design Second-Class Smart Weapon.”

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Alien Divine Kingdom Zone Information
paragraphs: Hearing this, even Yang Fan was slightly stunned, “It has already started?”
“Yes,” Yang Da nodded. “The Legacy contained within the Goddess of Wisdom far exceeds expectations.”
“Currently, a large number of Intelligent Life have begun constructing a brand-new weapon system.”
“It is estimated that within the next few thousand years, the overall combat power of the Mechanical Civilization will experience several more rounds of explosive growth.”
Yang Fan nodded slowly, his satisfaction undisguised. As a god, he felt this change even more clearly.
The growth curve that had originally tended to flatten, with the loading of the Heavenly Court and the Goddess of Wisdom, was now steepening again, even... more exaggerated than before.
Yang Fan fell into deep thought.

Now that the overall combat power of his divine kingdom was in a period of rapid explosive growth, should he head to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone now? Or should he play it safe for a bit longer? Wait until his overall strength improved further?

Currently at the Demi-god stage, Yang Fan had absolute confidence in his strength. If not for the restrictions of the divine kingdom rules, his divine kingdom should have already given birth to Core Formation level believers.

After a moment of silence, Yang Fan made his decision. Before graduation, he had to go there eventually. He would find someone to ask clearly first, then decide what to do. And for him, asking Gu Le was naturally the most appropriate choice. After all, like Sima Bang, she had lived in Taichu City since childhood.
Gu Le exited the Virtual World. Just as she took off her helmet, she found Yang Fan already sitting beside her, waiting for her.
“What’s the matter?” Gu Le asked, somewhat puzzled.
Yang Fan went straight to the point, “I want to ask about the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.”
Hearing this, Gu Le was visibly stunned for a moment, then her expression became serious, “You want to go now?”
“I want to understand the situation first,” Yang Fan replied. Gu Le then nodded.
“The Alien Divine Kingdom Zone is actually not complicated.”
“Every year, Primordial Academy captures some Alien Demigods from the front lines.”
“Their Physical Body will be sealed, and their divine kingdom coordinates are inscribed upon the cage, allowing students to challenge them.”
Yang Fan raised an eyebrow, “So direct?”
“Because this is originally resources given to students by Primordial Academy,” Gu Le continued to explain.
“However, the rules are very strict.”
“In the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone, there are only one-on-one Divine Kingdom Wars, and you are responsible for your own life or death.”
“And...” Gu Le looked at Yang Fan, “All currently enrolled students only have two chances to challenge.”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, “Only twice?”
Gu Le nodded.
“Capturing an Alien Demigod alive and obtaining their divine kingdom coordinates is not an easy task in the first place.”
“The Alien Divine Kingdom Zone is not a place that gives away Divine Kingdom Core for free.”
“The meaning of its existence.”
Gu Le paused for a moment, then slowly spat out two words, “Raising Gu.”
“Raising Gu?” Yang Fan frowned.
Gu Le continued, “The Alien Divine Kingdom Zone is divided into three levels in total.”
“The Level 1 zone basically consists of Alien Demigods who were just captured.”
“Primordial Academy will deposit special buildings, special Wonders, and even a large number of A-grade resource buildings into their divine kingdoms.”
“These rewards are essentially prepared for the students, though the Alien Demigods can use them temporarily.”
“Because they haven’t had the resources for long and haven’t had time to fully digest them, they are the weakest in terms of strength.”
Speaking of this, Gu Le’s voice remained serious.
“But don’t underestimate them; to be able to go to the front lines and still be alive when captured by the school, they are definitely considered strong among Demi-gods.”
“As for the Level 2 zone...” Gu Le’s eyes gradually became solemn.
“These aliens have been developing for a very long time; some have even lived here for hundreds of years.”
“Many Human Race Prodigies have died at their hands, and those spoils of war have also been converted into their own divine kingdom foundations.”
Yang Fan’s expression changed slightly upon hearing this. And when Gu Le reached the end, her voice became noticeably lower.
“The Level 3 zone... it’s best not to touch it.”
“Many of the aliens imprisoned there have existed in Primordial Academy for over a thousand years.”
“Those who have died at their hands are not just Human Race Prodigies, but also peerless prodigies.”
“They are very strong.”
“Strong enough that many senior-year peerless prodigies wouldn’t challenge them easily.”
The air suddenly went quiet, and Gu Le looked at Yang Fan seriously.
“Yang Fan, don’t think you are special.”
“The school’s rules are the rules; once you get there, even if Father steps in, he won’t be able to save you.”
“The rules of the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone were jointly formulated by the upper echelons of the Five Great Families and the highest Intelligent Life.”
“There are no loopholes, no backdoors, and certainly no exceptions.”
Gu Le paused for a moment, her voice slowing down.
“Specific information can be found inside the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.”
“But you must be more cautious; many things in the outside world can be flexible, but that place is not.”
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then nodded, “Rest assured, I won’t take risks easily.”

After listening to Gu Le’s words, Yang Fan was not in a rush to head to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone. Since there were only two chances, he naturally had to pick stronger Alien Demigods. The higher the risk, the greater the reward.

If he hadn’t obtained the Heavenly Court and the Goddess of Wisdom, Yang Fan would not waste any more time. But now it was different; his divine kingdom was in a stage of rapid development, and his strength was skyrocketing every day. Since that was the case, it would be better to wait another month to maximize the benefits.

Time flowed slowly. Yang Fan’s divine kingdom welcomed earth-shaking changes almost every day. The population skyrocketed, resources skyrocketed, the Mechanical Civilization kept iterating, and the number of Intelligent Life continued to increase. The plan Yang Da formulated yesterday was already changed when Yang Fan entered the divine kingdom today.

And Yang Fan in reality was not idle either. He used almost all his remaining time to cram all kinds of knowledge about divine kingdoms. Divine kingdom development, civilization Evolution, Family influence, Divine Kingdom War, a large number of books were constantly being read. Besides that, Gu Le would also tell him about things inside the Five Great Families from time to time.

Among the Five Great Families, there was cooperation and even more competition. Within each Family, there were different factions. The older generation had exchanges of interests, and the younger generation had arranged marriages. There were also various frontline combat teams and interest groups. Even within the Gu Family, there were many factions. Although many things were not put on the surface, everyone understood. Once core interests were involved, the struggle was never absent. Yang Fan also gradually understood that the larger the Family, the more complicated things became. This had nothing to do with the system, but rather human nature. The cake was only so big; with more people, there would naturally be different opinions on how to divide the cake.
One day, Yang Fan suddenly received a message.
Sima Bang: [Brother Yang, are you free tonight?]
Sima Bang: [I would like to invite Brother Yang to Yuexiang Pavilion for a small gathering.]

Seeing the message, Yang Fan was slightly stunned, then opened the group chat. The small group once known as the Qingshan District F4 had become much quieter since he was evaluated as a Peerless Prodigy. And now the group members had changed from four to three. Wen Yushui had left the group at some point.

Yang Fan did not take this to heart; whether it was Wen Yushui or Ye Jianfeng, they could only be considered acquaintances at most. They were polite on the surface, but it was far from any friendship. Of the former small group, the only one who could still catch Yang Fan’s eye was Sima Bang. It wasn’t because of talent, but because of status. Everyone was from the Five Great Families, and furthermore, Sima Bang had an older brother who was a Peerless Prodigy. Yang Fan still had to give him this Face.
Yang Fan replied: [Okay.]

sentences.text: Hearing this, even Yang Fan was slightly stunned, “It has already started?”
“Yes,” Yang Da nodded.
“The Legacy contained within the Goddess of Wisdom far exceeds expectations.”
“Currently, a large number of Intelligent Life have begun constructing a brand-new weapon system.”
“It is estimated that within the next few thousand years, the overall combat power of the Mechanical Civilization will experience several more rounds of explosive growth.”
Yang Fan nodded slowly, his satisfaction undisguised.
As a god, he felt this change even more clearly.
The growth curve that had originally tended to flatten, with the loading of the Heavenly Court and the Goddess of Wisdom, was now steepening again, even... more exaggerated than before.
Yang Fan fell into deep thought.
Now that the overall combat power of his divine kingdom was in a period of rapid explosive growth, should he head to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone now?
Or should he play it safe for a bit longer?
Wait until his overall strength improved further?
Currently at the Demi-god stage, Yang Fan had absolute confidence in his strength.
If not for the restrictions of the divine kingdom rules, his divine kingdom should have already given birth to Core Formation level believers.
After a moment of silence, Yang Fan made his decision.
Before graduation, he had to go there eventually.
He would find someone to ask clearly first, then decide what to do.
And for him, asking Gu Le was naturally the most appropriate choice.
After all, like Sima Bang, she had lived in Taichu City since childhood.
Gu Le exited the Virtual World.
Just as she took off her helmet, she found Yang Fan already sitting beside her, waiting for her.
“What’s the matter?” Gu Le asked, somewhat puzzled.
Yang Fan went straight to the point, “I want to ask about the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.”
Hearing this, Gu Le was visibly stunned for a moment, then her expression became serious, “You want to go now?”
“I want to understand the situation first,” Yang Fan replied.
Gu Le then nodded.
“The Alien Divine Kingdom Zone is actually not complicated.”
“Every year, Primordial Academy captures some Alien Demigods from the front lines.”
“Their Physical Body will be sealed, and their divine kingdom coordinates are inscribed upon the cage, allowing students to challenge them.”
Yang Fan raised an eyebrow, “So direct?”
“Because this is originally resources given to students by Primordial Academy,” Gu Le continued to explain.
“However, the rules are very strict.”
“In the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone, there are only one-on-one Divine Kingdom Wars, and you are responsible for your own life or death.”
“And...” Gu Le looked at Yang Fan, “All currently enrolled students only have two chances to challenge.”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, “Only twice?”
Gu Le nodded.
“Capturing an Alien Demigod alive and obtaining their divine kingdom coordinates is not an easy task in the first place.”
“The Alien Divine Kingdom Zone is not a place that gives away Divine Kingdom Core for free.”
“The meaning of its existence.”
Gu Le paused for a moment, then slowly spat out two words, “Raising Gu.”
“Raising Gu?” Yang Fan frowned.
Gu Le continued, “The Alien Divine Kingdom Zone is divided into three levels in total.”
“The Level 1 zone basically consists of Alien Demigods who were just captured.”
“Primordial Academy will deposit special buildings, special Wonders, and even a large number of A-grade resource buildings into their divine kingdoms.”
“These rewards are essentially prepared for the students, though the Alien Demigods can use them temporarily.”
“Because they haven’t had the resources for long and haven’t had time to fully digest them, they are the weakest in terms of strength.”
Speaking of this, Gu Le’s voice remained serious.
“But don’t underestimate them; to be able to go to the front lines and still be alive when captured by the school, they are definitely considered strong among Demi-gods.”
“As for the Level 2 zone...” Gu Le’s eyes gradually became solemn.
“These aliens have been developing for a very long time; some have even lived here for hundreds of years.”
“Many Human Race Prodigies have died at their hands, and those spoils of war have also been converted into their own divine kingdom foundations.”
Yang Fan’s expression changed slightly upon hearing this.
And when Gu Le reached the end, her voice became noticeably lower.
“The Level 3 zone... it’s best not to touch it.”
“Many of the aliens imprisoned there have existed in Primordial Academy for over a thousand years.”
“Those who have died at their hands are not just Human Race Prodigies, but also peerless prodigies.”
“They are very strong.”
“Strong enough that many senior-year peerless prodigies wouldn’t challenge them easily.”
The air suddenly went quiet, and Gu Le looked at Yang Fan seriously.
“Yang Fan, don’t think you are special.”
“The school’s rules are the rules; once you get there, even if Father steps in, he won’t be able to save you.”
“The rules of the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone were jointly formulated by the upper echelons of the Five Great Families and the highest Intelligent Life.”
“There are no loopholes, no backdoors, and certainly no exceptions.”
Gu Le paused for a moment, her voice slowing down.
“Specific information can be found inside the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.”
“But you must be more cautious; many things in the outside world can be flexible, but that place is not.”
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then nodded, “Rest assured, I won’t take risks easily.”
After listening to Gu Le’s words, Yang Fan was not in a rush to head to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
Since there were only two chances, he naturally had to pick stronger Alien Demigods.
The higher the risk, the greater the reward.
If he hadn’t obtained the Heavenly Court and the Goddess of Wisdom, Yang Fan would not waste any more time.
But now it was different; his divine kingdom was in a stage of rapid development, and his strength was skyrocketing every day.
Since that was the case, it would be better to wait another month to maximize the benefits.
Time flowed slowly.
Yang Fan’s divine kingdom welcomed earth-shaking changes almost every day.
The population skyrocketed, resources skyrocketed, the Mechanical Civilization kept iterating, and the number of Intelligent Life continued to increase.
The plan Yang Da formulated yesterday was already changed when Yang Fan entered the divine kingdom today.
And Yang Fan in reality was not idle either.
He used almost all his remaining time to cram all kinds of knowledge about divine kingdoms.
Divine kingdom development, civilization Evolution, Family influence, Divine Kingdom War, a large number of books were constantly being read.
Besides that, Gu Le would also tell him about things inside the Five Great Families from time to time.
Among the Five Great Families, there was cooperation and even more competition.
Within each Family, there were different factions.
The older generation had exchanges of interests, and the younger generation had arranged marriages.
There were also various frontline combat teams and interest groups.
Even within the Gu Family, there were many factions.
Although many things were not put on the surface, everyone understood.
Once core interests were involved, the struggle was never absent.
Yang Fan also gradually understood that the larger the Family, the more complicated things became.
This had nothing to do with the system, but rather human nature.
The cake was only so big; with more people, there would naturally be different opinions on how to divide the cake.
One day, Yang Fan suddenly received a message.
Sima Bang: [Brother Yang, are you free tonight?]
Sima Bang: [I would like to invite Brother Yang to Yuexiang Pavilion for a small gathering.]
Seeing the message, Yang Fan was slightly stunned, then opened the group chat.
The small group once known as the Qingshan District F4 had become much quieter since he was evaluated as a Peerless Prodigy.
And now the group members had changed from four to three.
Wen Yushui had left the group at some point.
Yang Fan did not take this to heart; whether it was Wen Yushui or Ye Jianfeng, they could only be considered acquaintances at most.
They were polite on the surface, but it was far from any friendship.
Of the former small group, the only one who could still catch Yang Fan’s eye was Sima Bang.
It wasn’t because of talent, but because of status.
Everyone was from the Five Great Families, and furthermore, Sima Bang had an older brother who was a Peerless Prodigy.
Yang Fan still had to give him this Face.
Yang Fan replied: [Okay.]

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Who Does He Take After?
paragraphs: On the third floor of Yuexiang Pavilion, Yang Fan pushed open the door and entered.
Inside the room, there were only Sima Bang and Ye Jianfeng.
Seeing Yang Fan appear, the two of them stood up almost simultaneously.
Ye Jianfeng, in particular, even appeared somewhat reserved in his movements.
“Brother Sima, Brother Ye, long time no see,” Yang Fan said with a smile.
He did not display the slightest arrogance due to the change in his status.
Because Yang Fan understood that when there is a large gap in status between people, it often only means that there will be fewer opportunities for future cooperation between them.
But that does not mean one should trample others underfoot.
After truly seeing more of the world, one would instead discover: ‘Decency has more power than arrogance.’
Respecting others is, in many cases, also respecting oneself.
Sima Bang’s face was filled with smiles as he pulled Yang Fan directly to the main seat.
“Brother Yang, you are now in your prime.”
“Your ranking in the Primordial Battlefield has already broken into the top 100.”
“All the Family groups of our Sima Family are almost arguing to the point of turning upside down.”
“My dad has been scolding my third brother lately, saying that the investment quota given to you back then was too low.”
“Third brother?” Yang Fan was somewhat puzzled.
Sima Bang took a sip of wine and explained.
“My dad has over a hundred sons. My third brother is over eight hundred years older than me and is already a Mid-tier God.”
“Most matters regarding the Family’s external investment in Geniuses are decided by him.”
Speaking of this, Sima Bang’s eyes clearly carried a hint of fear.
Although they are brothers in name, in reality, the other party’s age is enough to be his ancestor.
Unlike a Divine Being, gods have lives that are too long.
Based solely on appearance, it is impossible to judge seniority.
The atmosphere among the three was much more relaxed than imagined.
As they chatted, Ye Jianfeng suddenly brought up.
“By the way, it was actually me who kicked Wen Yushui out.”
“There was a small conflict before.”
Speaking of this, Ye Jianfeng was somewhat embarrassed, still carefully observing Yang Fan’s expression.
Yang Fan just smiled and didn’t mind.
Whether it was leaving the group or the conflict.
These things are all too small for him now.
Some people will accompany you for a stretch, while others will get off early; it’s perfectly normal.
Soon the topic gradually shifted, and Sima Bang suddenly revealed a gossipy smile.
“Brother Yang, I heard something funny recently.”
“That guy Ma Huainan actually ran to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone, and he even chose the Level 1 area.”
“I’m almost dying of laughter.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally became a bit interested.
“Ma Huainan only chose the Level 1 area?”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
These days, Gu Le had already told him quite a bit about the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
He still remembered clearly the bet between Ma Huainan and himself during the Five Great Families gathering.
Especially that SS-rank talent — Martial God Body.
With such strength, he actually chose the weakest area?
Sima Bang sneered, “Who told this idiot to insist on challenging Brother Yang.”
“He even lost the most core building of his God-Kingdom, the War God Codex.”
Speaking of this, Sima Bang looked at Yang Fan, the envy in his eyes almost impossible to hide.
“After that battle, my third brother directly lowered his investment quota.”
“If he wants to maintain the development speed of his God-Kingdom, he naturally has to find a way to get resources.”
“And those Alien Demigods in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone all have high-value buildings and Wonders given by the Primordial Academy.”
“Even in the Level 1 area, there is quite a bit of profit in the God-Kingdoms of those Alien Demigods.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly, then asked with some curiosity, “With his strength, why not go to the Level 2 area?”
Sima Bang immediately shook his head, “Of course he can go, but the risk is too great.”
“After all, he is only a sophomore now.”
“According to normal circumstances, he should have waited until his senior year to bet both opportunities on the Level 2 area.”
“After all, those Alien Demigods have been developing for hundreds of years with the buildings given by the Primordial Academy.”
“Even if it’s just an A-rank or B-rank God-Kingdom talent, their strength won’t be weak.”
Speaking of this, Sima Bang lowered his voice.
“In the past, quite a few students were swallowed by aliens in the Level 2 area.”
“Those Alien Demigods have too deep a foundation; if your strength isn’t enough, you really wouldn’t dare to touch them.”
After eating and drinking his fill, Yang Fan left Yuexiang Pavilion and returned to his villa.
In the private room, Ye Jianfeng and Sima Bang had not yet left.
Ye Jianfeng took a sip of wine and couldn’t help but sigh.
“Brother Sima, Brother Yang’s personality is really good.”
“He is already a Peerless Prodigy, yet he is still willing to chat with us.”
Hearing this, Sima Bang just smiled but didn’t respond.
Wen Yushui couldn’t see herself clearly, so they despised her and kicked her out of the group.
But in some respects, isn’t Ye Jianfeng the same?
Didn’t he see it?
Throughout the entire meal just now, the only person Yang Fan was truly willing to talk to was himself.
Ye Jianfeng has an ordinary background, and his talent can only be considered decent, but it’s not enough to reach the circle of the Five Great Families.
Sima Bang suddenly remembered a saying.
People have two eyes; although they are parallel, they always like to look at people with bias.
Many people can easily see others clearly, but find it very difficult to see themselves clearly.
And what is even more ridiculous is that some people can neither see others clearly nor themselves.
Returning to the villa, Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly entered his God-Kingdom.
The next moment, the scene before him had already undergone earth-shaking changes.
In the Heavenly Court floating above the firmament, countless Foundation Establishment Realm Cultivators flew on swords, and streams of light constantly streaked across the sky.
The Cloud Step Heavenly Paths that once connected to Penglai Island and various auxiliary buildings had all disappeared.
A large number of old-era layouts had been completely changed.
The entire Heavenly Court was inherently a single whole.
Palaces hung in the air, blessed lands were scattered everywhere, lakes hung in the firmament, rivers traversed the heavens and earth, and gardens and Spirit Fields were interspersed.
The Immortal Qi was so dense that it almost turned into mist.
In such an environment, after long development, the Cultivation civilization had also gradually formed a complete social system.
A large number of Foundation Establishment Realm Cultivators began to form their own forces.
Sects, Families, Alliances, and Chambers of Commerce were constantly born.
Qi Refining Stage Cultivators were in the middle layer, supporting the operation of the entire civilization.
As for the Tier 5 Beings, they guarded the periphery of the Heavenly Court, responsible for patrols, defense, and war preparations.
And in the Heavenly Court, the most popular ones were still Alchemists.
Under Yang Da’s deliberate arrangement, Alchemy Towers were scattered throughout the Heavenly Court.
Whenever alchemy fires rose, countless Cultivators could always be seen gathering.
For the Cultivation civilization, Medicinal Pills had long become an important resource for maintaining the operation of the entire society.
And on the ground, the Wanxiang Martial Court belonging to the Martial Arts civilization had also undergone earth-shaking changes.
Martial Arts halls rose from the ground one after another, and a large number of Martial Master realm experts opened Sects to accept disciples.
They recruited Tier 5 Beings with Spirit Stones, Medicinal Pills, and resources as payment.
Teaching Cultivation Techniques, tempering the Physical Body, and honing Qi and blood.
Today’s Wanxiang Martial Court had long formed a complete system.
Every day, people had a Breakthrough, people challenged, and new Martial Arts halls rose.
Looking from afar, it was like a miniature version of a high-Martial Arts world.
Compared to other civilizations, the Mechanical Civilization was much purer.
There were not many classes here, no Sects, no factions.

Second-class Intelligent Life, first-class Intelligent Life, and even those Tier 5 Beings that had not yet completed transformation and were in a semi-Mechanical state, were all working day after day.
Receiving data, uploading information, absorbing the Mechanical Heart, adjusting body structure, and optimizing computing power.
The entire civilization was like a precision gear, constantly running.
The more powerful the Intelligent Life, the purer its thinking became.
They did not pursue power, nor did they pursue enjoyment.
The only goal was to continuously improve efficiency.
Yang Fan silently felt the changes in the Mechanical Civilization.
Suddenly his gaze paused, and then he couldn’t help but cover his forehead.
Compared to these ordinary Intelligent Life, Yang Da, as the supreme leader of the Mechanical Civilization, was the least like an Intelligent Life.
Don’t know when, but this guy had built himself a new palace, and it was even more magnificent than before.
Spirit jades paved the road, and gems decorated it.
He even used his authority to conscript beautiful female Foundation Establishment Cultivators and female Martial Masters to hold a beauty pageant.
At this, the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
Although it was outrageous, thinking about it carefully, it seemed to have almost zero impact on the development of the God-Kingdom, so he simply couldn’t be bothered to care.
“Who does he take after?”
“Can’t he just be a proper Intelligent Life?”
“So many bad habits.”
Yang Fan couldn’t help but complain.

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Good Steel Must Be Used on the Blade's Edge
paragraphs: Then, Yang Fan looked towards the Elf Kingdom.
Ever since loading the Heavenly Court, the aura of life had become much richer, and the growth speed of the Ancient Spirit Tree had significantly increased.
Yang Fan could feel that perhaps it would not take long.
The Adult Ancient Spirit Tree could grow into a real elf holy tree.
By then, Elven Warriors comparable to the Foundation Establishment Peak would be born within the Divine Kingdom.
Located in the center of the Divine Kingdom, the area of the Trading City had long exceeded 100,000 square kilometers.
This place gathered the Resources of the entire Divine Kingdom.
Magical Artifacts, Medicinal Pills, Ores, Mechanical components, Spirit Medicines, and Materials.
Every day, a massive amount of Resources flowed through it.
The four major factions each dispatched ten thousand elite soldiers to station there.
No one was allowed to fight in the Trading City.
The overall pattern of the Divine Kingdom had not changed.
However, its overall strength had long undergone a qualitative change.
“Foundation Establishment Realm (7 million).”
“Martial Master Realm (9 million).”
“Second-class Intelligent Life (4 million).”
Nowadays, the high-end combat power of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had officially broken through 20 million.
Looking at the thriving Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan suddenly felt that it was time to start a war.
The Divine Kingdom needed development, accumulation, and to build up its strength.
But it also needed war.
Because excessive comfort would make civilization lose its sense of crisis and enterprising spirit.
Without enemies, people would not desperately Cultivate.
Without death, people would not cherish the opportunity to become stronger.
War could precisely bring pressure, cohesion, and true growth.
All this knowledge was learned by Yang Fan from books.
Some cowardly gods dared not participate in real Divine Kingdom Wars, but they would still find trusted people of similar strength to conduct real war sparring sessions.
Letting believers face death and failure.
Then letting them reproduce, grow, and become stronger.
Everything was for the development of the Divine Kingdom.
“Yang Da.” Yang Fan said softly.
The next moment, Yang Da, who was originally still in the palace, immediately pushed away a female Foundation Establishment cultivator beside him.
Pulling up his pants, his figure instantly disappeared.
“Greetings, Master.” Yang Da bowed respectfully.
“Notify all factions to begin preparing for war,” Yang Fan slowly said.
Hearing this, Yang Da’s eyes lit up instantly.
“Yes, Master!”
In Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, Resources were already abundant to the extreme; there was no need to save money or calculate costs at all.
There was only one principle for cultivating believers.
That was to max out their demands.
Under such circumstances, the development of the Divine Kingdom instead became simple.
And as the highest Intelligent Life, Yang Da even felt that he was almost bored out of his mind.
In his view, his own Divine Kingdom’s combat power placed in the demigod stage definitely belonged to the top tier.
He should have gone to the Alien Divine Kingdom long ago to have a fierce battle and show off his might!
“How is Ling Xuzi’s Divine Kingdom developing?” Yang Fan suddenly asked.
Yang Da immediately replied, “Reporting to Master, with our resource support, his Divine Kingdom has returned to normal.”
“The Qi Refining Stage Void Spirit Race has already broken through ten thousand.”
Yang Fan slowly nodded, “Notify him that this war requires him to provide war intelligence.”
“Yes.” Yang Da immediately acknowledged.
Yang Fan had long investigated clearly that cooperation was prohibited in the Primordial Academy’s Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
But Subordinate Gods were an exception.
Because Subordinate Gods were inherently a part of the Lord God’s combat power.
Although Yang Fan had confidence in his own strength.
But after all, this was a Divine Kingdom War; any contempt or carelessness could bring heavy losses.
Caution could never be wrong.
Returning to reality, Yang Fan did not notify Gu Le, leaving his residence alone to head towards the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
In fact, entering the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone as a sophomore was considered an absolute act of stupidity by the vast majority of people.
Even though Yang Fan was rated as a Peerless Prodigy, it was still the same.
Because no one thought his strength was insufficient.
They just thought it was too hasty.
Which of the Alien Demigods in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone was not filthy rich?
Most students would wait until their senior year, stake their last two chances, pull off a big job, and then graduate.
Even those confident Peerless Prodigys would often only start trying in the second semester of their junior year.
Someone like Yang Fan definitely belonged to the minority.
However, Yang Fan was too lazy to explain.
After all, his Divine Kingdom talent was top secret.
If calculated according to Divine Kingdom time, his actual development time was already equivalent to the past forty or fifty college lives.
For the current Yang Fan.
The Divine Kingdom’s combat power had been pulled to the limit; continuing closed-door development would see diminishing returns.

Especially those S-Rank Buildings.
The earlier they were obtained, the higher the Divine Kingdom’s returns.

It appeared much quieter here.
On the wide streets, passing pedestrians were not very many.

Many people gave him the feeling that their strength basically surpassed Sima Bang.
Just at this moment, someone discovered Yang Fan.
The next moment, a large number of people lowered their heads one after another.
“Greetings, Young Lord.”
“Greetings, Young Lord.”
Yang Fan was too lazy to even pause and continued moving forward.
In fact, these people did not know him.
But the Primordial Academy’s identity key would not lie.
The moment they saw Yang Fan, the key had already given a warning.
[Peerless Prodigy]
These simple four words were enough to explain many issues.
Although they were already seniors, their ratings were too low, and many were even just Grade A or Grade B.
Facing such an existence, they did not even dare to raise their heads.
As for these bows, Yang Fan was already used to it.
Ever since he was rated as a Peerless Prodigy, whenever he went out, this kind of thing always happened.
Continuing forward, Yang Fan quickly saw the true core of the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
There were no building complexes here as imagined.
On both sides of the road, huge silver-white devices were neatly arranged.
The whole thing was like a sealed metal cabin, with not the slightest gap on the surface, full of technological sense.
Directly in front of the device floated a transparent display screen, with countless data constantly flickering.
A student stretched out his hand and gently swiped across the display screen.
The next moment, a large amount of blue data streams instantly flew out and directly entered the center of his brows.
At the same time, the other party’s Intelligent Life began to synchronize and analyze the information.
Yang Fan also came before a silver-white device, his gaze falling onto the screen.
The next moment, a large amount of information scrolled wildly.
Normal people needed Intelligent Life assistance.
But Yang Fan was different because of the long-term feedback from Mechanical Civilization.
To process this information, he alone was enough.
[Zone Rank: Level 1 Zone]
[Divine Kingdom Coordinates: LX — β]
[Alien Race: Black Bone Race]
[Demigod Age: 242 Years Old]
[Known Special Buildings:]
[A-Rank Building: Black Tide Blood Pool]
[A-Rank Building: Rending Bone Altar]
[A-Rank Building: Corroded Steel Mine]
[A-Rank Building: War Incubation Nest]
[A-Rank Building: Heavy Pressure Cultivation Ground]
[A Spiritual Vein X100]
[Known Divine Kingdom Area: 60 Million Square Kilometers]
[Known Battle Record: The Frontline has confirmed the kills of 10 Human Demigods]
[Danger Assessment: Higher]
Seeing this information, Yang Fan did not linger and continued moving forward.
“As expected of the Primordial Academy,” Yang Fan thought to himself.
If placed in the Divine Shop, this kind of strength would probably already be a high-risk coordinate.
However, he had little interest in it.
The reason was very simple: there were no S-Rank Buildings.
Nowadays, ordinary A-Rank Buildings did not have much attraction for Yang Fan.
With his current financial Resources, many A-Rank Buildings could be purchased directly.
What he truly lacked were S-Rank Buildings.
Especially those high-value buildings that could affect the entire Divine Kingdom environment, change the believers’ Cultivation system, and even promote civilization leaps.
The assets of that Alien Demigod just now were indeed quite a lot, but their value was limited.
He only had two chances.
Good steel must naturally be used on the blade’s edge.

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Undead Race Demi-god
paragraphs: Yang Fan stood in place, a sense of realization dawning in his heart.
He finally understood why Primordial Academy limited each student to only two challenge opportunities.
Although there weren’t many Demi-god powerhouses like him in Primordial Academy, they definitely existed.
If there were no limit on the number of times, the Alien Demigods in the First-Rank Zone would probably be wiped out.
After all, the resources obtained from conquering an Alien God-Kingdom here would absolutely be an astronomical figure.
Primordial Academy was indeed the top academy of the Human Federation; the depth of its investment in students far exceeded what the outside world imagined.
Yang Fan stepped into the Second-Rank Zone.
The people here were obviously stronger; every Human Race Prodigy who walked by carried a heavy sense of pressure.
Just as he was preparing to study the specific information of the Alien Demigods, a voice sounded from beside him: “Greetings, Young Lord Yang Fan.”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned and looked up.
The person who came was a woman, dressed flamboyantly, with a hint of flirtatiousness between her brows and eyes.
Yang Fan frowned, but there was no impression of her in his mind.
Seeing his indifferent expression, a flash of disappointment crossed the woman’s eyes: “I am Lu Wan of the Lu family. I saw Young Lord Yang’s heroic fighting posture at a gathering a while ago.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly and replied indifferently: “Hello, Young Miss Lu.”
Lu Wan continued to speak, her eyes filled with curiosity and probing: “Young Lord Yang is only a sophomore, right? Why come to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone so early?”
It was not strange that she noticed Yang Fan.
There were very few people in Primordial Academy who could be rated as a Peerless Prodigy, and even fewer who appeared in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
Here, Yang Fan’s identity was like a bright light bulb, attracting attention wherever he went.
“I’m just looking around,” Yang Fan answered indifferently, then turned his gaze aside.
If it weren’t for the fact that she was from the Lu family, he wouldn’t even bother to pay attention to her.
At this moment, he still had important business; he needed to find a suitable Alien Demigod and had no interest in small talk.

Seeing this, Lu Wan smiled slightly: “Young Lord Yang, I am about to graduate as a senior, and I am very familiar with the Alien Demigods in the Second-Rank Zone. Do you need me to help recommend some?”
Yang Fan hesitated slightly but eventually nodded. Whether she was being polite or not, it didn’t hurt him anyway.
Seeing that Yang Fan did not refuse, the smile on Lu Wan’s face became even brighter.
“If Young Lord Yang wants to select a target.”
“I can indeed offer some suggestions.”
While speaking, she leaned slightly forward, and her voice became much softer.
“For example, this one.”
Lu Wan reached out and swiped across the screen, and a large amount of data appeared.
“An Alien Demigod of the Red Scale Race in the Second-Rank Zone.”
“Possesses three S-Rank Building resource structures.”
“Among them is an S-Rank Building—the Red Flame Earth Vein Furnace, which is rich in resources.”
“Its believers have a simple fighting style, so it shouldn’t be too difficult for Young Lord Yang.”
While speaking, Lu Wan blinked gently at Yang Fan.
Unfortunately, Yang Fan didn’t even look at her much, just scanned the data and continued moving forward.
Seeing this, Lu Wan was not discouraged and continued to introduce with a smile.
“There is also this one, an Alien Demigod of the Mist Yao Race.”
“Possesses an S-Rank Building—the Thousand Illusion Spiritual Spring.”
“It is said to be able to significantly increase mental attributes.”
“However, it is quite troublesome; the opponent is skilled in illusions.”
“It has tricked many students to their deaths before.”
Yang Fan still just nodded calmly and continued filtering.
“Or this one, an Alien Demigod of the Rock Demon Race.”
“S-Rank Building—the Earth Mother Mine.”
“It has nearly one hundred thousand A-Rank Spiritual Veins.”
As Lu Wan spoke, she gently brushed her long hair behind her ear and smiled.
“Young Lord Yang, would you like to have a meal together later?”
“My Lu family has a restaurant nearby with a very nice environment.”
Yang Fan didn’t even lift his head, “Maybe some other time.”
With a few simple words, he cast his gaze back to the screen in front of him.
Lu Wan pouted slightly but still followed beside him.
With Lu Wan as a guide, Yang Fan’s filtering efficiency obviously improved.
However, he still hadn’t really made a decision.
The Alien Demigods in the Third-Rank Zone had all developed for thousands of years.
Countless Human Race Prodigies and peerless prodigies had died at their hands.
For his first Divine Kingdom War, Yang Fan preferred to test the waters in the Second-Rank Zone first.
In the past, for the sake of safety, the coordinates Yang Fan bought were mostly safe-level.
He hadn’t actually experienced many truly dangerous wars.
But here it was different.
These Alien Demigods had lived too long and experienced too many wars.
Who knew what trump cards they were hiding.
Being steady was never wrong.
Compared to the safety of the God-Kingdom, resources and buildings had to take a back seat.
Just then, Yang Fan suddenly stopped his footsteps.
His gaze fell upon a screen.
The next moment, his pupils contracted slightly.
“ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary...”
Yang Fan finally saw what he wanted.
This was the building that the federal supreme intelligent life had once recommended, capable of simultaneously adapting to the three major systems of Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical.
It could not only improve the Comprehension Ability of believers and increase Cultivate efficiency, but it could even increase the probability of job Breakthrough.
For the development of civilization, this was a core building in the true sense.
Yang Fan immediately began to check the specific information.
[Rank: Second-Rank Zone]
[God-Kingdom Coordinates: NX — γ]
[Alien Race: Undead Race]
[Demi-god Age: 600 years old]
[Known S-Rank Building: ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary, Eternal Corpse Mine, Life Essence Conversion Pool, Void Realm Energy Core]
[Spiritual Vein Quantity: 200,000]
[God-Kingdom Area: 78 million square kilometers]
[Known Battle Record: Killed three Human Race Prodigies]
[Danger Rating: Extremely High]
Seeing this data, even Yang Fan’s eyes gradually became serious.
This target was finally somewhat interesting.
Lu Wan stood beside him.
When she saw that Yang Fan’s gaze remained fixed on the information of that Undead Race Demi-god, she couldn’t help but swallow her saliva.
“Young Lord Yang.”
“Is this Alien Demigod a bit too strong?”
Lu Wan’s voice was obviously a few degrees weaker.
“You are only a sophomore now.”
“Perhaps it would be much safer to challenge it as a junior, or even a senior.”
In fact, the number of peerless prodigies who challenged those Alien Demigods in the Third-Rank Zone did not exceed three each year.
The vast majority of peerless prodigies would still look for targets in the Second-Rank Zone.
And this Undead Race Demi-god in front of Yang Fan belonged to the top tier, even within the Second-Rank Zone.
In Lu Wan’s view, Yang Fan treating such an existence as his first target was a bit too hasty.
Every Primordial Academy student had two opportunities to challenge the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
In the past, there were peerless prodigies who chose to challenge as sophomores to obtain high-Rank buildings in advance, exchanging them for two years of high-speed development time.
This was actually a common strategy.
But the problem was... others challenged weaker Alien Demigods in advance.
Yang Fan was clearly preparing to max out the difficulty right from the start.
Those densely packed S-Rank Buildings were indeed enviable.
But the Divine Kingdom War was not a game.
This thing, it kills people.
Yang Fan looked at the panel calmly and spoke slowly.
“Thanks for the reminder.”
“However...”
“It will be him.”
The next moment, Yang Fan pressed his right hand directly onto the screen.
In an instant, an extremely cold aura flowed along his right arm and instantly connected to the God-Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 243: Poaching
paragraphs: The coordinate information on the panel, previously hidden by asterisks, was now fully revealed.
At the same time, Yang Fan could clearly feel that the coordinates of his own Divine Kingdom had also been exposed to the opponent.
The moment he made his choice, the war had already begun.
Yang Fan slowly raised his head and looked at the silver-white device in front of him.
He knew that the Alien Demigod of the Undead Race was inside.
It was just that neither side could see the other.
Inside the Divine Kingdom, changes occurred suddenly.
Before Yang Fan had even launched an active attack, spatial rifts began to appear rapidly around the periphery of the Divine Kingdom.
Immediately after, a massive number of figures surged crazily from the rifts.
Skeleton soldiers, skeleton cavalry, and a large Undead Race legion riding bone horses.
Like a white tide, they covered the field of vision.
Looking out, they were dense and packed, with almost no end in sight.
Billions of Undead Race vanguard troops were descending.
Unlike the Human Race, the Undead Race creatures had extremely low consumption requirements.
Therefore, their population numbers were often exaggerated.
Even just the vanguard army reached billions in number.
The war officially began at this moment.
Inside the Divine Kingdom, a large number of City-Annihilating Cannons instantly completed their targeting.
Boom!!
Boom!!
Beams of terrifying energy tore through the sky, smashing crazily toward the periphery.
Whole swathes of the Undead Race evaporated instantly, leaving not even ashes behind.
But more bizarre scenes appeared.
Some skeleton soldiers had only half their bodies left, yet they still hopped forward.
However, they didn’t get far before they all fell into the Thousand Poison Swamp, completely losing their ability to move.
Even so, the Undead Race from the rifts continued to pour out endlessly, as if they could never be killed off.
“This is more like it.” Yang Da stood on high ground, his gaze fixed on the spatial rifts.
“It seems these skeleton soldiers cost nothing.”
“No matter how many die, it won’t hurt you.”
Yang Da spoke slowly, then immediately issued an order.
“Yang Yi.”
The next moment, Yang Yi’s figure appeared instantly, “I am here, my lord.”
“You are responsible for allocating war supplies.”
“Go to the Divine Shop immediately and purchase a large quantity of Holy Water.”
“Sprinkle a portion around the periphery of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Transport the other portion to the Mechanical Civilization.”
“I will integrate the Holy attribute into the newly produced Smart Weapons as soon as possible.”
Yang Da looked into the distance and said slowly,
“These Undead Race creatures fear these things the most.”
“Yes, my lord.” Yang Yi nodded and vanished instantly.
At the same time, the entire machine of the Divine Kingdom began to function fully.
The Immortal Alliance, Wanxiang Martial Court, Mechanical Civilization, and the Elf Kingdom all began to mobilize their troops.
A vast amount of resources were quickly allocated, and countless legions took to the sky.
They gathered from four directions toward the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
Looking from afar, they resembled four torrents rushing toward the battlefield.
At this moment, Yang Fan was still standing in place.
However, a part of his consciousness had long since split off to monitor the changes inside the Divine Kingdom.
Beside him, Lu Wan saw Yang Fan suddenly go quiet, his gaze even becoming somewhat unfocused, and she couldn’t help but ask cautiously,
“Are... are you okay?”
In fact, Lu Wan had already participated in a Divine Kingdom War in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone once.
Naturally, she knew the strength and foundation of these Alien Demigods.
She knew Yang Fan was very strong, perhaps even stronger than herself.
After all, being able to break into the top 100 of the Primordial Battlefield, even if relying on elite followers, was enough to prove that the foundation of his Divine Kingdom was terrifying.
But the problem was that the opponent Yang Fan had chosen was not simple either.
The Alien Demigod of the Undead Race before them was an extremely dangerous existence, even in the Level 2 Zone.
Targets of this level were generally only challenged by those fourth-year peerless prodigies.
Lu Wan looked at Yang Fan, her eyes filled with both worry and curiosity.
She couldn’t quite tell.
Did Yang Fan really have the confidence?
Or was he just too young and didn’t realize what the choice he had just made meant?
Hearing the voice, Yang Fan slowly came back to his senses.
“Thank you.”
“But I’m fine.”
“I have already found the coordinates of the Alien Demigod I wanted.”
Yang Fan said calmly.
The Divine Kingdom War had only just begun.
All command and coordination could be left to Yang Da.
Right now, both sides were still in the initial probing stage, and Yang Fan didn’t even feel any pressure.
Those Undead Race skeletons were relying on their numerical advantage to push deeper into the Divine Kingdom, collecting information.
On the other side, Yang Da had also arranged for Ling Xuzi to dispatch Void Spirit Race followers to infiltrate the opponent’s Divine Kingdom.
A true Divine Kingdom War often involved an information war that lasted for years.
Yang Fan was not in a hurry; after all, for him in reality, it would only be a few days.
Seeing that Yang Fan remained composed and unruffled, Lu Wan’s eyes brightened slightly.
“Young Lord Yang.”
“Since I’ve helped you for so long.”
“How about doing me the honor of having a meal together?”
Lu Wan said with a smile.
“Come to think of it.”
“I haven’t seen my cousin Gu Le for a long time.”
“Remember to say hello for me when you see her.”
The other party had already brought it up several times, and now she had even brought up Gu Le.
Yang Fan found it difficult to refuse again, so he finally nodded.
He then followed Lu Wan and left the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
In the Level 2 Zone of the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone, those who usually frequented the area were mostly at the level of Human Race Prodigy and above.
Many even came from the Five Great Families.
Now, seeing Lu Wan taking Yang Fan away, many people’s eyes lit up immediately.
“Is Lu Wan planning to do some poaching?”
“I heard that Gu Le’s mother and her elders had a falling out over the shares of Wanling Bio-Pharmaceutical.”
“Who can say clearly about the matters of the older generation?”
“I think Lu Wan is simply fishing.”
“She is a fourth-year socialite with friends everywhere.”
“Those she takes a fancy to don’t take a fancy to her, and those who take a fancy to her, she doesn’t take a fancy to.”
“Now that Gu Le has recruited a live-in son-in-law, who is also a golden treasure, she probably feels a bit unbalanced.”
“Stop talking, hurry and post to the group.”
“This gossip must be eaten.”
Inside the villa, Gu Le was sitting on the sofa.
She suddenly noticed the Family group messages jumping frantically, and she subconsciously clicked on it.
The next moment, a photo came into view.
The originally calm expression on Gu Le’s face instantly broke.
“Damn it.”
“Lu Wan, you little hussy.”
“How dare you poach my man?”
Gu Le looked down at her slightly protruding lower abdomen.
She took a deep breath, stood up, changed into a loose outfit, and left the villa directly.
Not long after, Lu Wan had brought Yang Fan to the Lu Family Restaurant.
The table was quickly filled with various dishes.
Many of them, even Yang Fan had never seen before.
But the rich energy aura made even his Physical Body feel a wave of comfort.
At this moment, Yang Fan suddenly noticed that Lu Wan had changed her clothes at some point.
She was sitting opposite him.
Her long hair was let down, her dress clung to her figure, and her shoulder and neck lines were faintly visible.
Every gesture she made carried an air of deliberately crafted, exquisite ambiguity.
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
By now, how could he not see it?
The other party’s goal was not just to have a meal.
He had thought she was just his wife’s friend, and having been invited multiple times, it was hard to refuse.
Now it seemed that was not the case at all.
