chapters.title: Chapter 244: Setting Out
paragraphs: “Miss Lu.”
“If there is nothing else.”
“I will be leaving now.”
Yang Fan stood up directly.
Seeing this, Lu Wan’s expression shifted slightly.
She immediately picked up the wine pot and poured a cup.
“This is the specially crafted Immortal Brew from the Lu Family.”
“Won’t you have a taste?”
Yang Fan shook his head. “No.”
He didn’t want to fall for the same trick a second time.
Regardless of whether there was a problem with the wine, he wasn’t planning to touch it.
He was currently the son-in-law of the Gu Family, and he had been warned by his father-in-law not long ago.
There was no need to walk into a trap.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan did not hesitate, turned around, and left.
Just as he walked out of the restaurant, Yang Fan suddenly stopped.
A familiar figure was slowly walking toward him from the front.
Gu Le quickly stepped forward, directly took Yang Fan’s right arm, and her face was full of smiles.
“Husband.”
“I’ve come to take you home.”
Yang Fan was stunned for a moment, then nodded.
Just as the two of them turned to leave.
With her back to the restaurant, Gu Le quietly raised her left hand and gave a middle finger.
On the second floor of the restaurant, Lu Wan happened to see this scene through the window.
Crack.
The wine glass was instantly crushed, and wine spilled all over the floor.
Lu Wan snorted coldly.
“Cousin Gu Le.”
“Since you are so protective of your food.”
“Then I insist on trying.”
After speaking, Lu Wan directly opened her watch and dialed a communication.
“Mom, I want to talk to you in the Virtual World.”
Upon returning to the villa, as soon as Yang Fan entered the door, he saw Gu Le sitting on the sofa, her expression clearly looking quite unpleasant.
Yang Fan quickly explained, “I thought she and you were friends!”
Gu Le took a deep breath and shook her head.
“It’s not about that.”
“What I’m truly angry about is why you are running off to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone right now.”
“Also, do you know what kind of battle record that Undead Race Demi-god you chose actually has?”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned; he had originally thought she was angry about him accepting Lu Wan’s dinner invitation.
He didn’t expect it to be because of this.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s heart suddenly felt a little warm.
Gu Le... seemed to be genuinely worried about him.
“Since things have come to this, I have already sent you the specific information.”
Gu Le’s expression was serious.
“The Human Race Prodigies who died at the hands of this Alien Demigod were all key investment targets of the Five Great Families.”
“Now, all those S-Rank Building in their divine kingdom are in the hands of this Undead Race Demi-god.”
Gu Le paused for a moment and snorted coldly.
“I’ve sent you the information.”
“I don’t want to be a widow at such a young age.”
After saying this, Gu Le turned and left the room.
She stood at the doorway and paused for a moment, as if wanting to say something, but in the end, she didn’t open her mouth.
After she left, Yang Fan opened the message, and a large amount of information quickly appeared.
[ 140 years ago (First Human Race Prodigy casualty record) ]
[ Gu Family investment Prodigy: Gu Xinghe ]
[ Challenge time: Before senior year graduation ]
[ Result: Divine kingdom destroyed ]
[ Lost core building ]
[ S-Rank Building — Nine Nether River ]
[ S-Rank Building — Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest X10 ]
[ 80 years ago ]
[ Sima Family investment Prodigy: Sima Yunxiao ]
[ Challenge time: Before senior year graduation ]
[ Result: Divine Kingdom Core swallowed ]
[ Lost core building ]
[ S-Rank Building — Life Essence Conversion Pool ]
[ 44 years ago ]
[ Lu Family investment Prodigy: Li Chen ]
[ Challenge time: Before senior year graduation ]
[ Result: Divine Kingdom Core swallowed ]
[ Lost core building ]
[ S-Rank Building — Dan Sea ]
[ S-Rank Building — Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest X5 ]
This information was data that the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone had not just made public; it belonged to internal data.
After reading it, Yang Fan’s expression remained calm.
To him, this battle was still within a controllable range.
Currently, his divine kingdom’s high-end combat power had exceeded twenty million.
Not to mention, he still had the Hundredfold Evolution Talent.
When he truly began the invasion.
The gap in troop sources between the two sides would reach an extremely exaggerated level.
It was just a Level 2 Zone Demi-god; Yang Fan had sufficient confidence.
His consciousness re-entered his divine kingdom.
At this moment, above the sky, the space rift was still continuously expanding.
Countless skeleton soldiers were still continuously pouring out.
Looking out, it was densely packed.
However, the strength of these skeleton soldiers was not strong; most were only equivalent to Tier 1 creatures.
Not to mention his believers taking action, just relying on the Thousand Poison Swamp on the periphery had already suppressed their advance speed.
“Yang Da.”
“How is Ling Xuzi’s investigation going?”
Yang Fan spoke slowly.
Yang Da immediately responded.
“Reporting to Master.”
“The first batch of Void Spirit Race believers has already brought back image information.”
After speaking, Yang Da waved his right hand lightly.
The next moment, a large number of images were projected into the sky.
These Void Spirit Race believers, under Yang Da’s arrangement, were all equipped with high-definition recording equipment.
Therefore, the situation on the periphery of the Undead Race could be seen clearly.
In the images, a large amount of grey-black land was continuously extending.
The air was permeated with thick Death Qi.
Hundreds of millions of skeleton soldiers were patrolling everywhere in the divine kingdom.
Besides this, there were also a large number of special buildings continuously producing troops.
There were huge bone pits from which skeletons were constantly crawling out.
There were grey-white towers continuously releasing Death Qi to the surroundings.
There were even massive bone furnaces hundreds of meters high, continuously spewing out corpses.
The entire divine kingdom was like a world of death.
“However, Master.”
“The periphery is fine.”
“But once we get close to the core area, the Undead Race Demi-god will clearly heighten its vigilance.”
“Currently, more than ten Qi Refining Stage Void Spirit Race have been lost.”
Yang Da continued to report.
Yang Fan was not at all surprised upon hearing this.
How could the Mental Energy of a Demi-god who had lived for six hundred years and killed three Human Race Prodigies be weak?
If they could reach the core area and still not be discovered at all.
Then there was only one possibility.
The opponent was deliberately showing weakness, and there was a trap waiting for him.
Yang Fan looked toward the periphery of the divine kingdom, his eyes gradually becoming calm.
“Since that’s the case, there’s no need to continue wasting time.”
“Start the invasion directly.”
“This person is very cautious and will not take the initiative to send out a large amount of their main force.”
“The opponent is waiting for him to enter the main battlefield.”
According to the rules of Primordial Academy.
The war must be ended before university graduation, otherwise the coordinates must be deleted.
They had a time limit, but the Alien Demigod did not.
If he wanted to devour the opponent, he had to break in.
The opponent obviously knew this as well.
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da immediately agreed.
The next moment, a large number of f3500 fighter jet began to lift off.
Densely packed, they obscured the sky.
After just a moment, laser missiles on the periphery of the divine kingdom poured down frantically, and the roar resonated through the heavens and earth.
Those skeleton soldiers that were still advancing were instantly cleared out completely.
The next moment, Yang Fan’s army officially set out.
The Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall slowly opened.
Rumble—
Accompanied by a loud noise.
Countless legions began to pour out like a torrent.
At the very front, a large number of Martial Master believers took the lead in clearing the path; they were clad in battle armor and held high-tier weapons.
With one step, their blood energy soared to the sky.
Above the sky, there were millions of Foundation Establishment Cultivator flying on swords.
Flying Sword were like rain, covering the sky and sun, and dense Spiritual Qi gathered.
And in the central army area, a large number of Intelligent Life marched forward slowly with completely uniform steps.
They held special weapons, their eyes were cold, and countless Mechanical structures emitted a low humming sound.
At the very back, a large number of Adult Elf carried longbows and followed slowly.
The rich life aura formed a sharp contrast with the cold military formation in front.
One billion vanguard troops set out at the same time.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Real Divine Kingdom War
paragraphs: Besides that, from Yang San to Yang Ten, all high-tier command-type Intelligent Life were dispatched.
Yang Fan’s consciousness descended along the divine kingdom coordinates, appearing on the outskirts of the opponent’s divine kingdom.
Coming into view was a boundless gray wasteland, with dense Death Qi covering the heaven and earth.
And at the exact moment Yang Fan’s consciousness descended,
the heaven and earth in the distance suddenly sank, as if the air had been instantly evacuated.
A huge phantom slowly condensed and formed, its terrifying coercive pressure sweeping across the entire wasteland like a tide.
That was an existence completely pieced together from white bones, with no skin or flesh, and its pale bones glinting coldly amidst the Death Qi.
Embedded on its chest was a beating blood-red sphere, constantly contracting and throbbing like a heart.
With a slightly tilted broken crown on its head, it slowly took its seat upon a huge bone throne, resembling a monarch wielding death.
And beside it, a row of special existences similarly stood tall.
They wore clothes that were long decayed yet still luxurious, with faint traces of a past civilization remaining between their skeletons.
Deep blue flames burned quietly in their eye sockets, like emotionless specters, coldly watching Yang Fan and his group.
At the same time, numerous Intelligent Life such as Yang Da and Yang San similarly appeared beside Yang Fan.
The two sides gazed at each other across the air.
The air seemed to freeze, and even the Death Qi stagnated at this moment.
“Human.”
“Meeting this deity—”
“Why do you not kneel?”
A gloomy voice resounded through heaven and earth.
At this moment, Yang Fan even felt a slight tremor in his spirit.
However, that was all.
Blessed by the entire Mechanical Civilization, this kind of mental interference was almost meaningless.
Yang Fan sneered.
“A skeleton frame dares to call itself a deity?”
“Locked up here by Primordial Academy as a resource pack, do you really think you are somebody?”
As the words fell, the opponent was obviously stung.
Boom!
Terrifying black Qi instantly erupted, and the Death Qi surged like a tsunami, instantly shielding the entire heaven and earth and pressing down toward Yang Fan’s legion.
“Everyone!”
“Form the Ten Halls of Yama Formation—!”
Yang San roared furiously.
In an instant, a large number of Cultivators simultaneously operated the Formation.
The sky trembled, and a huge Yama phantom slowly emerged.
A terrifying scythe swung down.
Boom!!!
The scythe fell, the black fog was forcefully torn into two halves, and the aftermath swept across heaven and earth, directly slashing toward that divine phantom.
The next instant, the phantom shattered with a bang, and heaven and earth returned to clarity, as if everything just now had never existed.
In the Void Realm, only the hoarse voice of the Undead Demigod echoed.
“Human, I’d like to see how much foundation your divine kingdom has.”
“In the core area, awaiting your decisive battle.”
“I love hunting Human Race geniuses the most.”
“Your buildings will eventually become my nourishment.”
The voice slowly disappeared.
And the Divine Kingdom War officially began.
The next moment, the war officially started.
In the outer area, Yang Fan’s large army advanced comprehensively like a torrent.
Those ordinary Skeleton Soldiers could not even form an obstacle.
Martial Masters and Foundation Establishment Cultivators did not even need to personally make a move.
Relying solely on the firepower coverage of Smart Weapons, a one-sided massacre had already been formed.
A large amount of energy weapons swept past, and patches of skeletons directly evaporated.
At the same time, a large number of defense buildings in this divine kingdom began to activate.
Undead spires, bone turrets, Death Qi catapult forts, nether bone walls... one defense building after another continuously activated, and dark beams of light poured down like raindrops.
However, the positions of these buildings had long been figured out by the Void Spirit Race.
A large amount of attacks were intercepted in advance before they could hit.
The advancement speed was hardly affected.
On the other side, Yang Er likewise actively requested to go to The Frontline.

At this moment, he had already led hundreds of millions of alien collectors to begin “cleaning up the battlefield” in advance, completely dismantling and transforming all recyclable Resources along the way.
A real Divine Kingdom War was never something that could end in a few days.
Right now, both sides were still in the outer area, and neither had exposed their trump cards.
Therefore, Yang Fan did not invest too much energy.
War-type Intelligent Life such as Yang San would not make major mistakes under normal circumstances.
Divine Kingdom War was never a simple crushing defeat, but a comprehensive collision of foundation, national strength, and system.
And right now, what Yang Fan lacked the least was precisely these.
After entering the opponent’s divine kingdom, the Hundredfold Evolution Talent was activated once again.
The losses on The Frontline were replenished almost in real-time.
Only a few days had passed in reality, and The Frontline troops invested by Yang Da had already broken through five billion.
The area of this Undead Demigod’s divine kingdom was frighteningly vast.
The believers marched within it for three or four years, yet they still had advanced less than a quarter.
Moreover, the further forward they went, the greater the resistance.
At this moment, within the divine kingdom, Yang Da shuttled back and forth between the two divine kingdoms, his gaze calm and sharp.
He continuously carried out overall coordination and deployment, approved resource allocation permissions, and personally issued orders to purchase war supplies.
“Continue to purchase 100 tons of holy water in the Divine Shop!”
“Medicinal Pills of the healing type will no longer be sold; supply them all to The Frontline!”

“Max out the production of the Divine Weapon Casting World Tower, increase the daily working hours of believers with forging talent by one hour. The opponent’s believers possess corrosive abilities, and B-grade weapons have suffered heavy losses.”
“Mechanical Civilization, make every effort to increase the production efficiency of Smart Weapons!”
“Purchase three more A-grade Breeding Cards and load them into the divine kingdom!”
Command after command was issued calmly and powerfully.
Yang Yi was busy between procurement and scheduling, rapidly placing orders in the Divine Shop while arranging the division of labor among the believers.
“Acting on behalf of the Divine Decree: All Alchemists, double the monthly production of healing-type Medicinal Pills.”
“Divide the believers transporting supplies to The Frontline into ten teams, each responsible for a fixed route, and arrange security personnel to accompany them.”
“The remaining believers are responsible for repairing defense towers and heavy weapons, reporting the loss situation every half-hour.”
“Transfer two groups of scouting believers into the outer dense forest to monitor the movements of the enemy’s Skeleton Soldiers in real-time.”
“Attention all Artifact Refiners: The loss of B-grade weapons must be replenished immediately, and delays are strictly prohibited!”
Each command was specific and meticulous, covering almost production, transportation, security, frontline supply, repair, and reconnaissance.
On The Frontline battlefield, seven war-type high-tier Intelligent Life were closely commanding the operations.
Yang San calmly ordered: “The left flank position must maintain Formation to avoid being slowed down by dark traps.”

Yang Ten sent personnel in charge of logistical supplies: “The Frontline supply convoy is ready to transfer medicine and energy blocks at any time, and any abnormalities must be reported immediately.”
Yang Four commanded the air unit: “Foundation Establishment Cultivators protect high-tier archers and cover the advancement of Mechanical soldiers!”
Yang Five, Yang Six, and Yang Seven were each responsible for different combat areas, modifying Formations and tactical plans in real-time.
War was not child’s play, encompassing troop replenishment, material scheduling, tactical application, and specialized means against alien races.
Even though Yang Fan himself was already equivalent to Intelligent Life, facing such a massive war system, he could not complete all the work alone.
And this Undead Demigod was indeed abnormally powerful; to stop Yang Fan’s advancement, various traps and peculiar tactics emerged endlessly.
These past few days, Gu Le also frequently came over to care about Yang Fan and inquire about the war situation.
“If it weren’t for the rules of Primordial Academy restricting me, I would have personally brought my believers over long ago.” Gu Le’s expression was concerned.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: Xiling Planet Development
paragraphs: Yang Fan comforted, “You don’t need to worry, the situation is completely under control.”
With the current battle situation, Yang Fan had absolute confidence.
Right now, his divine kingdom had only mobilized less than one-sixth of its combat power, and even the strategic-level weapon “Great Void Warship” had not been activated yet.
At this moment, a cold glint flashed through Yang Fan’s eyes.
This Undead Demigod’s strength could not be underestimated.
Even the most inconspicuous Skeleton Soldier had caused him quite a bit of trouble.
Endless Skeleton Soldier surged like a tidal wave from the end of the horizon, densely covering the field of vision, with every step accompanied by the harsh sound of bone friction.
They had no consciousness and did not fear death.
Smart Weapon easily destroyed a large area, but occasionally explosive foreign objects were hidden within them.
If not for Smart Weapon automatically protecting its master, several of his Martial Master Realm believers would have almost been blown to death directly.
Even so, relying solely on Smart Weapon, some believers were still injured.
The production of Medicinal Pill in the divine kingdom consequently appeared stretched to the limit.
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“This kind of building... can endlessly produce Skeleton Soldier?”
He scanned the periphery and found that the buildings placed at the periphery capable of producing Skeleton Soldier had long been moved to the core area.
The number of Skeleton Soldier was as dense as a tide.
“Can produce graded soldiers without cost?” Yang Fan frowned.
After a moment, he shook his head.
“Impossible.”
“Any output inevitably requires investment or relies on environmental energy circulation.”
Failing to figure it out, Yang Fan stopped thinking about it. Once he conquered the opponent’s divine kingdom and brought the building back, he would naturally know the reason!
These past few days, Gu Le often came over to inquire about his situation.
Even Gu Xuanting and Lu Qinglan specifically met him in the Virtual World.
Whether treating him as a son-in-law or because the early investment was too large and they did not want anything to happen to him, Yang Fan felt quite grateful in his heart.
To give everyone peace of mind, he deliberately stated that his divine kingdom was currently stable in every aspect and had no problems at all.
Originally, the challenge information of the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone was strictly confidential.
As it happened, he ran into Lu Wan, and someone took photos of it.
The younger generation of the Five Great Families were bored and inherently keen on gossip.
The news quickly spread.
Even elders like Gu Xuanting learned that he had already started a Divine Kingdom War with an Undead Demigod in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
“What a trouble.”
Yang Fan rubbed his brow, feeling slightly displeased in his heart.
When he completely resolved this Undead Demigod in the future, it would probably trigger a new round of discussions again.
He did not have the slightest intention of showing off.
Because the more he showed off, the easier it was to attract trouble.
Shining without dazzling, still waters run deep.
The more it was during smooth times, the more one needed to restrain their edge in order to guard their own Luck.
Yang Fan slowly let out a breath, suppressing these thoughts.
Back at the Primordial Battlefield, he had already shown his face a little.
At that time, even Gu Xuanting only regarded him as having merely cultivated a good elite army.
But the situation was different now.
If he easily defeated an Undead Race divine kingdom, his sharpness would inevitably be too exuberant.
Thinking of this, he was silent for a moment, and finally suppressed these thoughts down.
Not long after, he would step into the true divine level.
Only strength was the true foundation of confidence.
As long as he grew fast enough, all trouble could not catch up to him.
Although the Divine Kingdom War was fought in full swing, Yang Fan’s personal living rhythm remained stable.
There was not the slightest panic, nor any pressure.
The tax systems of Spirit Vein Planet, Spirit Plant Star, and Xiling Planet in reality were all continuously operating.
Even while conducting large-scale warfare, he still had the surplus energy to continue purchasing long-term developmental buildings like the f-class transformation pod.
Even if The Frontline consumption was huge and gaps appeared in the divine kingdom’s supplies, Yang Da could quickly make up for them through the Divine Shop.
For a demigod “kept in captivity” by Primordial Academy, a long-term war of attrition had almost no chance of winning.
And on today’s battlefield, the opponent had already begun dispatching high-level believers, attempting to slow down the advance speed of Yang Fan’s grand army.
On this day, Yang Fan entered the Virtual World and came to Xiling Planet.
To see his family.
As soon as he arrived, Ma Yu was already waiting aside to report.
During this period, the development speed of Xiling Planet had noticeably accelerated.
The demigods of Xiling Planet who had previously been forced to migrate away had also successively returned to their homeland.
After the headquarters of Elephant Loan moved in, it expanded the scale of investment attraction once again.
A large number of enterprises and divine kingdom workshops were introduced, creating more positions.
Meanwhile, the authorities were also intentionally guiding private divine kingdoms to participate in production, using part of the production capacity to manufacture war supplies.
Both supporting The Frontline and feeding back into the tax system.
Besides this, the deities of the Luo Family were also reassigned to new positions.
Among them, Luo Tietie, Zhan Yunxiao, and others were heavily transferred into the “Elephant Loan Headquarters”, responsible for resource dispatching and the divine kingdom financing system.
In addition, the development direction of Xiling Planet was expanding further.
The divine-natured Materials refining workshop was gradually taking shape, responsible for high-level Resources purification.
The cross-divine-kingdom logistics system was being laid out, beginning to connect surrounding Star Domain.
The war supplies futures exchange was established, used to allocate The Frontline supply and demand and capital flow.
The divine kingdom talent training academy was also launched simultaneously, specially cultivating two-way talents in warfare and logistics.
The entire Xiling Planet was transforming from a single economic planet into the “War Economy Core Hub”.
In order to curry favor with Yang Fan, Ma Yu had flipped through almost all the connections he could investigate during this period.
All forces with connections were given priority care by him.
After listening, Yang Fan nodded slightly, very satisfied in his heart.
Afterwards, he went to see his family.
In the center of Xiling Planet, a huge independent villa stood tall.
This was a residential area built by Ma Yu specifically for Yang Fan’s family.
Quiet, safe, and at the same time the most luxurious building on Xiling Planet.
Yang Fan walked up to his parents and handed over the building card in his hand: “Dad, Mom, Rou’er, Bing’er, this is Penglai Island.”
His tone was calm, as if he were handing over an ordinary item.
“It can improve the divine kingdom environment and has huge benefits for your divine kingdom development.”
Luo Bing and Luo Rou were slightly startled, somewhat surprised, but still accepted it.
Yang Fan’s parents did not ask much either.
They knew that things of this level were no longer something they could fully understand.
But they did not exchange polite pleasantries further, mainly because their own son was now the master of a planet, and they could not think of what they could help their son with.
Living well, preferably breaking through to become a demigod, and not letting Yang Fan worry was what they should do.
In fact, it was not that Yang Fan was unwilling to give more.
Rather, he could not give too much.
His parents, as well as Luo Bing and Luo Rou—the four of them—had not even stepped into the demigod level yet.
When strength was insufficient, excessive wealth might become a burden or even a target.
He himself had the protection of the Gu Family, and many core buildings had to be concealed.
But his relatives did not have a sufficient background. Once too many Resources were exposed, it would instead easily attract trouble.
Outsiders dared not touch him, but might not dare to touch his family; he was clear about this point in his heart.
When the future arrived, after these people gradually grew up and stepped into higher levels, he would naturally gradually increase Resources investment.
But now, it was not yet time.
The road of the future was still very long, and there was no need to rush for the moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 247: Sacrificial Array
paragraphs: After Yang Fan exited the Virtual World, he completed his daily knowledge study.
Subsequently, he contacted Gu Le.
“Don’t worry, I won’t have any issues.”
Yang Fan smiled.
“Perhaps before long, the news you hear will be that I have wiped out that Undead Demigod.”
Hearing this, Gu Le immediately rolled her eyes.
“How long has it been?”
“Can you draft a plan before bragging?”
Although Gu Le admitted that Yang Fan was indeed very strong.
However, that Undead Demigod was an existence that had grown by stepping over three Human Race Prodigies.
It possessed a powerful divine kingdom foundation, coupled with hundreds of years of development time.
This gap could no longer be easily bridged by just talent.
In her view, even if Yang Fan possessed the Hundredfold Time Sequence talent.
His growth time was ultimately too short.
Regarding this, Yang Fan just smiled without explaining.
Some things, the more you say, the more it only makes those who care about you worry.
Only results are the best proof.
Time passed slowly.
In the blink of an eye, another ten days passed.
At this moment, inside the Undead Race god-kingdom, the war had completely entered a white-hot stage.
The total troop strength Yang Fan had invested in the front line.
Had already exceeded ten billion!
Looking around, the entire world seemed to have turned into a meat grinder.
Above the sky, a large number of Foundation Establishment experts stood in the air.
Believers flew on swords, carrying Smart Weapons produced by Mechanical Civilization.
Waves of Spiritual Qi attacks poured down like a rainstorm.
Martial Master level experts in front of the great array crossed the battlefield.
Their blood and Qi exploded, resembling red Dragons entrenched in the sky.
With one punch, hundreds of meters of the area collapsed instantly.
The Mechanical legions fired at full capacity, with a large number of Intelligent Life forms standing at the center of the array.
Carrying laser cannons on their shoulders, with missile bays on their backs.
Countless electromagnetic cannons, particle beams, and laser torrents swept constantly.
Boom—!!
Terrifying explosions constantly swept across the land.
However, facing such an offensive.
The Undead Race legion was not weak at all.
Deep in the earth, countless skeletons broke through the soil.
Skeleton warriors formed phalanxes, and legions of rotting corpses pushed forward like a tide.
A large number of Undead Knights clad in black armor charged while riding bone horses.
Every charge would tear a huge gap in the crowd.
In the sky, a large number of Undead Dragons circled.
Riding on their backs were Undead Mages holding bone staves.
Frost, fire, corrosion, curses.
Various Spells fell crazily.
There were stitched giant corpses tens of meters high pushing siege equipment.
There were Undead behemoths burning with ghostly green flames rampaging.
There were even more Death Priests standing at the rear.
Constantly waving their staves, making fallen corpses stand up again.
On the battlefield, death seemed to have lost its meaning.
Although Yang Fan’s consciousness remained in his own god-kingdom.
But with the help of shared vision with his believers, the changes on the front line were still seen clearly.
His army followed a path of Fusion of Martial Arts, Cultivation, and Mechanical paths.
Close-quarters combat, long-range bombardment, and spiritual energy support compensated for each other’s defects.
And this Undead Demigod before him was not weak either.
The opponent possessed a large number of coordinated troop types, which was also a mature war system.
It was completely not on the same level as those Demigods Yang Fan had met in the past.
In such a war, even Yang Fan’s believers were suffering heavy casualties.
High-ranking believers fell every day.
However, Yang Fan’s expression remained calm.
Because his god-kingdom’s time flow was one hundred times that of the opponent’s.
When the opponent lost a high-ranking combatant, it was truly one less.
While here for Yang Fan, new believers were breaking through every day, an endless stream.
If not for the Evolution Talent, this level of front-line attrition.
Even Yang Fan would probably feel alarmed.
Yang Fan watched the battlefield quietly, a thought suddenly rising in his heart.
“The Demigods in the level 2 area are already this strong...”
“What would the level 3 area be like?”
Thinking of this, there was not a trace of fear in Yang Fan’s eyes, but rather a faint excitement.
The stronger the enemy, the deeper their foundation, and the more resources they had.
Just the peripheral gains alone, the assets Yang Er brought back now already exceeded ten billion Divinity Points.
If he completely swallowed this god-kingdom...
Yang Fan narrowed his eyes. “Yang Da.”
As the voice fell, Yang Da appeared instantly.
“Master, your subordinate is here.”
Yang Fan looked at the battlefield, his voice still calm.
“We are approaching the core area.”
“Dispatch a Great Void Warship and hand it over to Yang San.”
“Monitor the front line at all times.”
“Do not be careless.”
“This alien race was able to kill three Human Race Prodigies, they must still have trump cards.”
Yang Da’s expression turned solemn. “Yes, Master.”
Meanwhile, deep in the heart of the Alien Divine Kingdom.
Boundless Death Qi gathered, and countless pale bone towers stood between heaven and earth.
In the central area, a pitch-black throne hung high.
The Undead Demigod sat quietly on the throne.
Below the throne.
Countless Undead powerhouses crawled.
And in front of it, a huge bone mirror thousands of meters high hovered slowly.
Inside the mirror, the scene of Yang Fan’s believer army advancing was projected clearly.
Looking at the sky-covering Human Race army, this Undead Demigod not only had no panic.
Instead, the corners of its mouth slowly curled up.
“Ten billion Human Race believers...”
“To actually possess such a number of Foundation Establishment and Martial Masters.”
“Very good, very good.”
The ghostly fire in its eyes flickered slightly, as if it had seen some peerless treasure.
“The only pity is.”
“Those Intelligent Life forms don’t have much flesh and blood.”
“Otherwise...”
It slowly extended its withered palm, its voice becoming low.
“My array could be even more perfect.”
At this time, the Undead Race staff officer kneeling respectfully to the side.
“Great King.”
“Fighting until now.”
“These believers have basically been confirmed to be the true core combat power of the enemy god-kingdom.”
“As long as they step into the core area, the sacrificial array can be activated.”
“At that time, not only will the invading enemies all fall.”
“These flesh, blood, and Souls will all become our race’s new power.”
As the words fell, a large number of Undead officers around raised their weapons simultaneously.
Ghostly green Soul flames flickered constantly.
“The Great King will surely win!”
“Death is eternal!”
“Sacrifice begins!”
Huge roars echoed constantly throughout the entire world of death.
Meanwhile, in the central area of Yang Fan’s god-kingdom.
Yang Fan stood quietly, while Yang Da and Ling Xuzi stood on both sides.
As the war continued to advance.
Yang Fan himself also began to pay attention to the front-line war.
Ling Xuzi saluted first.
“Master, the situation is a bit wrong.”
“After the Void Spirit Race believers entered the core area, they gradually felt physical fatigue.”
“Even their stealth abilities began to fail.”
“There... is definitely something strange.”
Yang Fan did not speak upon hearing this, but slowly looked at Yang Da.
Yang Da hurried forward.
“Master.”
“Since the Void Spirit Race has such a reaction, the opponent’s core area must have set up a special array.”
“Every race has its own advantages.”
“The Undead Race has a long lifespan and only needs Death Qi to survive.”
“If your subordinate is not mistaken, this array is highly likely targeting living beings with flesh and blood.”

chapters.title: Chapter 248: He Is The One Who Should Be Anxious
paragraphs: Yang Fan nodded slightly.
“Yang Da, what is your opinion?”
Yang Da pondered for a moment, then bowed respectfully.
“Reporting to Master, your subordinate has two strategies, an upper and a lower one.”
“The upper strategy: continue to advance.”
“But do not let the main force enter the Divine Kingdom Core.”
“Instead, use the Mechanical legions, Intelligent Life, and long-range firepower to constantly probe.”
“Since the opponent targets flesh and blood, let existences without flesh and blood go in first.”
“Force him to reveal his trump cards.”
“If the opponent activates the Formation early, we will be able to gather intelligence.”
Speaking to this point, Yang Da paused for a moment before continuing.
“The lower strategy: increase troops directly.”
“Use a large number of believers to force an advance, constantly consuming the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core reserves.”
“Flatten this divine kingdom by sheer numbers.”
“However...”
Yang Da’s expression was slightly solemn.
“The losses from this method will likely be enormous, it depends on Master’s own wishes.”
Ling Xuzi, listening to Yang Da’s analysis from the side, couldn’t help but mutter to herself, “This... is there even a choice?”
Yang Fan did not answer immediately, but spoke slowly instead.
“What about time?”
Yang Da was slightly taken aback, then said:
“If we only send a single type of unit in.”
“Although Intelligent Life is not affected by Death Qi.”
“It is still difficult to break through the opponent’s core area.”
“If the opponent holds their ground and refuses to come out, the time required is uncontrollable.”
Speaking to this point, Yang Da paused for a moment to explain further.
“Master.”
“Although our divine kingdom currently possesses Mechanical Civilization, we have not invested all our resources into it.”
“Martial arts, Cultivation, and Mechanical, the coordination of these three paths is the reason why our divine kingdom’s legion is truly powerful.”
“If we rely only on a single type of unit, combat power will drop significantly.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then shook his head slowly.
“Your two strategies.”
“I choose neither.”
As soon as these words were spoken, Yang Da and Ling Xuzi looked up simultaneously.
“Master, you are...?”
Yang Fan looked at the image of the front line and suddenly smiled.
“Doesn’t he want to hold the Divine Kingdom Core?”
“In that case.”
“I will build him a real grave.”
Soon, Yang Fan issued a Divine Decree.
The advance on the front line stopped abruptly.
The ten billion troops that had been constantly attacking began to mobilize from all directions.
They surrounded and blockaded the opponent.
Building defensive lines, large Mechanical legions began to excavate the earth.
They built dams and dug canals.
Intelligent Life constantly transported resources, and a large number of Formation Masters began to set up purification Formations.
Meanwhile, procurement from the Divine Shop began frantically, and a vast amount of resources were continuously transported into the battlefield.
High-grade Holy Water, Spirit-Purifying Holy Liquid, Bright Purification Liquid, Sun Essence, Evil-Repelling Spirit Sand...
Countless resources were purchased, and Divinity Points were consumed frantically like flowing water.
Yang Fan had only one goal, and that was to change the environment!
The Undead Race relies on Death Qi to survive.
Since that is the case, then change the environment of this divine kingdom!
Turn the land of death into a land of life!
“Master!” Yang Da felt Yang Fan’s operations and his expression changed drastically.
“This move is inappropriate! The consumption of Divinity Points alone will likely exceed one hundred billion!”
“At such a cost, it would be better to use the lower strategy!”
“The life value of the believers on the front line is far lower than the consumption of Divinity Points!”
Hearing this, Yang Fan suddenly smiled.
“Do you think I care about the loss of believers on the front line?”
Yang Da was stunned.
Yang Fan turned around slowly, his voice calm but filled with an unquestionable tone.
“You are wrong.”
“As a god, there is only one thing I have ever cared about most.”
“And that is the safety of the divine kingdom.”
“Divinity Points are just that, in the future, I will only earn more and more.”
“At most, it will slow down the development speed by a month or two.”
“Your upper strategy has uncontrollable time.”
“If he is willing, he could even turtle up for thousands or ten thousand years.”
“By the time that happens, I will have already graduated, and the losses will only be greater.”
“And the lower strategy has higher risks.”
“If the war causes the overall military strength to lose more than half, and a new Demigod attacks my divine kingdom.”
“What then?”
Yang Fan looked at Yang Da and spoke slowly.
“Go, do as I say.”
“Divinity Points are just that.”
“They can be earned back in a month or two.”
As his voice fell, no one dared to refute him again.
If other Demigods knew about Yang Fan’s operations, they would probably be driven mad with anger.
Spending nearly one hundred billion Divinity Points to attack a Demigod.
This was no longer a war; this was preparing to smash the opponent to death with money!
A large number of orders were executed rapidly.
Yang Da and Yang Yi began to frantically purchase resources.
Countless transport ships shuttled back and forth.
The entire battlefield began to develop in a bizarre direction.
Meanwhile, in the core area of the Undead Race divine kingdom.
A large number of undead were also full of confusion.
“Why did the Human Race stop advancing?”
The Undead Demigod asked.
The aide on the side replied respectfully:
“Great King.”
“Perhaps the opponent has discovered something.”
“This human has mastered a special type of creature.”
“Those creatures were actually able to survive in space rifts.”
“Our race has captured thousands of them recently, I am afraid a lot of information has leaked.”
The Undead Demigod sneered after hearing this.
“No matter, the foundation of this human is indeed powerful.”
“If he does not send believers into the core area, there is no need to fight to the death.”
He leaned back on the throne slowly, ghostly fire flickering in his eyes.
“He is the one who should be anxious.”
“Not me.”
Over these years, Human Race Demigods have constantly entered his divine kingdom.
He had long known the location of his own body in reality.
Keep dragging it out, drag it out until this person graduates from university.
The one who ends up failing will still be the opponent.
If he cannot use the Formation to directly swallow these ten billion core troops.
He will never rashly counterattack.
To him, the safety of the divine kingdom is also the top priority.
Only dragging it out is the safest choice.
Outside, ten days had passed.
But in the Undead Race divine kingdom, a full ten years had passed.
Now, outside the core area of the divine kingdom, earth-shaking changes had already taken place.
Yang Da purchased another Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
Controlling it to shrink continuously, it finally completely surrounded the entire core area.
The towering city wall spanned the heavens and the earth, like an insurmountable chasm.
On the city wall, the City-Annihilating Cannon slowly adjusted its muzzle.
Adult Elves drew their longbows, and a large number of Intelligent Life stood ready.
Foundation Establishment powerhouses stood in the air, and the Martial Masters’ blood energy soared to the sky.
And on the other side of the city wall, a large number of undead also gathered.
The two sides faced each other across the wall, neither moving first.
The air was so oppressive that it felt like it could drip water.
“What on earth is this human trying to do?”
The Undead Demigod sat on the throne, his voice gradually deepening.
“Buying this level of defensive building.”
“And erecting it directly at the door of this King’s house.”
“Is this a provocation?”
The more he looked, the more he felt something was wrong.
If Yang Fan attacked frantically, he would not be worried.
But now the opponent had stopped advancing and was only surrounding them.
This unknown made him increasingly irritable.
Looking at the dense Human Race legions behind the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
A sense of unease rose inexplicably in his heart.
He did not believe that an enemy of this level would do meaningless things.
The opponent must be preparing something.
Just then, an undead aide suddenly exclaimed.
“My King!”
“There are so many machines outside!”

With a wave of his large hand, the giant bone mirror instantly turned.
The next moment, the scene outside was clearly reflected.
Outside the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, a massive amount of Mechanical equipment was operating frantically.
Countless excavators swung their giant Mechanical arms, digging downwards continuously.
A large number of bulldozers roared forward, flattening stretches of land.
Road rollers constantly crushed the ground, large drilling equipment bored downwards crazily, and transport machinery shuttled back and forth.
Engineering robots covered the entire battlefield.
In the sky, numerous transport ships were constantly delivering resources.
On the ground, giant trenches were rapidly forming.
“What is this???”
The Undead Demigod was slightly stunned.
A staff officer nearby hurriedly spoke up.
“My King, this should be a product of the Human Race’s Mechanical Civilization.”
The Undead Demigod’s expression darkened.
“Cut the nonsense.”
“What is this thing for?”
“Does it have any attack power?”
The staff officer was silent for a moment, his voice growing quieter.
“Your subordinate hasn’t figured it out yet.”
“It seems...”
“It can just dig dirt...”
The air suddenly went quiet.
They were now prisoners of the Human Race and could not communicate with the outside world at all.
Nor could they obtain war intelligence through the Undead Race’s information channels.
Based on their existing knowledge, they did not recognize these Mechanical devices at all.
The Undead Demigod stared at those steel machines, silent for a long time.
Finally, he spoke coldly.
“No.”
“Send a unit out.”
“No matter what these things are, I will never let him get his way with what he wants to do.”
“Yes, my King!”
Soon, in the Divine Kingdom Core area, a massive amount of Death Qi surged.
A full one hundred million ranked Undead began to assemble.
Skeleton Warriors, Undead Cavalry, and Stitched Giant Corpses rushed out like a tide.
However, the moment they left the core area, a large number of City-Annihilating Cannons on the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall slowly turned.
The next moment.
Boom—!!
Hundreds of destructive beams erupted simultaneously.
The massive number of Undead had just rushed out when they instantly melted.
The terrifying high temperature swept through, turning countless skeletons into ashes.
A large number of Undead legions were evaporated directly before they could even get close.
Of course, these Undead were not without results.
Many excavation areas suffered impacts.
Thousands of engineering machines were damaged to varying degrees.
Yang Da was even somewhat happy about this.
“Profit.”
“Huge profit.”
These machines were almost all scrap metal.
A million or two Faith Points could buy hundreds of thousands of them.
If he could trade them for these ranked Undead, it was a huge gain.
He even wished these Undead would come out in greater numbers.
“My King.”
The staff officer spoke respectfully.
“Now that the opponent is waiting for us to make a move, unless we send a massive amount of troops, it will be difficult to achieve results.”
The Undead Demigod looked at the bone mirror, silent for a moment, and finally snorted coldly.
“Since that’s the case.”
“Let’s wait and see.”
“Increase the troops stationed there, mobilize more Death Qi, and produce skeleton soldiers.”
He looked coldly into the distance.
“I don’t believe it.”
“He would do all this useless work.”
“Yes, my King.”
In the real world, another twenty days passed.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s consciousness had entered the divine kingdom.
Yang Da reported respectfully.
“Master, the front-line canals have all been excavated.”
“Furthermore, this subordinate has altered the surrounding geology.”
“Now the entire Divine Kingdom Core area has become a low-lying basin.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
“How is the resource procurement?”
Yang Da replied immediately.
“The first batch of resources has all arrived.”
“We purchased a total of 30 billion tons of High-Tier Holy Water, 8 billion tons of Soul-Purifying Holy Liquid, 12 billion tons of Light Purification Liquid, and 50 million units of Sun Essence.”
“200 billion catties of Evil-Repelling Spirit Sand, and 2 billion tons of Source of Life.”
“A total of 36.2 billion Divinity Points were consumed.”
“This subordinate will procure more based on the effectiveness of purifying the Death Qi.”
After listening, Yang Fan nodded gently.
“In that case.”
“Let’s see the results.”
Inside the Undead Race’s divine kingdom.
The next moment, heaven and earth roared.
A large number of Undead looked up simultaneously.
On the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, countless sluice gates slowly opened.
Rumble—a massive vibration swept across the world.
Then, countless liquids emitting holy auras began to pour down.
High-Tier Holy Water, Soul-Purifying Holy Liquid, Light Purification Liquid...
Like a dam bursting, they poured frantically into the trenches.
At the same time, the dams that had already been built opened their gates simultaneously.
Boom!!!
Countless dams released water at once, and artificial canals surged frantically.
A large amount of purification liquid roared forward along the trenches, converging toward the low-lying area.
Looking from afar, it seemed like countless rivers emitting white light were rushing toward the Divine Kingdom Core simultaneously.
A large amount of Evil-Repelling Spirit Sand was constantly scattered, and Pure Yang Crystals began to melt.
The purification Formation started simultaneously.
In just a moment, the entire world suddenly changed.
An extremely dense aura of life began to spread rapidly.
In less than a moment, the extremely dense Death Qi surrounding the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core was frantically diluted by the torrent of Holy Water and purification liquid.
Wherever the rivers passed, the earth radiated with vibrant vitality.
Between the soil, a touch of green quietly appeared.
Yang Da reported softly: “Master, the aura of life is beneficial to the vast majority of races, but for the Undead Race, it is like poison.”
The rivers flowed slowly past the periphery of the core, and the Undead Race soldiers stationed there, those skeletons filled with Death Qi, began to show cracks.
Rot spread, and the bones made slight cracking sounds.
“This... what is this?” a soldier exclaimed.
“My King!”
“The river is full of poison!”
The skeleton soldiers retreated in panic, trying their best to stay away from the river area.
At this moment, the Death Qi on them was rapidly dissipating, and they were extremely weak.
Yang San, who was commanding the army in the distance, saw this scene and felt eager to make a move.
He really wanted to order a pursuit, but remembering Yang Fan’s order, he ultimately remained in place.
Deep in the Divine Kingdom Core, the Undead Demigod sat high on his throne.
He was just a withered skeleton, his face incapable of expressing emotion.
But the giant red sphere in front of his chest emitted an exceptionally vivid light, revealing that his heart was not calm at this moment.
Staring at the picture in the bone mirror, he muttered to himself:
“How is it possible...?”
“Such a price... absolutely impossible!”
A staff officer nearby was trembling: “My King.”
“These High-Tier Holy Waters, no matter the race, are extremely expensive.”
“How could he invest so much?”
Another staff officer hurriedly echoed: “Bluffing! This Human Race Demigod must be bluffing.”
“He wants us to lose our footing and leave the Divine Kingdom Core to fight him!”
“That’s right!”
“According to visual estimation, the resources invested right now can at most submerge 1/5 of the core area. We can completely retreat and hold our ground!”
“My King, I also support this view.”
“Please order the soldiers to retreat ten thousand kilometers.”
“These resources with holy auras are too harmful to the Undead Race! Staying here is not worth the loss.”
The Undead Demigod was silent for a moment, then snorted coldly.
“To spend such a huge price just to weaken our army’s combat power.”
“This Human Race Demigod, for a single war, actually invested so much...”
“Extremely stupid!”

chapters.title: Chapter 250: The Way of a Subject
paragraphs: After listening to the Advisor’s analysis, he gradually calmed down.
Winning the Divine Kingdom War by altering the ecological environment of the enemy’s Divine Kingdom.
This operation was unprecedented.
Even just for the core area, the required Resources might not be something a single deity could easily produce.
“What you all say is extremely correct. What harm is there in letting him retreat ten thousand kilometers?”
“Today, I will shorten the defense line by ten thousand kilometers.”
“When the opponent graduates from university, everything will be in vain.”
Looking at the huge changes in the ecology of his Divine Kingdom in the bone mirror, the Undead Demigod was bleeding in his heart.
He needed Death Qi, not this vibrant scene.
Even if the enemy eventually withdrew their troops, he didn’t know how long it would take to make up for it.
Yang Fan’s consciousness was standing right at the Divine Kingdom Core of his own Divine Kingdom.
Yang Da respectfully reported, “Master, the Undead Demigod has withdrawn his troops.”
“He has not fought us to the death because of this.”
Yang Fan slightly raised his eyebrows, feeling somewhat surprised:
“He can endure even this?”
“I’ve damaged the ecology of his Divine Kingdom to this extent.”
“I actually thought he would immediately fight me to the death!”
Yang Da nodded, a trace of regret flashing in his eyes:
“This demigod has been trapped for too long, and his spirit has been worn down.”
“It’s just a pity; if we continue to dump holy water-type Resources, it will be too wasteful.”
In Yang Da’s view, compared to tens of billions of Divinity Points, what were those high-tier believers?
Before long, a new batch of believers in the Divine Kingdom would grow up.
Now that the enemy continued to turtle up, he had to act according to Yang Fan’s plan.
His own master simply didn’t treat money as money!
These Resources...
I wonder how many metamorphosis chambers can be bought? And how many high-tier believers can be nurtured!
Yang Fan was quite happy to see this outcome.
The longer it dragged on, the thinner the Death Qi in the core area of the enemy’s Divine Kingdom would become.
By then, the opponent’s greatest geographical advantage would completely disappear.
If the Undead Demigod chose to fight to the death,
Yang Fan wouldn’t be afraid either; anyway, his troop sources were sufficient.
What’s more, he still had two Great Void Warships as his trump card.
If the enemy continued to withdraw their troops and guarded a deeper location,
Yang Fan would be even happier.
Aren’t they just Divinity Points?
With the investment from the Gu Family and the endless tax revenue from Xiling Planet,
It wouldn’t take a few months before there would be no place left for the Undead Race to stand in the core area of the enemy’s Divine Kingdom.
By then, he could easily take down the enemy’s Divine Kingdom without even a bloody battle.
“Continue the plan.”
“Calculate the optimal input ratio of Resources and continue dumping.”
Yang Fan calmly commanded.
“Yes, Master.”
Withdrawing his consciousness from the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan returned to the Real World.
As soon as he opened his eyes, Gu Le sat down beside him.
“Husband, how is The Frontline doing?”
There was obvious concern in her voice.
Yang Fan was in an extremely good mood and casually pulled Gu Le into his arms.
Gu Le was slightly startled, but she didn’t struggle.
“So happy?” Gu Le asked, looking up.
Yang Fan smiled.
“The opponent made a wrong decision.”
“In a little while, all of his core buildings will belong to me.”
Gu Le blinked, obviously somewhat skeptical.
“Really?”
“That is an Undead Demigod who has lived for six hundred years.”
“How come in your mouth... he sounds so vulnerable?”
Yang Fan immediately raised his eyebrows, “You don’t believe it?”
Gu Le was just about to speak.
The next moment, Yang Fan directly reached out and tickled her waist.
“Hahaha...”
“Stop messing around!”
Gu Le instantly laughed and curled up into a ball, hurriedly surrendering.
“I believe it, I believe it, I believe it!”
“My husband is the best!”
Only then did Yang Fan stop with satisfaction and gently rubbed her head.
“That’s more like it.”
Inside the room, there was a rare touch of relaxation.
In the Real World, another five days passed.
Inside the Undead Divine Kingdom, a full five years had passed.
At this moment, the atmosphere in the core area of the enemy’s Divine Kingdom was obviously much more oppressive.
An Advisor slowly spoke:
“My King, I didn’t expect this Human Demigod to have such a profound foundation.”
“He has actually continuously dumped for five years.”
“However, this subordinate believes that even descendants of a big Family in the Human Federation could never be so domineeringly extravagant.”
“Therefore, this subordinate proposes.”
“Let The Frontline retreat another ten thousand kilometers.”
As the voice fell, many surrounding Advisors chimed in.
“That’s right, we must by no means throw our own footing into disarray.”
“The area conceded for the first time has long been covered by the aura of life.”
“If we send out troops now, just passing through this area will incur no small losses.”
“Taking one more step back will open up a vast and boundless horizon.”
“After all, this person is only a demigod, and it is absolutely impossible for him to have any more circulating funds.”
Listening to everyone’s analysis, the Undead Demigod slowly nodded.
“Since that is the case.”
“Then cede another ten thousand kilometers.”
His voice was low.
“This King does not believe.”
“He truly has so many Divinity Points.”
“Your Majesty is wise!”
On the other side, Yang Fan watched the enemy withdraw their troops through Yang San’s perspective, the corners of his mouth slowly curling up.
“Very good.”
“It went even smoother than I imagined.”
Yang Da respectfully saluted.
“Master, the invested funds have now exceeded sixty billion.”
“There are temporarily not that many circulating funds inside the Divine Kingdom to continue consuming.”
Yang Fan waved his hand.
“It’s fine, just stop for a moment to give the opponent the illusion that I have no money left.”
“In a few days, the tax revenue of Xiling Planet will arrive in our accounts.”
“Let the opponent catch their breath first; don’t really drive him to desperation.”
Yang Fan’s voice was calm, carrying a hint of a wicked smile.
“This Undead Race is not weak; if we fight to the death, the losses on The Frontline will not be small.”
“The more he endures, the more relaxed I will be in the future.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da nodded helplessly.
As an Intelligent Life, it could never understand this style of fighting.
It was simply using a cannon to swat a mosquito.
The effect was very good, it was just too wasteful of Divinity Points.
Yang Da secretly glanced at Yang Fan, unable to help muttering in its heart:
“Making money too fast by clinging to a wealthy woman makes a deity lose the concept of money, sigh.”
Just at this moment, Yang Fan suddenly turned his head, “What are you thinking about?”
Yang Da’s entire body stiffened, and it hurriedly straightened its body.
“Reporting to Master!”
“This subordinate was thinking that Master is wise and martial.”
“You were actually able to think of such a brilliant strategy; perhaps you really can capture the enemy’s Divine Kingdom without losing a single soldier.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction and said, “Consider you having an eye for things.”
Yang Da accompanied the smile on the surface, but wailed wildly in its heart.
“Using a golden mountain as military expenses to attack a city.”
“What on earth is there to be proud of about this...”
“Sigh.”
“As the highest Intelligent Life of the Divine Kingdom.”
“I have it too hard.”
Recently, because of giving too much advice, Yang Fan even bullied it, sealing off the palace it used for entertainment.
Yang Da felt that being a loyal subject was really too hard.
Thinking of this, it suddenly fell into deep thought.
“How about...”
“Taking some time to buy some human books?”
“To learn The Way of a Subject?”
A few days passed.
The Frontline of the Alien Divine Kingdom finally stopped its actions.
The high-level members of the Undead Race let out a long sigh of relief.
“Sure enough, this Human Demigod’s Resources have bottomed out!”
“So many Resources were actually used to destroy the ecological environment of my Divine Kingdom; truly hateful and pathetic!”
“Reporting to Your Majesty, since the opponent already knows there is a grand array ambushed at the Divine Kingdom Core, presumably he will not go deep.”
“Right now, we can only see when he will withdraw his troops!”
“Damned Human Race, making such a lose-lose choice, to think he could come up with it.”
